chapters.title: Chapter 4751: Second City
paragraphs: The Azure Phoenix Great Emperor wasn’t angered. Instead, he pondered for a moment before saying, "Perhaps you can kill me. However, you’ll also have to pay an exorbitant price, and it’s probably not something that you can withstand."

The Great Emperor Senluo looked hesitant. Indeed, just as the Azure Phoenix Great Emperor had said, his battle prowess was still superior to the latter. However, he had just fought a battle with his recovered full battle prowess. If he fought again, he would also be in great danger.
After all, he had traversed countless years, and defied the heavens. Would he not need to pay a price for doing so?
Just in time. At this moment, the storm of heaven and earth had temporarily subsided. The Great Emperor Senluo flicked his sleeves, picked up the dragon corpse, and turned to leave.

The Azure Phoenix Great Emperor merely watched as the Great Emperor Senluo left. When Great Emperor Senluo’s figure had completely disappeared from sight, he mumbled, "The situation is slightly beyond our control, but success is also in front of us. We still have to endure for a while longer."
After saying this, he turned around and flapped his wings at an indescribably quick speed.

Meanwhile, Ling Han, the Buddha Doga, and the others finally managed to throw the Great Emperor Senluo off their tails. Meanwhile, Little Ye and the Natural-born Gold Spirit, even though they were slightly troublesome, they were still manageable.
Thus, Ling Han stopped and turned around to face the Natural-born Gold Spirit and Little Ye.
"Come and fight me?" Ling Han asked with a smile.
Little Ye turned around to look, but frowned slightly, because he could no longer sense Great Emperor Senluo’s aura in this place.
This was the Primitive Abyss, a place that even Great Emperors had to be careful when entering. There were too many amazing things about it.
"There’s no rush," Little Ye giggled. "In any case, you’re just a few clowns, so I’ll let you live for a while longer."

He turned around and left, but after taking a few steps, he suddenly stopped, turned around and said, "I am already a Nine-Star Saint, and next, I will be breaking through to the level of Pseudo-Emperor. You have to know that it is allowed to become Emperor in this era, so... if you continue to stay here, you can only watch helplessly as I become Emperor."
A Great Emperor possessed the fortune of heaven and earth, and only one could appear in a single era.
Thus, if Ling Han continued to stay here, he would be cut off from heaven and earth, so how could he possibly become Emperor?
To say nothing of becoming Emperor, he wouldn’t be able to successfully become a Pseudo-Emperor.
This was naturally a psychological attack, wanting to mess with Ling Han’s Dao Heart.
Ling Han was unmoved. There was Genesis Substance in the Primitive Abyss, which could support his cultivation at the Saint Tier, and as for Great Emperor Tier?
He had to cultivate to the consummate level of Saint Tier first.
Little Ye and the Natural-born Gold Spirit left. Ling Han and the others didn’t pursue them.

Little Ye was only secondary. The Natural-born Gold Spirit was really too terrifying. Even if three Pseudo-Emperors combined forces, they still could not suppress it. The moment it threw away all reservations, and set its eye on Ling Han to attack, even Ling Han would have a headache.
"Now, should we advance or retreat?" a few Saints who were wielding Imperial Weapons asked. They could not be absorbed into Ling Han’s body.
Ling Han pondered for a moment before looking ahead and saying, "Since we’re already here, we naturally have to continue forward."

The three Pseudo-Emperors moved, helping everyone to hide their traces. Previously, they had clearly seen an azure divine bird fly through the skies. Though there was still a very far distance between them, Imperial Might had diffused the area, and from that, they knew very clearly that this was a Great Emperor.
"A large azure bird... could it be the Azure Phoenix Great Emperor?" everyone speculated.
Ling Han was even more astounded. Had the dead Divine Beasts really come back to life one after another?

First, there was the True Dragon. This was something that the little azure dragon had concluded was definitely dead, and in the case of the Azure Phoenix, Ling Han had obtained the images recorded after its death. It was similarly deader than dead.
Strange, too strange. How had these Divine Beasts come back to life? And why had they all come out at this time?
Ling Han couldn’t figure it out no matter what. What exactly was the Primitive Abyss hiding?
What exactly was the so-called immortality?

Similarly seeking immortality, some Great Emperors would become Lords of Death, some Great Emperors would be fighting against unknown powerful enemies in the Primitive Abyss, and some Great Emperors would be revived after death.
It was a complete mess.
They advanced, and not too long after, they saw the Azure Phoenix Great Emperor fly back. Similarly, because the Pseudo-Emperors had covered their tracks, they were still not discovered.

The group advanced at a much slower pace than a Great Emperor. This journey took about three days’ time, and they could see that a change had taken place in the desolate plain ahead of them. A desert had appeared.
Yellow sand was everywhere. There was no wind, and it was completely silent.
If they wanted to pass, they could only continue onwards. Everyone could only step onto the yellow sand, and begin a long journey of unknowns.

Actually, now that they were here, even Buddha Doga, Qian Yanghao and Xia Houping were completely at a loss. Though they had come to the Primitive Abyss before, they had only ventured as deep as the area of Dragon Head City, and did not dare go any further.
That was an area that only Great Emperors could enter.

But this time, they still had things like Battle Armors, which greatly increased their survivability. Furthermore, it seemed like there were cities built along the way, which gave them more reason and courage to venture deeper.
After walking in the desert for half a day, a breeze blew, causing the sand to gently roll.
This was an extremely normal phenomenon, but everyone’s faces were ashen.
It should be known that this speck of sand was as heavy as a star, but it was actually stirred up by a breeze. Then, if a strong wind blew, just how terrifying would it be?
When a grain of sand shot over, it would be like a star was crashing down.
Moreover, what kind of concept would it be if the sky was filled with sandstorms?
"We can’t advance any further. We’ll just forcibly defend here!" Buddha Doga said. He took the Clear Bamboo Swor, guarding on the front line.
It was too late to retreat. They had ventured deep into this place for half a day, so how could they leave immediately?

After only a short while, the winds immediately became stronger, and the yellow sand was no longer fluttering lightly. Instead, it was circling around on the ground, and it was possible that it would dance at any moment, turning into a sandstorm.
Ling Han unleashed the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, which enveloped everyone.
Boom, the yellow sand finally swatted over.
Buddha Doga brandished his sword. Shua, shua, shua! Sword Qi soared into the sky.
The might of the Pseudo-Emperor and the Imperial Weapon was still extremely astonishing. With a slash of the sword, all the grains of sand that attacked were destroyed.
However, in this desert, how much sand was there?
Millions and millions of grains!
It could be said that there was no end to it.
Even though Buddha Doga was so powerful, he was still unable to fully protect himself. There were still a few scattered grains of sand that passed through.
However, they still had a second line of defense.
The grains of sand landed on the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, releasing a heavy and muffled sound. At the same time, waves of shockwaves also assaulted them.

However, there were still two Pseudo-Emperors and Ling Han in the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower. They worked together to disperse the shockwave, and when Buddha Doga was about to collapse, Xia Houping and Qian Yanghao went out to take his place, one after another.
Moreover, there were also three Imperial Weapons here, which could also be of use.

This sandstorm lasted for a whole three months before it finally ended. When all the yellow sand fell onto the ground, and the winds stopped blowing, everyone was sprawled out on the ground in exhaustion.
After recovering for a while, no one dared to stay here any longer, and hurriedly continued onwards.
This was still not the most dangerous storm of heaven and earth of the Primitive Abyss. Otherwise, even Great Emperors would be blasted into smithereens, so what use would Imperial Weapons have?
Another two days later, a large city appeared ahead of them.
It was like a divine bird spreading its wings.

chapters.title: Chapter 4752: Tournament of the Nine Cities
paragraphs: Ahead of them, there was a city that was like a divine bird that was spreading its wings and soaring high, wanting to charge into the Nine Heavens.
"Are we... going there?" a Saint asked softly.

They couldn’t help but feel apprehensive. This was because they had seen a divine bird that they suspected was the Azure Phoenix streak across the sky just then. It was extremely likely that the Azure Phoenix Great Emperor was in the city ahead of them.
Who wouldn’t be terrified to barge into the territory of a Great Emperor?
"There’s no need for so many people to go. Just a few people would do. We will go and investigate the situation first," Ling Han said with a smile.
This caused the Saints to sigh in relief. Otherwise, their hearts might not have been able to withstand it.
After some discussion, Ling Han, Buddha Doga, and the other Pseudo-Emperors set off as a group, entering into the Azure Phoenix City to see how things were going.
In any case, Ling Han had already absorbed most of them into his body. At that time, he had already endured for more than 200 years. As for now? It was no big deal.
Very soon, the four of them arrived at the city gates.
There were still guards here, but when they saw that one of Ling Han’s group was wearing a Silver Battle Armor, they immediately chuckled, "Which Great Emperor are you under, Milord?"
By the looks of it, the Silver Battle Armor was the standard for disciples of the Great Emperors.
Ling Han smiled and said, "I’m the disciple of the True Dragon Emperor, the Ninth King!"
In any case, this guy had long since died. However, only Ling Han and the others had seen him die. To outsiders, since he had died without a corpse, it could only be said that he had disappeared.

"So it’s the Ninth King. Please come in!" The guard hurriedly stepped aside, and said very considerately, "Lord Ninth King, you really targeted the timing and came just in time. The Nine Cities Tournament will be held tomorrow."
Yi, what Nine Cities Tournament?
Ling Han naturally didn’t ask. This question would definitely give him away.
They thought that he had come to participate in the competition of the Nine Cities, but what the heck was this?
Ling Han first pushed his doubts back into his mind. Then, with a wave of his hand, he brought Buddha Doga and the others into the city.
"What extravagance!" That guard hissed. He had come out to participate in a tournament, and actually brought three Saints with him as guards. Wasn’t this extravagant enough?
What he didn’t know was that Buddha Doga and the others were actually Pseudo-Emperors. Otherwise, his tongue would probably be sticking out of his mouth as he gaped.
After Ling Han entered the city, he randomly grabbed a person and ducked into a hidden spot, and then asked around.
In truth, when others saw him wearing a Silver Battle Armor, they would have long since developed reverence, and would definitely tell him everything they knew.

After a round of queries, Ling Han finally understood. As it turned out, a battle for supremacy among the disciples of the Great Emperors would be held in the Azure Phoenix City tomorrow, and the range of participation would be the nine great cities of the first line of defense, which included the True Dragon, Azure Phoenix, the Crimson Ape and the other Divine Beasts.

At first, Ling Han had not been interested in this. However, when he found out that the prize for the first place was a Genesis Substance-level Celestial medicine, he could not hold himself back any longer.
What he needed the most now was the Genesis Substance, which could allow him to accommodate more Regulations while his body would not experience Silent Destruction.

Of course, Genesis Substance was not all that multi-purpose. It only allowed the user to possess the ability to accommodate more Regulations without going through Silent Destruction. It did not mean that one would definitely be able to accommodate Regulations. The key was still the individual’s own ability.
Only if prodigies obtained it, would it be like adding wings to a tiger, and strengthen them further..
This was icing on the cake, and definitely not timely help.
"You want to participate?" When Buddha Doga saw Ling Han’s excited expression, he knew that Ling Han couldn’t hold himself back any longer.
Ling Han nodded earnestly, "M-hm."
Buddha Doga and the others exchanged hesitant glances.

If Ling Han wanted to participate in the competition, he could only pretend to be the disciple of the True Dragon Emperor. It would either be the Ninth King, or the Fifth King. However, there was still a Great Emperor in charge here, so how could it be easy to put on a disguise in front of such a being?
If he was discovered, would he be directly blasted into smithereens?
"Ling Han, you have to consider carefully," Xia Houping said solemnly.
"You may be the only hope for the future," Qian Yanghao said.
Ling Han nodded earnestly, "Precisely because of this, I need to mature as soon as possible."
"All right!" Buddha Doga nodded. Being able to become Emperor, his temperament was naturally outstanding. Once he had made a decision, he would definitely not waver.
Ling Han stretched out a hand, and erased the memories of that person who had been questioned during this period of time.
Then, he boldly walked out, heading directly to a place in the city. At present, the disciples of the Great Emperors of the Nine Cities were all gathered here.
This kind of tournament wasn’t held often. On the other hand, there were pitifully few such tournaments. After all, the Genesis Substance was used as a reward, so how could it be held often?
Otherwise, no matter which Great Emperor, they would definitely go bankrupt.

When he arrived, this was actually a very simple and crude courtyard. After all, it was the Primitive Abyss. Being able to build a city was already an inconceivable feat, so how could he expect it to be resplendent and dazzling?
This was the temporary residence of the disciples of the Great Emperors. There were two guards at the entrance, and when they saw Ling Han, they immediately felt deep veneration.
"Lord!" They paid their respects. Wearing a Silver Battle Armor, that was the standard setup for disciples of a Great Emperor.
Ling Han couldn’t help but smile. This was really simple, saving him a lot of trouble.
"I am the Ninth King under the True Dragon Emperor," he declared proudly.
"Lord Ninth King!" The two guards bowed again.
"I’ve just arrived. Please bring me in," Ling Han said calmly. He didn’t want to give himself away.
"Understood!" A guard hurriedly brought Ling Han in.
Even though this courtyard was simple and crude, it still occupied a considerably large area, with multiple buildings lined up one after another.
Ling Han didn’t see anyone else, but he could sense that many rooms were exuding powerful fluctuations of aura.
Saint Tier!
Disciples of Great Emperors would definitely be Saint-level. Otherwise, they would not have been qualified to come here to participate in the so-called Nine Cities Tournament.

"Lord Ninth King, this is your residence." The guard led Ling Han to a more remote location. He seemed to be afraid that Ling Han would be unhappy, so he continued to explain, "You came later, so the good places have all been chosen by other Lords."
"It’s fine." Ling Han waved his hand, and strode into the house.
"Lord Ninth King, please have a good rest." The guard bowed again, then turned and left.

Ling Han entered the room, and his eyes swept over the surroundings. This place was even simpler. There wasn’t even a bed. There was only a bamboo mat, and it wasn’t very big either. This should be used for meditation.
However, Ling Han’s eyes lit up.
This bamboo mat was really something good!

He stretched out a hand to sense. There was a sliver of Genesis Qi within. Though he could not extract Genesis Substance, if he sat cross-legged on it and cultivated, the benefits would be much greater.
Hehe, though the conditions here were harsh, there was a considerable amount of good stuff.
Ling Han nodded. No matter what, this bamboo mat belonged to him now, and there was definitely no way he could return it.
"I have to think of a way to steal the bamboo mats in the other rooms as well," he muttered.
A night passed, and a new day arrived.
There was a man-made sun here. It was too simple. There was no need for a Great Emperor to move, and the Saint would be able to create a beautiful one.
Ling Han followed the others out of the Azure Phoenix City and into a large mountain.
There... was a mine here.

Disciples of Great Emperors would definitely be Saint-level.
Otherwise, they would not have been qualified to come here to participate in the so-called Nine Cities Tournament.
"Lord Ninth King, this is your residence." The guard led Ling Han to a more remote location.
He seemed to be afraid that Ling Han would be unhappy, so he continued to explain, "You came later, so the good places have all been chosen by other Lords."
"It’s fine." Ling Han waved his hand, and strode into the house.
"Lord Ninth King, please have a good rest." The guard bowed again, then turned and left.
Ling Han entered the room, and his eyes swept over the surroundings.
This place was even simpler.
There wasn’t even a bed.
There was only a bamboo mat, and it wasn’t very big either.
This should be used for meditation.
However, Ling Han’s eyes lit up.
This bamboo mat was really something good!
He stretched out a hand to sense.
There was a sliver of Genesis Qi within.
Though he could not extract Genesis Substance, if he sat cross-legged on it and cultivated, the benefits would be much greater.
Hehe, though the conditions here were harsh, there was a considerable amount of good stuff.
Ling Han nodded.
No matter what, this bamboo mat belonged to him now, and there was definitely no way he could return it.
"I have to think of a way to steal the bamboo mats in the other rooms as well," he muttered.
A night passed, and a new day arrived.
There was a man-made sun here.
It was too simple.
There was no need for a Great Emperor to move, and the Saint would be able to create a beautiful one.
Ling Han followed the others out of the Azure Phoenix City and into a large mountain.
There... was a mine here.

chapters.title: Chapter 4753: Awkwardness
paragraphs: Yi, this wouldn’t be asking them to compete in who would be mining faster, right?
Ling Han couldn’t help but curse in his mind.
Quite a number of people had come under the banner of every Great Emperor, and usually, these Great Emperors would barely interact with one another, allowing Ling Han to blend in.
—Everyone thought that he was a disciple of some Great Emperor, though he was not from their own faction.
Thus, if Ling Han didn’t speak and didn’t take sides, he wouldn’t be exposed.
An elder spoke up. He was a Nine-Star Saint, but in this place, his cultivation level could not be considered the highest, because there was no shortage of Nine-Star Saints here.
From this aspect alone, the Primitive Abyss’s overall level of cultivation was higher than the outside world.

All the Imperial Clans added together, even taking into account the old Saints that lived in seclusion and were rumored to have long since died, the number of nine-star Saints could only be counted on two hands, at most, but in this place, there were only nine cities, and that had already exceeded this number.
There was nothing that could be done. With a Great Emperor overseeing things, wasn’t this very normal?

"Inside this mine, there are four Ignited Stone Beasts. You guys go and kill them. The four people who return with the heads of the Ignited Stone Beasts can advance to the next round. As for the others, they will all be eliminated," the old Saint said.
This was really simple and rough. No matter how many people there were, it would be directly passing through a round of selection to the top four.
"Go on." The old Saint waved them off.
Instantly, one after another, teams set out, and rushed into the cave.
"Yi, why haven’t you entered yet?" The old Saint looked towards Ling Han.
Why was this guy so strange?
Ling Han was also very confused. He didn’t know which team belonged to the True Dragon Emperor. Moreover, even if he knew, if he forcefully approached, how could those people recognize him?
Wouldn’t his identity instantly exposed?
This was about to become Ling Han’s sore spot. This was a persona, a persona that couldn’t be destroyed too quickly.
"I’m a more modest person," Ling Han said with a smile. "So, let them go first."
The old Saint’s eyes involuntarily lit up. This kind of quality was really too rare.
"Which Great Emperor are you under?" he asked.
"Ninth King under the True Dragon Emperor," Ling Han said calmly.
The old Saint nodded. He would remember this.
"Hurry up and go. You can’t fall too far behind. After all, there are only four Ignited Stone Beasts," the old Saint said with a smile. His eyes were filled with kindness as he looked at Ling Han.
Ling Han gave an ’oh’. He had only been making up nonsense, so how had he gained a favorable impression?
Er, who cares.
Ling Han strode into the mine.

He didn’t care whether others would beat him to it or not. In any case, if he saw one person defeat one, then even if the Ignited Stone Beast was killed by another, he could still snatch the beast’s head.
After all, this was only a request to bring back the beast’s head. There was no requirement that it must have been killed by oneself.
He was very relaxed, whistling as he thought about how he was going to cover up for his identity later.
En, if all the disciples of the True Dragon Emperor had "disappeared", then there would definitely be no one who would expose his identity.
Ling Han thought for a moment, and felt that this matter could not be resolved any easier.

The paths in the mine extended in all directions. The deeper they went, the more forks there were. Furthermore, this was an abandoned mine, and there were no miners. After countless years of excavation, the passageways here were also like a spider’s web, densely packed.
Ling Han released his divine sense, and searched for the location of the Ignited Stone Beast.
Since it was called Ignited Stone Beast, it must be related to flames. Thus, one only had to grasp the movement of the flames.
However, why was the gravity field here so powerful?

Previously, Ling Han had also gone to a mineshaft. The gravity fields there were very weak, and even if he didn’t wear Battle Armor, he could still come and go as he pleased in the mineshaft, even if he was in the Spiritual Transformation Tier.
But in this place, the gravity was extraordinarily strong, and there was not much difference between this place and the outside world.
Could it be because the mines here had the effect of cancelling out the gravity fields, and now that the ores had been dug out, the gravity fields had returned to their original level?
Yes, that should be the case.
Ling Han mulled over this as he continued his search.
Found it.

He smiled, crossed his arms behind his back, and began walking in this beehive-like mine. It was a walk in the park for him, and he didn’t need to hesitate at all when he encountered a fork in the path.
Half a day later, boom, the shockwaves of a great battle suddenly spread out ahead of him.
Someone had beaten him to it?
Ling Han pursed his lips. Whatever, he would just snatch it back.
He continued to advance. Boom! Boom! Boom! The shockwaves of the great battle surged over continuously, causing the shards on the stone walls to fall one after another.

After another while, the path ahead suddenly opened up. Seven silver-armored warriors were attacking a giant beast made of green stone, and the strange thing was that this was clearly a fierce beast made of stone, yet it was burning with flames, exuding a blazing heat.

It was precisely because of these flames that the seven people surrounding it didn’t dare to force it too far. As their attacks continued, more than half of them were directly burned by the flames, and it was difficult for them to have a very good effect.

However, two of these seven people were Nine Star Saints, and the remaining were either Eight Star Saints or Seven Star Saints. The weakest was at least Six Stars, and with the addition of the Silver Battle Armor, their battle prowess could be said to be considerably strong. Sooner or later, they would be able to grind this fierce beast to death.
En, this must be the Ignited Stone Beast.
Ling Han had no intention of hiding himself. Thus, the seven people immediately discovered him.
"Old Eighth, go and stop him. Don’t let him send out a signal to draw another team over," a silver-armored warrior said.
"All right!"
One of the seven silver-armored warriors broke away from the battle, and with a leap, arrived in front of Ling Han.
"Hehe, which Great Emperor is this brother under?" this person asked.
Ling Han coughed and said, "Under the True Dragon Emperor’s banner, the Ninth King!"
The person on the other side clearly faltered for a moment, then forced out a smile, "Sir, there is no need to act all mysterious. We are the disciples of the True Dragon Emperor!"
Er... what a coincidence!
"Hehe, that would really be awkward," Ling Han said with a smile.
’You’re still smiling so brightly?’

The silver-armored warrior was the eighth disciple of the True Dragon Emperor. He said coldly, "Ninth disappeared tens of thousands of years ago, and you impersonated him. Humph, are you provoking us?"

"Eighth Brother, do you not recognize me? I am really Ninth!" Ling Han said very exaggeratedly, "In these tens of thousands of years, I have been trapped by the storms of heaven and earth, and only managed to break free not too long ago."
"Have I changed so much? So much that my Eighth Brother doesn’t even recognize me anymore?"

The expression of the Eighth King immediately darkened, "Though strictly speaking, we are all family, you keep impersonating my Ninth Brother, and could possibly be blaspheming a dead man. I will definitely not spare you."
"Eighth Brother! I really am your Ninth Brother!" Ling Han continued his performance.
"Damn it!" The Eighth King charged out, and moved to thrash him with a single punch.
Ling Han moved, and exchanged a blow with the Eighth King. Boom, when their fists crashed into each other, the Eighth King immediately turned into a cannonball, shooting backwards rapidly.
Peng, he crashed heavily into the cave wall, then bounced back. A hemispherical pit was actually revealed behind him.
The might of this punch showed clearly just how violent it was.

chapters.title: Chapter 4754: Stomped to Death
paragraphs: "Who exactly are you?" the Eighth King asked balefully. He had repeatedly joked about their Ninth Brother; he had gone too far.
Furthermore, how could he be so strong?

Ling Han laughed loudly, and said, "Alright, I won’t tease you guys anymore. I accidentally killed your Ninth Brother, so you guys can transfer him from the list of missing people to the list of dead."
"What!" The Eighth King was shocked, and looked suspiciously at Ling Han.
If it was said that he had only gone too far previously, then killing the Ninth King was definitely a heinous crime.
As a fellow disciple of a Great Emperor, how dare you?
"Humph, I’ll capture you first, then slowly interrogate you!" The Eighth King moved, grabbing out at Ling Han.
Weng, the Silver Battle Armor had bestowed him with great power. As he shot out an attack, not only was Regulations boiling, there was also another mysterious power that boosted his battle prowess.
Ling Han was unconcerned, and casually sent out a palm strike.
Peng, the Eighth King instantly sprawled out on the ground.
"You!" The Eighth King immediately shot up again. He looked at Ling Han in horror, revealing a hint of wariness.
Too strong, this was a trump card-level ability!
"First!" The Eighth King called out loudly, "We seem to have been targeted by the trump card of some Great Emperor!"

"Oh?" With a flash, the man who had commanded the Eighth King to battle earlier had already left the battle and stood beside the Eighth King. He was the number one disciple of the Azure Dragon Great Emperor, Liu Yuhao.
"First, why did you run away without any warning!"
"F***, we’re under great pressure!"
The remaining five called out one after another. The battle situation was instantly reversed by the Ignited Stone Beast, and they could only retreat successively in defeat.
"It’s all right. You won’t die for a while," Liu Yuhao said indifferently, his eyes fixed on Ling Han, "You look unfamiliar. Who exactly are you?"
Ling Han wore an astounded expression as he shouted, "Big Brother, I’m your Ninth Brother!"
’F*** you!’

The Eighth King rolled his eyes. Just now, you already said that you accidentally killed the Ninth King, and now you’re here to impersonate Ninth. Wasn’t that just toying with him like he was a monkey?
"Among the trump cards under the Great Emperors, you definitely do not exist!" Liu Yuhao stated calmly, then faltered, "Could it be that you come from the second level?"
The 36 Divine Beasts formed groups of nine, guarding the Primitive Abyss. Each group was divided into various levels, going deeper and deeper.
For example, the True Dragon Emperor, Azure Phoenix Emperor, and so on all belonged to the first level.
Now, an unfamiliar elite had suddenly appeared. Aside from coming from the second level, was there any other explanation?
Er, this guy also had a very strong imagination. Could it be that he had attributes like Tang Sishui, and forcibly explained so that he would never be silenced?
Ling Han laughed loudly, "Wrong, wrong. I do not come from within, but rather from outside."
"What?!" Liu Yuhao and the Eighth King exclaimed in astonishment. This person had actually come from the outside world?
All of a sudden, a baleful killing intent appeared on their faces.
They stood guard here, and their daily task was to cultivate and supervise the mines, and the true mission they bore was to kill all outsiders.
However, in their long lives, they had never encountered outsiders, so they did not take it to heart at all.
Right until this moment.
There was actually an outsider that had come in!
’How did he suddenly appear?’
It should be known that without the protection of a special Battle Armor, to say nothing of battle, even standing here itself was an extremely extravagant thing.
But now, not only had he come safely, he had even managed to snatch a Silver Battle Armor!
"You killed Ninth?" Liu Yuhao asked balefully.

"Er, strictly speaking, I didn’t want to kill him," Ling Han said with a smile. "I took off his Battle Armor, and as a result, this guy was crushed into smithereens. Not even a single hair was left behind."
"Don’t you f*cking know? Without the protection of the Battle Armor, anyone can only die!" Liu Yuhao and the Eighth King shouted at the same time.
Didn’t this idiot have any common sense? They couldn’t help but curse.
Ling Han was extremely displeased, and he exclaimed, "I hate it the most when others insult me!"
"Humph, not only am I insulting you, but I am also going to kill you!" Liu Yuhao rushed out, and stretched out a hand, delivering a palm strike towards Ling Han.
This person was indeed extraordinary. His cultivation level was that of a Nine Star Saint, and his battle prowess had actually reached thirty stars.
Even with the boost from the Battle Armor, his strength could not be denied. He was even more awesome than the majority of the Golden Generation.
Unfortunately, he was still far inferior to Ling Han.
Ling Han casually threw a punch. Peng! Liu Yuhao was instantly sent flying, crashing into the battle between the other five kings and the Ignited Stone Beast.
His sudden arrival was something that no one had expected. The Ignited Stone Beast’s claw just happened to strike down, and Liu Yuhao was trampled beneath its feet.
This!

Just how terrifying was the battle prowess of the Ignited Stone Beast? Even if the seven of them joined forces, they could only place their hopes on slowly wearing down this fierce beast. Now that Liu Yuhao had been firmly stomped on, just how terrifying was the destructive power that he had to sustain?

"Ang?" Even the Ignited Stone Beast was very confused. Why had someone suddenly charged over to die? Furthermore, it was that most ruthless and most powerful person who had ganged up on it previously.
As it roared, it continued to crush down its claw.
"Boss!" the remaining six kings shouted at the same time. Oh no, he might still have had a breath of life at first, but now, he was definitely dead.
The Ignited Stone Beast raised its leg, and saw that the Silver Battle Armor was still completely unscathed, but as for the person inside... he was already too horrible to look at.
This Battle Armorcould have defensive effects, but it wasn’t omnipotent. As long as the attack power exceeded the upper limit of its absorption rate, the person inside would still be affected.

Originally, with Liu Yuhao’s strength, he would have been able to disperse this part of the impact. But the problem was, he had already passed out at the same time that he had been sent flying by Ling Han. How could he defend in that situation?
He was a nine-star Saint, a disciple of a Great Emperor, and a trump card at that. Yet, he had been killed with a single stomp from the ferocious beast just like that.
What an injustice!
"You!" Instantly, the gazes of the remaining six kings were all focused on Ling Han, and it was as if they were about to spit fire.
Ling Han smiled, and stretched out a finger to remind them, "Take note, that fierce beast doesn’t seem to have eaten enough!"
"Ang!" The Ignited Stone Beast roared loudly, and was already charging towards the Second King and the others.
Weren’t you guys very fierce just now?
’Come on, continue to be fierce!’
The fiercest one had already been stomped to death by it, and the remaining people, hoho, couldn’t even withstand a single blow!

The six disciples of the Great Emperor hurriedly regathered their battle lines, blocking this great beast. However, they were terrified, because there was an even more terrifying bringer of misfortune behind them.
Even as powerful as Liu Yuhao was, he was still no match for a single punch from his opponent. What if this guy took advantage of the opening to attack them as well?
In front of them, there was the Ignited Stone Beast, and behind them, there was the bringer of misfortune. What were they to do now?
Ling Han snickered, and resolutely moved to cause trouble.
Peng, one person was sent flying, and just happened to be stepped on by the Ignited Stone Beast, which directly crushed him to death.
This... another person had died.

The remaining five kings were both shocked and furious, but in this situation, they could not stop at all. Otherwise, they would be instantly annihilated by the Ignited Stone Beast, but even so, they were only struggling at death’s door.
What could they do? What could they do?
Xiu, xiu, xiu! Ling Han attacked continuously, throwing the remaining disciples of the Great Emperor towards the Ignited Stone Beast, and they were all trampled to death.

Now that Liu Yuhao had been firmly stomped on, just how terrifying was the destructive power that he had to sustain?
"Ang?" Even the Ignited Stone Beast was very confused.
Why had someone suddenly charged over to die?
Furthermore, it was that most ruthless and most powerful person who had ganged up on it previously.
As it roared, it continued to crush down its claw.
"Boss!" the remaining six kings shouted at the same time.
Oh no, he might still have had a breath of life at first, but now, he was definitely dead.
The Ignited Stone Beast raised its leg, and saw that the Silver Battle Armor was still completely unscathed, but as for the person inside... he was already too horrible to look at.
This Battle Armorcould have defensive effects, but it wasn’t omnipotent.
As long as the attack power exceeded the upper limit of its absorption rate, the person inside would still be affected.
Originally, with Liu Yuhao’s strength, he would have been able to disperse this part of the impact.
But the problem was, he had already passed out at the same time that he had been sent flying by Ling Han.
How could he defend in that situation?
He was a nine-star Saint, a disciple of a Great Emperor, and a trump card at that.
Yet, he had been killed with a single stomp from the ferocious beast just like that.
What an injustice!
"You!" Instantly, the gazes of the remaining six kings were all focused on Ling Han, and it was as if they were about to spit fire.
Ling Han smiled, and stretched out a finger to remind them, "Take note, that fierce beast doesn’t seem to have eaten enough!"
"Ang!" The Ignited Stone Beast roared loudly, and was already charging towards the Second King and the others.
Weren’t you guys very fierce just now?
’Come on, continue to be fierce!’
The fiercest one had already been stomped to death by it, and the remaining people, hoho, couldn’t even withstand a single blow!
The six disciples of the Great Emperor hurriedly regathered their battle lines, blocking this great beast.
However, they were terrified, because there was an even more terrifying bringer of misfortune behind them.
Even as powerful as Liu Yuhao was, he was still no match for a single punch from his opponent.
What if this guy took advantage of the opening to attack them as well?
In front of them, there was the Ignited Stone Beast, and behind them, there was the bringer of misfortune.
What were they to do now?
Ling Han snickered, and resolutely moved to cause trouble.
Peng, one person was sent flying, and just happened to be stepped on by the Ignited Stone Beast, which directly crushed him to death.
This... another person had died.
The remaining five kings were both shocked and furious, but in this situation, they could not stop at all.
Otherwise, they would be instantly annihilated by the Ignited Stone Beast, but even so, they were only struggling at death’s door.
What could they do?
What could they do?
Xiu, xiu, xiu!
Ling Han attacked continuously, throwing the remaining disciples of the Great Emperor towards the Ignited Stone Beast, and they were all trampled to death.

chapters.title: Chapter 4755: Killing a Beast
paragraphs: Ling Han didn’t directly kill them because he had taken into account the fact that he couldn’t expose any flaws.
No matter what kind of martial arts competition it was, they would not allow members of their own forces to kill each other — except for some freakish sects.
Thus, if these people had died by his hand, it would definitely lead to an investigation, and there was a Great Emperor standing guard here. How could Ling Han possibly take such a risk?
In that case, he could only borrow the hand of another to do the dirty work.

In this way, though it was a little strange that so many people had died, all of them had indeed died at the hands of the Ignited Stone Beast. As long as the Ignited Stone Beast was killed, there would really be no one left to bear witness.
The Ignited Stone Beast was also very confused. Why did they all take the initiative to charge under its claws, scrambling to be smacked to death by it?
Could it be that its strength had become stronger again?
This fierce beast set its eyes on Ling Han; there was only one person left.
"Hey, hey, hey, I can also be considered half your savior. Are you planning to repay kindness with ingratitude?" Ling Han asked with a smile.
This human wasn’t afraid of him at all.
The Ignited Stone Beast was slightly hesitant, but it was not because it was grateful to Ling Han, but rather because it felt that this seemingly tiny human had unfathomable depths.
It wasn’t smart enough, but it wasn’t stupid.
However, it had killed seven people in a row, and it was already swelling with pride, feeling that it was invincible in this world.
"Ang!" It roared loudly, and charged towards Ling Han.
"Sigh!" Ling Han shook his head, and greeted the incoming attack with a raised fist.
Peng!
The man and beast exchanged a blow, and the energy turned into a wild wave that surged out in all directions.
The Ignited Stone Beast was actually sent flying, crashing towards the wall. Then, it bounced back, leaving behind a massive groove.
It shook its head as it crawled up, feeling extremely dizzy.

Ling Han was surprised. This fierce beast was really tough and coarse. Aside from the fact that he had not used the Destructive Energy and light of dao, he had not held anything back in terms of power and Regulations, but this attack actually did not kill this fierce beast instantly.
"Your skin is so tough," he said with a smile. "It definitely doesn’t taste good."
He evaluated from a very professional angle.
"Ang!" That fierce beast was furious. A mere human actually dared to look down on an existence like itself?
’Die!’

It gathered its remaining power, and charged towards Ling Han again. However, with a bang, it was once again sent flying, and crashed heavily into the wall. It experienced another wave of dizziness and blurred vision.
After being unable to withstand a single blow twice in a row, the Ignited Stone Beast couldn’t help but look panicked. Its swelling confidence also returned to normal in an instant.
This human was too strong. It was far from being a match for him.
Run!
However, the problem was that this human was blocking its path. If it wanted to escape, it would have to circle around him first.
For the sake of survival, he would give it his all.
It charged towards Ling Han, but this attack was not meant to defeat this human, but rather wanted to force Ling Han to retreat, so it could then circle around him.
Unfortunately, this was naturally an extravagant hope.
Peng!
Ling Han threw a punch, and sent the Ignited Stone Beast flying again.
He played it down, and did not use his full strength at all. Yet he was able to cause the Ignited Stone Beast to have a psychological breakdown, and doubt reality.
—Amongst the Primitive Abyss beings, it could also be considered a "king"-like existence, but it was actually bullied to this extent by a Saint, so how could it not doubt reality?
However, it didn’t have much time to ponder over this problem. Ling Han finally unleashed his full power, killing this ferocious beast before severing its head.
In this place, the gravity fields were so strong that even the Spatial Tool could be forcefully crushed. Thus, Ling Han was unable to store such a massive head into the Spatial Tool.
Moreover, this was the head of a Holy Beast, so it couldn’t be easily shrunk down.
It was possible, but this would expose Ling Han’s strength.
Thus, it would be slightly more troublesome for him, but he would just have to carry it like this.

"En, I have to set up the scene again." Ling Han dealt with the scene, making it conform to what he would say in future — their team had fought to the death to kill the Ignited Stone Beast, but had also paid the price of seven people dying in battle.
To the people here, Ling Han did not feel any pity. There was no difference between them and the fallen Imperial Sons.
He went back the way he came.

"Yi?" He had not walked for too long, when a person appeared ahead of him. Seeing that he was carrying a massive head that was still burning with flames, that person faltered at first, and then looked overjoyed.
"Wait!" Ling Han stretched out his hand first. "If you want to say that I should hand the head of this Ignited Stone Beast over to you, then you don’t have to speak."
’Holy f*ck!’
That person instantly felt a suffocating feeling in his chest. This was what he wanted to say, and now these words were stuffed back into his throat, which made him feel very uncomfortable.
"Humph, do you think I will let you go just because you say that?" That person asked coldly, appearing very disdainful.
"I am the Ninth King of the True Dragon Emperor. Who are you?" Ling Han introduced himself first.
"Xu Gao, the seventh disciple of the Flying Snake Great Emperor," the other replied.
En, he had found out the origins of another Divine Beast.
"Aren’t you afraid that you won’t be able to defeat me?" Ling Han asked with a smile.
Xu Gao couldn’t help but shiver. Ling Han was carrying the head of an Ignited Stone Beast. What did this signify?
He could kill such a fierce beast!

It should be known that this kind of fierce beast was incredibly frightening. Even if one was a trump card, he would have to pay a considerable price to be able to kill it. Otherwise, it would not have become a tool for the first round of elimination battles.
Hence, the other’s strength... was extraordinary!
However, how strong could the ninth disciple of the True Dragon Emperor be?
Wasn’t the disciple of the True Dragon Emperor Liu Yuhao?

With this thought, he wasn’t afraid anymore. Presumably, this Ignited Stone Beast was definitely killed by all the disciples of the True Dragon together, and for some unknown reason, the beast’s head had fallen into the hands of this person.
Haha, wasn’t this gifting him a huge advantage?
"Defeat you? It would be a piece of cake," he said proudly.
Ling Han revealed a playful expression, "Are you sure?"
"Of course!" Xu Gao shot out like an arrow, charging towards Ling Han.

Ling Han smiled and flipped his palm over. Hong, instantly, a terrifying pressure crushed down on Xu Gao. With a peng, Xu Gao was pressed onto the ground. He felt as if he was carrying a sky full of stars on his back, and couldn’t even move a single finger.
He couldn’t help but feel shocked. What kind of abilities were these? He was frighteningly strong!

Ling Han said seriously, "Could it be that you don’t know? Previously, I disappeared for tens of thousands of years! That was because I was trapped by the storm of heaven and earth, yet accidentally obtained a great amount of Genesis Substance. Though my cultivation level hasn’t increased, my battle prowess has soared by tons."

This could be considered as a forceful explanation. Otherwise, it was unbelievable that a mere disciple ranked at the last would have battle prowess that would suddenly soar to surpass the trump card.
Xu Gao had to believe it even if he didn’t want to. Otherwise, how could he explain the other’s strength?
"Since you dare to provoke me, you’ll have to pay the price!" Ling Han wanted to take off his Battle Armor.
Xu Gaoi’s face instantly turned green with fear.
Why did he take off his clothes?
He wouldn’t believe it even if it killed him, and that was Ling Han was merely trying to snatch his Battle Armor!
Could it be that this guy, was, a pervert!
All of a sudden, cold sweat poured down his body like a waterfall.
"F***, what nonsense are you thinking!" Ling Han delivered a slap. Xu Gao’s resentful gaze was practically intolerable to him.

chapters.title: Chapter 4756: Attracting animosity
paragraphs: Ling Han still stopped.

The mines here had been completely emptied, so the gravity field was extraordinarily strong. If it weren’t for the protection of the Silver Battle Armor, it was guaranteed that Xu Gao would be instantly crushed into dust.
Then, this would be a deliberate murder.
Sigh, for the sake of Genesis-level Celestial medicines, I will endure!
Ling Han stood up and walked forward.
Xu Gao breathed a sigh of relief, feeling cold sweat all over his body.
Thankfully, this guy had pulled back from the edge. Otherwise, he would have been in deep trouble just now.
Ling Han hummed a soft tune as he strode forward.
With strength, that was how confident he was.

"Yi, the Ignited Stone Beast’s head!" Another person appeared ahead of them. Before they saw Ling Han, they had already discovered the head of the Ignited Stone Beast. It couldn’t be helped; that thing was too big and too obvious.
"Which sect are you from?" the person shouted.
"I am the disciple of the Strongest Great Emperor, the True Dragon!" Ling Han began to attract animosity.
"Humph, though the True Dragon Emperor is strong, it can’t be considered the strongest!" The person on the other side was immediately angered, "Our Crimson Ape Emperor is the strongest!"
"Nonsense!" Ling Han said resolutely, "However the Master is, that is how the disciple would turn out like. Let’s compete. Whoever wins will prove whose Great Emperor is stronger."
Er, could they be compared like this?
The man hesitated. What if he lost? Would he really have to admit that the True Dragon Emperor was stronger than the Crimson Ape Emperor?
"Haha, you don’t dare?" Ling Han asked with a chuckle.
"I’m afraid that you’ll go back on your word after losing!" That person hurriedly sneered, and charged out.
Peng!
Ling Han sent him flying with a single kick.
That person only saw stars in front of his eyes. How could he be so strong?
He was no match at all!
"Now do you know how awesome our True Dragon Emperor is?" Ling Han said with a chuckle.
That person gritted his teeth, and did not deny it.
Who asked him to lose?
"Who are you?" This person was definitely not the first disciple of the True Dragon Emperor. Though he did not know all the disciples of the True Dragon Emperor, he definitely knew the trump card.
"Ninth King!" Ling Han said with a smile.
"Impossible!" That person could not believe it no matter what.
Ling Han forcibly explained again, "That’s right, though tens of thousands of years ago, I encountered a storm of heaven and earth, and was trapped in..."
Blah, blah, blah. Ling Han believed that as long as he spoke to a few more people, very soon, there would be no further need for him to explain.
That person was extremely depressed, but did not connect Ling Han with an outsider at all.

Because only an Emperor could enter this space, Saints would only be seeking death if they entered. Thus, this was a paradox. Since they couldn’t obtain the Battle Armor and couldn’t enter the Primitive Abyss, how could they possibly appear in front of them?
Ling Han left again. Not too long after, he encountered another person who tried to block his way and rob him. After he taught him a lesson, he also related his "fateful encounter story".
Half a day later, the exit was already within sight.
However, there was an additional group of seven here.
They were clearly on the same side, and blocked the way. The only thing missing was the word "robbers" to be written on their faces.
"Which Great Emperor are you under?!" Ling Han asked.
"Haha, you don’t even recognize our trump card, An Heming?" one of them immediately shouted. "We’re disciples of the Great Emperor Bai Ze!"
It was not every Great Emperor would take nine disciples. There were only seven disciples under this one, and his first disciple was An Heming, the trump card under Great Emperor Bai Ze.
In truth, it was not that the first disciple was a trump card, but rather that after becoming a trump card, one would automatically be promoted to become the first disciple.

For example, An Heming hadn’t been his first disciple before. However, after he had displayed his outstanding talent, he had been bestowed the title of trump card, and he had been promoted to the position of first disciple.
Ling Han gave an ’oh’, and began to attract animosity, "I am the disciple of the Strongest Great Emperor, True Dragon, the Ninth King!"
"Pei!" His self-introduction instantly elicited strong objections. Even the aloof An Heming wore an expression of displeasure.
They had never seen such a shameless person. When he was introducing himself, he would flatter his Master madly, and belittle the other Divine Beasts while he was at it.
The Strongest Great Emperor?
Who had bestowed this title?
"Ninth, aren’t you a little too arrogant?"
"Humph, even if the True Dragon Emperor knew about this, he wouldn’t allow you to do so!"
"Don’t fail to curry favor, and instead get yourself into trouble!"
The seven people all said coldly.
Ling Han cracked a smile, "My Lord True Dragon is number one, and you guys don’t like it? Then I’ll beat you guys into submission!"
Everyone was eager. He was merely the ninth disciple, so what was there to be afraid of?
Meanwhile, An Heming frowned slightly, and said, "There’s something strange about this person!"
To be able to kill the Ignited Stone Beast, that definitely had to be the strength of the team, but now, Ling Han was the only one left. Where were the other disciples of the True Dragon Emperor?
Was this a bait to deliberately draw their attention, and then there would be an unpredictable ambush lying in wait for them?

It had to be admitted that the appearance of Ling Han alone was too outrageously bold. Furthermore, he was carrying the head of the Ignited Stone Beast. This was practically luring others to rob him, so it was too illogical.
This didn’t make sense, so there was definitely a trap.
"Old Fourth, go and scout the area," An Heming commanded.
"Yes," one of them immediately replied. Then, his figure slowly became transparent, as if he had disappeared into thin air.

Ling Han wasn’t in a hurry to make a move either. He simply talked nonsense with the six people on the other side, trying his best to instill the concept of the True Dragon being the strongest, madly attracting animosity.
He was born with a natural halo of trouble, and now that he was actively attracting aggro, so the amount he attracted was naturally impressive.
"First, I can’t help but want to attack!"
First, I also want to fight!"
Everyone was excited, and all of them were about to erupt.

An Heming also found this slightly intolerable. However, he had just told Old Fourth to investigate the situation and see if there were any ambushes. Thus, they had no option but to endure this for now.
"Close your ears, and don’t listen!" He outlined a strategy.
That’s right!
The remaining five immediately shut their ears. With their Saint-level cultivation, this was naturally no big deal.
A while later, Old Fourth, who had gone to scout, returned. He said, "First, there is no ambush."
Yi?
He was taken aback. It was as if First and the others had gone stupid, and actually turned a deaf ear to his words.
That... that would be terrifying!
He had only left for a short while, and First and the others had already been "dealt with" without his knowledge?
With this in mind, he couldn’t help but break out in a cold sweat.
"What did you say?" An Heming suddenly asked.
This caused Old Fourth to be dumbfounded. What was going on?
Were they in a different time flow?
Or had there been a lapse in our space, which caused a great delay in the transmission of sound?
"Fourth, what did you say just now?"
"Fourth Brother, I didn’t hear what you said either."
The others also came to their senses, and asked one after another.
This!
Old Fourth was even more stunned. What exactly was going on here?
How could he have imagined that First and the others had no choice but to close their ears because they could not bear Ling Han’s blabbering? Naturally, they could not hear what he had said.
However, when he confirmed that there was no ambush, An Heming and the others were all burning with fighting spirit.
There was no ambush, so they could move without any reservations!
Humph, this blabbering guy, though they could not kill anyone, no matter what, they had to teach him a harsh lesson.

"Haha, you don’t even recognize our trump card, An Heming?" one of them immediately shouted.
"We’re disciples of the Great Emperor Bai Ze!"
It was not every Great Emperor would take nine disciples.
There were only seven disciples under this one, and his first disciple was An Heming, the trump card under Great Emperor Bai Ze.
In truth, it was not that the first disciple was a trump card, but rather that after becoming a trump card, one would automatically be promoted to become the first disciple.
For example, An Heming hadn’t been his first disciple before.
However, after he had displayed his outstanding talent, he had been bestowed the title of trump card, and he had been promoted to the position of first disciple.
Ling Han gave an ’oh’, and began to attract animosity, "I am the disciple of the Strongest Great Emperor, True Dragon, the Ninth King!"
"Pei!" His self-introduction instantly elicited strong objections.
Even the aloof An Heming wore an expression of displeasure.
They had never seen such a shameless person.
When he was introducing himself, he would flatter his Master madly, and belittle the other Divine Beasts while he was at it.
The Strongest Great Emperor?
Who had bestowed this title?
"Ninth, aren’t you a little too arrogant?"
"Humph, even if the True Dragon Emperor knew about this, he wouldn’t allow you to do so!"
"Don’t fail to curry favor, and instead get yourself into trouble!"
The seven people all said coldly.
Ling Han cracked a smile, "My Lord True Dragon is number one, and you guys don’t like it?
Then I’ll beat you guys into submission!"
Everyone was eager.
He was merely the ninth disciple, so what was there to be afraid of?
Meanwhile, An Heming frowned slightly, and said, "There’s something strange about this person!"
To be able to kill the Ignited Stone Beast, that definitely had to be the strength of the team, but now, Ling Han was the only one left.
Where were the other disciples of the True Dragon Emperor?
Was this a bait to deliberately draw their attention, and then there would be an unpredictable ambush lying in wait for them?
It had to be admitted that the appearance of Ling Han alone was too outrageously bold.
Furthermore, he was carrying the head of the Ignited Stone Beast.
This was practically luring others to rob him, so it was too illogical.
This didn’t make sense, so there was definitely a trap.
"Old Fourth, go and scout the area," An Heming commanded.
"Yes," one of them immediately replied.
Then, his figure slowly became transparent, as if he had disappeared into thin air.
Ling Han wasn’t in a hurry to make a move either.
He simply talked nonsense with the six people on the other side, trying his best to instill the concept of the True Dragon being the strongest, madly attracting animosity.
He was born with a natural halo of trouble, and now that he was actively attracting aggro, so the amount he attracted was naturally impressive.
"First, I can’t help but want to attack!"
First, I also want to fight!"
Everyone was excited, and all of them were about to erupt.
An Heming also found this slightly intolerable.
However, he had just told Old Fourth to investigate the situation and see if there were any ambushes.
Thus, they had no option but to endure this for now.
"Close your ears, and don’t listen!" He outlined a strategy.
That’s right!
The remaining five immediately shut their ears.
With their Saint-level cultivation, this was naturally no big deal.
A while later, Old Fourth, who had gone to scout, returned.
He said, "First, there is no ambush."
Yi?
He was taken aback.
It was as if First and the others had gone stupid, and actually turned a deaf ear to his words.
That... that would be terrifying!
He had only left for a short while, and First and the others had already been "dealt with" without his knowledge?
With this in mind, he couldn’t help but break out in a cold sweat.
"What did you say?" An Heming suddenly asked.
This caused Old Fourth to be dumbfounded.
What was going on?
Were they in a different time flow?
Or had there been a lapse in our space, which caused a great delay in the transmission of sound?
"Fourth, what did you say just now?"
"Fourth Brother, I didn’t hear what you said either."
The others also came to their senses, and asked one after another.
This!
Old Fourth was even more stunned.
What exactly was going on here?
How could he have imagined that First and the others had no choice but to close their ears because they could not bear Ling Han’s blabbering?
Naturally, they could not hear what he had said.
However, when he confirmed that there was no ambush, An Heming and the others were all burning with fighting spirit.
There was no ambush, so they could move without any reservations!
Humph, this blabbering guy, though they could not kill anyone, no matter what, they had to teach him a harsh lesson.

chapters.title: Chapter 4757: Story
paragraphs: Peng, peng, peng! They all charged forward.

Ling Han very much wanted to defeat all of them, but if he could easily defeat even a trump card, how could he explain the fact that aside from him, the entire line of the True Dragon, had all died in battle?
He could be strong, but he couldn’t be too strong. Only like this, would it match with the theory that only he had managed to escape.
Fine then.
Ling Han sighed, and began to contend with these seven people.
He did not go all out, but with his present strength, he was completely capable of moving freely among them.
This caused An Heming and the others to feel both humiliated and furious.
The seven of them joined forces, yet they were still unable to capture Ling Han?
In truth, this guy was not very strong either. It was just that he was too slippery. No matter how strong your martial arts were, what could you do if you did not hit your target?
"I’m not playing with you guys anymore." Ling Han laughed loudly, and sped up. Xiu, he began to break out of the siege.
"You won’t be able to escape!" An Heming said with a cold chuckle. ’You’re bringing such a large beast head, yet you still want to break free from the seven of us?’
He really did not take them seriously — f***!

A muscle twitched in his cheek, and he saw that Ling Han had successfully broken out of the siege. He was clearly still carrying the head of a beast, but his speed was getting faster and faster, leaving them in the dust, so his Junior Brothers and Junior Sisters could only look at his back.
W-what kind of freak was this?
"Chase!" The seven of them were all furious. If this spread out, how would they be able to face others in future?
To say nothing of the fact that this was only the ninth disciple of the True Dragon, even if he was a trump card, they could not allow him to come and go as he pleased.
Otherwise, Ling Han’s claim that the True Dragon was the StrongestGreat Emperor would be confirmed. At least, the True Dragon was more powerful than Great Emperor Bai Ze.
They worked hard to catch up. This was no longer just a competition for the top four spots, b@stard!
However, none of them could match Ling Han’s speed. When they chased out of the mine, they saw that Ling Han had already stopped and unloaded the beast’s head.
On the sidelines, that old Saint had a benevolent expression, as if he was very fond of Ling Han.
In the eyes of the old Saint, this was the repayment for Ling Han’s previous benevolence.

You see, he had been humble and courteous, yet in the end, it was he who was the first to bring out the head of the Ignited Stone Beast. Wasn’t this the blessing of the heavens mysteriously bestowed upon him?
If An Heming and the others found out about this, they would definitely complain.
This guy was humble and respectful?
His words could drive one to fury, all right?
The old Saint was also very curious, and asked, "How did you kill this Ignited Stone Beast?"
This also piqued the curiosity of An Heming and the others. Indeed, how had Ling Han done it?
Even if it was a trump card, he would still need the support of others to slowly grind the Ignited Stone Beast to death. Otherwise, even if he could succeed, hewould have to pay a very heavy price.
But looking at Ling Han... he didn’t seem to have suffered any injuries.

Ling Han immediately put on an expression of grief, and said, "You know that I entered later. When I rushed to meet up with the other Senior Brothers, the Senior Brothers had already begun a fierce battle with this stone beast."
"I was too late. Senior Brother and the others experienced a bloody battle, and this stone beast was already on its last breath, but Senior Brother and the others... also died in battle."
Yi!
The old Saint, An Heming, and the others all widened their eyes in shock. F*ck! They had actually lost their lives for the sake of this competition?
Hiss, how could there be such idiots?
The old Saint immediately wanted to enter the mine to investigate, but when he recalled that he was still responsible for the role of referee, and could not leave, he could only suppress this urge.
Now, he could only wait. When the competition ended, he would go in and investigate.
Someone had died. This was a serious matter.
Another three days passed, and only then did the trump cards of the various forces take out the heads of the Ignited Stone Beasts one by one.
It could not be helped. The Ignited Stone Beast was very, very strong. If one pursued a speedy kill, they would definitely have to pay a heavy price.
After the old Saint announced the top four, he immediately rushed into the mine.
The others also followed him in out of curiosity.
As expected.
They saw the corpses of the seven people. It was obvious that they had all been stomped to death by the Ignited Stone Beast.
Gasp! Just how brutal and intense was this battle?
Furthermore, what was the point?
Though Genesis-level Celestial medicines were very precious, sacrificing one’s life for them was definitely not worth it.
Why didn’t they grind it down slowly?

Ling Han added insult to injury as appropriate, "It’s all because Senior Brothers dote on me and want to take down the Ignited Stone Beast as soon as possible, to prevent other teams from snatching it! Thus, in order to prevent Senior Brothers from dying for nothing, I must take first place!"
If the large black dog was here, he would definitely give him a thumbs up.
This kind of shamelessness was really at least half as skilled as Old Black.
Everyone looked at each other. Though Ling Han’s words seemed to be very logical, why did they feel a strange feeling when they heard it?
The competition ended, but the fact that almost all the disciples of the True Dragon Emperor had died had to be carefully investigated. After all, such a thing like this had never happened before.
The investigation was one thing, but the competition still had to continue.
The top four had already appeared, and the next step was to draw lots.

The opponent that Ling Han had drawn for the first round was Luoyi Xingxiao, the ace under the Great Emperor Crimson Ape. He was an elegant-looking young man, and when he was in the city, he wore a long white robe, looking a little flamboyant.
The two elimination battles would be held at the same time, and the victors would immediately enter into the final battle.
There was no need to drag things out. In this place, efficiency was what was most important.

"Junior Brother, please." Luoyi Xingxiao smiled faintly. By now, he was naturally already wearing the Silver Battle Armor. Without this Battle Armor, one’s battle prowess would be completely different.

Ling Han chuckled and said, "Right now, I’m the first disciple and trump card of the True Dragon Emperor. Our True Dragon Emperor has never been inferior to anyone in his life. It’s best that you address me as Senior Brother."
’Holy f*ck!’
Luoyi Xingxiao almost threw up blood.
I am only being polite to you. Furthermore, you are the ninth disciple of the True Dragon, so isn’t it only right that I call you Junior Brother?
’Why are you suddenly getting so serious?’
Are you here to spar or to infuriate me?
Could it be that you have some kind of negative emotion system that can help you increase your cultivation level and redeem treasures?
"First come, first served," Luoyi Xingxiao said. "Junior Brother, even if you become the first disciple under the True Dragon Emperor, there’s nothing wrong with me calling you Junior Brother."

"That’s not right. All the Great Emperors are on equal footing, and we are all trump cards, so why am I Junior Brother?" Ling Han argued strongly, "Moreover, the True Dragon Emperor has been invincible all his life, and is considered the strongest."
Hey, hey, hey, why are you starting to attract animosity again?
Luoyi Xingxiao suppressed his anger, "Junior Brother, your words are incorrect. All the Great Emperors can suppress the world, so how could there be anyone who is superior?"
Hearing the two of them engage in an intense debate, everyone felt like mocking.
Have you come to spar or debate eloquence?
Luoyi Xingxiao, you are really taking it too seriously. Why do you have to bicker with this guy on the issue of Senior Brother and Junior Brother?
However, in terms of debate, how could Luoyi Xingxiao compare to Ling Han?

Whether it was a twisted reason or not, Ling Han could always speak logically, causing Luoyi Xingxiao to become more and more driven mad. Usually, he would need to consider for as long as one to two minutes to be able to come up with a response.
If the outcome was decided through debate, then Ling Han had already won, and it was a complete victory at that.

chapters.title: Chapter 4758: Bet
paragraphs: Luoyi Xingxiao racking his brains over the matter, but everyone was becoming more and more impatient.
What was going on?
Have you both come to perform a crosstalk performance?
Even the old Saint who was the referee couldn’t bear to watch on any longer. He warned, "The tournament battle is to begin immediately. There is no need to continue this pointless entanglement!"
However, his words were ineffective.
Luoyi Xingxiao was a trump card!
What was a trump card?

The strongest disciple of the Great Emperor. Not only was he a Nine-Star Saint, he was also an outstanding existence among Nine-Star Saints. Thus, did Luoyi Xingxiao need to take this old Saint seriously?
The only thing that could make a trump card obey obediently was the Great Emperor.
Seeing that Luoyi Xingxiao was still scrambling his brains to think of how to refute Ling Han, the old Saint could only turn to Ling Han, and say, "Hurry up and begin the competition."
These words were spoken with a pleading tone.
Ling Han smiled and nodded. Xiu, he charged towards Luoyi Xingxiao.
Though he did not go all out, how could his battle prowess be underestimated?
Moreover, Luoyi Xingxiao was still racking his brains over how to refute Ling Han, so he was naturally caught off guard and instantly flustered.

"Despicable, you are too despicable!" Luoyi Xingxiao hurriedly shouted, as if his train of thought had suddenly been cleared up by Ling Han. As he parried, he said, "You are so shameless, what right do you have to be a trump card?"
He then looked around, "You have all seen for yourselves. This guy is so shameless. If he was allowed to become the trump card, would there still be any law or reason?"
However... his logic was too profound, and no one paid attention to him at all.
Yi, why are you guys like this?
Was he wrong?
Ling Han laughed loudly, his palms moving like wheels, endlessly striking out at Luoyi Xingxiao. His palms were like heavy axes, incredibly terrifying.
Luoyi Xingxiao had no choice but to stay alert. In front of such an offensive, how could he possibly be distracted any longer?

The two of them instantly engaged in a fierce battle. Thankfully, this was in the Primitive Abyss. Otherwise, if two Saints with battle prowess of at least 30 Stars were to exchange blows, just how terrifying would the damage be?
Crushing one or two galaxies was no big deal.
"Yi, how could the ninth disciple of the True Dragon City be so strong?"
"That’s right, his abilities are close to trump cards!"
"I’ve never heard of him being this strong?"
Everyone was extremely curious. How had a prodigy that was comparable to a trump card suddenly popped out?

"You guys don’t know, but tens of thousands of years ago, when he went out to search for Genesis Substance, he encountered a storm of from heaven and earth, and was trapped. However, this guy also got lucky, and obtained quite a number of Genesis-level Great Herbs from where he was trapped."
"And like that, his cultivation level has not changed, but his abilities have increased greatly."
Immediately, someone who "understood" the situation hurriedly explained.
Oh, so that was the case.

Everyone came to a sudden realization, and nodded repeatedly. Though they were still a little jealous, as to why they had not encountered such a good thing, they also knew that even if Genesis Substance was piled up in front of them, not everyone could become a trump card.

That was because Genesis Substance would only give you a chance to break through under the condition of not going through Silent Destruction, but whether you could break through would still have to depend on your own comprehension ability and grasp of Regulations.
Thus, to most people, Genesis Substance was indeed useful, but it definitely couldn’t turn them into supreme prodigies.
Ling Han was only able to become as strong as he was now because of Genesis Substance, but more so because of his own natural talent.
There was no need for Ling Han to explain anything. The seeds that he had planted previously had already bloomed and bore fruit, automatically helping him explain.
Ling Han added some power appropriately, and gained a great advantage on the scene, gradually suppressing Luoyi Xingxiao.
This caused Luoyi Xingxiao to throw up blood again.
He couldn’t refute him, and he couldn’t even defeat him?
He was about to die of fury!
Peng!

In a moment of carelessness, he was struck by Ling Han’s palm strike. Teng, teng, teng! His feet retreated continuously, and he felt his chest flip over, as if all his organs had been knocked upside down.
He had lost.
Luoyi Xingxiao was at a loss. How had he lost?
Hiss, he had still been thinking about how he was going to defeat Ling Han verbally. How had he been knocked down by Ling Han, and did not even have the chance to speak?
He couldn’t help but throw up blood, feeling indescribably terrible.
Ling Han smiled, and did not make another move.
The victor of the other battle was also determined with great difficulty, yet the victor was a woman.
Though there were many women under the nine Great Emperors, there was only one that could become their trump card.
This was Mo Ziyun, a disciple of the Azure Phoenix.
Without any rest, the finals immediately began.

Ling Han sized up his final opponent. This was an exquisite beauty. Though her whole body was covered by the Silver Battle Armor, her beautiful hair was like clouds, cascading down like a waterfall. Every strand of her hair was so black that it shone.
She was also extremely beautiful, with a jade-like nose and cherry lips, especially her eyes, which were filled with a captivating spirit.
Even Ling Han, who was accustomed to seeing beautiful women, felt a slight ripple in his heart when he first set eyes on her.
But it was only a sliver, and his heart and spirit calmed.
Mo Ziyun was also sizing up Ling Han. This time, she was battling on her home ground, so it would not be strange for her to be able to make it into the finals.
However, she had never imagined that her final opponent would not be a trump card, but rather the ninth disciple from True Dragon City!
She resolutely didn’t argue with Ling Han about who was the Senior Brother or Senior Sister. What happened to Luoyi Xingxiao was clear to see.
"Please!" She drew her sword. The sword was three feet long, and was as black as ink, as if it had been refined from the darkness itself.
Ling Han couldn’t help but feel surprised. He could sense an aura of destruction from this sword.
It was a little similar to Destructive Energy.
Yi?
What kind of material was this?
Or was it that ... after it was forged, Destructive Energy had been infused into it?
"Please," he said with a nod. His eyes were still fixed on the black sword.
But in everyone’s eyes, his target was Mo Ziyun.
He was too direct, wasn’t he?

Although Mo Ziyun was indeed a well-known beauty in the first level, there were at least eight hundred people who wanted her, if not a thousand. However, she was a trump card, so no one would dare to have the slightest bit of improper thoughts.
Ling Han, on the other hand, was just staring straight at her.
"Shameless brat!" Luoyi Xingxiao couldn’t help but reprimand him. How could such a person be qualified to be a trump card, what more when he was using him as a stepping stone.
Mo Ziyun also revealed an expression of anger. This person actually dared to look at her like this; he was really lecherous!
"How about we make a bet?" Ling Han suddenly spoke up.
"What are we betting on?" Mo Ziyun asked darkly.
Ling Han cracked a smile, "If I win, I want you—"
"Fine, if you lose, I’ll take your life!" Mo Ziyun said resolutely, interrupting Ling Han’s words.
Yi?
Ling Han was astonished. ’If you say this, others will misunderstand, okay?’
’I only want your sword. I’m not interested in your people!’
But when he thought about it, he had already won the battle, so how easy would it be to get a sword?
"All right." Ling Han nodded, his face full of smiles.
In everyone’s eyes, this was clearly a lewd grin!
Shameless, too shameless, to actually propose such a wager in public, how utterly shameless!
