As he parried, he said, "You are so shameless, what right do you have to be a trump card?"
He then looked around, "You have all seen for yourselves.
This guy is so shameless.
If he was allowed to become the trump card, would there still be any law or reason?"
However... his logic was too profound, and no one paid attention to him at all.
Yi, why are you guys like this?
Was he wrong?
Ling Han laughed loudly, his palms moving like wheels, endlessly striking out at Luoyi Xingxiao.
His palms were like heavy axes, incredibly terrifying.
Luoyi Xingxiao had no choice but to stay alert.
In front of such an offensive, how could he possibly be distracted any longer?
The two of them instantly engaged in a fierce battle.
Thankfully, this was in the Primitive Abyss.
Otherwise, if two Saints with battle prowess of at least 30 Stars were to exchange blows, just how terrifying would the damage be?
Crushing one or two galaxies was no big deal.
"Yi, how could the ninth disciple of the True Dragon City be so strong?"
"That’s right, his abilities are close to trump cards!"
"I’ve never heard of him being this strong?"
Everyone was extremely curious.
How had a prodigy that was comparable to a trump card suddenly popped out?
"You guys don’t know, but tens of thousands of years ago, when he went out to search for Genesis Substance, he encountered a storm of from heaven and earth, and was trapped.
However, this guy also got lucky, and obtained quite a number of Genesis-level Great Herbs from where he was trapped."
"And like that, his cultivation level has not changed, but his abilities have increased greatly."
Immediately, someone who "understood" the situation hurriedly explained.
Oh, so that was the case.
Everyone came to a sudden realization, and nodded repeatedly.

Though they were still a little jealous, as to why they had not encountered such a good thing, they also knew that even if Genesis Substance was piled up in front of them, not everyone could become a trump card.

That was because Genesis Substance would only give you a chance to break through under the condition of not going through Silent Destruction, but whether you could break through would still have to depend on your own comprehension ability and grasp of Regulations.
Thus, to most people, Genesis Substance was indeed useful, but it definitely couldn’t turn them into supreme prodigies.
Ling Han was only able to become as strong as he was now because of Genesis Substance, but more so because of his own natural talent.
There was no need for Ling Han to explain anything.
The seeds that he had planted previously had already bloomed and bore fruit, automatically helping him explain.
Ling Han added some power appropriately, and gained a great advantage on the scene, gradually suppressing Luoyi Xingxiao.
This caused Luoyi Xingxiao to throw up blood again.
He couldn’t refute him, and he couldn’t even defeat him?
He was about to die of fury!
Peng!
In a moment of carelessness, he was struck by Ling Han’s palm strike.
Teng, teng, teng!
His feet retreated continuously, and he felt his chest flip over, as if all his organs had been knocked upside down.
He had lost.
Luoyi Xingxiao was at a loss.
How had he lost?
Hiss, he had still been thinking about how he was going to defeat Ling Han verbally.
How had he been knocked down by Ling Han, and did not even have the chance to speak?
He couldn’t help but throw up blood, feeling indescribably terrible.
Ling Han smiled, and did not make another move.
The victor of the other battle was also determined with great difficulty, yet the victor was a woman.
Though there were many women under the nine Great Emperors, there was only one that could become their trump card.
This was Mo Ziyun, a disciple of the Azure Phoenix.
Without any rest, the finals immediately began.
Ling Han sized up his final opponent.
This was an exquisite beauty.
Though her whole body was covered by the Silver Battle Armor, her beautiful hair was like clouds, cascading down like a waterfall.
Every strand of her hair was so black that it shone.
She was also extremely beautiful, with a jade-like nose and cherry lips, especially her eyes, which were filled with a captivating spirit.
Even Ling Han, who was accustomed to seeing beautiful women, felt a slight ripple in his heart when he first set eyes on her.
But it was only a sliver, and his heart and spirit calmed.
Mo Ziyun was also sizing up Ling Han.
This time, she was battling on her home ground, so it would not be strange for her to be able to make it into the finals.
However, she had never imagined that her final opponent would not be a trump card, but rather the ninth disciple from True Dragon City!
She resolutely didn’t argue with Ling Han about who was the Senior Brother or Senior Sister.
What happened to Luoyi Xingxiao was clear to see.
"Please!" She drew her sword.
The sword was three feet long, and was as black as ink, as if it had been refined from the darkness itself.
Ling Han couldn’t help but feel surprised.
He could sense an aura of destruction from this sword.
It was a little similar to Destructive Energy.
Yi?
What kind of material was this?
Or was it that ... after it was forged, Destructive Energy had been infused into it?
"Please," he said with a nod.
His eyes were still fixed on the black sword.
But in everyone’s eyes, his target was Mo Ziyun.
He was too direct, wasn’t he?
Although Mo Ziyun was indeed a well-known beauty in the first level, there were at least eight hundred people who wanted her, if not a thousand.
However, she was a trump card, so no one would dare to have the slightest bit of improper thoughts.
Ling Han, on the other hand, was just staring straight at her.
"Shameless brat!" Luoyi Xingxiao couldn’t help but reprimand him.
How could such a person be qualified to be a trump card, what more when he was using him as a stepping stone.
Mo Ziyun also revealed an expression of anger.
This person actually dared to look at her like this; he was really lecherous!
"How about we make a bet?" Ling Han suddenly spoke up.
"What are we betting on?" Mo Ziyun asked darkly.
Ling Han cracked a smile, "If I win, I want you—"
"Fine, if you lose, I’ll take your life!" Mo Ziyun said resolutely, interrupting Ling Han’s words.
Yi?
Ling Han was astonished. ’If you say this, others will misunderstand, okay?’
’I only want your sword.
I’m not interested in your people!’
But when he thought about it, he had already won the battle, so how easy would it be to get a sword?
"All right." Ling Han nodded, his face full of smiles.
In everyone’s eyes, this was clearly a lewd grin!
Shameless, too shameless, to actually propose such a wager in public, how utterly shameless!

chapters.title: Chapter 4759: Misunderstanding
paragraphs: Mo Ziyun took a deep breath to calm herself down, then drew her sword.
Shua, the sword slashed out, and a black-coloured Sword Qi sliced towards Ling Han. Though it was only thirty metres long, the Sword Qi condensed, possessing astonishing might.

Ling Han couldn’t help but raise a brow. His opponent’s battle prowess could possibly only be thirty stars, but this strike carried a sliver of Destructive Energy, which instantly increased its destructive power greatly, and could produce the might of thirty-one or even thirty-two stars.
He didn’t take it head-on, as he didn’t want to expose the secret that he possessed Destructive Energy.
Relying on the agility of his footwork, Ling Han aggressively charged forward, planning to engage in close-quarter combat.
"Despicable!" Everyone couldn’t help but curse softly.
Aren’t you clearly trying to take advantage by engaging in close-quarter combat with a female cultivator?
Hiss, this pervert!

Even the old Saint’s expression became a little strange. He was indeed very optimistic about Ling Han. However, Ling Han’s performance caused his jaw to drop in shock. He was such a humble young man, so how had he fallen into the path of lust?
Mo Ziyun was even more enraged. He actually dared to insult her like this?
"You deserve to die!" she shouted lightly, as she increased her attacks.
Ling Han found this strange. Could it be that he wasn’t allowed to win?
How had it become that he deserved to die?

Sigh, it was all this woman’s fault. She had cut off his words, and did not let him speak fully. Otherwise, if he had said that he would be winning the other party’s treasured sword, would it still cause the current misunderstanding?
Thankfully, thankfully. Even if she was ruining someone’s image, it was not his image.
Ling Han felt a sense of relief. In any case, he wouldn’t be exposed, so it didn’t matter.
He continued to charge forward, attacking with every move.

If the two of them were men, then it wouldn’t matter. It was very normal, but now, it was a man and a woman. Then, Ling Han’s action was a little vulgar, as if he was deliberately taking advantage of Mo Ziyun.
It couldn’t be helped. Everyone had first impressions, and already had the impression in their minds that Ling Han was a pervert, so that would naturally taint any movement he made.
As they saw it, Ling Han wasn’t contending for victory at all. Instead, he was deliberately taking liberties with her, so Mo Ziyun would become wary of him.
However, Mo Ziyun was in the middle of it, so only she herself would be aware of her own suffering.

She knew that Ling Han’s attacks weren’t attempts to take liberties with her. Uh, although some moves were indeed very perverted, aimed at her chest, and seemed to be grabbing and touching at the same time, most attacks were still normal.

However, his battle prowess was extremely strong, and he was extremely experienced in battle. He would always be able to grasp the flaw that had been revealed in a flash, and then enlarge it, chasing after her and attacking fiercely.

She clearly felt that the battle prowess of the two of them was about the same, but it was the other party that had caught hold of one small flaw after another, gradually causing her to fall into a disadvantage.
What kind of person was this? Why was his comprehension and sensitivity to battle so terrifying?

Seeing that Mo Ziyun had fallen into a disadvantage, everyone was filled with righteous indignation. As they saw it, it was clearly Ling Han who had used such a despicable move to restrain Mo Ziyun, causing her to be unable to unleash her full strength.
Despicable, too despicable!
After exchanging over three hundred moves, Mo Ziyun was already at a complete disadvantage, and had no choice but to admit defeat.
Without saying a word, she turned around and left.
Ling Han couldn’t help but sigh. Could it be that she had forgotten the bet?
’My sword!’
Seeing Ling Han’s despondent expression, everyone wanted to beat him up even more. Could it be that you really hope to win the beauty over just like that?
To win in such a despicable manner, who would submit to you?

Ling Han had obtained a Genesis-level Celestial medicine. Logically speaking, he should have successfully retreated, but when he thought of that sword, he decided to wait a little longer. He would find a chance to knock out Mo Ziyun, and then leave with the sword.
But just as he was planning to leave the city to refine the Celestial medicine, he suddenly discovered that someone had entered into this shabby room of his.
Yi... it was Mo Ziyun.
Was this woman unwilling to lose to him, and wanted to snatch the Celestial medicine?
Hehe, he really wanted to see who would be doing the snatching here.

Ling Han walked out and saw that Mo Ziyun was no longer wearing the Silver Battle Armor. Instead, she had changed into a dark green tight-fitting suit. Though the attire was not the slightest bit luxurious, it completely outlined her perfect curves.
Beautiful, alluring, capable of captivating one’s soul.
Ling Han took a second look. Tsk, tsk, tsk! Previously, she had been concealed in the Battle Armor, and he had not realized that this little girl’s figure was so impressive.
She was shapely and curvaceous, and could be considered perfect.
"Whatever happened tonight, you are not allowed to tell anyone!" Mo Ziyun bit her red lips and said, "Otherwise, I will definitely kill you!"
Hold on, have you misunderstood?
Ling Han grimaced, and said, "I say, Young Miss Mo, you may have misunderstood!"
Mo Ziyun’s pretty face changed drastically. ’You said you wanted me in public, and now you’re saying I misunderstood?’
He was too petty!
But who asked her to lose?
Actually, this was the Azure Phoenix City, and she was also a disciple of the Azure Phoenix Great Emperor. As long as she was unwilling, who could force her?
Moreover, Ling Han’s actions had already incited public anger, and there was even less support for him.
However, Mo Ziyun had a proud and aloof personality. Since she had lost the bet, she would accept her loss. No matter how upset she would be in the future, she was not willing to break the bet.
She turned around, relaxed her defenses, and said resignedly, "Hurry up!"
F***, what kind of discrimination was this?
’Am I the type to be very "fast"?’
Ling Han hurriedly shook his head. He had almost been led astray by this girl.
’Huh? Where’s your treasured sword?’
Ling Han originally wanted to knock her unconscious and leave with his sword, but what sword was there with Mo Ziyun?

The gravity fields here were too strong, and there was absolutely no possibility for a Spatial Spirit Tool to exist. Thus, Mo Ziyun must have placed both her sword and Battle Armor in her quarters. This could be imagined. After all, she had not come here to fight.
Damn it!
Ling Han coughed, and said, "Actually, what I’m interested in is your sword."
W-what?

Mo Ziyun was taken aback, and recalled again. Indeed, it was she who had interrupted Ling Han’s words at the time. As it turned out, he had not been staring at her at the time, but her sword. The so-called "I want you" was actually "I want your sword".
Er!
However, now that the misunderstanding was resolved, she instead felt a sense of shame, anger, and indignation.
Since the misunderstanding had already happened, and she had taken the initiative to come over to fulfil her promise, Ling Han actually did not want her!
Was she that bad?
He did not want her, even when she was taking the initiative to throw herself into his arms?
This was a great humiliation!
Humph!
Mo Ziyun directly leaped and fled.
She fled?
She ran off just like that?
Ling Han didn’t give chase. Firstly, he didn’t know where Mo Ziyun lived. So what if he captured her? He couldn’t find the sword.
Moreover, to make a move right in front of the eyes of the Azure Phoenix, wasn’t this looking down on this Great Emperor a little too much?
He wasn’t like the True Dragon Emperor, who was recuperating from his injuries!
Ling Han shook his head, and directly left the city. Then, he began to refine the Celestial medicine.
He ingested the Celestial medicine, and instantly, Genesis Substance channeled inside his body, sending a streak of great dao soaring into the sky.
After he refined the Genesis Substance, the number of Regulations he could accommodate in his body reached as many as 50. Furthermore, the light of great dao had also become slightly thicker.
The change was not very obvious, but it had indeed improved slightly.
A smile appeared on Ling Han’s face. He had profited greatly this time.
Though he still did not know how much might the light of great dao could ultimately unleash, this level was very possibly superior to Regulations.

chapters.title: Chapter 4760: Joint Challenge
paragraphs: The Nine Star Regulations were supreme, and the Eight Star Regulations could not be intertwined at all.
Thankfully, Ling Han had grasped the light of great dao. This was very possibly an existence that surpassed Regulations, giving Ling Han the possibility to challenge a higher level.

At present, he was still no match for a Pseudo-Emperor. However, when he grasped some more eight-star Regulations, he might be able to. After all, even a Pseudo-Emperor had only touched a corner of Nine Star Regulations.
And added with the light of great dao?
Ling Han believed that he even had a chance of defeating a Pseudo-Emperor.

As for this, hehe, he would find out when he sparred with Buddha Doga and the others in the future. As many as three Pseudo-Emperors would become his sparring partners; aside from Ling Han, there was no one else who could have that in this world.
What made Ling Han frown was whether there were Pseudo-Emperors as well on the side of the Lands of Death.

For example, Little Ye. He had appeared out of thin air, and had never been heard of before. In fact, even the Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters of the Lands of Death did not know of such an existence.
It could be seen that the Lords of Death favored him, allowing him to obtain the Genesis Worlds from Origin and the others. Thus, he could use Destructive Energy.
Why didn’t the Lords of Death take it?
Perhaps... they were no longer living beings, and had no way to accommodate the Genesis World.
Ling Han frowned. Little Ye was extremely strange. Could it be that he had also come from the Primitive Abyss? Otherwise, he had really never seen anyone who could control time.
—Even Pseudo-Emperors like Buddha Doga could not do it.
Ling Han returned to the Azure Phoenix City. Although the competition had already ended, if he still stayed here shamelessly, naturally, no one would chase him away.
His target was the sword in Mo Ziyun’s hand, but the others didn’t know. Seeing that he didn’t want to leave, they only thought that he had feelings for Mo Ziyun, so they were naturally all furious.
You pervert, using underhanded means to defeat Mo Ziyun, could it be that you really want Goddess Mo to fulfill the bet?
This was too shameless.
Obviously, Mo Ziyun’s popularity in the Azure Phoenix City was considerably high. Now, when everyone saw Ling Han, they first humphed, then spat.
This!
Ling Han felt gloomy. It was clearly little girl Mo that had caused this misunderstanding, so why was it that he was the only one to bear the consequences?
He decided that when it was time to snatch the sword, he would definitely give Mo Ziyun a good spanking to vent his anger.
Er, in any case, they would not be able to find him, so there was no need for him to worry about exposing his identity.

If the large black dog and the others were here, they would definitely point out, ’Is there any other freakish guy like you in this world? Could you put on a false face, or could you fake your abilities?’

Buddha Doga and the others arrived. Because the competition had already ended, it was about time for them to leave. After all, there was a Great Emperor watching over this place. How could they not be on tenterhooks when they were doing things right under the nose of this Great Emperor?
This had nothing to do with cowardice or courage, but rather caution.
Meanwhile, Ling Han had the three Pseudo-Emperors leave first; he still had to stay for a few more days.
"Yi, could it be that you really have feelings for that little girl?" Xia Houping asked with a smile.
Ling Han was speechless. This news had already spread to the point that even the three Pseudo-Emperors knew?
Rumors!
He shook his head, and said, "That person has a Spirit Tool. I think there’s a need to study it."
After some discussion, the three Pseudo-Emperors decided to leave first, and continue to scout ahead. They would come back in a few days.
Originally, the Primitive Abyss was completely desolate, so why would there be cities?
Thus, the three Pseudo-Emperors all wanted to investigate just how these thirty six Divine Beasts came to be, and why did they insist on overseeing this area?
Meanwhile, Ling Han continued to inquire about Mo Ziyun’s residence, planning to knock her out as soon as possible, snatch her sword and leave. He couldn’t be bothered to waste time.
However, in the Azure Phoenix City, everyone treated him like a perverted evil spirit, and no one was willing to tell him Mo Ziyun’s whereabouts.
Thus, Ling Han felt like he was a rat that everyone wanted to beat up. His image had already been ruined to the extreme.
"Fortunately... that is the Ninth King, and has nothing to do with me!" Ling Han murmured to himself.
However, before he could find out Mo Ziyun’s whereabouts, he had already drawn public indignation.
—Aside from the Azure Phoenix City and True Dragon City, the remaining seven trump cards of the Great Emperors joined forces to issue a challenge to Ling Han.
He would either have to get out of the Azure Phoenix City himself, or they would make him get out.
Ya, was Mo Ziyun really that popular?
Ling Han definitely wouldn’t leave the Azure Phoenix City. He was extremely curious about that sword—why did it also possess the unique trait of Destructive Energy?
Since you guys are so determined to seek a beating, I will oblige you.
Ling Han accepted the letter of challenge.
The next day, he arrived at the small plaza in the city.
This actually couldn’t be considered a plaza. It was just that this place was relatively empty, and as time passed, it was used as a plaza.
If they fought here, it was fine. The structure of the Primitive Abyss was too sturdy. To say nothing of the fact that Saints could not damage it, even Great Emperors could not.
How could the place where heaven and earth began be anything ordinary?
When Ling Han arrived, not only were the seven trump cards already waiting there, but even many citizens of the city had come, looking to be in high spirits.
When they discovered that Ling Han had come over, the commoners all booed.
Was there a need to do this?
Ling Han shook his head. Was Mo Ziyun’s popularity really that high?
He naturally wouldn’t care. Amidst everyone’s cheers, he walked to the center of the plaza.
"Ninth, I really can’t help but admire your courage!" Luoyi Xingxiao said. He deliberately emphasized the words "Ninth", obviously still fixated on his "debate" with Ling Han previously.
Ling Han wore a playful smile, and said, "Enough with the nonsense. Let’s battle! Are you guys going to fight me one by one, or all at once?"
"You’re indeed arrogant!" An Heming said coldly. "However, you’re far too naive to try to provoke us into a one-on-one battle!"
No matter what, Ling Han was the champion of this tournament. Theoretically speaking, he was invincible in a one-on-one battle. Thus, it was reasonable for them to gang up on him.
Most importantly, there were no rules here, as long as no one was killed or crippled.
Xiu, a figure flew over, her white robes fluttering. It was Mo Ziyun.
Obviously, with such a big event happening, how could she, the local tyrant of Azure Phoenix City, not have discovered it?
When they saw Mo Ziyun, even these trump cards’ eyes lit up.
Ling Han also stared at Mo Ziyun. This little girl was always unwilling to appear, causing him to search everywhere. This time, he definitely could not allow her to escape.
"How dare you!" Seeing that Ling Han actually dared to stare at Mo Ziyun, the seven trump cards were all furious.
"Sigh, I’ve already told you guys to speak less nonsense. Don’t waste time. Hurry up and make your move," Ling Han said with a smile, looking disdainful.
This enraged the seven trump cards. To look down on them like this, he really had no concept of proper behaviour.
"Hehe, this Ninth of the True Dragon City is really arrogant!"
"It can’t be helped. He’s the new champion of the martial arts competition, so it’s normal for him to be a little arrogant."

"Hmph, in the first round, it was because he sacrificed his Senior Brothers. In the knockout battles, he first messed up Luoyi Xingxiao’s mind, then used despicable means to instill wariness in Lady Mo so she could not go all out. All his victories were not honourable at all!"
"This kind of person... where did he get his true abilities from?"
The spectators discussed spiritedly, all of them thinking that Ling Han’s first place was very undeserved.

sentences.text: The Nine Star Regulations were supreme, and the Eight Star Regulations could not be intertwined at all.
Thankfully, Ling Han had grasped the light of great dao.
This was very possibly an existence that surpassed Regulations, giving Ling Han the possibility to challenge a higher level.
At present, he was still no match for a Pseudo-Emperor.
However, when he grasped some more eight-star Regulations, he might be able to.
After all, even a Pseudo-Emperor had only touched a corner of Nine Star Regulations.
And added with the light of great dao?
Ling Han believed that he even had a chance of defeating a Pseudo-Emperor.
As for this, hehe, he would find out when he sparred with Buddha Doga and the others in the future.
As many as three Pseudo-Emperors would become his sparring partners; aside from Ling Han, there was no one else who could have that in this world.
What made Ling Han frown was whether there were Pseudo-Emperors as well on the side of the Lands of Death.
For example, Little Ye.
He had appeared out of thin air, and had never been heard of before.
In fact, even the Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters of the Lands of Death did not know of such an existence.
It could be seen that the Lords of Death favored him, allowing him to obtain the Genesis Worlds from Origin and the others.
Thus, he could use Destructive Energy.
Why didn’t the Lords of Death take it?
Perhaps... they were no longer living beings, and had no way to accommodate the Genesis World.
Ling Han frowned.
Little Ye was extremely strange.
Could it be that he had also come from the Primitive Abyss?
Otherwise, he had really never seen anyone who could control time.
—Even Pseudo-Emperors like Buddha Doga could not do it.
Ling Han returned to the Azure Phoenix City.
Although the competition had already ended, if he still stayed here shamelessly, naturally, no one would chase him away.
His target was the sword in Mo Ziyun’s hand, but the others didn’t know.
Seeing that he didn’t want to leave, they only thought that he had feelings for Mo Ziyun, so they were naturally all furious.
You pervert, using underhanded means to defeat Mo Ziyun, could it be that you really want Goddess Mo to fulfill the bet?
This was too shameless.
Obviously, Mo Ziyun’s popularity in the Azure Phoenix City was considerably high.
Now, when everyone saw Ling Han, they first humphed, then spat.
This!
Ling Han felt gloomy.
It was clearly little girl Mo that had caused this misunderstanding, so why was it that he was the only one to bear the consequences?
He decided that when it was time to snatch the sword, he would definitely give Mo Ziyun a good spanking to vent his anger.
Er, in any case, they would not be able to find him, so there was no need for him to worry about exposing his identity.
If the large black dog and the others were here, they would definitely point out, ’Is there any other freakish guy like you in this world?
Could you put on a false face, or could you fake your abilities?’
Buddha Doga and the others arrived.
Because the competition had already ended, it was about time for them to leave.
After all, there was a Great Emperor watching over this place.
How could they not be on tenterhooks when they were doing things right under the nose of this Great Emperor?
This had nothing to do with cowardice or courage, but rather caution.
Meanwhile, Ling Han had the three Pseudo-Emperors leave first; he still had to stay for a few more days.
"Yi, could it be that you really have feelings for that little girl?" Xia Houping asked with a smile.
Ling Han was speechless.
This news had already spread to the point that even the three Pseudo-Emperors knew?
Rumors!
He shook his head, and said, "That person has a Spirit Tool.
I think there’s a need to study it."
After some discussion, the three Pseudo-Emperors decided to leave first, and continue to scout ahead.
They would come back in a few days.
Originally, the Primitive Abyss was completely desolate, so why would there be cities?
Thus, the three Pseudo-Emperors all wanted to investigate just how these thirty six Divine Beasts came to be, and why did they insist on overseeing this area?
Meanwhile, Ling Han continued to inquire about Mo Ziyun’s residence, planning to knock her out as soon as possible, snatch her sword and leave.
He couldn’t be bothered to waste time.
However, in the Azure Phoenix City, everyone treated him like a perverted evil spirit, and no one was willing to tell him Mo Ziyun’s whereabouts.
Thus, Ling Han felt like he was a rat that everyone wanted to beat up.
His image had already been ruined to the extreme.
"Fortunately... that is the Ninth King, and has nothing to do with me!" Ling Han murmured to himself.
However, before he could find out Mo Ziyun’s whereabouts, he had already drawn public indignation.
—Aside from the Azure Phoenix City and True Dragon City, the remaining seven trump cards of the Great Emperors joined forces to issue a challenge to Ling Han.
He would either have to get out of the Azure Phoenix City himself, or they would make him get out.
Ya, was Mo Ziyun really that popular?
Ling Han definitely wouldn’t leave the Azure Phoenix City.
He was extremely curious about that sword—why did it also possess the unique trait of Destructive Energy?
Since you guys are so determined to seek a beating, I will oblige you.
Ling Han accepted the letter of challenge.
The next day, he arrived at the small plaza in the city.
This actually couldn’t be considered a plaza.
It was just that this place was relatively empty, and as time passed, it was used as a plaza.
If they fought here, it was fine.
The structure of the Primitive Abyss was too sturdy.
To say nothing of the fact that Saints could not damage it, even Great Emperors could not.
How could the place where heaven and earth began be anything ordinary?
When Ling Han arrived, not only were the seven trump cards already waiting there, but even many citizens of the city had come, looking to be in high spirits.
When they discovered that Ling Han had come over, the commoners all booed.
Was there a need to do this?
Ling Han shook his head.
Was Mo Ziyun’s popularity really that high?
He naturally wouldn’t care.
Amidst everyone’s cheers, he walked to the center of the plaza.
"Ninth, I really can’t help but admire your courage!" Luoyi Xingxiao said.
He deliberately emphasized the words "Ninth", obviously still fixated on his "debate" with Ling Han previously.

Let’s battle!
Are you guys going to fight me one by one, or all at once?"
"You’re indeed arrogant!" An Heming said coldly.
"However, you’re far too naive to try to provoke us into a one-on-one battle!"
No matter what, Ling Han was the champion of this tournament.
Theoretically speaking, he was invincible in a one-on-one battle.
Thus, it was reasonable for them to gang up on him.
Most importantly, there were no rules here, as long as no one was killed or crippled.

chapters.title: Chapter 4761: Like cutting straws
paragraphs: No one was optimistic about Ling Han, even if he was the champion this time.
On his way here, there had been too much controversy.
How could the masses convinced with such empty victories?
Only Mo Ziyun did not think so. She was the one who had personally exchanged blows with Ling Han, and was more willing to accept the truth than Luoyi Xingxiao.
However, if the seven trump cards joined forces, would Ling Han still have a chance of winning?
She was also very concerned, and stood at the sidelines, watching quietly.

"Ninth, it would be better for you to return to the Azure Dragon City and cultivate for a few more years!" Luoyi Xingxiao strongly emphasized "Ninth" again, and led the charge, heading towards Ling Han.
Boom!
This time, he no longer focused his energy on arguing with Ling Han about who should be the "Senior Brother". He was like a primal ferocious beast that had charged out, his aura astonishing.
Each of the trump cards was a Nine-Star Saint, and they were the most outstanding among them at that. Their battle prowess far surpassed ordinary Nine-Star Saints.
Xiu, xiu, xiu! An Heming and the others also charged over.
They didn’t mind battling seven against one at all. This wasn’t a sparring match.
Ling Han smiled, and charged towards the seven great trump cards.
"Hiss!"
"This guy is really outrageously bold!"
"It’s a one-on-seven battle, yet he still dares to attack?"
"Does he really think that just because he has gotten first place, he would be able to sweep aside all opposition in Saint Tier?"
"Hehe, even if he is the strongest of Saints, he could not possibly match the combined forces of seven trump cards!"
"He’s asking for a beating."
The spectators all shook their heads. Even if Ling Han was really the number one Saint, he should still focus on circling around the seven great trump cards, defeating them one by one.
To rashly charge into enemy lines like Ling Han was, was he complaining that he wasn’t losing fast enough?
"Sigh, after all, he’s all young."
"It is inevitable that a young man would be overwhelmed in his success."
"F*ck!"
However, when everyone was still chattering, they suddenly saw an inconceivable scene.
—Human figures flew through the air like straws.
Those were the seven trump cards!
Ling Han barged through, and wherever he passed, there was no one that could match him. They were all sent flying.
This!

Those were seven trump cards, top grade nine-star Saints. Even if there was someone that could surpass them, they would only be slightly superior, at most. How could they possibly sweep aside all opposition like he was doing now?
If they didn’t know that these seven people were trump cards, they would have thought that they were just cats and dogs. They were completely weaklings in battle.
Mo Ziyun’s small mouth was also wide open, completely unable to close.
She knew that Ling Han’s strength was superior to hers, but how could he possibly be strong to this extent?
Are you even human?
Peng! Peng! Peng!
Though Ling Han hadn’t gone all out, even without using the power of belief, the number of Regulations he could use had still reached as many as fifty. Just how overwhelming was this?
"Haha, after refining the Genesis-level Celestial medicine, my divine arts have reached Great Accomplishment level, and I am invincible in this world!" he called out, forcibly explaining.
Everyone broke out in a cold sweat. Could this kind of battle prowess be f****** forged by a Celestial medicine?
’Are you lying through your teeth?!’

However, Ling Han was really too powerful. One punch after another, no one could withstand a single blow from him, blasting the seven great trump cards like they were straws dancing wildly in the wind.
"Don’t let him defeat you one by one!" An Heming shouted. "Let’s work together!"
"All right!"

The seven trump cards didn’t dare to be careless anymore. After being beaten so badly by Ling Han, they finally realized that though Ling Han was despicable and vulgar, his abilities were still very strong, and chillingly strong at that.
But this guy’s abilities were clearly so strong, so why did he still use such a despicable and vulgar method to win?
"Hah!"
The seven trump cards finally joined forces, and attacked in unison.
Though they had also attacked together just now, they had each fought on their own, as if they were scattered sand.

It couldn’t be helped. They were all trump cards, and thought that they were not inferior to Ling Han in a one-on-one battle. It was already very embarrassing for them to attack together, so what need was there for them to cooperate well?
However, they now knew that Ling Han was too strong, so strong that they had to cooperate well. Otherwise, they would really be defeated by Ling Han.
Boom! The truly violent attack finally arrived.
Everyone turned pale as they watched, especially the Saints. They were very clear how terrifying this attack was.
With a single strike, a Saint could be insta-killed!
How was Ling Han supposed to block this?
This time, the seven trump cards were going all out.
Ling Han smiled faintly, completely unconcerned. He merely shot out a very ordinary punch.
This punch was very ordinary, but it was incredibly smooth, and matched the charm of the Dao of Heaven and Earth.
Peng!
It was only a single strike, and the seven great trump cards were all sent flying like fireworks.
What!
Seeing this scene, everyone’s eyes widened, as if they had seen a ghost. Their hair was about to stand on end.

Peng, peng, peng! The seven trump cards all collapsed to the ground. Although they weren’t severely wounded, the seven of them still couldn’t withstand a single strike from Ling Han. How could they not feel despair?
This was too terrifying.
How could there be such a monster?
All of a sudden, a dead silence fell. This kind of battle prowess was like a sudden strike of lightning on flat ground, shocking everyone.
"Still want to fight?" Ling Han asked calmly.
These words were not spoken very loudly, but it caused everyone’s hearts to tremble.

The seven trump cards were all silent. What was the point of continuing the battle? The seven of them had joined forces, yet were still sent flying with a single punch. Unless their heads had been kicked by a donkey, they would not think of fighting Ling Han again.
Ling Han looked towards Mo Ziyun and couldn’t help but feel gloomy. This little girl wasn’t wearing a Battle Armor, so she naturally hadn’t brought the sword he wanted.
Damn it, was he again not allowed to snatch it from her?
"Junior Sister Mo, let’s have a chat," Ling Han said with a smile, striding over.
Mo Ziyun couldn’t help but feel her heart palpitate. Ling Han was too strong, so strong that the defense in her heart crumbled with a single strike.
An exquisite prodigy like her could not possibly fall in love, because even if it was a prodigy of about the same standard, in her eyes, it was only "barely", so how could she possibly be moved?
But now?
Ling Han’s appearance directly shattered her defenses. His battle prowess was so strong that she was instantly conquered.
"All right." She nodded gently, like an obedient little wife.
This!
Everyone felt suffocated as they watched. It was obvious that such a beautiful flower was about to be snatched.
"Let’s go to your quarters," Ling Han suggested.
"En." Mo Ziyun nodded again.
Seeing the two of them leave side by side, everyone was filled with envy, jealousy, and hatred.
As long as one wasn’t blind, one could tell that Mo Ziyun had already developed great fondness for Ling Han. Then, what would a man and woman do alone in the same room?
Damn it!
However, after witnessing Ling Han’s terrifying battle prowess, who would dare to "save the damsel in distress"?
Moreover, if anyone stepped forwards, the beauty would be the first to flip out.
Sigh!
Everyone shook their heads. There was nothing they could do about it. This was consensual, so whoever stepped forwards would only be asking for a beating.

On the other side, Ling Han and Mo Ziyun walked together, and very soon, arrived at her quarters. Though this was also an incredibly simple and crude house, it had been tidied up by Mo Ziyun, so it was exuding an elegant aura.
However, Ling Han’s intentions did not lie here. He released his divine sense to sense the location of the sword.
"Senior Brother!" Mo Ziyun whispered softly, her pretty face flushed, captivating one’s soul.

chapters.title: Chapter 4762: Black light within the sword
paragraphs: Found it!
Ling Han smiled faintly, and said to Mo Ziyun, "Junior Sister, come here."
Was he going to kiss hwe?
Mo Ziyun couldn’t help but feel like her heart was beating wildly. Should she act shy, or should she be more proactive?
Oh no, she didn’t know what type Senior Brother liked.
She slowly approached, yet saw Ling Han’s palm strike slash over. Peng, she instantly felt her consciousness rapidly dim.
Yi, did Senior Brother like the type that lies down and doesn’t move?
What a hardcore taste!
This was the last thought that streaked through her mind. Then, she completely lost consciousness.
Ling Han laughed loudly, and laid Mo Ziyun against the wall. Meanwhile, he entered her rooms and found the sword.
After some thought, he also took away Mo Ziyun’s Silver Battle Armor while he was at it.
He immediately left the city and found the three Pseudo-Emperors and the others, then left the Primitive Abyss.
Though Ling Han could accommodate stars in his body, that still placed some pressure on him, after all. He couldn’t keep them like this forever, right?
Release them here?
Then these stars would definitely be destroyed immediately; how could they possibly sustain the extreme weight of gravity from the Primitive Abyss?
Thus, everyone left first.
But this time, they encountered multiple energy storms, and here and there, they waited for seven years, before finally arriving at the Azure Dragon City.
Here, everything was peaceful.
Had the news of the deaths of the Great Emperor’s disciples not transmitted over, or had it been transmitted over, yet everyone did not care?
They snuck into the Azure Dragon City, and the city was also completely peaceful, as if nothing had happened at all.
With the True Dragon Emperor holding down the fort, they wouldn’t be afraid even if the sky collapsed.
Ling Han and the others didn’t find this strange. A Great Emperor was the strongest existence in the world, and with a Great Emperor as overseer, the situation was naturally stable.

However, Ling Han hadn’t been present at the time, so he didn’t know that the True Dragon Emperor had actually been killed by the Great Emperor Senluo. Otherwise, all of them would have definitely gone numb with shock.
A dead Great Emperor... had actually come back to life?
How could such a thing happen?
Because they didn’t know, Ling Han and the others instead felt that this was only natural.
They exited the Dragon Head City and experienced several storms of heaven and earth on their way. Finally, they exited the Primitive Abyss.
Ling Han released the three stars in his body. Instantly, he felt relaxed, as if even his battle prowess had increased slightly.
In that case... should he take out the Genesis World as well?
Ling Han had always had this thought. A star could not match the crushing power of this great universe, but dimensions should be able to, because every dimension was no weaker than the Venerate Tier.
He began to experiment. Though this would cause him to lose the power of belief, at his current height, did he still need the power of belief?
It was only worth five stars of battle prowess.
Moreover, Ling Han had a feeling that if he truly wanted to become the strongest, he would need to strip the Genesis World from his body.
—What elite had relied on the power of others to become invincible in this world?
At the same time that Genesis World helped him, wasn’t it also a burden on his body?
He would make a decision when the time came!
He began to make an attempt. He didn’t bring out the entire Genesis World, but only one of the dimensions.
Under his continuous strengthening, the dimensions inside his body were all transcendent leve, which was equivalent to an Eighth Tier Heavenly Venerate.
Hence, if this was taken out, it would definitely be able to resist the compression of the great world.
This wasn’t difficult. Ling Han quickly took out this dimension.
Weng! The pressure of heaven and earth instantly surged over, yearning to crush this dimension.
However, the dimension itself was equivalent to an Eighth Tier Heavenly Venerate, so it naturally withstood this kind of pressure, and soon stabilized.
Ling Han guided it appropriately, allowing the power of heaven and earth to flow in, and also allowing this dimension to slowly integrate into the great world.
One day, two days, three days, everything was stable.
That was enough.

Ling Han revealed a smile. In this way, he would no longer need to use his divine sense to "meet" Liu Yutong and the other beautiful wives. Instead, he would be able to truly communicate with them face-to-face.

Furthermore, after entering into this great world, everyone could use the cultivation techniques of this great world to cultivate, and everyone could break through the limits of Heavenly Venerable Tier.
The only problem was that this dimension wasn’t very big. Even the entire dimension was only the size of a grain of sand.
Er, this was a small problem.

Ling Han retrieved dimensions one after another from his body. The second dimension was the dimension that Liu Yutong and the other wives and descendants were in. When this dimension appeared, he finally met his parents and the others.
After spending a whole three years, Ling Han finally took out all the dimensions. Then, he felt an unprecedented relaxation.

It was just like how he had previously been burdened with the identity of the ruler of the Genesis World. This was a supreme position, but at the same time, it was also a responsibility. Now, he had lost the power of belief of the dimensions inside him, but had also obtained true freedom.
From now onwards, he no longer had to bear the fate of others.
"And now, my mind is finally cleared."

Ling Han smiled. He had never coveted power. Thus, while others might envy his identity as the Genesis World’s overlord, he didn’t care at all. If it weren’t because he had to do it to save their lives, he wouldn’t have taken on this responsibility.
Boom! He stretched out his hand, only to see that his fist was still enshrouded in Destructive Energy. This didn’t disappear just because the dimensions had left his body.
"Very good. As long as the Destructive Energy hasn’t disappeared, I’ll still have a powerful weapon."
Ling Han took out Mo Ziyun’s sword and began to study it.
Previously, he had suddenly had an idea, and brought out the dimensions in his body. He had forgotten about this sword.

He studied it carefully, and sure enough, the destructive power of this sword was boundless. It possessed about the same traits as the Destructive Energy. However, the two were different, but exactly what was different, Ling Han couldn’t put his finger on.
It was as if the two were born from the same mother. They were very similar, but even blood brothers would have a lot of differences.
He could think of no better analogy.
"Let’s dismantle it and see."

Ling Han began to dismantle his sword. This was a Saintly Material, and logically speaking, Saints would also have to draw on the power of heaven and earth to slowly refine it. It would be very, very difficult to damage it by force.
But in Ling Han’s hands, this was no big deal.
Under his dismantling, this sword soon turned into pieces. Then, multiple thin streaks of black light rose up, and rapidly disappeared.
Ling Han tried his best to capture it, storing it in his mind.
Weng, the light of great dao shone with blazing brilliance, and actually took the initiative to attack these black lights.
Even though there was pitifully little light of great dao, compared to these fine black lights, it was still a colossal existence.
The thin black light couldn’t block it at all!
Ling Han hurriedly stepped forward to protect it. However, the light of great dao shone down on him, and the thin black light was like snow, rapidly disappearing.

Ling Han cursed in his mind. However, with a thought, boom, the Destructive Energy instantly combusted in his mind. At this moment, the thin black light seemed to have seen its birth parents, and immediately surged over, fusing with the Destructive Energy.
This time, even the light of great dao couldn’t do anything. It could only confront the Destructive Energy head-on.

sentences.text: Found it!
Ling Han smiled faintly, and said to Mo Ziyun, "Junior Sister, come here."
Was he going to kiss hwe?
Mo Ziyun couldn’t help but feel like her heart was beating wildly.
Should she act shy, or should she be more proactive?
Oh no, she didn’t know what type Senior Brother liked.
She slowly approached, yet saw Ling Han’s palm strike slash over.
Peng, she instantly felt her consciousness rapidly dim.
Yi, did Senior Brother like the type that lies down and doesn’t move?
What a hardcore taste!
This was the last thought that streaked through her mind.
Then, she completely lost consciousness.
Ling Han laughed loudly, and laid Mo Ziyun against the wall.
Meanwhile, he entered her rooms and found the sword.
After some thought, he also took away Mo Ziyun’s Silver Battle Armor while he was at it.
He immediately left the city and found the three Pseudo-Emperors and the others, then left the Primitive Abyss.
Though Ling Han could accommodate stars in his body, that still placed some pressure on him, after all.
He couldn’t keep them like this forever, right?
Release them here?
Then these stars would definitely be destroyed immediately; how could they possibly sustain the extreme weight of gravity from the Primitive Abyss?
Thus, everyone left first.
But this time, they encountered multiple energy storms, and here and there, they waited for seven years, before finally arriving at the Azure Dragon City.
Here, everything was peaceful.
Had the news of the deaths of the Great Emperor’s disciples not transmitted over, or had it been transmitted over, yet everyone did not care?
They snuck into the Azure Dragon City, and the city was also completely peaceful, as if nothing had happened at all.
With the True Dragon Emperor holding down the fort, they wouldn’t be afraid even if the sky collapsed.
Ling Han and the others didn’t find this strange.
A Great Emperor was the strongest existence in the world, and with a Great Emperor as overseer, the situation was naturally stable.
However, Ling Han hadn’t been present at the time, so he didn’t know that the True Dragon Emperor had actually been killed by the Great Emperor Senluo.
Otherwise, all of them would have definitely gone numb with shock.
A dead Great Emperor... had actually come back to life?
How could such a thing happen?
Because they didn’t know, Ling Han and the others instead felt that this was only natural.
They exited the Dragon Head City and experienced several storms of heaven and earth on their way.
Finally, they exited the Primitive Abyss.
Ling Han released the three stars in his body.
Instantly, he felt relaxed, as if even his battle prowess had increased slightly.
In that case... should he take out the Genesis World as well?
Ling Han had always had this thought.
A star could not match the crushing power of this great universe, but dimensions should be able to, because every dimension was no weaker than the Venerate Tier.
He began to experiment.
Though this would cause him to lose the power of belief, at his current height, did he still need the power of belief?
It was only worth five stars of battle prowess.
Moreover, Ling Han had a feeling that if he truly wanted to become the strongest, he would need to strip the Genesis World from his body.
—What elite had relied on the power of others to become invincible in this world?
At the same time that Genesis World helped him, wasn’t it also a burden on his body?
He would make a decision when the time came!
He began to make an attempt.
He didn’t bring out the entire Genesis World, but only one of the dimensions.
Under his continuous strengthening, the dimensions inside his body were all transcendent leve, which was equivalent to an Eighth Tier Heavenly Venerate.
Hence, if this was taken out, it would definitely be able to resist the compression of the great world.
This wasn’t difficult.
Ling Han quickly took out this dimension.
Weng!
The pressure of heaven and earth instantly surged over, yearning to crush this dimension.
However, the dimension itself was equivalent to an Eighth Tier Heavenly Venerate, so it naturally withstood this kind of pressure, and soon stabilized.
Ling Han guided it appropriately, allowing the power of heaven and earth to flow in, and also allowing this dimension to slowly integrate into the great world.
One day, two days, three days, everything was stable.
That was enough.
Ling Han revealed a smile.
In this way, he would no longer need to use his divine sense to "meet" Liu Yutong and the other beautiful wives.
Instead, he would be able to truly communicate with them face-to-face.

Furthermore, after entering into this great world, everyone could use the cultivation techniques of this great world to cultivate, and everyone could break through the limits of Heavenly Venerable Tier.

chapters.title: Chapter 4763: Matching Pseudo-Emperor?
paragraphs: Yi?
Ling Han was surprised. When the thin black light fused into the Destructive Energy, a subtle change actually took place in the Destructive Energy.
Originally, even if this was of the same origin as Destructive Energy, because of the slight difference, merging should not have been possible.

However, the current situation was special. The thin black light was facing the great danger of being destroyed by the light of great dao, so it could only be forced to fuse into the Destructive Energy.
At this moment, Ling Han once again saw the Dao of Heaven and Earth.
It was as if he were his own body, and he himself was heaven and earth.
—This Dao of Heaven and Earth was in his mind.
In this great dao, Ling Han saw creation and destruction, life and death, which evolved endless mysteries.
But it was only an instant, and this Dao of Heaven and Earth had disappeared.
Ling Han couldn’t help but feel disappointed and frustrated, feeling extremely terrible.
In comparison, the light of great dao in his mind didn’t live up to its name.
This was not yet qualified to be called the light of great dao. It was only a branch of great dao, at most.

"The true great dao includes creation, destruction, life, and death." Enlightenment dawned on Ling Han. This was an existence that had surpassed Regulations, and was the true cornerstone of heaven and earth.
"If I could grasp this kind of foundation stone of heaven and earth, would I be able to suppress even a Great Emperor?"
Ling Han’s heart beat wildly. The Great Emperor had only dealt with the Nine Star Regulations, but in the case of the Dao of Heaven and Earth... this could crush everything.

In fact, because the Great Emperor was being suppressed by the Dao of Heaven and Earth, there would even come a day when his lifespan would dry up. However, what if he was cultivating the Dao of Heaven and Earth itself?
Could he become immortal and indestructible?
Ling Han’s heart throbbed wildly. He felt that he may have found the correct way to achieve immortality.
It was no wonder that the Great Emperors had entered the Primitive Abyss in pursuit of immortality. The secret of the creation of heaven and earth was indeed hidden here.
And as for Ling Han, he was even luckier.

As the Genesis World’s ruler, it was equivalent to him naturally grasping the Destructive Energy. Otherwise, he wouldn’t have obtained the great dao light, and now, he couldn’t fuse with that tiny bit of black light.
All the coincidences allowed him to glimpse the Dao of Heaven and Earth.
"In other words, if I want to peek into the Dao of Heaven and Earth, I’ll need more Genesis Substance, or this kind of destructive substance."
However, this was something that could only be encountered but not sought. Obtaining even one was as difficult as ascending the heavens.
"I can’t rush things. I need to take things one step at a time."
Ling Han went to look for Buddha Doga.
"Senior, I would like to ask for some guidance," he said.
Buddha Doga couldn’t help but smile and nod. "Alright, I want to see just how far you are from Pseudo-Emperor."
The two of them arrived in space, and immediately began a fierce battle.
Buddha Doga deliberately controlled his battle prowess to avoid defeating Ling Han as soon as he started fighting.
Ling Han directly used 50 eight-star Regulations. After getting used to it, Buddha Doga also used his battle prowess to resist.
Hong! Hong! Hong!

Though their battle prowess had not reached Pseudo-Emperor-level, it had surpassed all Saints. Thus, it was very soon that Qian Yanghao and Xia Houping, these two Pseudo-Emperor-level beings were drawn over, followed by the large black dog, the empress and the others.
They naturally would not interfere, and merely watched the battle from the sidelines.
"Can Ling Han win?" Chi Menghan suddenly asked.
This!

Logically speaking, everyone thought that it was impossible for Ling Han to win. After all, his opponent was a Pseudo-Emperor! No matter how freakish Ling Han was, even if he was the strongest Saint of eternity, it was useless. With the word ’Emperor’ in the title, that meant a completely different level.
However, Ling Han had created too many miracles on his way here, so it was inevitable that people would feel hope again. What if?
What if he could stand against a Pseudo-Emperor?
However, Buddha Doga only exerted a slight bit of force, and Ling Han immediately fell into a disadvantage.
"You want to fight me with such measly abilities?" Buddha Doga asked calmly.
Ling Han chuckled. If he wanted to stand against a Pseudo-Emperor with fifty Eight Star Regulations, the idea was too naive.

He began to increase his power. Although he had transferred all the dimensions in his body out now, and lost the boost from the power of belief, his body had regained true freedom, which increased his battle prowess from another aspect.
Overall, his battle prowess should have been slightly weakened, but in the long run, this was indeed completely worth it.
Ling Han channelled Destructive Energy. Boom! As punches rained down, his destructive power soared.

Even someone as powerful as a Pseudo-Emperor didn’t dare to face Destructive Energy head-on with his physical body. Thus, Buddha Doga had no choice but to increase the distance between them, using long-distance attacks to disperse Destructive Energy.
In this way, he was naturally safe. However, it also greatly decreased the pressure he exerted on Ling Han.
Hence, he had no choice but to increase his battle prowess further, so that he could maintain the suppression on Ling Han.
"As expected of the number one prodigy of all eternity," Qian Yanghao and Xia Houping both said with a nod. They were filled with praise for Ling Han.

They had all come from Saints, and now that they had advanced into the level of Pseudo-Emperor, they were very clear about the battle prowess of Saints, and just how far the gap was between them and Pseudo-Emperor.
It was precisely because of this that they were so stunned. Just how terrifying was Ling Han’s battle prowess?
However, as Buddha Doga increased his power further, Ling Han was once again embroiled in a tough battle, swaying on the verge of defeat.
This was naturally a deliberate move by Buddha Doga, who wanted to accurately calculate Ling Han’s battle prowess.
Ling Han shouted loudly, and the light of great dao also channelled out. Boom, his battle prowess instantly increased greatly again.

Right now, the majority of Imperial Techniques were already useless to him. He had already created his own path, and each and every move was profound and mysterious. In fact, he had even glimpsed the traces of great dao, and every move he made had the charm of heaven and earth fusing together.
Buddha Doga couldn’t help but exclaim in surprise. This light of great dao was an attack style that he had never seen before, and it gave him a slight shock.
But that was all.
Buddha Doga’s attacks became even more powerful, yet he was still able to suppress Ling Han.

Though Ling Han still had trump cards, such as the holy flame and the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, the holy flame was used to fight only in desperate straits, while the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower was an external object. It was not his own strength, so it was naturally not suitable to be used.
After Ling Han battled for a while longer, he took the initiative to admit defeat.
"You’ve now grasped fifty eight-star Regulations?" After Ling Han revealed everything, the three Pseudo-Emperors were all extremely shocked.
Fifty, that was too terrifying.
It should be known that Ling Han was presently only a Three Star Saint!
Then what was this guy’s limit?
"Judging from your current battle prowess, you’ll probably possess Pseudo-Emperor-level battle prowess when you grasp 70 eight-star Regulations," Buddha Doga said.
Ling Han nodded. That was why a Pseudo-Emperor was so powerful.

Saints, even if they were the son of a Great Emperor, and were extremely talented, at nine stars, they would only be able to grasp around thirty eight-star Regulations at most, which was ridiculously far from seventy.
Furthermore, without the light of great dao and Destructive Energy, even if he could really grasp seventy eight-star Regulations, he would not be able to match a Pseudo-Emperor.
This also indirectly proved the strength of a Pseudo-Emperor.
As for Ling Han?
Even without the Genesis Substance, it would still be a piece of cake for him to master 70 eight-star Regulations even if he had to go through Silent Destruction four times.
He was the most powerful Saint in all of history, and he truly lived up to his name.

chapters.title: Chapter 4764: Reappearance of the Nine Disciples
paragraphs: After this battle, Ling Han also gained a complete understanding of his own strength.
The three Pseudo-Emperors did not hold anything back either. They each related their respective experiences of breaking through to the level of Pseudo-Emperor.
This was definitely priceless!
Although Pseudo-Emperor still had the word ’Pseudo’, even so, throughout history, there were not many such existences.
This path of advancement was really, really too difficult.
And now, there was someone there to give Ling Han an explanation. Just how great of a help was this?
Ling Han wouldn’t take the same path as these three Pseudo-Emperors. However, he could avoid the wrong turns that these three Pseudo-Emperors had taken. This would save him a lot of time.

In truth, there were also differences in battle prowess among Pseudo-Emperors. However, because there were really, really too few people that could attain the level of Pseudo-Emperor, so the level of Pseudo-Emperor was not further divided into sub-levels, unlike the level of Saint Tier, which was differentiated into levels of One to Nine Stars.

If it was just Buddha Doga and the other two, it should be Buddha Doga that was the strongest. However, compared to Qian Yanghao and Xia Houping, he was not much stronger. This was practically an instinctive feeling. There was no need to compare, as they each knew their own measure.
But if it was really a mortal duel, then this kind of strength may not become the basis for whichever side would survive.
That was because a battle of this level was too delicate. Even the slightest difference in reaction speed could possibly affect the final result.
Again, who would be weaker than the other among those who could become Emperor?
It was the same for Pseudo-Emperors.
What was his next plan?
Going back to plunder Yin souls?
Ling Han shook his head. This trip would take at least 200 years, and to return here again, it would be 400 years. Where would he get so much time to waste?
Moreover, if he didn’t become Emperor, what was the point of going back? If he encountered the Lords of Death, he would still have to flee with his tail between his legs.
Thus, it would be better to train here.
Then... should he enter into the Primitive Abyss again?
This seemed to be the only option. Otherwise, what could he do in this dark, boundless space?
There were only three planets.
Before Ling Han could enter into the Primitive Abyss, he saw Ding Shu, Jing Haoran, and Shui Qingchang return.
They had finally succeeded, and could now hold a planet with their bodies!

This was a piece of good news. When Buddha Doga and the others found out, they decided to go through the trouble and make a few more trips. They would bring Ding Shu and the others to bring more planets over.

With how big the universe was, it would take more than a little time for the Netherworld to invade this place. However, 99% of the stars in the entire universe were gathered in one-ten-thousandth of this area, or even one-ten-hundred-millionth of this area.
Thus, in terms of planets alone, the Living Realm had practically fallen completely.
There was no time to lose. Buddha Doga and the others each took one Genesis World’s ruler with them, and left respectively.
In the next few thousand years, the three of them would probably be busy with this matter.
Ling Han pondered for a moment before deciding to enter the Primitive Abyss again.
Only the Genesis Substance could allow him to rapidly increase his cultivation level, and only this thing could allow Ling Han to reach the height of being able to absorb 99 eight-star Regulations.
—With another twenty Regulations, he would be able to reach the battle prowess of Pseudo-Emperor.
This filled Ling Han with motivation. When he reached this level, he would truly be the strongest Saint in history.
Capable of standing against a Pseudo-Emperor!

Brother Monkey, the large black dog, and the little azure dragon all set off together, entering the Primitive Abyss with Ling Han. After a proper discussion, everyone set out.

They journeyed cautiously. Even if it was only the first passage, aside from Ling Han, there was still no one that could be careless. At the slightest provocation, they would be severely injured by the shockwave, or even die.
Then, Ling Han’s group and the empress’s group went their separate ways.

Why?

The True Dragon Emperor’s nine great disciples had all died by Ling Han’s hand — or had died because of Ling Han. This was something that Ling Han had seen very clearly.
Now, he was told that his nine great disciples were still alive?
Wasn’t this a joke?
But others did not know that they had come, so what reason did they have to lie to them?
"There’s something strange about this!"
"Extremely strange!"
"But could it be that the True Dragon Emperor has taken in another nine disciples?"
This was possible. After all, they had been in the outside world for a few years, and in the Primitive Abyss, that would be several hundred years.
However, this True Dragon Emperor was far too efficient, wasn’t he? He had taken in nine disciples in just a few hundred years?

Ordinarily, when one had reached the level of Emperor, taking in a disciple would definitely be a very cautious matter. It would not be strange for one to only get a disciple that he liked after tens of thousands of years.
And now, he had taken nine disciples in just a few hundred years?
Was there any need to rush things like this?
"This is worth investigating."
Ling Han and the others set off to investigate the residences of the nine disciples.
With their Saint-level strength, they were completely capable of being impenetrable.
Thus, when the day ended, and they returned respectively, the whereabouts of the nine disciples also became clear.
"Which one should we go to first?"
Ling Han pondered for a moment before replying, "The Ninth King."
Previously, he had impersonated the Ninth King, so it must be fate.
The four of them moved out, and soon arrived in front of the manor of the Ninth King.
Of course, though this was called a manor, it was incredibly simple and crude. In the Primitive Abyss, the main theme was simple and plain.
In fact, there wasn’t even a single servant here. In the Primitive Abyss, the population was really too small. Manpower was a kind of precious resource, and they were all sent to mine.
This was good too. Ling Han would be able to spend a little less effort, to use the murderous aura to knock someone unconscious.

However, though the manor was simple and crude, it occupied a large area. Thus, Ling Han and the others still spent some time to finally find the location of the Ninth King. After all, they were all Saints, so they couldn’t be too impudent.
Yi!
When they arrived in front of the building where the Ninth King was, they were shocked to discover that the aura exuding from within was actually only that of a Half-Saint.
The four of them looked at each other. True enough, the True Dragon Emperor had taken in another nine disciples, so he needed to start nurturing from the very beginning.
"Genesis Substance!" Ling Han sensed it for a moment, and couldn’t help but feel his heartbeat quicken.
He looked around secretly, only to see a person sitting cross-legged in the room. He held a Celestial medicine in his hand, and this was the aura that was unique to Genesis Substance.
F***, how extravagant, to actually use Genesis Substance to cultivate!

En, because this Ninth King’s cultivation level was still relatively weak, and had not advanced into Saint Tier, he did not dare to directly ingest the Celestial medicine either, fearing that his body would explode from the force. He could only sniff it, and obtain a little bit of "fertilizer".
For a Half-Saint, this was enough to allow his cultivation level to soar.
Ling Han’s sharp eyes swept over the face of this Ninth King, and his mouth involuntarily gaped widely.

chapters.title: Chapter 4765: The same Ninth King
paragraphs: "Little Han, have you seen a ghost?" the large black dog asked.
"Or did you see a beauty come out of the bath, which made your eyes widen?" the little azure dragon also asked.
Of course, they were both using their divine sense to ask this question.
Ling Han shook his head, and directly rushed into the room. Weng, the murderous aura attack was also activated at the same time.
With his current strength, could a Half-Saint block a single thought from him?
Pa, this Ninth King immediately fainted.
Xiu, xiu, xiu! Brother Monkey and the others also leaped in one after another, "This is the Genesis-level Celestial medicine?"
They looked at the Celestial medicine that the Ninth King was still holding in his hands, and all of them looked curious.
Ling Han nodded, "However, the reason why I couldn’t help but make a move is not because of this Celestial medicine."

"Yi, have you changed your personality, brat?" The large black dog immediately asked curiously, and even wanted to stretch out a hand to touch Ling Han’s forehead, "Come, let Grandpa Dog see if you have a fever!"
"Go!" Ling Han waved his hand dismissively, "This Ninth King is exactly the same as the Ninth King I have seen before."
’Hah?’
Brother Monkey and the others looked at each other in confusion.
It should be known that the Ninth King had died.

"Could it be a brother?" The large black dog speculated, "Perhaps this True Dragon Emperor is more nostalgic, and after he found out that his nine disciples had died, he took the younger brother or son of his original nine disciples as his disciple."
Ling Han shook his head, "You didn’t understand what I meant. I mean, these two people are exactly the same."
"Even in terms of divine sense?" Brother Monkey asked solemnly.
"En." Ling Han nodded.
Hiss!
Brother Monkey and the others all inhaled sharply. This was inconceivable.
There were no two flowers that were the same in this world, nor were there two souls that were the same.

The appearance could be similar, and elites like Ling Han could even completely disguise themselves as others. However, the soul could not be completely simulated. Even if Ling Han possessed the Soul Forming Technique, it was still possible that he would be seen through by those with higher cultivation levels.
Thus, even if this Ninth King had also cultivated a secret technique like the Soul Forming Technique, would his cultivation level be higher than Ling Han’s? Would he be able to deceive Ling Han?
Moreover, there was no need for him to do so.
What was he doing? Was he also an impersonator like Ling Han? But if he was really an impersonator, why would he be a Half-Saint?
This was completely inexcusable, wasn’t it?
"So, this is the Ninth King, and it turns out to be the same one from before!" The large black dog emphasized again.
"That should be the case." Ling Han nodded.
"But when one dies, the soul will enter the Netherworld and all memories would be erased. One would have nothing to do with the Living Realm anymore," the little azure dragon said.
Ling Han pondered for a moment, then said slowly, "This is the Primitive Abyss."
The Primitive Abyss was where heaven and earth originated. Thus, while there was the Living Realm and the Netherworld outside, in this place, it was a complete area of Primal Chaos.
This wasn’t the Living Realm, nor was it the Netherworld. However, it was both the Living Realm and the Netherworld.
So... even the dead could be revived?
The four of them exchanged looks. What relation did the so-called immortality have with this?
"Could that True Dragon Emperor has also been revived like this?" the little azure dragon suddenly said. He had always been extremely bothered by this matter.
If so, who was behind this?
The little azure dragon was one hundred percent sure that the True Dragon had indeed died.
It should be known that when the Great Emperor died, his soul would be fused with heaven and earth. It could not be helped. He was too strong, and could not possibly enter into the Netherworld.
Since that was the case, how could it be that anyone else could snatch back the soul of the True Dragon from the hands of the Dao of Heaven and Earth?
If he was really that strong, then he would be able to suppress the whole world with a single thought, so what was the point of continuing the game!
Ling Han first collected the Celestial medicine, then smacked the Ninth King awake.
The Ninth King woke up in a daze, and when he saw four unfamiliar faces, he couldn’t help but feel shocked. Hurriedly, he asked, "Who are you people?"
He still wanted to use his divine sense to send out a warning wave, but his cultivation level was completely restricted by Ling Han, so he naturally couldn’t send it out.
Ling Han cracked a smile, "Little Ninth, do you know me?"
"Who are you?" The Ninth King looked at Ling Han blankly.
Yi, this was not an act; he really did not know.
Otherwise, how could he not have revealed the slightest bit of resentment after being "accidentally" killed by Ling Han?
"Forget it!" Ling Han stretched out a hand, and placed it on the forehead of the Ninth King, directly searching his soul.
"Wu!" The Ninth King was once again knocked unconscious.
After a while, Ling Han withdrew his hand, revealing an astounded expression.

He discovered that the memories of the Ninth King only comprised of a few hundred years. He had been cultivating in Dragon Head City all this while, and afterwards, he had been taken as the last disciple by the True Dragon Emperor. His whole life had been spent in cultivation.
This... there was nothing strange about it, but it was also filled with strangeness.
Someone had really given birth to the Ninth King, and he had not been directly revived, but had rather started from the stage of infancy... that was not right either.
In the memories of the Ninth King, he didn’t have a childhood at all.
It was understandable that he couldn’t remember things from when he was an infant. However, he only had memories from when he was an adult. What the hell was this?
Ling Han’s expression suddenly became very strange, and he asked, "Have you seen any children in the city?"
"No."
"No."
Brother Monkey and the others all shook their heads. They didn’t understand why Ling Han was asking this.
"In the memories of the Ninth King, there are no memories of childhood," Ling Han said.
"Hiss!"
With how smart Brother Monkey and the others were, they immediately understood why Ling Han had asked previously.
"This city is not naturally developed at all. Everyone is like a puppet!"

There was no childhood. The moment they were "created", they would be adults. However, everyone’s fate was different. Some had become disciples of the Great Emperor, some had become Saint-level guards, and some had become miners.
"Hold on!" The large black dog suddenly waved his paws, signaling for everyone to remain silent, "Say, could this True Dragon Emperor also be... like this?"
As it said this, it glanced at the little azure dragon. After all, the little azure dragon was more sensitive about this matter.

"Very likely." Ling Han nodded. The little azure dragon was absolutely certain that the True Dragon had definitely died, and reality had also proven that this True Dragon Emperor’s battle prowess was inferior to a normal Great Emperor.
Hence, if this Great Emperor was actually created, then it could be explained.
What had been created would definitely be inferior to the strength that came from true cultivation.
However, this was still incredibly terrifying.
A Great Emperor could actually be created?
Even if they were weaker Great Emperors, they could still crush the Nine Heavens and Ten Lands, and were chillingly strong.
There were a total of 36 Divine Beast Great Emperors in the Primitive Abyss.
Was, was it all like this?
Ling Han couldn’t help but recall the scene he had seen in the feather of the Azure Phoenix. An unknown Divine Beast had appeared, and entered into the Divine Beast Graveyard.
There was definitely a connection, but what exactly was it?
Ling Han felt a headache coming on. The information he had was limited, and it was really difficult to deduce.
Furthermore, this truth could possibly be world-shaking.
The Great Emperor Wu Ya said that there was a terrifying danger in the Primitive Abyss that could threaten the survival of the whole universe. Could it be related to this?
"My abilities are insufficient!" Ling Han said sincerely. Otherwise, he could completely barge all the way into the depths of the Primitive Abyss, and ask the Great Emperor Wu Ya about it.
