chapters.title: Chapter 4766: You’ve Got the Wrong Person
paragraphs: Ling Han and the others continued to set off, heading to the locations of the other eight disciples.

As expected, their cultivation levels were either Half-Saint, One Star Saint, or Two Star Saint. After they were "created", they could only cultivate again from the beginning. Being able to become Saints in a few hundred years was already an amazing miracle.
Some had already refined the Genesis-level Celestial medicine. Some had not, so Ling Han and the others naturally wouldn’t be reserved. They would loot those that had yet to refine it!
Ling Han kidnapped all nine of the disciples. He really wanted to see if there would be any more disciples that would be created.
"Let’s go!"
They exited the city, and Ling Han immediately began to refine the Celestial medicine.
They had obtained a total of four Genesis-level Celestial medicines, and now, these were all handed over to Ling Han.

—The large black dog and the others all knew that only by raising Ling Han’s cultivation level as soon as possible, would they be able to stand against the Lands of Death, and truly possess the right to live.
Ling Han wasn’t reserved either. They were all family, so there was no need for reservations.

However, the higher the cultivation level, the greater the expense of Genesis Substance. Furthermore, Ling Han discovered that though this was Genesis-level Celestial medicine, the Genesis Substance contained within was not very high. All four of them added together were only comparable to the one he had previously obtained.
Thankfully, when he refined the four Celestial medicines, he had also absorbed 54 Regulations.
In a situation where his body had only experienced Silent Destruction three times, the fact that he could attain such accomplishments was extremely astonishing.
"Just a little bit more, just a little bit more," Ling Han murmured. He was getting closer and closer to Pseudo-Emperor-level battle prowess.
They were indeed talented and courageous. They returned to Dragon Head City, wanting to know if another nine disciples would appear.
In the end... there was none.
Was it because they hadn’t died, or was it because there wasn’t enough time?
What surprised Ling Han and the others even more was the fact that the True Dragon Emperor didn’t react at all even though his nine disciples had disappeared. He was still in seclusion.
This, what was going on here?

If Ling Han and the others knew that the True Dragon Emperor had been killed by Great Emperor Senluo, they could now make a deduction. Could it be that this Great Emperor had also just been "created", and was in need of a great amount of time to return to the level of Great Emperor?
However, it was a shame that they had only cared about fleeing at that time. Whether it was the Azure Phoenix Emperor or Great Emperor Senluo, they wouldn’t have especially notified them, right?
However, an uninvited guest had also arrived at Dragon Head City.
Mo Ziyun.
Why had this woman come?
That’s right. She had been tricked by Ling Han, so she naturally had to run to Dragon Head City to look for him.
Ling Han couldn’t help but think. After this little girl came here, when she discovered that the Ninth King had disappeared again, what would she think?
She took it for granted that everyone in the city was lying to her. Thus, she was reluctant to go, and was determined to seek an explanation.
Er, this was his fault.
"Little Han, it looks like this is your doing," the large black dog immediately said.
Ling Han wore a righteous expression as he said, "Nonsense!"
However, Mo Ziyun suddenly left again, very quickly.
Yi, what was going on?
Ling Han was extremely curious. With his understanding of Mo Ziyun, would she give up so easily?
"Come, let’s follow."
Ling Han and the others trailed behind Mo Ziyun.
If it was only Brother Monkey and the others, they would definitely be discovered by Mo Ziyun. After all, Mo Ziyun’s strength was superior to theirs.

However, with Ling Han around, it was a different story. His present strength was already getting closer and closer to the level of Pseudo-Emperor. If he did not want to be discovered, Mo Ziyun would really not be able to discover them no matter how hard she tried.
Because the weather was not too bad, a dozen over days later, they arrived at the Azure Phoenix City. Then, there was practically no waiting, and they saw Mo Ziyun leave the city.
This time, she wasn’t alone. Instead, she was accompanied by the other disciples of the Azure Phoenix Emperor.
There were a total of eight of them.
"Looks like they’re going to carry out some kind of mission," the little azure dragon said.
"No matter what kind of mission it is, nothing good will happen." The large black dog roared, "Come, let’s go and stop them."
Ling Han waved his hand dismissively, "There’s no hurry. Let’s see what they want to do first."
The four of them followed, and the eight people in front of them were completely unaware, as they continued onwards.
In this period of time, their luck was not very good. They repeatedly encountered storms of heaven and earth, causing Ling Han to almost lose track of them.
Thankfully, after losing them a few times, they caught up again, and finally managed to control the situation.
This trip took seven years, and they finally arrived at their destination.

Actually, the time that was really used for their journey was not very long. However, the storms of heaven and earth were too frightening. If they encountered them, they would have to dodge. Sometimes, they would even have to take a detour. They may even be forced to change their course, and this led to their progress being very, very slow.
Mo Ziyun and the others arrived at a lake.
This made Ling Han very surprised, because he had never seen a lake in the Primitive Abyss.

This lake wasn’t large, and its widest point was only 5km, while its narrow point was only 1km or so. It appeared narrow and long, and the lake waters were as black as ink. Who knew what kind of liquid it was.

The lake was not calm and without waves, but was rather slowly spinning, forming two holes on the left and right side. One was moving in a clockwise direction, while the other was moving in a counter-clockwise direction, which was very bizarre.

Mo Ziyun and the others were not the only ones who had come. There were four other teams as well. Ling Han immediately recognized them. They were all disciples of the Great Emperors that had taken part in the Nine Cities Tournament.
Yi, why had so many disciples of the Great Emperors come here?
Ling Han believed that the disciples of the other Great Emperors would also come. This was only a matter of time.
As expected, a few months later, another three teams arrived, and there were a total of eight teams.
Obviously, if it was not for the fact that all the disciples of the True Dragon Emperor had been wiped out by Ling Han, there should be nine teams here by now.
"I wonder what they’re planning." The large black dog was extremely curious, and it felt an itch in its heart.
"Want to know?" Ling Han asked with a smile.
"You have a way?" the large black dog asked.
"Why don’t we go up and ask?" Ling Han said matter-of-factly.
"Yi, that works?"

"Of course, just say that you’re a new disciple of the True Dragon Emperor," Ling Han said. In any case, in the perception of Mo Ziyun and the others, all the old disciples had died, leaving behind only the Ninth King.
Hence, was this not easy to impersonate?
The large black dog’s interest was immediately piqued, "Then give the Silver Battle Armor to Grandpa Dog!"

Ling Han exchanged the Battle Armor with the large black dog. Seeing that the large black dog still didn’t forget to take off his iron underwear when wearing the Battle Armor, and then wear it outside, Ling Han instantly felt an urge to hit him.
Was he going to advance indomitably on the path of the Despicable Saint, and never look back?
"Boys, follow Grandpa Dog!" The large black dog stood on its hind legs, crossed its front paws behind its back, and swaggered towards the lakeside.
The moment the four of them came out, they immediately attracted the attention of Mo Ziyun and the others. They all looked over.
Yi, who were these four people?
What a strange combination!
Although they were wearing Battle Armors, they could still clearly see that only one of them was a human. Then, there was a dog, a monkey... and there was also a four-legged snake?
"You are—" Mo Ziyun immediately stared at Ling Han, feeling that this person gave her a familiar feeling.
"I’m not!" Ling Han hurriedly shook his head. "You’ve got the wrong person."

chapters.title: Chapter 4767: Demon Star Lake
paragraphs: ’F*ck! I haven’t even said who you are yet, so how do you know that I’ve made a mistake?’
Mo Ziyun was extremely suspicious. Why did this kind of expression and tone seem so much like that irresponsible guy?
While she was pondering over this, the others all turned their attention to the large black dog. After all, it was the large black dog that was wearing the Silver Battle Armor.
In the Primitive Abyss, the type of Battle Armor represented one’s identity.
Disciple of a Great Emperor?
There were already eight teams of disciples of Great Emperors here, so these four people definitely belonged to the True Dragon City.
Hiss, since when did the True Dragon Emperor have such strong tastes, to actually take a dog as his disciple?
"Under the True Dragon Emperor?" An Heming asked. This was a "fact" that everyone already knew.
"That’s right." The large black dog puffed out his chest, "Grandpa Dog is the first disciple of the True Dragon Emperor, Black Murderous Dog King!"

Everyone couldn’t help but break out in a cold sweat. It was very normal for disciples of Great Emperors to be called "king", and this guy was a dog. It seemed right for him to be called "dog king", but from its mouth, why did it feel like it was demeaning him as well?
Just look, they, they were all Seventh King, Eighth King, Ninth King and so on, and suddenly a Dog King appeared in their midst. Wouldn’t their status instantly decline?
They couldn’t help but glance at the large black dog’s iron underwear. There was nothing they could do about this. The golden light was far too dazzling.
"You guys... don’t even think of snatching Grandpa Dog’s treasure!" the large black dog immediately warned solemnly.
"We don’t have that kind of interest!" everyone immediately shouted. In fact, they were even a little embarrassed.
Gods, just how hardcore did they have to be to snatch a dog’s underpants?
"Where’s your Ninth?" Mo Ziyun came back to her senses and asked the large black dog.

"Oh, Ninth." The large black dog’s eyes darted around, and he immediately started to speak without thinking, "You’re that Mo Yuzai, right? My Ninth said that he has had a sweetheart since childhood, so he can only disappoint your deep love."
When these words fell, it immediately attracted tons of animosity for it, and everyone was looking at it angrily.
The large black dog was given a fright, and hurriedly covered his iron underwear, his expression filled with terror, "You guys are indeed trying to snatch Grandpa Dog’s treasure!"
Everyone was instantly rendered speechless. Then, they felt like they were about to go crazy. Why was this disciple of a Great Emperor exuding a strong sense of despicableness?
This kind of despicable dog would actually be taken as disciple by a Great Emperor, and his first disciple at that?
However, such a team had come from the True Dragon City. Even if they didn’t want to believe it, they had to.

"Forget it, let’s not waste any more time on this," An Heming hurriedly said. This was because he saw Luoyi Xingxiao opening his mouth to speak again. This guy took things too seriously. What would happen if he was allowed to speak?
Clearly, the large black dog’s battle prowess wasn’t weak either.
"The Demonic Eyes have already appeared on the Demon Star Lake. Then, in at most a year’s time, we would be able to enter," he said.
Ling Han and the others remained calm and collected. However, they all gave an ’oh’ in their minds. As it turned out, this was the Demonic Star Lake, and those two whirlpools were the Demonic Eyes.
Their aim was to enter the bottom of the Demon Star Lake?
What was there there?
Were they going to directly dig a hole and travel to the bottom of the lake?
That was too naive. Didn’t everyone know just how sturdy the ground here was? The strike of a Saint would not even leave behind the slightest mark.
Unless Ling Han made a move, and unleashed the combined might of Destructive Energy and light of great dao together. He would then possess destructive power that surpassed even the Imperial Weapon.
However, Ling Han didn’t know what would happen after he went to the bottom of the lake. Thus, he naturally didn’t move now.
The group of people settled down here. Thankfully, there was no storm of heaven and earth in the area of the lake — perhaps, this lake itself contained great danger.
Though Ling Han had not entered into the lake, he had a feeling that the waters of the lake were filled with destructive power, and definitely could not be touched easily.
Thus, even though everyone here was a Saint, they could only watch from the sidelines. No one dared to enter the lake.
Looking at this whirlpool, it looked like it was getting faster and faster, and bigger and bigger. At this rate, the bottom of the lake would soon appear.
Was this what they were waiting for?

Because they had to wait, everyone set up camp by the lake, and Mo Ziyun was the goddess in everyone’s hearts. The Ninth King of the True Dragon City was not present, so it was a good opportunity to strike at her defenses
These people kept circling around Mo Ziyun, making her extremely annoyed. Naturally, she did not have the time to look for Ling Han again to prove the suspicion in her heart.
Day after day passed, and the two holes in the Demon Star Lake became larger and larger. On a certain day, the bottom of the lake was finally revealed.
"Same rules as before. We’ll draw lots to decide who enters the left eye and who enters the right eye," An Heming said.
"All right."
Everyone began to draw lots. Not long after, the lots were drawn, and Ling Han drew the left eye, while Brother Monkey and the others drew the right eye.
The four of them communicated through divine sense for a while, and reached a consensus. They would go with the flow first, and see what exactly was inside this Demon Star Lake.
They didn’t ask. It was clear that they would definitely be tied up if they asked. Before setting out, would the True Dragon Emperor not have informed them first?
After drawing lots, they were divided into two groups, each leaping towards the eye of the lake.
Xiu, xiu, xiu! This time, none of them hesitated, as if they were dumplings being thrown into a pot.
In the crowd, Ling Han appeared especially eye-catching, because he was the only one wearing a Bronze Battle Armor.
This caused everyone to look at him with a hint of disdain. In fact, they even felt a displeasure as if they had been insulted.
—A mere guard could actually associate with them?
However, none of them flared up for the moment.
The group arrived at the bottom of the lake, and saw that there was actually a cave here. It was dark and eerie, and its depth was unknown.

They then entered into this cave, walking all the way. At times, they would go downwards, and at times, they would go upwards. After walking for a long time, the path ahead of them suddenly opened up.
This was still underground, but an extremely large cave had appeared. It was as tall as three thousand meters, and was extraordinarily huge.
Ling Han was extremely curious. What was hidden here?
Why did they have to enter different Demonic Eyes?

No one gave Ling Han an explanation, and even if he asked, it was probable that no one would answer him — who are you? You are merely a guard, so why are you talking so much? Don’t you know the hierarchy of seniority?

They merely advanced. After advancing for a certain distance, a dead old tree appeared ahead of them. However, there was also a purple vine entwined around the old tree. However, this vine was about to die, and there was no longer any sign of life circulating around it.
However, to be nurtured in such a dangerous place, it was definitely no ordinary item!
Unfortunately, it was about to die.
Ling Han could sense that this vine was exuding the aura of Genesis Substance, but it was too weak.
Yi, did they travel so far just for this old vine?
Wasn’t this too much? It was completely not worth it.
Ling Han didn’t say anything. There should be something that he didn’t know.
"You, go over," one of them suddenly shouted at Ling Han.
"Me?" Ling Han pointed at himself, then smiled, "Why?"
"Do you have the right to refuse?" That person smirked coldly, "We are all disciples of Great Emperors, so who do you think you are?"
Ling Han pondered for a moment, then said, "I’m your uncle!"
Instantly, that person was angered. A mere guard actually dared to provoke him?
How reckless!

chapters.title: Chapter 4768: What goes around comes around
paragraphs: All the disciples of the Great Emperors looked coldly at Ling Han, their killing intent flickering.
As they saw it, even if they killed a mere guard, so what? He actually dared to be insolent in front of them?

"Hehe, the True Dragon City is really weird. It has produced a Ninth King, and something like you who knows no respect for seniority!" The Great Emperor’s disciple from before said coldly. His name was Guo Ming, and he was the sixth disciple of the Crimson Ape City.
Ling Han was extremely displeased, "Do you know how to speak properly?"
"You still dare to be arrogant?" Everyone was surprised. Could it be that this guy did not have a brain?
As a mere guard, what right did he have to talk back to the disciples of a Great Emperor?
Or had the line of the True Dragon been led astray by the Ninth King? Did he think that just because the Ninth King had defeated Saints, he, a servant, could act arrogant and domineering?
Humph!

"Since you have disrespected us, I will allow you to suffer the consequences of your own actions!" Guo Ming said, and stretched out a hand to grab Ling Han, intending to throw him directly towards the withered tree and old vine.
Ling Han shook his head in exasperation. F*ck, his image had collapsed again.
Why did he always destroy his image so quickly?
See, wasn’t he very low-key this time? He didn’t take the initiative to cause trouble at all, right?
"Could it be that I am too dazzling?" he murmured.

At this time, Guo Ming’s large hand had already caught hold of him, but when he was about to throw Ling Han out, he felt awkward, because he discovered that Ling Han was completely motionless, and could not be picked up at all.
Hiss, what the hell was this?
Guo Ming faltered for a moment. Then, he exerted force with one hand, and continued to pull, but it was still useless.
Instantly, he felt his face burn.
The other didn’t even fight back, and he was actually helpless. What face did he have left?
He stretched out his other hand, and both of them grabbed onto Ling Han. Then, with a loud shout, he wanted to throw Ling Han out.
However, it was still completely useless.
Ling Han simply stood there, as if his feet were rooted into the ground.
Guo Ming was stunned. Could it be that this guard’s cultivation level was superior to his?
But he was already a Seven Star Saint. Even if Ling Han was a Nine Star Saint, with how high his natural talent was, how could he not be able to suppress him?
"You should go on your own." Ling Han moved, and with a wave of his hand, xiu, Guo Ming’s whole person was sent flying, and then crashed heavily into the great tree.
In the process of flying out, Guo Ming’s expression changed drastically, as if he had received a massive shock. Thus, the moment he landed, he immediately wanted to flee back, but it was too late.
Zi, a purple lightning bolt suddenly struck out from the old vine, rapidly slashing towards Guo Ming.
Guo Ming wanted to dodge, but the speed of the lightning was really too fast, so how could he possibly dodge?
"Ah!" He released a terrible scream, smoke rising from all over his body, and the fragrance of meat wafted out.

Zi, zi, zi, the purple lightning struck one after another. Even if Guo Ming was wearing a Silver Battle Armor, which greatly increased his defenses, it was useless. It was as if the purple lightning could ignore this layer of defense, and directly strike his body.
After a few times, Guo Ming was seen lying on the ground, with traces of burnt smoke continuously exuding from his body.
"Is it seventy percent cooked?" Ling Han guessed. This was the judgment of a professional glutton.
Shua! All of a sudden, the other disciples of the Great Emperors all turned to look at him.
"Who exactly are you?" An Heming asked. There was a hint of seriousness in his voice, as well as a hint of shock.
With a wave of his hand, he had thrown Guo Ming out. He had done it so casually, as easily as if he had thrown out a piece of scrap paper. What kind of powerful strength was that?
How could a guard... possess such a level?
Ling Han sighed, and said, "Do you guys know what I hate the most?"
How would we know?
Even though An Heming thought this, he still suppressed his urge to attack and asked in a solemn voice, "What is it?"

"Destroying my public image!" Ling Han said bitterly. "Can you all understand? You spent so much effort to conceal your identities and infiltrate the enemy camp, yet in the end, you were forced to reveal your identities for such a trivial matter?"
F***, what kind of mockery was that?
An Heming humphed, and said, "As expected, you’re an imposter!"

Ling Han wasn’t the only one. There was also that despicable dog, as well as the monkey and the four-legged snake. That’s right, why would the True Dragon Emperor have such hardcore tastes in choosing disciples?
Ling Han cracked a smile, "Since my public image has collapsed, I can only kill all of you to keep the secret!"
With a thought, he returned to his original appearance.
This naturally could not possibly be recognized by the masses. After all, his appearance was completely unlike the "Ninth King".
An Heming laughed loudly, and said, "Who do you think you are?"
Aside from the boundlessly freakish Ninth King, could there be a second person in this world that could sweep aside seven great trump cards all by himself?
There was none! That was impossible.
"Capture him, and interrogate him about his origins!"
"En!"
All the disciples of the Great Emperors nodded, every one of them showing an ominous glint.
"Come!" Ling Han crooked a finger at them, appearing extremely disdainful, filled with provocation.
"Attack together!" An Heming shouted. The opponent was truly powerful, so he didn’t dare to be careless.
Thus, just to be safe, it was best to gang up on him.
Xiu, xiu, xiu, everyone pounced out.
Ling Han sighed, appearing disinterested.
Previously, when the seven great trump cards had joined forces to fight him, he had also dealt with them easily.
But now?
His strength had increased greatly, but there were only four trump cards here. How much stronger was this comparison?

Ling Han stretched out a hand. It was not clear how fast he was, nor how mysterious his movements were, but with a stretch of his hand, a person was captured by him. Then, xiu, he smashed him towards the old vine.
Zi, purple lightning rose again, striking madly at that person.
Ling Han did not make another move. He merely dodged, and then observed from the sidelines.
Not long after, that person lay on the ground and stopped moving, and the lightning did not strike him again.
Again.
Ling Han casually grabbed out, and another person was captured, which he tossed towards the withered tree.
It was still the same. Lightning struck, causing that person to cry out endlessly.
He moved casually and in a relaxed manner. However, in the eyes of An Heming and the others, this was far too terrifying.
Under their combined attacks, Ling Han could still be so relaxed. He caught one of them and threw them in a single stroke, as if he was in a place where he faced no opposition.
Was this opponent... a demon?
What could they do?
They looked at each other, and a strong chill rose up in both of them.
"Summon the Saint Tool!" They all drew out their Saint Tool, and then attacked Ling Han.
However, what use was this?
Ling Han threw a punch. Not only did the Saint Tool’s light dim, but it even shattered the Saint Tool!
This, what kind of monster was this!
"Who exactly are you!"
"A Great Emperor?"
Everyone’s hair stood on end. Aside from a Great Emperor, was there any other existence that was so powerful?
"Don’t be surprised!" Ling Han shook his head, and attacked repeatedly, blasting everyone onto the ground. Not a single person managed to escape.
As powerful as he was, he already had a sliver of the might of Pseudo-Emperor.
He grinned as he tossed them one after another towards the withered tree, "How is it? Do you now know what the wheel of fortune has turned?"

Everyone was speechless. They had only wanted to force Ling Han to approach the withered tree, and had not succeeded. You are not a victim at all, so what need is there to talk about how the tables have turned?
This couldn’t be condoned. After defeating them physically, he still had to continue to torture them mentally.
What kind of person was this!

chapters.title: Chapter 4769: Purple Shell Leaf
paragraphs: When Ling Han threw out the ninth person, he discovered that the might of the lightning that the old vine had shot out had suddenly decreased.
He threw again, and again, and again. When he threw the fourteenth person, its might was extremely weak. Even after throwing the fifteenth person, it did not seem to have weakened further.
Right at this moment, a leaf floated down from the old vine. It danced in the air for a while, and slowly descended towards Ling Han.
Yi?
Ling Han swept an eye over them, and saw that those who had not passed out were all staring at that leaf, as if it was very important.
He wasn’t careless, and he used his divine sense to scan the leaf. Only then did he reach over and grab the leaf.
This caused everyone to involuntarily swallow, revealing expressions of envy and jealousy.
Ling Han was surprised. This leaf did indeed have a sliver of Genesis Substance, but it was pitifully little. Did you guys have to be so nervous?
Could it be that it could be used for other purposes?
Ling Han stretched out a hand, and retrieved the people that he had thrown out through the air. Then, he slapped them awake one by one.
"Now, who can tell me what this leaf is used for?" Ling Han asked. After sweeping an eye over the masses, he set his eyes on Luoyi Xingxiao, and smiled. "You answer."
"Humph, do you think I’ll tell—"
Xiu!

Luoyi Xingxiao still wanted to argue, but before he could finish speaking, he was thrown out by Ling Han. Peng, he crashed into the withered tree. Instantly, the old vine showed its might, blasting out purple lightning, and what surprised Ling Han was that the might had actually become stronger again. Furthermore, it was stronger than at the beginning.
Yi, what the hell was this?
The others inhaled sharply. This guy was too cruel. He had clearly obtained the leaf, so why was he still torturing them?

"Enough!" Seeing that Ling Han was about to reach over, An Heming couldn’t help but shout, "You’ve already obtained the Purple Shell Leaf, so there’s no need to deliberately torture others like this!"
That’s right!
Everyone was filled with righteous indignation, and felt that Ling Han had really gone too far.
Ling Han shook his head, "Are you guys retarded? I’m not from here, so how would I know what Purple Shell Leaf or Red Shell Leaf is?"
Everyone’s aura instantly weakened. That’s right, this guy was too unfamiliar. Since he was not from this place, how could he know so much?

"All right, I’ll tell you!" An Heming said. "Take this Purple Shell Leaf and walk forwards. There are still three ahead of you, and use the same method to obtain a leaf from each. Then, join up with the other team, and you will be able to open the mother vine and enter into the Pool of Genesis."
Pool of Genesis?
Ling Han couldn’t help but feel a rush of excitement. This sounded like something good.
"Come, come, come. Be more specific," he said.
Since An Heming had already started, he didn’t hide anything else. He revealed all the information that he knew.

As it turned out, the old vines they encountered here were all branches of a mother vine. There were a total of eight branches, and they were located in the two areas that could be entered from each Demonic Eye.
Obtaining a leaf on each of the old vines would allow one to pass through the mother vine and enter the Pool of Genesis.
After the Demonic Eye opened, it would be the weakest period for the mother vine, but it would only last for a few days.
Thus, they had to hurry up, and split into two groups. Otherwise, they wouldn’t be able to obtain all eight leaves in this time when the mother vine was weakest.
—If they could not get it now, then there was no way they would be able to in future.
And every time, the mother vine would only shed a single leaf. Subsequently, it would become incredibly violent, and there was no way to pluck a second leaf at all.
Ling Han gave an ’oh’. He looked at the old vine in front of him, and suddenly felt a sense of curiosity. Could he block that kind of lightning attack?
Involuntarily, he walked forwards.

"This guy’s crazy!" An Heming murmured softly. Even though they were wearing Silver Battle Armors, they didn’t dare to face the old vine’s lightning attacks head-on. After going berserk, killing people would be as easy as mowing grass.
"Hehe." Ling Han paused, then turned to look at An Heming. "Your warning is very reasonable."
This caused the others to want to beat up An Heming. It wasn’t easy for this bringer of misfortune to seek his own death, so why did you have to remind him?
An Heming also felt great regret. That’s right, why had he suddenly become such a blabbermouth?
Ling Han reached over and picked An Heming up. He then continued to advance.
An Heming’s expression instantly changed drastically. As it turned out, Ling Han hadn’t dismissed the idea of testing the might of the old vine yet. Meanwhile, he had become a human shield.
Heavens, was he shooting himself in the foot?
He was about to cry. Why did he have to blabber just now?
He wasn’t Luoyi Xingxiao, a guy who liked to argue with others. Why did he suddenly lose control of his mouth?
Ling Han slowly approached. Crackle... A bolt of lightning quickly struck over.
An Heming discovered that Ling Han had raised him up to block his front.
He was done for!
Being struck by such violent lightning, even if he didn’t die, he would be severely injured.
Yi?
It wasn’t long before he discovered that he didn’t feel any wounds on his body.
What was going on?
He turned around, only to see that the lightning had already disappeared. It was as if it hadn’t struck him at all.
Where did he go?
He looked back at those people behind him, and saw that all of them were dumbfounded, as if they had seen a ghost.
What was going on?

He hadn’t seen it, but everyone had seen it clearly. When the lightning had struck, though Ling Han had blocked An Heming in front of him, that had only been a feint to scare An Heming. In truth, he had greeted it with a punch.
The most terrifying thing was that this punch actually shattered the lightning!
Heavens!
How could there be such a monster?
With that kind of strength, he was completely capable of not plucking any Purple Shell Leaf, and directly rush to the mother vine, and barge in forcefully.
Zi, another bolt of lightning struck over.
This time, An Heming saw things clearly. Ling Han threw a punch, which landed on the lightning, forcibly dispersing this terrifying lightning.
Are you f****** a Great Emperor?
Otherwise, how could he possibly be so powerful?
Ling Han cracked a smile, "Of course I am a Saint. If you don’t believe me, look at my holy flame."
He showed off his holy flame. It was orange in colour, proving he was a genuine Three Star Saint.
Everyone was petrified at this. This was a Three Star Saint!
This guy that was so strong that they suspected that he was a Great Emperor, was actually only a Three Star Saint.
Who could believe this?
After Ling Han took a few blows, he lost interest.
This power was indeed strong. It was just a step away from reaching the level of Pseudo-Emperor, but he was completely capable of withstanding it.
In the outside world, this was an extremely terrifying existence, but this was the Primitive Abyss, and compared to the natural storms of heaven and earth, this was practically child’s play.
He plucked a few more leaves, then tossed An Heming and the others at the feet of the old vine. In an instant, they were severely wounded and knocked unconscious.
Even if these people woke up, they did not dare to move recklessly. If they moved, they would be struck by lightning, and could only stay here obediently.

Ling Han and them couldn’t be considered enemies, but it was very likely that he and the 36 Divine Beasts were on opposing sides. Thus, it was already benevolent of him not to kill these disciples of the Great Emperors with his own hands.
—Most importantly, even if they were killed, it was highly possible that these people would be created again, so it would be better to trap them here.

Ling Han cracked a smile, "Of course I am a Saint.
If you don’t believe me, look at my holy flame."
He showed off his holy flame.
It was orange in colour, proving he was a genuine Three Star Saint.
Everyone was petrified at this.
This was a Three Star Saint!
This guy that was so strong that they suspected that he was a Great Emperor, was actually only a Three Star Saint.
Who could believe this?
After Ling Han took a few blows, he lost interest.
This power was indeed strong.
It was just a step away from reaching the level of Pseudo-Emperor, but he was completely capable of withstanding it.
In the outside world, this was an extremely terrifying existence, but this was the Primitive Abyss, and compared to the natural storms of heaven and earth, this was practically child’s play.
He plucked a few more leaves, then tossed An Heming and the others at the feet of the old vine.
In an instant, they were severely wounded and knocked unconscious.
Even if these people woke up, they did not dare to move recklessly.
If they moved, they would be struck by lightning, and could only stay here obediently.
Ling Han and them couldn’t be considered enemies, but it was very likely that he and the 36 Divine Beasts were on opposing sides.
Thus, it was already benevolent of him not to kill these disciples of the Great Emperors with his own hands.
—Most importantly, even if they were killed, it was highly possible that these people would be created again, so it would be better to trap them here.

chapters.title: Chapter 4770: Pool of Genesis
paragraphs: Ling Han strode off, and not too long after, he discovered another old vine.
This time, he didn’t hold back and directly barged over. He allowed the lightning to strike him as he plucked a few more leaves.
Just like that, he advanced. In less than half a day, a massive withered tree appeared ahead of him, but there was also an old vine entwined around it.
The difference was that this old vine was filled with vitality, and every single leaf was exuding the light of lightning.
Its might could not be underestimated.
Ling Han couldn’t help but feel an itch in his hands. He strode over, wanting to give it a try.
However, he discovered that this old vine actually did not attack him.
Yi?
He was taken aback at first, then realization dawned on him. He had Purple Shell Leaf on him, and had the aura of the old vine, so the old vine treated him as one of their own.
Fine then.
He walked to the side, took out the Purple Shell Leaf, and placed it on the ground.
It was fine. The Purple Shell Leaf had grown here, and could completely withstand the gravity fields here.
Ling Han then stepped forward again.
This time, the old vine was no longer reserved. Instantly, multiple bolts of lightning shot out, blasting towards Ling Han.
"Good timing!" Ling Han laughed loudly, greeting the incoming attack with a raised fist.
Zi!
It was only a single strike, and a charred mark had already appeared on Ling Han’s fist. He had used 54 eight-star Regulations at the same time, and he was actually still no match?
Ling Han was astonished. No wonder this was a mother vine. Its might was far greater than that of the branch vines.
However, would this be enough to stop him?
Ling Han brandished his fists, advancing bravely.

This time, he used the Destructive Energy. When the lightning struck, it was instantly annihilated by the Destructive Energy. Even if there was a sliver of remnant might left behind, it would still be a piece of cake for 54 eight-star Regulations to neutralize it.
Ling Han laughed loudly, and attacked aggressively. Very soon, he had arrived in front of this mother vine.

He discovered that the trunk of the withered tree was hollow, revealing a massive tree hollow that was as wide as three people could wrap their arms around. It was completely wide enough for one to easily descend downwards.
Was this... the Pool of Genesis?
Ling Han immediately entered into the tree hollow and descended.

In a short while, he arrived at the bottom. He saw that this was a small cave. It was not very big, and in the middle of the cave, there was a small pool of water. There was about a third of the liquid in the pool, and it was exuding a dense aura of Genesis Substance.
Ling Han looked pleasantly surprised. This was a great gain!
He was rich, he was rich now!

Ling Han thought for a moment, and first went to retrieve the Purple Shell Leaf. Then, he came into the tree hollow, scooped up a mouthful of pool liquid, and delivered it into his mouth, swallowing it without hesitation.
Weng, a sliver of great dao immediately appeared in his head.
By now, Ling Han was certain that this was an incomplete great dao. It only had Life as a cornerstone, and did not have Creation, Destruction or Death.
He naturally wouldn’t care. He simply observed the great dao, continuously extracting the Regulations.
At the same time, with the support of Genesis Substance, his body accommodated these newly grasped Regulations under the condition that he didn’t go through Silent Destruction.
Half a day later, Ling Han successfully accommodated a new Regulation, totalling up to 55.
However, Genesis Substance had also been exhausted, so he took another sip.
Again.
This time, one mouthful of Genesis Substance was already not enough to support him in comprehending another Regulations. Thus, he took another mouthful.
Two days later, Ling Han increased the number of Regulations he had absorbed to 56.
At this moment, he sensed an aura surging over from outside.
Brother Monkey and the others had arrived.
Ling Han wasn’t in a hurry to leave. He simply used his divine sense as a tentacle to observe the surroundings.
"Yi, the other group hasn’t arrived yet." Someone looked left and right.
"Hehe, we’re still the fastest."
"Let’s just wait."
"We can only do that."
This group of people sat cross-legged 300 meters away from the mother vine, not daring to approach any closer. Otherwise, they would definitely be struck by lightning.

Ling Han "saw" that Brother Monkey, the little azure dragon, and the large black dog had traces of being struck by lightning on their bodies. Moreover, there were extremely many of them, unlike the others, who only had one or two.
Clearly, they had suffered the same treatment as Ling Han and the others, and were forced to charge forwards to exhaust the might of the branch vines.
Ling Han immediately couldn’t bear it any longer. He directly stood up, and exited through the hollow.
"Yi!"
Seeing a person actually climb out of the tree hollow, Mo Ziyun and the others were all completely stunned.
There... was actually someone here!
How was this possible?

Every few million years, the mother vine would experience a period of weakness. They could each pluck a single Purple Shell Leaf from the branch vine. They definitely could not pluck more, or it would definitely go berserk.
And to pass through the obstruction of the mother vine, and enter into the cave, one would need to harvest at least eight Purple Shell Leaves.
And now, with four Purple Shell Leaves in their possession, how had this person managed to enter?
—The Purple Shell Leaves that had been left behind from the last time?
Sorry, once the Purple Shell Leaves have left the vine, it could only last for a month, at most. Then, it would definitely melt back into the heaven and earth, and would not exist in the slightest.
"Who are you? How can you possibly have so many Purple Shell Leaves?" Immediately, someone shouted at Ling Han.
How could Ling Han possibly pay any heed to him? He smiled at the large black dog, "You didn’t succeed in showing off this time, and have instead been bullied, right?"
The large black dog was extremely depressed, "Who would have known that these guys don’t have the camaraderie of Sect Brothers at all, pushing Grandpa Dog into danger!"
Hearing these words, Mo Ziyun, Ziyun and the others all felt disdain.
How despicable is your mouth? Don’t you have any idea?
’We are already giving the True Dragon Emperor some face by not killing you.’
Ling Han nodded, "All right, let’s get our revenge!"

"Brat, who do you think you are?" someone shouted at Ling Han. Though Ling Han was still wearing the Bronze Battle Armor, because he had returned to his original appearance, he was naturally not recognized by others.

"You have a dirty mouth!" Ling Han humphed, and with a flash, he had already appeared in front of that person. Then, with a grab and a toss, that person was picked up by Ling Han, and thrown towards the mother vine.
Zi!
The lightning struck, and that person only managed to let out a terrible scream before collapsing onto the ground. It was unknown whether he was dead or alive.
The chances of him dying were higher, because the might of the mother vine was comparable to 54 eight-star Regulations, or perhaps even stronger.
Everyone was shocked, because they had not seen how Ling Han had moved.
With just a blur of vision, he had been thrown out?
Not even the slightest bit of resistance?
Mo Ziyun stared fixedly at Ling Han. It seemed like there was only one person that possessed such powerful strength.
"Ninth King?" she asked. There was a hint of resentment in her voice, and there was also a hint of anger.
This was too much of a bully. He had tricked her, stolen her sword, and even hid himself in the True Dragon City without seeing her!

"You’ve got the wrong person," Ling Han resolutely denied. Upon further thought, he definitely couldn’t allow his aura to weaken. Immediately, he revealed his viciousness again. "Brother Monkey, Old Black, we’ll avenge our grudges, and we’ll avenge our grievances!"
’Die!’
The four of them immediately charged out, unconcerned even if they were outnumbered.
Everyone was furious. ’You guys are underestimating us too much, aren’t you?’
However, as soon as they exchanged blows, they knew that the four people on the other side really weren’t underestimating anyone.
F***, they were too strong. They were completely outmatched.

chapters.title: Chapter 4771: Can rival Pseudo-Emperor!
paragraphs: Ling Han didn’t waste any time, and soon defeated Mo Ziyun and the others.
"Little Han, aren’t you a little too unfeeling towards the fairer sex?" The large black dog pointed at Mo Ziyun, "She seems to be constantly thinking about you."
You see, she had almost recognized Ling Han twice, though in her heart, the appearance of the Ninth King should be Ling Han himself.
Ling Han shrugged, "At most, when you guys make your move later, be gentle."

"Hehe, understood!" The large black dog and the little dragon weren’t people who were willing to suffer losses. They immediately threw everyone toward the mother vine. Bolts of lightning struck, causing everyone to scream and wail in pain.

Thankfully, the large black dog and the others did not intend to kill anyone, and did not throw them too close to the mother vine. Otherwise, at most, only a few of the trump cards would be able to survive, and the others would all die.
Mo Ziyun was also one of the luckier ones. She was tossed in the outermost circle, and practically no lightning had struck her.
"Come, let’s go in and absorb Genesis Substance," Ling Han said.

The eyes of Brother Monkey and the others lit up. They naturally wanted to increase their cultivation level as well. However, their resources were limited, so it definitely had to be used on Ling Han first. As for themselves? They would have to completely depend on hard cultivation.
Judging by Ling Han’s words, it seemed like there was a very great amount of Genesis Substance!
"There aren’t enough Purple Shell Leaves," the large black dog immediately said.

"It’s fine." Ling Han distributed the Purple Shell Leaves that he had on him first, and added with the four leaves that he had robbed from Mo Ziyun and the others, it was just enough to equip Brother Monkey and the others.
"What about you?" the large black dog and the others asked.
"Me?" Ling Han smiled faintly, and directly strode forwards.
Zi, zi, zi, lightning immediately appeared, striking out at Ling Han. However, Ling Han threw punches left and right, and the lightning bolts were all sent flying and annihilated.
"Ah!" However, the people lying on the ground were miserable. Being struck by the lightning that had been sent flying, it was really painful.
This made Mo Ziyun and the others depressed. Not only did they have to watch Ling Han show off, they also had to suffer lightning strikes for no reason. Life was really too unfortunate.
Ling Han quickly arrived at the side of the withered tree. Then, he turned around and waved at Brother Monkey and the others.
Brother Monkey and the others also stepped forward. They had the Purple Shell Leaf, which concealed their aura, so the mother vine naturally wouldn’t attack them.
Thus, the four brothers arrived at the bottom of the tree hollow.
"So much Genesis Substance?" The large black dog was immediately excited.
"Come, come, come, don’t stand on ceremony!" Ling Han said with a smile.
The four of them gathered around the pool. Then, they each scooped up a mouthful of Genesis Substance and placed it into their mouths.
Unlike Ling Han, though Brother Monkey and the others had ingested Genesis Substance, there was no great dao rushing out of their heads.
Was this a trait that only the Genesis World’s Master possessed?
This thought flashed through Ling Han’s mind, but he immediately put it aside, and also began refining.
The four brothers drank one mouthful after another, rapidly increasing their cultivation level.

Ling Han’s natural talent in cultivation was indeed heaven-defyingly strong, but Brother Monkey and the others weren’t weak either. With the help of Genesis Substance, they all grasped even more Regulations in a short period of time.
Theoretically speaking, this was enough to elevate their cultivation by a few levels. However, due to the unique nature of Genesis Substance, none of their bodies experienced Silent Destruction.
Even though their cultivation level hadn’t increased, this was a good thing that couldn’t be obtained even if one begged for it.
Originally, Brother Monkey and the others were still slightly inferior to the sons of the Great Emperors. However, with this opportunity, they should be able to catch up.
After all, there wasn’t much of a gap between them in the first place.

However, Genesis Substance was only icing on the cake, but could not provide coal in the <anno data-annotation-id="1e7b1366-af3e-4040-a820-87df91802a96" data-title="snow">snow1</anno>. After Brother Monkey and the others absorbed a few Regulations, they had reached their limit. They had to wait until their bodies went through Silent Destruction to be able to accommodate more Regulations.
From this aspect, they were considerably inferior to Ling Han.

Moreover, Ling Han had a feeling that after he had removed the Genesis World from his body, it was as if a lot of space had been vacated in his body, which could be used to accommodate even more Regulations.
In other words, even without the help of the Genesis Substance, if he cultivated in the outside world, the maximum number of Regulations he could accommodate would be increased to another level.

Brother Monkey and the others had already reached a bottleneck. They could no longer increase their cultivation level by depending on Genesis Substance. They had to take another step forward in appreciation of Regulations.
Thus, they didn’t ingest Genesis Substance anymore. That was purely a waste of treasures.

Furthermore, the Purple Shell Leaves on them was also slowly wilting. The mother vine was rooted here, and there were already flashes of lightning flickering indistinctly, ready to attack them at any moment.
There was nothing else that could be done. Brother Monkey and the others could only leave first.
The large black dog wanted to stow away some Genesis Substance before leaving, but it was impossible to bring a Spatial Spirit Tool here, so how could he stow anything away?
At most, he would only keep a mouthful in his mouth, but could it be that he would have to keep it like this forever?

Meanwhile, Ling Han continued to cultivate by the pool. He was already used to being struck by lightning, and had even developed a habit of instinctively parrying when he was experiencing the great dao.
57th, 58th, 59th!
The number of Regulations he could absorb was increasing. Though the rate of increase was becoming slower and slower, it was also very stable.
Though Ling Han’s heart was as calm as an ancient well, he was also filled with slight anticipation.
70 Regulations was a dividing line. Once he crossed it, he would be able to match a Pseudo-Emperor.Any more than that, he would be able to defeat even a Pseudo-Emperor.
What was the greatest threat to him now?
It was not the 36 Divine Beasts that were all hiding in the Primitive Abyss, rarely showing themselves.
Nor was it the Lords of Death, because they would be greatly restricted, and could not easily make a move.
Instead, it was the Natural-born Gold Spirit!
This was a Pseudo-Emperor in itself, and added with being controlled by a sliver of divine sense from the Lords of Death, how terrifying would its battle prowess be?
Even if Buddha Doga and the others joined forces, they could only just barely block it. It could be claimed that this was the number one battle prowess of the Great Emperors.
The Natural-born Gold Spirit didn’t have any restrictions. It could go wherever it wanted, so the threat it posed was naturally great.
There was only one left, but the Genesis Substance in the pool would more or less be consumed completely by Ling Han.
Charge, no matter what, he had to reach seventy flashes.
Ling Han grasped this last chance, appreciating the great dao, extracting the Regulations.
When the light of great dao disappeared, his figure also trembled, and as his eyes opened, brilliance exploded. Pa, pa, pa, pa, it actually burst open even the Void.

It should be known that the structure here was extremely sturdy. Even if a battle broke out between Great Emperors, they would not be able to cause much damage. And now, he actually managed to burst open the Void. Just how terrifying was that?
Though the Void had only burst open for a moment, and immediately closed back up again, and there was absolutely no way anyone could enter.
The lightning struck again, yet Ling Han couldn’t even be bothered to attack, and allowed it to strike him. However, when the lightning struck him, multiple patterns of light appeared on his body.
That was the 70 eight-star Regulations formed into a net!
Ling Han was completely unscathed.
He stood up and came out of the tree hollow.
Brother Monkey and the others had already waited for a long time, and they all asked, "How’s your progress?"
Ling Han smiled, "I can rival a Pseudo-Emperor!"
<annotations style="display: none;">A Chinese saying that means help delivered when you are in need is better than congratulations offered when you are successful.</annotations>

There was nothing else that could be done.
Brother Monkey and the others could only leave first.
The large black dog wanted to stow away some Genesis Substance before leaving, but it was impossible to bring a Spatial Spirit Tool here, so how could he stow anything away?
At most, he would only keep a mouthful in his mouth, but could it be that he would have to keep it like this forever?
Meanwhile, Ling Han continued to cultivate by the pool.
He was already used to being struck by lightning, and had even developed a habit of instinctively parrying when he was experiencing the great dao.
57th, 58th, 59th!
The number of Regulations he could absorb was increasing.
Though the rate of increase was becoming slower and slower, it was also very stable.
Though Ling Han’s heart was as calm as an ancient well, he was also filled with slight anticipation.
70 Regulations was a dividing line.
Once he crossed it, he would be able to match a Pseudo-Emperor.Any more than that, he would be able to defeat even a Pseudo-Emperor.
What was the greatest threat to him now?
It was not the 36 Divine Beasts that were all hiding in the Primitive Abyss, rarely showing themselves.
Nor was it the Lords of Death, because they would be greatly restricted, and could not easily make a move.
Instead, it was the Natural-born Gold Spirit!
This was a Pseudo-Emperor in itself, and added with being controlled by a sliver of divine sense from the Lords of Death, how terrifying would its battle prowess be?
Even if Buddha Doga and the others joined forces, they could only just barely block it.
It could be claimed that this was the number one battle prowess of the Great Emperors.
The Natural-born Gold Spirit didn’t have any restrictions.
It could go wherever it wanted, so the threat it posed was naturally great.
There was only one left, but the Genesis Substance in the pool would more or less be consumed completely by Ling Han.
Charge, no matter what, he had to reach seventy flashes.
Ling Han grasped this last chance, appreciating the great dao, extracting the Regulations.
When the light of great dao disappeared, his figure also trembled, and as his eyes opened, brilliance exploded.
Pa, pa, pa, pa, it actually burst open even the Void.
It should be known that the structure here was extremely sturdy.
Even if a battle broke out between Great Emperors, they would not be able to cause much damage.
And now, he actually managed to burst open the Void.
Just how terrifying was that?
Though the Void had only burst open for a moment, and immediately closed back up again, and there was absolutely no way anyone could enter.
The lightning struck again, yet Ling Han couldn’t even be bothered to attack, and allowed it to strike him.
However, when the lightning struck him, multiple patterns of light appeared on his body.
That was the 70 eight-star Regulations formed into a net!
Ling Han was completely unscathed.
He stood up and came out of the tree hollow.
Brother Monkey and the others had already waited for a long time, and they all asked, "How’s your progress?"
Ling Han smiled, "I can rival a Pseudo-Emperor!"
<annotations style="display: none;">A Chinese saying that means help delivered when you are in need is better than congratulations offered when you are successful.</annotations>

chapters.title: Chapter 4772: Arrival of the Great Emperor
paragraphs: Hearing Ling Han’s reply, Brother Monkey and the others were all excited.
"Come, let’s go and have a great battle!" the large black dog roared.
Ling Han smiled, "Should I seek out the Lords of Death, or the Divine Beasts?"
This immediately caused the large black dog to wilt. A Pseudo-Emperor was still not enough in front of Great Emperors.
"Then let’s go deeper and search for Genesis Substance?" the little azure dragon said.
Ling Han shook his head, swept his gaze over Mo Ziyun and the others, and said with a smile, "We have to leave first, and send out the Battle Armors that they are wearing."
"En!" This made Brother Monkey and the others all nod. Whether they had Battle Armors or not truly made a difference in the Primitive Abyss.
If this batch of Battle Armors was transported out, more people would be able to enter this place and join the teams that were searching for Genesis Substance.
"Also, I want to see if these people will be ’created’ after they disappear," Ling Han added.
The little azure dragon was even more curious if the True Dragon Emperor was also created.
If that was the case, then he would hate the existence that had created the True Dragon Emperor, because this was a great insult to his father!
Thinking back to the past, the True Dragon had been rampant in the world, and was called the Number One Divine Beast, but now?
He had been defeated by a fallen Great Emperor in just two or three moves. This was practically a great humiliation to the line of the True Dragon!
They captured Mo Ziyun and the others, then retreated all the way back, tying An Heming and the others together. Then, they exited the Demonic Star Lake, and returned all the way.
It was quite peaceful when they returned. They didn’t encounter the storms of heaven and earth, and in just two months, they arrived at the Dragon Head City.
With such a large number of people, how were they supposed to pass through this city?
Go around it?
No.

Because the Dragon Head City was actually built from a severed mountain range, if they wanted to circle around it, they had to cross mountains and ridges. However, this mountain range was too terrifying. There was a super killing intent, and it was not difficult for a Pseudo-Emperor to be killed. Thus, if they took risks by circling around the city, it was extremely possible that their party would be completely wiped out.
This caused Ling Han to sigh with emotion. A Great Emperor was indeed a Great Emperor. He had actually transformed a dangerous place into a city. His power was too astonishing.
Then, should they walk into the city, and then strut out?
However, they had brought a large number of disciples of Great Emperors with them, so it would be difficult for them not to attract attention.

"In comparison, it’s safer to enter the city." Ling Han finally decided. "I have the Imperial Weapon in hand, and now I have Pseudo-Emperor battle prowess now. No matter what, I should be able to block two to three moves from the True Dragon Emperor."

Thinking of this, the four of them were filled with confidence, and Ling Han was even more expectant. If he were to battle with the True Dragon Emperor now, though he would definitely lose, just how many moves would he be able to block?
They knocked Mo Ziyun and the others unconscious, then boldly knocked on the doors.

"Lord, Lords!" When they discovered that there were actually so many people wearing Silver Battle Armors, the guards were so shocked that their eyes almost popped out of their heads, and could not even speak properly.
Ling Han nodded, "These Lords are all severely injured, and need to enter the city as soon as possible for treatment!"

"Yes, yes, yes!" The guard hurriedly invited Ling Han and the others respectfully into the city, and then reported to his superiors. With so many disciples of Great Emperors, this was of great importance.
Ling Han and the others didn’t wait, immediately bringing people with them.
With their speed, they arrived at the other side of the city gates in a short while.
Once they exited these gates, they would be able to truly set out on the path to leave.
"The Lords are here to do something, hurry up and open the doors!" the little azure dragon immediately shouted loudly.
Seeing so many people dressed in Silver Battle Armor, the guards were already stunned. How could they dare to ask too many questions? They hurriedly opened the city gates.
Ling Han and the others exchanged a smile before leaving the city with their "trophies".
At this time, even if the city discovered something was off, when they chased out again, would they still be able to catch up to Ling Han and the others?
Moreover, the True Dragon Emperor didn’t appear, so even if they chased after them, they would only be delivering themselves up to die.
Boom!

But they were out of luck. They had not walked too far, when they encountered a storm of heaven and earth. Frightening meteorites descended from the skies, and even a Great Emperor would frown at the force of their impact. Naturally, they could only stop in their tracks, and even retreat.
After taking a few steps back, Ling Han suddenly frowned.
He could sense a powerful aura rapidly surging over. It would probably arrive in two to three breaths.
After him, Brother Monkey and the others also sensed this aura.
"Haha, the True Dragon Emperor has come out of seclusion and caught up to you guys. You guys are done for!" An Heming immediately said with a cold chuckle.
—These few people had already regained consciousness, but their cultivation levels had been sealed by Ling Han, so they were unable to resist.
Furthermore, the gravity fields here were too strong. Even if they were wearing Silver Battle Armors, they were barely able to survive.
"Once a Great Emperor appears, all of you will die!"
"Humph, daring to kidnap disciples of Great Emperors, you guys are really outrageously bold!"
These prisoners all smirked coldly.

"What are you shouting for? Believe it or not, Grandpa Dog will kill all of you first!" The large black dog’s eyes shone with viciousness, scaring An Heming and the others so much that they didn’t dare to make another sound.
This was called a wise man does not fight when the odds are against him. Once the True Dragon Emperor arrived, that clown would ultimately be unable to do anything else.
"Little Han, what do we do?" the little azure dragon asked.
’F*ck! This was a Great Emperor that was coming!’
Meanwhile, Brother Monkey directly drew out his staff. So what if he was a Great Emperor? He would fight to his heart’s content.
Yet Ling Han looked surprised, and did not answer.

Xiu, just how fast was the speed of the Great Emperor? In a mere instant, a massive Azure Dragon had already caught up to them, and appeared in the skies behind them. It was a dragon soaring in the skies, exuding supreme dominance.
"True Dragon Emperor!" An Heming and the others exclaimed in excitement.
After being trampled over by Ling Han for so long, they finally saw their savior.
The large black dog and little azure dragon bared their teeth. Meanwhile, Brother Monkey tightened his grip on the metal staff and was just about to charge out to fight.
"Brother Monkey!" Ling Han stretched out a hand and placed it on Brother Monkey’s shoulder, "Leave it to me!"

Brother Monkey frowned. Under normal circumstances, Ling Han could use the Imperial Weapon to exchange a few moves with the True Dragon Emperor, covering for their escape and allowing them to escape in time.
However, this was the Primitive Abyss. Behind them was a violent meteorite rain, and anyone who entered would definitely die.
Thus, if they fought here, they could only fight to the death!
Fighting to the death with a Great Emperor, what was the result?

"Don’t worry!" Ling Han laughed loudly, and actually took the initiative to charge out. With a leap, he had arrived in midair. With a wave of his fist, boundless energy entwined around him, turning into furious fists the size of a small mountain that ruthlessly crashed towards the True Dragon Emperor.
After obtaining Pseudo-Emperor-level battle prowess, he would also be able to break free from the extreme weight of gravity to a certain extent, and soar through the air.
The True Dragon Emperor humphed coldly, and stretched out a claw to parry Ling Han’s attack.
Peng!
The fist and claw collided, and a blinding light instantly exploded in the sky. So what if they were Saints? They could only feel their vision blur, and could not see anything at all.
However, everyone shook their heads internally. Fighting a Great Emperor head-on, just how stupid was he to do that?
’You’re seeking death!’
The large black dog, Brother Monkey, and little azure dragon were also very surprised, because Ling Han actually did not awaken the Imperial Weapon.
Hiss, would Ling Han be so arrogant?
Absolutely impossible!
Could it be?
The eyes of the large black dog and the others lit up.

chapters.title: Chapter 4773: Pseudo-Emperor Battle
paragraphs: "Ah, Grandpa Dog’s poor eyes have been blinded!" the large black dog shouted.

This rendered An Heming and the others speechless. ’Are you f*cking too open-minded, or are you completely heartless? One of your people is fighting a Great Emperor, yet you’re still in the mood to joke around?’
This had already surpassed the range of despicable, right?
In the skies, the ball of light gradually dimmed.
Everyone’s eyes swept over the surroundings, yet they all looked incredibly shocked at the same time.
Ling Han was actually standing proudly in midair. He wasn’t as dead as everyone had imagined.
How was this possible?
How was this possible!
That was the True Dragon Emperor. With a single strike, the heavens and earth would collapse. If this was in the outside world, galaxies would collapse, one after another.
And now, the attack of a Great Emperor actually did not manage to kill Ling Han?
Heavens!
Everyone looked at Ling Han in shock. Could it be that this guy wasn’t a Saint at all, but rather a Great Emperor?
However, Brother Monkey and the others knew that Ling Han wasn’t a Great Emperor, but having Pseudo-Emperor-level battle prowess.
Being able to fight the True Dragon Emperor to a tie—at least, he hadn’t been defeated—what did that mean?
Right now, the True Dragon Emperor was only at the Pseudo-Emperor level.
Why?
Perhaps he had been severely wounded by Great Emperor Senluo, and had not recovered even until now.

If they knew that the True Dragon Emperor had actually been killed by Great Emperor Senluo once, they would have guessed that the True Dragon Emperor had probably been revived again. However, it could not directly reach the cultivation level of a Great Emperor, and needed to recover step by step. At present, it had only reached Pseudo-Emperor level.
But no matter what, the present cultivation level of the True Dragon Emperor was no longer capable of crushing Ling Han.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and said, "Fake True Dragon, hurry up and reveal your true form!"
"A mere Saint can actually possess Pseudo-Emperor-level battle prowess, truly remarkable!" The True Dragon Emperor spoke up, his voice booming, reverberating throughout the surroundings.
What!
Hearing these words, Mo Ziyun and the others were all numb with shock. As it turned out, Ling Han was really a Saint, but his battle prowess was... shockingly Pseudo-Emperor-level.
Hold on, so what if he was at the level of Pseudo-Emperor? Shouldn’t he be a piece of cake in front of a Great Emperor?
They were both stunned and dumbfounded. Why did they suddenly not understand?
"That’s right. You should be the savior that those old b@stards are looking forward to!" The True Dragon Emperor nodded, "Very good. After killing you, those old b@stards should give up resisting!"
These words came out of nowhere, and Mo Ziyun and the others were completely confused.
What old b@starrds? What savior?
However, Ling Han’s heart throbbed wildly. The True Dragon Emperor’s so-called old b@stards... was he referring to the Great Emperor Wu Ya, the Battle Saint Emperor and the others?

Many, many years ago, these Great Emperors had already entered the Primitive Abyss in search of the opportunity to attain immortality. Meanwhile, Ling Han had also received a message from the Great Emperor Wu Ya, saying that the Primitive Abyss was in dire need of reinforcements.
Thus, connecting the two together, the words of the True Dragon Emperor were very understandable.
Sure enough, the 36 Divine Beasts were enemies with the Battle Saint Emperor and the others!
However, what exactly was the point of conflict here?
Was this still immortality?
It didn’t seem like it. They hadn’t died even after so many years, which meant that everyone had obtained the technique of immortality. Why did they still have to fight to the death?
Moreover, if the war situation at the front lines was tense, why would the True Dragon Emperor and the others be distributed in this relatively outer circle?
A dignified Great Emperor was actually only used to guard the city? Wasn’t that ridiculous?
Ling Han felt like his mind was in a mess. There were more and more clues, so how could the truth that he had pieced together become more and more ridiculous?
The True Dragon Emperor didn’t waste any more words as he charged over with his colossal body. He swiped with his claw, and it was as if a star were crashing down. It was as heavy as could be.
Ling Han was unafraid. He already possessed Pseudo-Emperor-level battle prowess.
Peng!
He replied with a punch of his own, greeting the attack of the True Dragon Emperor.
Everyone saw a scene that caused their eyes to pop out in shock. Ling Han was battling fiercely with a Great Emperor, and was not at a disadvantage at all.
This person was actually a Saint! How could they believe this?

"Good one!" Brother Monkey and the others cheered for Ling Han. They had watched Ling Han slowly grow from weak to strong, and even Brother Monkey, who had become sworn brothers with Ling Han on a whim, would never have imagined that Ling Han would actually become so powerful, and at such a fast speed at that.

"Little Han, work harder, we’ll have roasted dragon meat and stewed dragon meat to eat tonight!" The large black dog drooled loudly. It was well known that the most delicious meat from the skies was that of a dragon, and the most delicious meat from the lands was donkey meat.
The little azure dragon’s expression instantly darkened. "Old Black, are you asking for a beating?"
Ling Han laughed loudly, "All right, we’ll eat dragon meat tonight!"
He attacked aggressively, every move domineering.
The True Dragon Emperor was actually forced to the point that he could only parry, and this made him extremely depressed.
How could a dignified Great Emperor endure this?

He could be considered to be having a bad year. First, he had been thrashed by the Great Emperor Senluo, then he had been beaten to burst by Great Emperor Senluo. Now, his abilities had not recovered yet, and that was even worse. He was actually being ravaged by a Saint.
"Ah!" The True Dragon Emperor roared in fury. His dragon’s might boiled, turning into a terrifying shockwave.
However, what use was this to Ling Han?
Ling Han channeled the Destructive Energy and light of great dao at the same time, and a strong killing intent emanated from his entire body.
Today, he was going to kill an Emperor to prove his Dao!
"What!" The True Dragon Emperor looked stunned, "A mere Saint can actually grasp the light of great dao?"
In an instant, realization dawned on him. "So, you’re the Stone of Life that those old geezers threw out!"
"I can’t let you live!"
The True Dragon Emperor raised his head and roared at the sky. The soundwaves were like waves that spread into the distance in waves.
Hearing these words from the True Dragon Emperor, Ling Han’s thoughts instantly flew.
’Stone of Life?’
It should be the Divine Stone that he had come out of rfrom the Genesis World.
However, judging by the True Dragon Emperor’s tone, there should only be one Stone of Life, which later turned into seven.

—It was believed that the Stone of Life should have been obtained by Xuan Taiyu. However, after the battle between Xuan Taiyu and the Lords of Death, the Stone of Life was shattered into seven pieces, which flew to various corners of the universe, giving rise to seven Genesis Worlds.

Ling Han had long since suspected that there was a link between the Divine Stone and the Primitive Abyss, but he had never imagined that this was actually sent out from the Primitive Abyss by the Great Emperor Wu Ya and the others.
"Ang!" As the True Dragon Emperor attacked, it continued to release dragon’s roars.

Ling Han, meanwhile, was solemn. With how terrifying the Destructive Energy and the light of great dao were, he had already suppressed the True Dragon Emperor. However, if he wanted to kill this Lord, it was not something that could be done in a short while.

However, this True Dragon Emperor had already sent out a call for help. He was sure that not too long after, the Azure Phoenix Emperor would arrive. In fact, Crimson Ape Emperor and the others would also appear.
If he were really blocked by the few Great Emperors, then no matter how powerful Ling Han was, his only fate would still be death.
Hence—

Ling Han summoned the Clear Bamboo Sword. It suddenly awakened, rapidly increasing his battle prowess. At the same time, he also released the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, increasing his defense and allowing him to penetrate deeply, only attacking and not defending.
This time, the True Dragon Emperor felt immense pressure.
It was equivalent to having to face a Great Emperor and a Pseudo-Emperor at the same time, and this Pseudo-Emperor still had a Pseudo-Imperial Weapon protecting him.
How was he supposed to withstand this?
