The True Dragon Emperor’s so-called old b@stards... was he referring to the Great Emperor Wu Ya, the Battle Saint Emperor and the others?
Many, many years ago, these Great Emperors had already entered the Primitive Abyss in search of the opportunity to attain immortality.
Meanwhile, Ling Han had also received a message from the Great Emperor Wu Ya, saying that the Primitive Abyss was in dire need of reinforcements.
Thus, connecting the two together, the words of the True Dragon Emperor were very understandable.
Sure enough, the 36 Divine Beasts were enemies with the Battle Saint Emperor and the others!
However, what exactly was the point of conflict here?
Was this still immortality?
It didn’t seem like it.
They hadn’t died even after so many years, which meant that everyone had obtained the technique of immortality.
Why did they still have to fight to the death?
Moreover, if the war situation at the front lines was tense, why would the True Dragon Emperor and the others be distributed in this relatively outer circle?
A dignified Great Emperor was actually only used to guard the city?
Wasn’t that ridiculous?
Ling Han felt like his mind was in a mess.
There were more and more clues, so how could the truth that he had pieced together become more and more ridiculous?
The True Dragon Emperor didn’t waste any more words as he charged over with his colossal body.
He swiped with his claw, and it was as if a star were crashing down.
It was as heavy as could be.
Ling Han was unafraid.
He already possessed Pseudo-Emperor-level battle prowess.
Peng!
He replied with a punch of his own, greeting the attack of the True Dragon Emperor.
Everyone saw a scene that caused their eyes to pop out in shock.
Ling Han was battling fiercely with a Great Emperor, and was not at a disadvantage at all.
This person was actually a Saint!
How could they believe this?
"Good one!" Brother Monkey and the others cheered for Ling Han.

They had watched Ling Han slowly grow from weak to strong, and even Brother Monkey, who had become sworn brothers with Ling Han on a whim, would never have imagined that Ling Han would actually become so powerful, and at such a fast speed at that.
"Little Han, work harder, we’ll have roasted dragon meat and stewed dragon meat to eat tonight!" The large black dog drooled loudly.
It was well known that the most delicious meat from the skies was that of a dragon, and the most delicious meat from the lands was donkey meat.
The little azure dragon’s expression instantly darkened.
"Old Black, are you asking for a beating?"
Ling Han laughed loudly, "All right, we’ll eat dragon meat tonight!"
He attacked aggressively, every move domineering.
The True Dragon Emperor was actually forced to the point that he could only parry, and this made him extremely depressed.
How could a dignified Great Emperor endure this?
He could be considered to be having a bad year.
First, he had been thrashed by the Great Emperor Senluo, then he had been beaten to burst by Great Emperor Senluo.
Now, his abilities had not recovered yet, and that was even worse.
He was actually being ravaged by a Saint.
"Ah!" The True Dragon Emperor roared in fury.
His dragon’s might boiled, turning into a terrifying shockwave.
However, what use was this to Ling Han?
Ling Han channeled the Destructive Energy and light of great dao at the same time, and a strong killing intent emanated from his entire body.
Today, he was going to kill an Emperor to prove his Dao!
"What!" The True Dragon Emperor looked stunned, "A mere Saint can actually grasp the light of great dao?"
In an instant, realization dawned on him.
"So, you’re the Stone of Life that those old geezers threw out!"
"I can’t let you live!"
The True Dragon Emperor raised his head and roared at the sky.
The soundwaves were like waves that spread into the distance in waves.
Hearing these words from the True Dragon Emperor, Ling Han’s thoughts instantly flew.
’Stone of Life?’
It should be the Divine Stone that he had come out of rfrom the Genesis World.
However, judging by the True Dragon Emperor’s tone, there should only be one Stone of Life, which later turned into seven.
—It was believed that the Stone of Life should have been obtained by Xuan Taiyu.

However, after the battle between Xuan Taiyu and the Lords of Death, the Stone of Life was shattered into seven pieces, which flew to various corners of the universe, giving rise to seven Genesis Worlds.

Ling Han had long since suspected that there was a link between the Divine Stone and the Primitive Abyss, but he had never imagined that this was actually sent out from the Primitive Abyss by the Great Emperor Wu Ya and the others.
"Ang!" As the True Dragon Emperor attacked, it continued to release dragon’s roars.
Ling Han, meanwhile, was solemn.
With how terrifying the Destructive Energy and the light of great dao were, he had already suppressed the True Dragon Emperor.
However, if he wanted to kill this Lord, it was not something that could be done in a short while.
However, this True Dragon Emperor had already sent out a call for help.
He was sure that not too long after, the Azure Phoenix Emperor would arrive.
In fact, Crimson Ape Emperor and the others would also appear.
If he were really blocked by the few Great Emperors, then no matter how powerful Ling Han was, his only fate would still be death.
Hence—
Ling Han summoned the Clear Bamboo Sword.
It suddenly awakened, rapidly increasing his battle prowess.
At the same time, he also released the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, increasing his defense and allowing him to penetrate deeply, only attacking and not defending.
This time, the True Dragon Emperor felt immense pressure.
It was equivalent to having to face a Great Emperor and a Pseudo-Emperor at the same time, and this Pseudo-Emperor still had a Pseudo-Imperial Weapon protecting him.
How was he supposed to withstand this?

chapters.title: Chapter 4774: Slaughtering Emperor
paragraphs: Ling Han’s attacks became fiercer and fiercer, one wave stronger than the last.
There wasn’t much time left for him, and the meteorite shower just happened to cut off the True Dragon Emperor’s path of retreat, giving him a chance to kill the True Dragon Emperor.
Otherwise, even Saints were difficult to kill, what more a Pseudo-Emperor.
Below, Mo Ziyun and the others were already watching dumbfounded.
Heavens, there was actually a possibility that the True Dragon Emperor could be killed!
Even if the True Dragon Emperor was now a Pseudo-Emperor, they still couldn’t accept this at all.
In their hearts, every Divine Beast was all-powerful and invincible.
Looking at this kind of battle, all of them felt their scalps go numb. How could it be that the invincible Great Emperor would be slaughtered today?

The True Dragon Emperor fought to the death. Firstly, he had already been forced to the point of no retreat by Ling Han. He had to dodge the meteorite rain even when he had been a Great Emperor, what more when it was only a Pseudo-Emperor that was fighting now. Secondly, he had already sent out a signal for reinforcements, and reinforcements should arrive soon.
Thus, what he had to do now was to hold Ling Han back.
Although he was extremely confident, Ling Han was still a variable that could slightly affect "his" grand plan. Thus, he had to be eliminated.
In any case, it didn’t matter even if he died. It wasn’t like he couldn’t come back to life.
Fight, fight, fight.
Ling Han also knew that time was of the essence. Even the Imperial Weapon and Pseudo-Imperial Weapon were summoned at the same time. He had to kill the True Dragon Emperor as soon as possible.
Boom!
He spared no expense, and even used the holy flame.
Once this move was used, his battle prowess instantly rose to another level.
The True Dragon Emperor’s expression finally changed drastically. "Even the Destruction Origin Seed has fallen into your hands?"
If it was said that there was only a slight possibility that it would affect his grand plan previously, then now, the possibility had increased tenfold!
The Seed of the Holy Flame was also called the Destruction Origin Seed?
No wonder its destructive power was so terrifying. It was also related to the word "destruction".
Ling Han humphed, "Now you can go on your way in peace!"

He had even used this holy flame, which meant that Ling Han was going to put his life on the line, and he had the upper hand in the first place. If he put his life on the line again, just how terrifying would his battle prowess be?
The True Dragon Emperor had nowhere else to retreat, so he could only face this attack head-on.
And right at this moment, the meteorite rain actually began to weaken.
This terrifying storm of heaven and earth was about to end.
The True Dragon Emperor looked pleasantly surprised. Once the storm of heaven and earth ended, he would be able to escape.
Though he could still come back to life, there was ultimately a price to be paid. If he could avoid death, he naturally would.
"You won’t have the chance!" Ling Han said coldly. He had already used the holy flame, so how could he allow the True Dragon Emperor to escape?
Hong! Hong! Hong!
He aggressively attacked, and the Imperial Weapon and Pseudo-Imperial Weapon bombarded him madly, endlessly smashing into the body of the True Dragon Emperor.
"Wu!" Even someone as powerful as the True Dragon Emperor let out a muffled groan. Whether it was the Imperial Weapon or the Pseudo-Imperial Weapon, being blasted by it would result in great pain.
However, what he was most wary of was still Ling Han’s own attack.

The holy flame, Destructive Energy and light of great dao were combined. The destructive power they formed was too terrifying, and even he didn’t dare to take them head-on. Otherwise, with his current cultivation level of Pseudo-Emperor, he would definitely die.
The problem was, were Imperial Weapons and Pseudo-Imperial Weapons weak?
After taking a few consecutive blows, the True Dragon Emperor was also throwing up blood madly. He couldn’t hold on any longer.
’Hmm?’
Ling Han suddenly sensed that an incredibly powerful aura was rapidly approaching from behind him.
The Azure Phoenix Emperor!
"Haha, your time of death has come!" the True Dragon Emperor said with a laugh.
Ling Han shook his head, and said, "As a mighty Great Emperor, you actually need someone to save you? You’re not worthy of being called a Great Emperor at all!"
"Die!"

He charged forward. At this moment, the True Dragon Emperor had been blasted several times by the Imperial Weapon and Pseudo-Imperial Weapon. He was at its weakest, so how could he possibly withstand the attacks?
Peng! Peng! Peng!

Ling Han threw three punches in a row, all of which landed on the True Dragon Emperor’s chest. The power of his punches entered the True Dragon Emperor’s body, and their destructive power was boundless. In an instant, the True Dragon Emperor’s vitality was extinguished.
Heavens!
Seeing this scene, everyone was numb with shock.
Slaughter an Emperor!
A mere Saint had actually performed the miracle of killing an Emperor, even if the cultivation level of this Great Emperor had already "fallen" to Pseudo-Emperor-level.

Mo Ziyun and the others could not believe their eyes. Even if the Azure Phoenix Emperor was rapidly approaching them from behind, they could not feel anything at all. In front of their eyes, and in their minds, they could still see the scene of the True Dragon Emperor being forcefully destroyed by Ling Han.
"Let’s go!"

Ling Han did not hesitate in the slightest. He picked up Brother Monkey and the others, then picked up Mo Ziyun and the others as well. Finally, he dragged the True Dragon Emperor’s corpse with him, and charged forward madly.
"Humph, I’m here, and you still want to run?" The Azure Phoenix Emperor’s voice sounded in Ling Han’s mind.
F***, the Azure Phoenix was actually a man?
Ling Han was shocked. This Divine Beast had revived, and actually changed its gender?
He mocked internally, then fled with all his might.
Shua, shua, shua! He continuously slashed out with the Clear Bamboo Sword. Sword Qi danced unhindered, and no matter what, it would be able to stop the Azure Phoenix Emperor for a while.

However, a Great Emperor and Pseudo-Emperor weren’t from the same dimension at all. Ling Han could kill the True Dragon Emperor, but in front of the Azure Phoenix Emperor, he couldn’t even withstand a single blow.
So what if the Imperial Weapon delivered an attack? With a casual flap of his wings, the Sword Qi that blasted out would be shattered, and it could be said that the obstruction to him was negligible.

Thankfully, no matter what, Ling Han still had Pseudo-Emperor-level battle prowess, so his speed had naturally increased to another level. Even if the Azure Phoenix Emperor was closing in on him, he could still maintain it for a while before being caught up.
Boom!
Right at this moment, the storm of heaven and earth came again.
A flame gushed out, turning into a spring that spread out in all directions.

Coincidentally, the location of Ling Han and the Azure Phoenix Emperor just happened to sandwich the spring of flames. Thus, the moment the flames appeared, they turned into a wall of fire, separating Ling Han and the Azure Phoenix Emperor on either side.
Even as powerful as the Great Emperor, he could only stop and retreat in the face of this storm of heaven and earth. Otherwise, he would definitely die if he faced it head-on.

Ling Han didn’t dare to breathe a sigh of relief. The violent flames were hot on his heels, and if he was one step slower, he would be caught up. It was guaranteed that even a Pseudo-Emperor would be burnt to ashes.
He ran with all his might, and the speed of the flames was actually not slower than him. They continued to close in on him from behind.
"Little Han, hurry up and run! Grandpa Dog’s hair is about to be burnt bald!" The large black dog was still screaming in pain.
Ling Han’s body was also boiling hot. Even if the flames hadn’t reached him yet, they had already caused him a lot of trouble.

He ran madly, and after running for a whole five days and five nights, the flames behind him finally stopped chasing him. They had already burned to the limit of their range, and the flames soared skywards, which was extremely terrifying.
Ling Han glanced at it, then turned around and left.

Now that the danger had been resolved, everyone naturally rushed on their own, and even if Mo Ziyun and the others had already recovered their cultivation level, they did not dare to make any rash moves.
Could they not see that Ling Han was holding the corpse of the True Dragon in his hands?
If they didn’t want to die, they had best listen obediently.
A few months later, they came out of the Primitive Abyss and arrived on the Four Origin Planet.
All three Pseudo-Emperors were nowhere to be seen.

This was very normal. They had gone to recruit other Imperial Clans, and this trip would take at least 400 years, and taking into account the time in the Primitive Abyss, that would take as long as 40,000 years.
It was still too early!
However, because Hu Niu, the empress, and the others had also gone to the Primitive Abyss, they soon returned.
"Eat meat!" When she saw the True Dragon’s corpse, Hu Niu’s eyes instantly shone brightly, and she drooled.
"Haha, we’ll eat dragon meat tonight!" Ling Han waved his hand and decided.
Everyone cheered. This was True Dragon meat, and it was Pseudo-Emperor-level at that. It was definitely very nutritious.
The little azure dragon: "..."
Why didn’t anyone ask for his opinion!

chapters.title: Chapter 4775: Calling for help
paragraphs: Ling Han reserved a portion of dragon meat for Buddha Doga and the others. He then prepared the rest of the meat and began cooking.
This was True Dragon meat! Even though it was only a Pseudo-Emperor, it was still emanating Imperial Might. Saints could not approach at all.
Ling Han could only cleanse the Imperial Might and harmful substances from the dragon’s flesh, leaving behind only pure natural energy.
Cooking this was also extremely slow. How difficult would it be to thoroughly cook a Pseudo-Emperor-level precious meat?

It was still because this True Dragon didn’t live up to its name, and its physical body wasn’t all that tough. Otherwise, if it was the one from the ancient era, even a Pseudo-Emperor could not slice open its flesh.
However, before the dragon meat was cooked, they discovered that the Primitive Abysswas exuding a terrifying aura one after another.
The Azure Phoenix Great Emperor, Crimson Ape Great Emperor, Flying Snake Great Emperor... the remaining eight Great Emperors in the first level all appeared!
This lineup could be said to be terrifying.

Eight Great Emperors. Even if these were inferior to the batch from years ago, their advantage lay in their numbers. It was guaranteed that even the Lords of Death would turn around and flee upon seeing them, not daring to face them head-on.

How could Ling Han still have the time to cook? He hurriedly stored all three planets into his body, including the Genesis World dimensions that he had previously split out. Then, he fled into the Void to avoid being traced by the Great Emperors.
If he were to battle against a Great Emperor, he would definitely be no match for it at this moment. However, it would still be no problem for him to dodge the search of the Great Emperor.

The eight Great Emperors split up, and began a search in the vast space. However, even if the Great Emperor possessed all-powerful abilities, it was practically impossible to find Ling Han in such a large space.
Ling Han waited quietly. A dozen over days later, he finally came out of the Void, and released the three planets and the dimensions.
Continue.
Ling Han became a chef again. Then, a month later, the dragon meat was finally cooked.
Eat!
As long as one had reached Saint Tier, everyone would have a share. This was Pseudo-Emperor-level dragon meat. It was definitely very nutritious.
However, even Saints could only take a small bite. Multicolored light burst from their bodies, and it was as if they were about to ascend and die.
Only Ling Han was completely unconcerned, and ate ravenously, not stopping at all.
After eating, everyone immediately began to sit cross-legged and cultivate.
This was the meat of a Pseudo-Emperor, how many people in history would be able to eat it?
Weng, weng, weng! Resplendent light continuously exuded from their bodies. This meant that they had all attained a breakthrough.
Ling Han’s improvement was also obvious. He had touched the ceiling of his cultivation level.

At the level of Three Star Saint, he had accommodated too many Regulations, which was more or less his limit. Thus, even if he still had Genesis Substance, he could not possibly accommodate more Regulations without his body experiencing Silent Destruction again.
The breakthrough this time could also be said to have come naturally.
Ling Han started to break through.
It took a very long time, and after a whole half year’s time, he finally managed to have another part of his body go through Silent Destruction, and advance into the level of Four Stars.
75 Regulations!

Ling Han believed that with his current strength, he should be able to exchange blows with Qian Yanghao and Xia Houping. When he reached the level of 80 Regulations, he would be able to match Buddha Doga. And when he reached the level of 85, or even 90 Regulations, he would be able to look down on the level of Pseudo-Emperor.
It seemed like he had found another way to rapidly increase his cultivation level!
It should be known that within the Primitive Abyss, there were still 35 Divine Beasts.
Unfortunately, these were all Great Emperors, and he was no match for them.
Hold on!
If the Great Emperor could also be revived, then didn’t that mean that the True Dragon Emperor would soon appear again?
If that was the case, they would be able to eat dragon meat again.
Ling Han waited for a while, then quietly entered the Primitive Abyss by himself.
Of course, just to be safe, he drew everyone into his body.
He arrived at the Dragon Head City and used his divine sense to scan the surroundings. However, he couldn’t find any signs of the True Dragon Emperor.
Was it because there was too little time, and this Great Emperor had not been revived yet? Or was it because he feared that he would fleece him again, so he might as well not revive here?
Ling Han couldn’t find out the answer, but he also didn’t find any new disciples of the Great Emperor in the city.
He was unwilling to give up, so he hid in the city, and observed if anything strange had happened.
However, after a few years, the eight Divine Beast Emperors returned, and the Azure Phoenix Emperor directly stood guard here.
Ling Han didn’t dare to stay any longer and quietly left the city, leaving the Primitive Abyss.
Now, it would become extremely difficult to enter the Primitive Abyss to search for Genesis Substance.

The beings there had already set their eyes on him. Previously, the eight Divine Beast Emperors had all come out to search for him, and now, the Azure Phoenix Emperor was guarding here, which made him extremely wary.
Hold on.
Ling Han suddenly faltered. Could it be that these Divine Beast Emperors were standing guard here just to intercept him?
Otherwise, just for the sake of mining, what need was there for Great Emperors to be mobilized?

He possessed the elements of the Primitive Abyss, such as the holy flame, Destructive Energy and light of great dao. Thus, those Great Emperors were very wary of him, and did not want him to pass through the many barricades to meet up with Great Emperor Wu Ya and the others.
With this in mind, the fact that the 36 Divine Beast Emperors were overseeing the core path that led to the Primitive Abyss could be explained.
Hiss, going by that theory, could it be that in the core of the Primitive Abyss, there were even more Divine Beast Emperors?
In the ancient times, the number of Divine Beasts was indeed not just thirty-six.
Ling Han gritted his teeth. He had finally dealt with a True Dragon Emperor after much difficulty, but why did the situation seem to have become even more dire?

"I can’t go to the Primitive Abyss for the time being," he muttered. "Those Great Emperors are definitely looking for me everywhere. F*ck, there are still the Lords of Death outside. Why do I feel like I’ve become a rat?"
He couldn’t help but reflect on his actions. Had he done some heinous deed? How had he fallen to such a miserable state?

"Little Han, I just received news!" The large black dog ran over, "Among those fallen Imperial Sons, several Pseudo-Emperors have emerged all of a sudden. They are presently attacking those Imperial Clans that have fled. Those Imperial Clans are all in imminent danger, and are seeking help from us."
Though there was no Galaxy Network, through the sequence in which the life tokens were shattered, Four Origin Planet could still communicate with the various Imperial Clans.
"All right, send out troops to save them!" Ling Han’s eyes lit up. He had just obtained Pseudo-Emperor-level battle prowess, and was just wanting to make a move.
The large black dog shook his head, and said, "However, we’ll need at least 200 years to reach that place. By then, it’ll probably be too late."
Ling Han smiled and said, "I couldn’t do anything before, but now, I should be able to set up a teleportation formation for an extremely long distance."
"You can do that from so far away?" the large black dog asked in shock.
Ling Han nodded, "We’ll only know after trying."

Previously, there was nothing he could do, because he only had Saint-level battle prowess, but it was different now. His battle prowess had already advanced into Pseudo-Emperor-level. More importantly, he had a great many Silver Battle Armors in his possession. If he dismantled them and used them as formation foundations, they would be able to withstand the burden of super long-distance teleportation.

sentences.text: Ling Han reserved a portion of dragon meat for Buddha Doga and the others.
He then prepared the rest of the meat and began cooking.
This was True Dragon meat!
Even though it was only a Pseudo-Emperor, it was still emanating Imperial Might.
Saints could not approach at all.
Ling Han could only cleanse the Imperial Might and harmful substances from the dragon’s flesh, leaving behind only pure natural energy.
Cooking this was also extremely slow.
How difficult would it be to thoroughly cook a Pseudo-Emperor-level precious meat?
It was still because this True Dragon didn’t live up to its name, and its physical body wasn’t all that tough.
Otherwise, if it was the one from the ancient era, even a Pseudo-Emperor could not slice open its flesh.
However, before the dragon meat was cooked, they discovered that the Primitive Abysswas exuding a terrifying aura one after another.
The Azure Phoenix Great Emperor, Crimson Ape Great Emperor, Flying Snake Great Emperor... the remaining eight Great Emperors in the first level all appeared!
This lineup could be said to be terrifying.
Eight Great Emperors.
Even if these were inferior to the batch from years ago, their advantage lay in their numbers.
It was guaranteed that even the Lords of Death would turn around and flee upon seeing them, not daring to face them head-on.
How could Ling Han still have the time to cook?
He hurriedly stored all three planets into his body, including the Genesis World dimensions that he had previously split out.
Then, he fled into the Void to avoid being traced by the Great Emperors.
If he were to battle against a Great Emperor, he would definitely be no match for it at this moment.
However, it would still be no problem for him to dodge the search of the Great Emperor.
The eight Great Emperors split up, and began a search in the vast space.
However, even if the Great Emperor possessed all-powerful abilities, it was practically impossible to find Ling Han in such a large space.
Ling Han waited quietly.
A dozen over days later, he finally came out of the Void, and released the three planets and the dimensions.
Continue.
Ling Han became a chef again.
Then, a month later, the dragon meat was finally cooked.
Eat!
As long as one had reached Saint Tier, everyone would have a share.
This was Pseudo-Emperor-level dragon meat.
It was definitely very nutritious.
However, even Saints could only take a small bite.
Multicolored light burst from their bodies, and it was as if they were about to ascend and die.
Only Ling Han was completely unconcerned, and ate ravenously, not stopping at all.
After eating, everyone immediately began to sit cross-legged and cultivate.
This was the meat of a Pseudo-Emperor, how many people in history would be able to eat it?
Weng, weng, weng!
Resplendent light continuously exuded from their bodies.
This meant that they had all attained a breakthrough.
Ling Han’s improvement was also obvious.
He had touched the ceiling of his cultivation level.
At the level of Three Star Saint, he had accommodated too many Regulations, which was more or less his limit.
Thus, even if he still had Genesis Substance, he could not possibly accommodate more Regulations without his body experiencing Silent Destruction again.
The breakthrough this time could also be said to have come naturally.
Ling Han started to break through.
It took a very long time, and after a whole half year’s time, he finally managed to have another part of his body go through Silent Destruction, and advance into the level of Four Stars.
75 Regulations!
Ling Han believed that with his current strength, he should be able to exchange blows with Qian Yanghao and Xia Houping.
When he reached the level of 80 Regulations, he would be able to match Buddha Doga.
And when he reached the level of 85, or even 90 Regulations, he would be able to look down on the level of Pseudo-Emperor.
It seemed like he had found another way to rapidly increase his cultivation level!
It should be known that within the Primitive Abyss, there were still 35 Divine Beasts.
Unfortunately, these were all Great Emperors, and he was no match for them.
Hold on!
If the Great Emperor could also be revived, then didn’t that mean that the True Dragon Emperor would soon appear again?
If that was the case, they would be able to eat dragon meat again.
Ling Han waited for a while, then quietly entered the Primitive Abyss by himself.
Of course, just to be safe, he drew everyone into his body.
He arrived at the Dragon Head City and used his divine sense to scan the surroundings.
However, he couldn’t find any signs of the True Dragon Emperor.
Was it because there was too little time, and this Great Emperor had not been revived yet?
Or was it because he feared that he would fleece him again, so he might as well not revive here?
Ling Han couldn’t find out the answer, but he also didn’t find any new disciples of the Great Emperor in the city.
He was unwilling to give up, so he hid in the city, and observed if anything strange had happened.
However, after a few years, the eight Divine Beast Emperors returned, and the Azure Phoenix Emperor directly stood guard here.
Ling Han didn’t dare to stay any longer and quietly left the city, leaving the Primitive Abyss.
Now, it would become extremely difficult to enter the Primitive Abyss to search for Genesis Substance.
The beings there had already set their eyes on him.
Previously, the eight Divine Beast Emperors had all come out to search for him, and now, the Azure Phoenix Emperor was guarding here, which made him extremely wary.
Hold on.
Ling Han suddenly faltered.
Could it be that these Divine Beast Emperors were standing guard here just to intercept him?
Otherwise, just for the sake of mining, what need was there for Great Emperors to be mobilized?
He possessed the elements of the Primitive Abyss, such as the holy flame, Destructive Energy and light of great dao.
Thus, those Great Emperors were very wary of him, and did not want him to pass through the many barricades to meet up with Great Emperor Wu Ya and the others.
With this in mind, the fact that the 36 Divine Beast Emperors were overseeing the core path that led to the Primitive Abyss could be explained.
Hiss, going by that theory, could it be that in the core of the Primitive Abyss, there were even more Divine Beast Emperors?
In the ancient times, the number of Divine Beasts was indeed not just thirty-six.
Ling Han gritted his teeth.
He had finally dealt with a True Dragon Emperor after much difficulty, but why did the situation seem to have become even more dire?
"I can’t go to the Primitive Abyss for the time being," he muttered.
"Those Great Emperors are definitely looking for me everywhere.
F*ck, there are still the Lords of Death outside.
Why do I feel like I’ve become a rat?"
He couldn’t help but reflect on his actions.
Had he done some heinous deed?
How had he fallen to such a miserable state?
"Little Han, I just received news!" The large black dog ran over, "Among those fallen Imperial Sons, several Pseudo-Emperors have emerged all of a sudden.
They are presently attacking those Imperial Clans that have fled.
Those Imperial Clans are all in imminent danger, and are seeking help from us."
Though there was no Galaxy Network, through the sequence in which the life tokens were shattered, Four Origin Planet could still communicate with the various Imperial Clans.
"All right, send out troops to save them!" Ling Han’s eyes lit up.
He had just obtained Pseudo-Emperor-level battle prowess, and was just wanting to make a move.
The large black dog shook his head, and said, "However, we’ll need at least 200 years to reach that place.
By then, it’ll probably be too late."
Ling Han smiled and said, "I couldn’t do anything before, but now, I should be able to set up a teleportation formation for an extremely long distance."
"You can do that from so far away?" the large black dog asked in shock.
Ling Han nodded, "We’ll only know after trying."
Previously, there was nothing he could do, because he only had Saint-level battle prowess, but it was different now.
His battle prowess had already advanced into Pseudo-Emperor-level.
More importantly, he had a great many Silver Battle Armors in his possession.
If he dismantled them and used them as formation foundations, they would be able to withstand the burden of super long-distance teleportation.

chapters.title: Chapter 4776: Breaking through the Imperial Formation
paragraphs: Ling Han began to construct the Transfer Formation.

This was not much different from an ordinary Transfer Formation. However, because the distance they could cross was really very far, it naturally had extremely high requirements for energy consumption and ingredients.
You see, even a Pseudo-Emperor would have to expend Imperial Source to arrive at the destination, which showed how colossal the price was.

Ling Han’s trump card was those Silver Battle Armors. There was Genesis Substance inside them. Though the amount was very limited, if it was used to construct a Transfer Formation, there should still be a chance of success.
On one side, he was constructing, and on the other side, he was also communicating with the corresponding Imperial Clan, and similarly set up the sub-formation for the Transfer Formation.

—The Imperial Clan naturally did not have Genesis Substance, but that was all right. Whichever side one was teleporting from, that side would bear the lion’s share of the expenditure. Thus, Ling Han only had to bring enough materials, and construct a new sub-formation at the Imperial Clan’s side.
The key was whether he could be teleported to the right location or not.
In just a single day, Ling Han had already finished constructing the Transfer Formation.
Through the connection of their life tokens, the Transfer Formation on the other side was also completed.
All right, let’s set out.

Because he didn’t know if he could succeed, Ling Han was naturally the only one on the first mission. Only when he safely arrived would he send out a signal for Brother Monkey and the others to come over.
Of course, the fewer people that came, the better. To travel so far across the universe, the expense was really too great. Ling Han might not even have enough materials in his possession.
Because of their close relations, the first stop that Ling Han chose was the Donglin Planet.
Weng, the teleportation began. The formation foundations created by the Silver Battle Armor immediately emitted a shocking light, and then Ling Han suddenly disappeared.

He began to traverse through the Void at a high speed. In just over half a day, the Void passageway suddenly exploded, and Ling Han’s whole person was thrown out. Boom, violent energy surged, which was extremely terrifying.
Thankfully, he presently had Pseudo-Emperor-level battle prowess, and this was only slightly troublesome for him, but could not wound him.
Ling Han looked around. This was a world of darkness, but it was not an empty space. Instead, there were a great many stars, but they had all dimmed and extinguished.

He revealed a smile. Though the teleportation had failed, it had also sent him to the central area of the universe. It would be simple to find those Imperial Clan planets from here. It would only take a few steps to get there.
His divine sense spread out, and Ling Han began to locate the whereabouts.
On the other side, Donglin Planet.

Peng, they had finished constructing the Transfer Formation. This was a sub-formation, which had the effect of being a location to be navigated to. They were filled with anticipation that Ling Han and three Pseudo-Emperor would appear together to resolve a great disaster, but all of a sudden, this sub-formation actually exploded.
They were done for!
In the clan, the Saints and Venerates all wore ugly expressions.
These were the core members of the Chi Clan. At present, there were two Saints and eleven Venerates.

"Ancestor, what are we going to do?" a Venerate said to Chi Taiming. His name was Chi Xuan, and he was extremely young. He was only a few thousand years older than Chi Menghan. Previously, he had been the Imperial Son of the Chi Clan, but following Chi Menghan’s sudden appearance, his brilliance had dimmed.
However, now that Chi Menghan had "married", his status had also risen accordingly. He had become an important heir of the Chi Clan again, and was on the same level as Chi Dao.
"It’s impossible for Buddha Doga and the others to arrive!" Chi Xuan said. "Why don’t we surrender?"

Chi Taiming couldn’t help but raise his white brows, and said in displeasure, "We’re the descendants of an Ancestral King. In the past, Ancestor ruled over an era and suppressed demons and monsters from the Netherworld, and now we’re actually going to surrender to these demons and monsters? Humph, how are we supposed to meet Ancestor after death?"
Chi Xuan muttered internally. Ancestor had long since passed away. His soul had fused with heaven and earth, and even if they died, they could not possibly meet him.
However, he didn’t dare to say this directly, so he could only hesitate.

"However, Ancestor, the army is at the city gates. If we fight to the death, it’s very likely that the entire clan will be destroyed!" Another Venerate advised. His name was Chi Xiyue, and he was much older than the others. The whiteness of his beard was not the slightest bit inferior to Chi Taiming.

Chi Taiming was unmoved, and said, "Menghan and Ling Han are together. I’ve already sent out news that if all the members of the Chi Clan die in battle, they’ll have a son with the surname of Chi! In any case, the Imperial Weapon can’t be seized, and in the future, when Menghan passes down the control technique, our Chi Clan can still start from the beginning again!"
Chi Xuan, Chi Xiyue, and the others who voted to surrender all frowned. They didn’t want to die!

"Ancestor, just how valuable is the Imperial Weapon? If all of us from the Chi Clan die in battle, who knows if Ling Han will ask Menghan for the method to control the Imperial Weapon, and take advantage of the opening to snatch the Imperial Weapon!" they continued to persuade.
"Humph, if you guys have so much energy to talk, why don’t you save it for battle!" Chi Taiming’s tone was very heavy, showing that the old man was already very furious.
If it was not for the fact that these two people were his descendants, he might have long since killed them with a single palm strike.
The words of a Nine-Star Saint were no less than the willpower of heaven and earth, and you guys are actually still blabbering nonsense?
Boom!
At this time, a massive sound of impact rang out in the skies, and the whole ground was trembling endlessly.
"Chi Clan, surrender quickly!" A voice rang out. If one were to carefully distinguish it, they would be able to tell that this was Shi Gang.

Outside the imperial formation, there were 12 Skeleton Saint Tools standing behind Shi Gang. Meanwhile, he controlled the Imperial Weapon, the Demon Subduing Staff, to continuously attack the imperial formation.
He was shockingly a Pseudo-Emperor!

Pseudo-Emperor and Imperial Weapon. This lineup was too frightening. Furthermore, the twelve Skeleton Saint Tools were incredibly powerful, barging into the imperial formation by force. Even the imperial formation could only stop them, and could not damage them. It implicated a great amount of power, causing Shi Gang to be able to continuously weaken the might of the imperial formation, and it was only a matter of time before the imperial formation was completely broken.
He was not in a hurry. That way, he would have the thrill of a cat toying with a mouse.

He was a petty person, so once he became a Pseudo-Emperor, he immediately charged over to the Donglin Imperial Clan. He wanted to capture a few people from the Donglin Imperial Clan and use them to threaten and toy with Ling Han.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
Under the powerful bombardment of the Demon Subduing Staff, the imperial formation was on the verge of collapse.

If it was just an Imperial Weapon, though the Imperial Formation could do nothing against it, it was also unafraid. However, added with a Pseudo-Emperor and twelve Skeleton Saint Tools, it was a completely different story.
Kuang!
After reaching a critical point, the imperial formation finally crumbled.
"Hahaha!" Shi Gang laughed loudly, his hand holding the Demon Subduing Staff, as he strode into the ancestral grounds of the Chi Clan.
In this world, who could stop him?
"Unfilial brats of the Chi Clan, are you still not going to bow your heads and plead your crimes to me?" He activated his Imperial Might, an aura that could drive one to despair.
Pa, pa, pa! Countless people fell to their knees. It wasn’t that they truly wanted to surrender, but rather that they couldn’t withstand the Imperial Might.
A Pseudo-Emperor still bore the name of Emperor!
"Lord Shi, on behalf of the Chi Clan, we are willing to submit to you!" Chi Xuan and Chi Xiyue immediately called out loudly.
In the present situation, if they were the ones who surrendered first, it would definitely be of great significance to Shi Gang.
"Traitors!" Chi Taiming couldn’t help but humph, and a cold light finally shot from his eyes.
There was no need for this kind of clansmen to exist!

chapters.title: Chapter 4777: Pseudo-Emperor, Shi Gang
paragraphs: Chi Feihong immediately moved, grabbing out at Chi Xuan and Chi Xiyue.
He was a Saint, so how could Chi Xuan and Chi Xiyue block or dodge his attack?
However, even though he had grabbed down, he was unable to withdraw his hand.
A disdainful smile appeared on Shi Gang’s face, and he said, "Where did you get such courage to attack me?"

Chi Feihong’s forehead was covered with cold sweat. Though the large hand he had stretched out was formed from a sliver of divine sense that was wrapped with Regulations, and was not his real body, it was still firmly restrained, and could not be retracted. In fact, it was about to be severed.
If this was really severed, then his spirit would definitely be wounded.
"Humph!" How could Chi Taiming just stand by and watch? He was just about to make a move.

"Break!" Shi Gang said calmly. Peng, Chi Feihong’s extended hand immediately crumbled, but there was no trace of blood. Instead, it was extremely pure energy that immediately returned to the heaven and earth.
He was a Pseudo-Emperor!

Moreover, even if he had not become a Pseudo-Emperor, with his aptitude as the personal disciple of a Great Emperor, he had long since been able to match a veteran nine-star Saint like Chi Taiming when he had been a six-star Saint.
Thus, in his eyes, the Chi Clan only had two things to rely on: the Imperial Formation and the Imperial Weapon.
Now that the Imperial Formation had been unravelled, in the case of Imperial Weapon, he would also have one in his possession that could cancel it out.
Then, in a battle of elite against elite, who could be a match for him?
Chi Taiming took a deep breath before proudly stepping forward to block his path.

"If you don’t die from old age, you’re a <anno data-annotation-id="e9019821-c611-42c1-b135-9d1905a329d0" data-title="thief">thief1</anno>!" Shi Gang sneered, his expression filled with mockery, "When I swept through the universe all those years ago, who knew where you were! And now, you actually dare to brandish your weapons in front of me. I really don’t know where you got your courage from!"
He flicked out a finger, and the Imperial Might surged. Peng, Chi Taiming was sent backwards, completely no match for him.
And this was still because he wanted to play around with him. Otherwise, how could the attack of a Pseudo-Emperor be blocked by a Nine-Star Saint?
Chi Taiming gave a loud shout. Weng, the Mysterious Ice Banner immediately flew over and hovered above his head.
Imperial Weapon!

Seeing the Imperial Weapon, Shi Gang finally showed a hint of caution. Even if he was now a Pseudo-Emperor, if it was a head-on clash with an Imperial Weapon, it would still mean definite death for him.
However, he also possessed an Imperial Weapon, so what did he have to fear?
Weng, the Demon Subduing Staff immediately shone with majestic light, and Imperial Might boiled like water. This was much stronger than Shi Gang.
The Imperial Weapons cancelled each other out, but Shi Gang was still invincible, what more when he had twelve Skeleton Saint Tools with him. Each one of them could drive a Saint to despair.
"Lord Shi Gang, we have come to surrender!" Chi Xuan and Chi Xiyue ran towards Shi Gang.
"All right!" A smile appeared on Shi Gang’s face. It was too easy to destroy a force, causing them to kill each other due to internal strife. That was what was interesting.

He suppressed Chi Taiming with all his might. Chi Taiming was no match for him at all, and he continued to attack Chi Taiming relentlessly, to the point that he was throwing up copious amounts of blood.
"Ancestor, ancestor!" the members of the Chi Clan all called out, all of them filled with grief and indignation.

They were members of the Imperial Clan, yet a nine-star Saint was still easily pummeled to the point of throwing up blood even though he had attacked with his Imperial Weapon. This caused them to feel extreme fury and despair.
What kind of world was this!
"Shi Gang, you won’t be smug for long. When Ling Han becomes a Pseudo-Emperor, you’ll all be swept aside!" Chi Feihong shouted loudly.
Ling Han, it was Ling Han again!
Shi Gang couldn’t help but feel his killing intent rise. In his heart, Ling Han was a forbidden name.
He was the personal disciple of the Great Emperor, yet he had been mercilessly defeated by Ling Han.
In fact, his fiancee was actually having an affair with Ling Han, causing him to feel like he had been cuckolded.

He couldn’t help but humph coldly, "In front of me, what is Ling Han worth? Not too long after, I will deliver your heads to him. I really want to see what kind of expression he would have on his face!"
Peng! Peng!
He moved, and with just two casual strikes, Chi Feihong and Chi Taiming were both sent flying, throwing up blood endlessly in midair.
And this was still because he had deliberately held back. Otherwise, he would definitely have insta-killed them.
He was naturally not being benevolent, but rather wanted to slowly torture these two people to death.
Don’t say, when they saw the two Saints being toyed with in the palm of his hand, the majority of them had lost all hope, their eyes dim, without the slightest bit of light.

Peng! Peng!

He had gone too far!

The Chi Clan elites were also filled with fighting spirit. Worse come to worst, they would all die. They were the Donglin Imperial Clan, and would only be willing to become ghosts that had died in battle, and not live to be slaves that would kneel in submission!
"Die!"
These people all rushed forwards, but with a flick of Shi Gang’s finger, they were either killed or sent flying.

Shi Gang smiled balefully and said, "I heard that your sister is one of the top ten beauties of the universe. Hehe, I don’t mind keeping her by my side as a maid!"
He stretched out a hand and grabbed out at Chi Dao.
In this place, he was completely capable of giving and taking as he liked, and no one could stop him.
"Retract your filthy hand." A voice suddenly rang out.
’Hmm?’
Shi Gang faltered slightly. Why did this voice sound a little familiar?
He naturally would not obey. As a dignified Pseudo-Emperor, he had a certain amount of say even in front of a Great Emperor.
His hand tightened, and he was just about to capture Chi Dao, but he suddenly realized that he actually couldn’t retract his hand that he had stretched out!

This naturally wasn’t his true hand, but a manifestation of his power of belief. However, wasn’t it a piece of cake for a Pseudo-Emperor to obliterate a planet with a single thought? He couldn’t even retract his manifested hand?
Hiss, who had made a move?

"Who are you, sir?" Shi Gang said calmly. "Could you be a friend from the Primitive Abyss? Our GrGreat Emperor has said that we will not interfere with each other. Otherwise, the twelve Great Emperors would not mind making a move and turn the Primitive Abyss into a river of blood."
These words displayed the domineering nature of the Lords of Death.
In their eyes, the 36 Divine Beasts were nothing at all. It was only a matter of making a trip. With the 12 Emperors working together, they could easily crush them.
Thus, they had their own plans and those in the Primitive Abyss had best not interfere, or they would only be seeking their own demise.
"Hehe, you wanted to see me?" The voice rang out again.
"Stop acting, get out here!" Shi Gang shouted loudly.
"Since you’re so eager to see me, I’ll grant you your wish."
A figure descended from the sky. Peng! He stood on the ground, tall and slender, his black robes fluttering in the wind.
"Ling, Ling Han!" The members of the Chi Clan instantly erupted.
Their savior had arrived!
However, elites such as Chi Feihong, Chi Taiming, and the others all frowned. No matter how strong Ling Han was, he was only a Saint, so how could he stand against a Pseudo-Emperor?
Shi Gang was initially stunned, but a cold smile immediately appeared on his face.
It would not be like how it had been before!
Previously, he had indeed been no match for Ling Han. The latter’s title as the strongest Saint of all eternity was definitely not just for show.
However, he was no longer a Saint now, but a Pseudo-Emperor!

chapters.title: Chapter 4778: Blood from a Single Punch
paragraphs: "Where’s Buddha Doga, Qian Haoyang, and Xia Houping?" Shi Gang asked calmly. These were his true opponents.
Ling Han?
He was not worthy!
Ling Han shook his head, and said with a smile, "Do I still need those seniors to deal with trash like you?"
"What big talk!" Shi Gang was about to explode in fury, "I am a Pseudo-Emperor! Pseudo-Emperor!
Ling Han shook his head, "Being so flustered and exasperated, and having such poor temperament, you actually managed to become a Pseudo-Emperor?"

He activated his eye technique, and looked towards Shi Gang. He saw that there were eight regions in Shi Gang’s body that had gone through Silent Destruction, but there was one region that was incredibly active, and was self-contained, so he could not see it clearly.
There were far too few Pseudo-Emperors. Thus, the level of Pseudo-Emperor was not further differentiated into levels, but in truth, there were also weaker and stronger Pseudo-Emperors.

The cultivation of Saints was to slowly have their bodies go through Silent Destruction, so that they could be assimilated with heaven and earth, accommodating more Regulations, while Pseudo-Emperor was the opposite.
If one wanted to become Emperor, they would need to be independent of heaven and earth.

Thus, the cultivation of a Pseudo-Emperor was actually a reversal of Silent Destruction Tier. Step by step, a body that had gone through Silent Destruction was revived again, but it was not a simple revival, but rather becoming self-contained.

When the body that had gone through Silent Destruction nine times was fully awakened, then the stage of Pseudo-Emperor would come to an end, and they could truly attempt to break through to become Emperor.
In this process of destruction and revival, the change in battle prowess was like the difference between heaven and earth.
Thus, the Pseudo-Emperor had the word "Emperor" in its name, suppressing all Saints.

Shi Gang had now revived a portion of his body, which meant that he had just taken the first step on the path of Pseudo-Emperor, and to provide further description, he was now a one-star Pseudo-Emperor, and the limit was nine stars.
However, for a particular freak, this was actually not applicable.

—As long as Ling Han was given enough Genesis Substance, he could completely cultivate 99 eight-star Regulations under the condition of going through Silent Destruction four or five times. Then, he would be able to directly revive his body, and become a Pseudo-Emperor.

And because he had only performed Silent Destruction four to five times previously, when he was in Pseudo-Emperor Tier, he only needed to revive four to five times, and he would be able to reach the end of Pseudo-Emperor Tier.
Though the path he had taken would be shorter, there was no doubt that he would be stronger.

Of course, giving any Saint the Genesis Substance would allow that person to reach the limit of what Regulations he could accommodate without experiencing Silent Destruction nine times. Then, at the level of Pseudo-Emperor, this person would be able to reach the pinnacle even faster.
This was the effect of Genesis Substance. It was icing on the cake, and elites would become stronger.
Shi Gang= was furious. I am now a Pseudo-Emperor, and you still dare to look down on me like this?

"Ling Han, just in time, you delivered yourself to my doorstep!" He was only wary of Buddha Doga and the others. After all, they were veteran Pseudo-Emperors, so his abilities were definitely superior to them.
But Ling Han?
So what if he was the strongest Saint? Could he compare to a Pseudo-Emperor?
He waved his hand again, and grabbed out at Ling Han.
So what if Buddha Doga and the others were waiting on the sidelines? The 12 Skeleton Saint Tools were enough to block their attacks and buy him some time to retreat.
Humph, he would properly torture Ling Han.
He actually dared to cuckold him!
Boom! How astonishing was the attack of a Pseudo-Emperor?
A large hand blotted out the skies and covered the earth, as it brandished the Imperial Might. That was the strongest attack in the world.
Chi Taiming and the others were all looking forward to see which among Buddha Doga, Qian Yanghao and Xia Houping had arrived.
However, Shi Gang’s attack had already reached him, but there was still no Pseudo-Emperor that made a move.
This!
What was going on?
Right at this moment, Ling Han smiled and casually threw a punch at Shi Gang.
Peng! With a single punch, Shi Gang’s large hand instantly crumbled. However, the power of Ling Han’s punch didn’t dissipate, continuing to attack Shi Gang.
What!
Everyone was numb with shock. How was this possible?
Against a Pseudo-Emperor, not only was he not insta-killed, but he even had the upper hand?
’Holy f*ck!’
Shi Gang was also incredibly stunned, but when the attack came, he still instinctively retreated, dodging this attack.

However, he had still managed to capture Chi Dao with his divine sense just then, yet his divine sense had been trapped and could not be retracted. Now that he had taken the initiative to retreat, it was equivalent to him cutting his losses and directly severing this sliver of divine sense.
Though it was rare, he still felt a sharp pain, and blood was dripping from his nose.
This caused everyone to be even more shocked. One strike was enough to make a Pseudo-Emperor bleed; this was awesome to the extreme.
Shi Gang frowned deeply, and exclaimed in shock, "Y-y-you, could it be that you have broken through to Pseudo-Emperor-level?"
Otherwise, how could he have sent him retreating with a single strike?
Ling Han immediately said solemnly, "Don’t speak carelessly. I am a genuine Saint!"

If he was really a Pseudo-Emperor, he would either have already charged into the Primitive Abyss and created a massacre, or started an outright war with the Lords of Death. How could he possibly playing around with small fry like Shi Gang?
"Really, you think too highly of yourself!" Ling Han said bluntly.
Shi Gang almost went mad with fury. He was a Pseudo-Emperor.
Pseudo-Emperor!
Someone who had the word ’Emperor’ in his name, and possessed the strength to sweep aside all opposition in the universe, was actually underestimated by Ling Han?
Er, the other party had sent him backwards with a single punch. It seemed like he really had that kind of qualification.
Shi Gang trembled in fury, and exclaimed, "Impossible! If you were a Saint, how could you have possibly sent me into a retreat!"
No matter how renowned the name of the strongest Saint in history was, no matter how strong he was, he could not possibly match a Pseudo-Emperor. This was an iron rule.
Ling Han sighed, "Though I disdain from proving anything to trash like you, who asked me to be a good person?"
He drew out his holy flame.
Yellow.
This was a Four-Star Saint, and he was completely honest.
How, how was this possible!
Shi Gang was dumbfounded. He had already seen the holy flame, so what else could be fake?
Ling Han was genuinely a Saint!
Heavens! How could there be such a powerful Saint?
Moreover, if Ling Han was a Nine-Star Saint, Shi Gang would still feel slightly better. However, he was only a Four-Star Saint. This was a huge blow to him.
The dignified Pseudo-Emperor was actually inferior to a Four-Star Saint?
This would make him a joke for all eternity.
"I don’t believe it!" he shouted loudly.
"Whether you believe it or not, what business is it of mine?" Ling Han said calmly, "Furthermore, you are about to die, so there is even less need for me to care about your feelings!"
"Humph, you still want to kill me?" Shi Gang sneered. He gradually calmed down, "Even if your strength is superior to mine, as a Pseudo-Emperor, can you detain me?"
"Won’t you know if you try?" Ling Han smiled faintly, and took the initiative to attack.
Boom! He threw a punch, yet it unleashed 12 streaks of light.
Not good!
Shi Gang had no time to stop it, and the 12 streaks of light already slammed into the Skeleton Saint Tools. Peng, peng, peng! The 12 war machines were instantly obliterated.
What terrifying destructive power!
Though Shi Gang was angered, he was more so shocked.

He had already become a Pseudo-Emperor. However, even if he used his full power, he would not be able to damage the Skeleton Saint Tool. It was formed from the fusion of several hundred Saintly Material, and after sustaining an attack, it would be divided evenly among every piece of Saintly Material. Thus, unless a true Great Emperor made a move, even an Imperial Weapon or Pseudo-Emperor would not be able to damage it.
It was clear how powerful Ling Han was.
He couldn’t help but feel dejected. He was already a Pseudo-Emperor, yet he was still no match for Ling Han.
’Damn it! Damn it!’

chapters.title: Chapter 4779: Pseudo-Emperor goes all out
paragraphs: "How can you possibly be so strong?" Shi Gang gritted his teeth and said.
This kind of strength was practically defying the natural order.
Just look at all the previous Great Emperors. Which one of them could match a Pseudo-Emperor when they were Saints?
None. Even if they had become a Nine-Star Saint, they would not be able to do so.
However, it just so happened that such a freak had appeared now, and he was standing on the opposite side at that!
He had to leave.

He no longer hesitated. It was definitely not appropriate for him to clash head-on with Ling Han. He needed to find help as soon as possible. He believed that as long as there were two Pseudo-Emperors combining forces, they would be able to match Ling Han, and they still had two trump cards.
The Natural-born Gold Spirit, and Little Ye!

The Natural-born Gold Spirit was a nine-star Pseudo-Emperor. Moreover, he was controlled by the twelve Lords of Death, and he himself was inclined towards killing. His battle prowess was unfathomably powerful, and even Buddha Doga and the other Pseudo-Emperors combining forces could only barely match him.

Little Ye was even more freakish. It was unknown where he had popped out from, but being earnestly nurtured by the Lords of Death, his cultivation speed was astonishingly fast. He had even advanced into Pseudo-Emperor Tier one step ahead of him.
This person could control the flow of time, and cultivators of the same cultivation level couldn’t even make a move. They would either age unbearably, or become infants.
Even if he had now become a Pseudo-Emperor, he still had to resist with all his might against Little Ye’s flow of time. Would he still have any excess energy to resist Little Ye’s attack?
"You’re only running now?" Ling Han shook his head, and said, "It’s too late!"
Peng!
Sure enough, Shi Gang was immediately sent flying back the moment he stepped forward.
He shockingly discovered that the space around him had already been restricted by Ling Han.
Hiss, the other party should have arrived long ago, and the reason why he did not immediately appear was to set up a restriction, to prevent him from escaping.
This... he was really too scheming.
Actually, this restriction was not all that powerful. He was completely capable of breaking through it, but this would need time.
However, would Ling Han allow him to slowly break through the restrictions?
If that was the case, would the other party still need to deliberately expend effort to set up such a restriction?
He suddenly turned around, like a trapped beast, exuding the ruthlessness of a life-or-death battle.
Being able to be taken in as the first generation Buddha Son, he naturally had outstanding talent. Otherwise, he wouldn’t have been valued by Ah Han.
Now that he was in desperate straits, it instead ignited his fighting spirit.
"Come!" Ling Han said with a smile. Killing someone who had no fighting spirit was truly boring.
No matter what, this was still a first generation Imperial Son, so a battle with him should be able to satisfy him to his heart’s content.
Shi Gang shouted loudly, and charged towards Ling Han. His hands moved like axes, opening the sky and striking the ground.
Ling Han parried casually, appearing to be extremely relaxed.
As he saw it, Shi Gang’s strength was only equivalent to when he had grasped 65 flashes of Regulations, but now, he had grasped 75 flashes of Regulations. Just how wide was the gap between them?
Ling Han didn’t even need to use any ultimate moves, and he was already completely suppressing Shi Gang, so much so that the latter couldn’t see any hope of turning the tables.
"I’ll give it my all!" Shi Gang shouted loudly. Boom! The Imperial Might he exuded became even more intense.
He ignited the Imperial Source, and went all out.

This was an extremely significant boost to his battle prowess. At this moment, it was as if he had removed the "Pseudo" character from the name of Pseudo-Emperor and transformed into a Great Emperor Particle.
—Even if this was the weakest Great Emperor.
In this manner, Shi Ganginstantly took the initiative, suppressing Ling Han instead.
"Ling Han, you are only a Saint, after all, and cannot burn the Imperial Source!" Shi Gang said balefully, "Thus, you have made a colossal mistake, to actually force me to this extent!"
Otherwise, as long as there was the slightest bit of hope, he would not have chosen to burn the Imperial Source.
He had just advanced into Pseudo-Emperor, so how much Imperial Source could he possess?
Thus, after using it this time, he would basically fall from the position of Pseudo-Emperor.
Ling Han remained silent. He didn’t face this attack head-on. Instead, he summoned the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower.
Kuang!
Shi Gang’s attacks landed on the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, causing the precious tower to shudder. However, it was completely undamaged.

This was Origin Gold, and it was one of the most powerful among Origin Gold. Moreover, it had been tempered by the Metal of Creation, so it wouldn’t be an exaggeration to call it the number one Origin Gold.
Such a terrifying attack would naturally create a powerful shockwave. Even the Origin Gold couldn’t block it, but with how tough Ling Han’s physique was, he could easily disperse such a shockwave.
Ling Han cracked a smile, "Looks like you won’t be able to kill me."
Shi Gang gritted his teeth. He had already ignited the Imperial Source, yet he was still unable to suppress this opponent?
Hiss, had this guy been deliberately sent down by the heavens to anger him to death?
However, it was only an instant, and Shi Gang turned around. Without the slightest hesitation, he broke through the restrictions, and left quickly.

If he left now, he could still save his life. Although his battle prowess would drop from Pseudo-Emperor, and he wouldn’t be able to seek Ling Han out for revenge in the future, it was still better than being killed on the spot.
"Yi, you were speaking so confidently just now, so why did you suddenly turn around and run?" Ling Han asked with a smile. Phoenix Wings Divine Flight activated, and he quickly chased after him.
Boom!
Shi Gang’s palm struck over, but Ling Han didn’t take it head-on. Instead, he turned around to dodge, and then shot out a murderous aura attack.
"An!" Shi Gang roared the Six Characters Bright King Curse against Ling Han’s murderous aura barrage.

For those in Pseudo-Emperor-level like them, martial arts techniques were actually no longer important. It all depended on whose power of belief was stronger, who grasped more Regulations, and whose power was stronger.
The two streaks of power of belief collided, and Shi Gang couldn’t help but grunt. His face had also become slightly pale.
He was astounded. The strength of Ling Han’s divine sense was actually superior to his!
Heavens, physique, divine sense, battle prowess, and so on were all freakishly strong. How could heaven and earth allow such a being to exist?
He continued to flee, yet Ling Han tailed tightly behind him, preventing him from escaping.

After combusting the Imperial Source, his battle prowess had indeed increased greatly, but even if Ge Qianqiu had combusted the Imperial Source, he had still been killed by a Lord of Death. Furthermore, it was done from an endless distance away, which showed that compared to a real Great Emperor, combusting the Imperial Source was not of much use.
This was the same for Shi Gang. He was indeed strong, and could even suppress Ling Han. However, he was unable to completely throw Ling Han off his tail.
More importantly, the Imperial Source was extremely limited, so how long could he last?
He was battered and exhausted. After fleeing for a while, he suddenly turned around and charged towards Ling Han, wanting to catch Ling Han off guard.
But who was Ling Han?
Just how much battle experience did he have?
As soon as Shi Gang became fierce, he immediately avoided a head-on confrontation, and when Shi Gang was just about to run, he immediately stuck close to him, not giving him the chance to escape.

It should be known that after he had used the Destructive Energy and light of great dao, the destructive power of his attacks had even surpassed the Imperial Weapon. Would Shi Gang dare to flee at all costs while allowing him to attack him as he liked?
A few minutes passed, and Shi Gang’s aura suddenly trembled. Then, it declined rapidly.
The Imperial Source had been completely burnt.
Ling Han didn’t say anything. He simply clenched his fists and continued to attack.
"Humph!" Shi Gang sneered, and brandished his palm to parry Ling Han’s attack. His aura instantly increased by another large amount.
—His Imperial Source Source had not been completely burnt. Just now, it was he who had deliberately put on a pretence.
Ling Han also smiled. Could it be that he had not seen through it?
How naive.

chapters.title: Chapter 4780: Showing off
paragraphs: After Shi Gang exchanged a few more blows, his aura declined again.
This time, he had really burnt the Imperial Source completely.

A look of shock appeared on his face. At present, he only possessed the battle prowess of a nine-star Saint, so how could he be a match for Ling Han? Furthermore, even if Ling Han was willing to let him go, this Imperial Source was completely burnt, which was equivalent to exhausting his flame of life as well. How much longer could he live?
If he could escape, then with the abilities of the Twelve Lands of Death, it wouldn’t be a problem to extend his lifespan. However, this was also the key. How could he escape?
Even burning the Imperial Source was not enough, what more now?
Shi Gang didn’t beg for mercy. Instead, he gritted his teeth and fought Ling Han to the death.
But as a nine-star Saint?
Hehe.
Peng, Ling Han shot out a punch, and Shi Gang fell down from space at an incredibly fast speed. With a loud bang, he fell heavily onto the ground, raising dust and dirt all over the ground.
He wanted to get back to his feet, yet he was unable to do so. He felt as if all of his bones had been shattered.
Chi Taiming, Chi Feihong and the others all gathered around him, all of them filled with killing intent.
Previously, Shi Gang had been so arrogant and domineering, but now?
The wheel of fortune had turned. He had not thought that he would be reduced to fall to their mercy so quickly.
Meanwhile, Chi Xuan and Chi Xiyue were trembling in fear, and they were filled with grievance.

—Why couldn’t you, Ling Han, have appeared earlier, causing them to be muddleheaded for a moment, and lean towards the side of the Lords of Death? And Shi Gang, are you a f****** piece of trash? You are a dignified Pseudo-Emperor, and you actually can’t deal with a Saint?
But what was the use of regretting now?

"Ling Han, the wheel of fate is already rolling, and there is nothing you can do to stop it. You will only be crushed into pieces!" Shi Gang spat out blood as he said to Ling Han who was slowly descending, "You will definitely die, you will definitely die!"
Ling Han smiled faintly and said, "Everyone dies, and I won’t be an exception. However, when I die, the universe will definitely be at peace!"
His words were filled with confidence.
Even if Shi Gang was filled with resentment, he was still intimidated by this confidence. For a moment, he did not refute.
Just when he was about to say something else, Ling Han threw a punch. Peng! He was crushed into a bloody pancake, and even his divine sense was unable to escape. He was completely dead.
He had killed another Pseudo-Emperor.

Ling Han was very pleased with his own battle prowess. He was only a Saint, yet he was already able to kill a Pseudo-Emperor. This proved his previous thoughts: when he became a Pseudo-Emperor, he would definitely be able to stand against a Great Emperor.
"When I become a Great Emperor, I will be able to pacify the unrest."

The Chi Clan had survived a calamity, so they were naturally all glad. Added with the fact that Ling Han could be considered a son-in-law of the Chi Clan, though the wedding had not been held yet, now that Ling Han had obtained the battle prowess of aPseudo-Emperor, how could the Chi Clan not be happy?
Although some people had died, the Chi Clan still held a banquet, which could be considered a welcome ceremony for Ling Han.
In the meantime, they asked why Chi Menghan hadn’t come, and even asked if Chi Menghan was pregnant, making Ling Han blush.

After staying on the Donglin Planet for two days, Ling Han decided to leave. Now, there was not only one Pseudo-Emperor that had appeared on the side of the Lands of Death, but rather several of them. These Pseudo-Emperors would frequently set off in pursuit of the Imperial Clans that were fleeing, causing the Imperial Clans to be in imminent danger.
Ling Han also took the Donglin Planet into his body while he was at it. For the current him, there was really no difficulty at all. However, he was still unable to take in an Imperial Weapon.
It didn’t matter. Worse come to worst, he would just wield the Imperial Weapon.
He connected to the heaven and earth, and began to locate the locations of the other Imperial Clans.

In the universe, the areas with planets had basically been transformed into the environment of the Netherworld. Even Ling Han’s divine sense could not penetrate into this place. However, the Imperial Clans had naturally long since stimulated their planets, and fled towards the edge of the universe. Thus, Ling Han only had to search in this outer region.
However, this area was too vast, so Ling Han would still need some time.
"I found one."
"I found another one."
Ling Han continuously located those Imperial Clans, but as long as they had not been targeted by the Lands of Death, Ling Han naturally would not move out either.
En.
Ling Han suddenly stood up, and Phoenix Wings Divine Flight unleashed. With a xiu, he broke through space.

The flaming wings flapped, and less than half a day later, Ling Han appeared in the Void. A massive star appeared in front of him, but it was obvious that a great battle had broken out. The Netherworld was launching a large-scale invasion.
This was the Demon Ox Imperial Clan.
Ling Han’s eyes swept over, and saw that the Netherworld being leading the team was Lin Dong, the son of Fire Clouds Ancestral King.
This guy had also become a Pseudo-Emperor. With the Fire Clouds Sword in hand, he slashed down repeatedly, heading towards the Demon Ox Planet.

Thankfully, there was an Imperial Formation on the Demon Ox Planet. Every time the Sword Qi slashed down, a spherical shield of light would appear, enshrouding the entire planet and dispersing the attacks of the Imperial Weapon.

Theoretically speaking, there was an inexhaustible supply of energy for the Imperial Formation, unlike the Imperial Weapon, which could only be activated for a short period of time. It was the most reliable defense system in the world.
However, it was a Pseudo-Emperor that was controlling the Imperial Weapon!

This was completely different. Though a Pseudo-Emperor did not have the might of a Great Emperor, it was completely no problem for one to support the continuous channelling of the Imperial Weapon. Furthermore, Lin Dong also had the help of six Skeleton Saint Tools, which was even more terrifying. They held back a great deal of the might of the Imperial Formation, allowing Lin Dong to gain the upper hand.
Not too long after, he would be able to break through the imperial formation, and penetrate straight in.
Ling Han humphed, and directly charged over.
"Ling Han?" When Lin Dong saw Ling Han, he couldn’t help but be startled.

Yi, the person that the Lands of Death wanted to kill the most was Ling Han, but he could not be found anywhere. In fact, the Lords of Death had attacked Ling Han time and time again, and Ling Han had managed to escape. He had not thought that Ling Han would actually appear on his own volition.
After being stunned for a moment, Lin Dong laughed loudly.
This brat definitely did not know that he had already advanced into Pseudo-Emperor-level, and thought that he was a Saint. Thus, he charged out without any reservations.
Haha, alright, I’ll give you a surprise.
"You’re quite bold, daring to appear in front of me!" Lin Dong said proudly.
Ling Han smiled faintly, "What is it? Could it be that you have become Emperor?"
Precisely.
Lin Dong thought to himself, but his expression did not change, "If I have become Emperor, would you still have a way out?"
Ling Han shook his head, and said, "Then you should ask the Lords of Death. They’re more experienced."
’F*ck! You’re far too arrogant!’

Lin Dong cursed internally, but for the sake of an even greater surprise, he endured it, and said, "Against trash like you, there is no need for the Great Emperors to move. I am enough to deal with you."
"Come." Ling Han crooked a finger at him.
At this time, because Lin Dong stopped attacking the imperial formation, the members of the Demon Ox Imperial Clan also appeared.
Lin Dong was afraid that these people would expose his cultivation level, so he didn’t waste any more time and directly charged towards Ling Han.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and replied with a punch.
"No!" the members of the Demon Ox Imperial Clan all shouted.
But how fast was the attack of a Pseudo-Emperor?
Shua, Lin Dong didn’t use the Fire Cloud Sword. He merely delivered a palm strike, yet it was as if it was a sharp blade that could slide open heaven and earth, arriving with a single thought.
Peng!
Ling Han’s fist landed on the tip of Lin Dong’s palm, and the two of them exchanged a head-on blow without any fancy moves.
They were done for!
The members of the Demon Ox Imperial Clan all closed their eyes. Fighting head-on with a Pseudo-Emperor was completely courting death.
