In fact, the Lords of Death had attacked Ling Han time and time again, and Ling Han had managed to escape.
He had not thought that Ling Han would actually appear on his own volition.
After being stunned for a moment, Lin Dong laughed loudly.
This brat definitely did not know that he had already advanced into Pseudo-Emperor-level, and thought that he was a Saint.
Thus, he charged out without any reservations.
Haha, alright, I’ll give you a surprise.
"You’re quite bold, daring to appear in front of me!" Lin Dong said proudly.
Ling Han smiled faintly, "What is it?
Could it be that you have become Emperor?"
Precisely.
Lin Dong thought to himself, but his expression did not change, "If I have become Emperor, would you still have a way out?"
Ling Han shook his head, and said, "Then you should ask the Lords of Death.
They’re more experienced."
’F*ck!
You’re far too arrogant!’
Lin Dong cursed internally, but for the sake of an even greater surprise, he endured it, and said, "Against trash like you, there is no need for the Great Emperors to move.
I am enough to deal with you."
"Come." Ling Han crooked a finger at him.
At this time, because Lin Dong stopped attacking the imperial formation, the members of the Demon Ox Imperial Clan also appeared.
Lin Dong was afraid that these people would expose his cultivation level, so he didn’t waste any more time and directly charged towards Ling Han.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and replied with a punch.
"No!" the members of the Demon Ox Imperial Clan all shouted.
But how fast was the attack of a Pseudo-Emperor?
Shua, Lin Dong didn’t use the Fire Cloud Sword.
He merely delivered a palm strike, yet it was as if it was a sharp blade that could slide open heaven and earth, arriving with a single thought.
Peng!
Ling Han’s fist landed on the tip of Lin Dong’s palm, and the two of them exchanged a head-on blow without any fancy moves.
They were done for!
The members of the Demon Ox Imperial Clan all closed their eyes.
Fighting head-on with a Pseudo-Emperor was completely courting death.

chapters.title: Chapter 4781: Surprised?
paragraphs: "What!"
An exclamation of shock, filled with disbelief.
Lin Dong stared dumbly at Ling Han’s smiling expression. At this moment, too many thoughts surged through his mind, and he didn’t know how to express them.
’Holy f*ck!’
He had become a Pseudo-Emperor, and wanted to bully Ling Han who was ignorant of this. He wanted to use this to trick him, and give Ling Han a big "surprise".
However, he had never imagined that he would be the one who would be surprised!
"Are you surprised? Shocked?" Ling Han asked with a smile.
How experienced was he? Furthermore, it had always been him that was showing off, and this guy actually wanted to show off in front of him?
Hehe, then he would only be shocked.
Lin Dong was were still speechless. He had really been frightened.
Ling Han was... a Pseudo-Emperor?

Hiss, when this guy was a Saint, he was already known as the strongest in all eternity, and now that he had become a Pseudo-Emperor... he should also be able to sweep aside all opposition at the level of Pseudo-Emperor.
All of a sudden, his whole body was covered with cold sweat.
"Ling Han!" Below them, the members of the Demon Ox Imperial Clan called out again, but this time, they were filled with pleasant surprise.
As it turned out, Ling Han had already become a Pseudo-Emperor.
"Don’t misunderstand. I am still a Saint," Ling Han explained. You see, he has always been an honest person.
"Do you think I’ll believe you?" Lin Dong said coldly.
F***, who are you trying to fool? Being able to take a blow from me, and you actually call yourself a Saint? How could there be a Saint as shameless as you?
Speaking of shamelessness, where was that despicable dog?
Lin Dong couldn’t help but be distracted. Moreover, his thoughts had still been led astray at this moment. This was a clear sign of just how despicable the large black dog was.
Ling Han sighed, and took the initiative to show the holy flame.
Yellow represented a Four-Star Saint.
’Holy f*ck!’
This time, Lin Dong was truly shocked.
Ling Han really was a Saint.
Heavens!
A mere Four-Star Saint was actually capable of fighting him head-on. How could there be such a freak?
He looked at Ling Han, and understood that Ling Han wasn’t trying to kindly explain things to him. He was clearly trying to scare him.
And what was disappointing was that he had indeed been frightened.
Really, even if the same thing happened a hundred more times, he would still be shocked.
A Four-Star Saint was capable of fighting a Pseudo-Emperor; what kind of concept was that?
Beneath them, the members of the Demon Ox Imperial Clan were also shocked.
As it turned out, Ling Han was really a Saint. However, this was even more frightening than if Ling Han had become a Pseudo-Emperor.
Heavens! Heavens! Heavens!
At this moment, everyone was numb with shock, their minds blank. Only the six Skeleton Saint Tools were still attacking dutifully. They had no emotions.
"Humph!"
Ling Han’s figure moved, and with a flap of his fiery wings, he had instantly arrived in front of a Skeleton Saint Tool. Then, he shot out a kick.
Peng! Without a doubt, the Skeleton Saint Tool instantly exploded into pieces like an egg.
Ling Han didn’t stop at all. He kicked again, and again. After six consecutive kicks, the six Skeleton Saint Tools were all destroyed.
’Holy f*ck!’

This caused the members of the Demon Ox Imperial Clan to inhale sharply. It wasn’t like they didn’t know how powerful this Skeleton Saint Tool was. Even a nine-star Saint couldn’t defeat it, and the Imperial Weapon could only blast it backwards, unable to damage it. But in Ling Han’s case, f***, he was practically destroying everything in his path.
The strongest Saint in history?
These words were probably no longer enough to describe how powerful Ling Han was.
When Ling Han obliterated the six Skeleton Saint Tools, Lin Dong finally came back to his senses.
Ling Han really did possess a Pseudo-Emperor-level battle prowess, though he was only a puny four-star Saint.
"I can’t let you live!" He immediately charged over.
Ling Han smiled, and confronted Lin Dong head-on.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
The moment the two of them exchanged blows, Lin Dong was at a disadvantage. He was no match for Ling Hanhui at all.
Lin Dong’s expression changed drastically. Though he was only a One Star Pseudo-Emperor, with the word ’Emperor’, he should be able to crush all life, and be invincible in this world.
How could he be inferior to a mere Four-Star Saint?
He could not understand, and could not accept either.
The position of Emperor noble and lofty, crushing everything. This level could only be seen, but could not be reached. Why did this logic not apply in this era?
Hong! Hong! Hong!
However, Ling Han’s fists rained down like mad, not giving Lin Dong any chance to catch his breath.
Lin Dong had no choice but to summon his Fire Cloud Sword to block Ling Han’s violent attacks.
He knew that Ling Han also possessed an Imperial Weapon. Thus, he didn’t dare to continue fighting at all. He immediately turned around and fled.
This time, Ling Han was unable to set up any restrictions, so he was naturally unable to stop Lin Dong from fleeing.
He gave chase, and Lin Dong didn’t linger in battle at all. He ran as fast as he could.
This made Lin Dong extremely sullen.
He was a Pseudo-Emperor. In history, had there ever been such a miserable Pseudo-Emperor that had to flee in panic? In fact, the person who was hunting him down was actually only a Saint.
As he pursued, it wasn’t long before Lin Dong entered the Netherworld. Ling Han also immediately sensed a terrifying divine sense surging over.
A Lord of Death!

Ling Han finally understood. In reality, the Lords of Death were already Yin souls. Thus, they were much more at home in the Netherworld. On the other hand, the Living Realm was completely incompatible with them.
Thus, once he entered the Netherworld, Lin Dong would be able to communicate with the Lands of Death, and the person he contacted... would naturally be the Fire Clouds Ancestral King.
Ling Han didn’t hesitate in the slightest. He immediately turned around and fled.
Boom!
Just as he rushed out of the Netherworld, he saw flames surging behind him, turning into a massive cloud of flames.
A large hand suddenly stretched out, grabbing out at Ling Han.
The Fire Cloud Ancestral King made his move.
A Great Emperor was a Great Emperor.

Ling Han couldn’t help but sigh. He clearly hadn’t appeared, and he was even in a weak state. However, this attack was still indescribably terrifying. It wasn’t something that a Pseudo-Emperor could withstand.
Weng, the Clear Bamboo Sword revived, and Ling Han slashed out with his sword.
The Sword Qi slashed onto the giant flaming hand, and immediately crumbled. Meanwhile, the giant flaming hand only paused slightly, and then grabbed out at Ling Han.
Boom, the Sword Qi shattered, forming a powerful rebound, causing Ling Han’s chest to boil.
Thankfully, his present physique was too tough. This shockwave was naturally no big deal, and was not enough to cause any damage to him.
Ling Han used the Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, his speed extremely fast.
The Fire Cloud Ancestral King didn’t pursue him any further. He only revealed two massive eyes in the fiery clouds, which were even larger than stars. However, these eyes soon disappeared.
If he could not kill Ling Han, even a Lord of Death would not be willing to rashly awaken and hunt him down.
Ling Han ran madly, and returned to the Demon Ox Planet. Without another word, he also took the Demon Ox Planet into his body, and began to move it.
After a long time, he finally came out of the Void and released the Demon Ox Planet and Donglin Planet.

Ling Han didn’t construct another Transfer Formation for the ultra-long distance. It was too unstable, and could easily explode. Aside from him, even the physique of the little azure dragon wasn’t strong enough to withstand the energy shockwave from the explosion of the Void. Thus, it was best to wait until he made more adjustments to ensure his safety.
Only a day later, Ziwei Imperial Clan sent out a message for help.

Though Ling Han really did not like the Baili Clan, it was the Netherworld that was invading now, so he still had to prioritize the overall situation. Furthermore, Ling Han wanted to take advantage of this opportunity to kill a few more fallen Imperial Sons, and destroy even more Skeleton Saint Tools. Thus, he still went on his way.

chapters.title: Chapter 4782: Betrayal
paragraphs: This trip to the Ziwei Imperial Clan was only half a day’s journey, and Ling Han walked out of the Void.
With Ling Han’s cautious nature, he naturally wouldn’t charge over just like that. He released his divine sense and wrapped it around the Ziwei Planet.
This time, the leader of the team was Di Wuji. He had also shockingly become a Pseudo-Emperor.
Yi, why did it seem like Pseudo-Emperors had become wholesale?

These were all the children of Great Emperors, and they had also appeared repeatedly in the long passage of history to train themselves. Naturally, all of them had outstanding natural talent, and had incredibly deep foundations.
However, the title of Emperor had held back who knew how many people since ancient times. Furthermore, Imperial Clans were unable to produce another Great Emperor, which was like a curse.
Thus, Ling Han wouldn’t find it strange if one or at most two of the Fallen Imperial Sons became Pseudo-Emperors. Instead, he would think that it was a natural course of events.
However, any fallen Imperial Son had actually become Pseudo-Emperors. This was something that Ling Han could not accept.
Could there be some kind of trick to this?
A heaven-defying treasure?
This was very possible. The Lords of Death had ventured deep into the Primitive Abyss before, and in the place where heaven and earth began, there were really too many treasures.
Just look at Ling Han. If he hadn’t come from the Genesis World, would he have been as freakish as he was now?
To say nothing of natural talent, among those who had been able to become Great Emperors since ancient times, whose natural talent would be inferior?
Moreover, Ding Shu and the others were also masters of their own Genesis World, so why couldn’t they compare to Ling Han?
Wasn’t it because they had obtained too few treasures from the Primitive Abyss?
Thus, it was not the slightest bit false that the treasures in the Primitive Abyss could defy the heavens and change one’s fate.
Multiple thoughts streaked through Ling Han’s mind, but in the end, they all turned into raging fighting spirit.
He wanted to destroy all of the Skeleton Saint Tools, and kill as many of the fallen Imperial Sons as possible. Then, he would slowly recover the lost territory.
The Twelve Lands of Death transforming the Living Realm into the environment of the Netherworld must be a massive scheme, and he definitely had to stop it.

Xiu, Ling Han’s figure landed, and hecould see that a bloody massacre was presently taking place here. The imperial formation had already been breached, and the Ziwei Imperial Clan was being massacred. Corpses lay all over the ground, looking extremely tragic.
Peng!
Ling Han immediately lashed out, unleashing a punch that smashed a Skeleton Saint Tool into smithereens.
"Ling Han!" His aggressive attack immediately attracted the attention of those nearby, drawing a wave of shouts.
The only difference was that the Ziwei Imperial Clan was filled with delighted cries, and when it came to Di Wuji’s side, it turned into a low growl filled with hatred.

"Little wolf pup, long time no see," Ling Han said with a wave of his hand. However, he didn’t stop, and he continued to throw punches at the Skeleton Saint Tool. A dazzling column of light shot into the air, and another Skeleton Saint Tool was obliterated.
Di Wuji, on the other hand, was not in a rush to make a move. He merely stared coldly at Ling Han, killing intent seeping from his eyes.
A long time ago, he actually had the chance to kill Ling Han, but at that time, how could he take Ling Han seriously?
Unexpectedly, not only was he no match for Ling Han, even the Lord of Death had failed to kill Ling Han after several attempts.

This made him feel extremely displeased. An Imperial Son should have been able to do as he liked in this world, and he was now a Pseudo-Emperor, but in front of Ling Han, he did not feel the slightest bit of superiority.
However!
He humphed, "Ling Han, today will be the day of your death!"
"Oh?" Ling Han smiled faintly, "Why are you so confident?"
"Because this is a trap set up against you!" Another voice rang out. This was... Yang Yihuan. He had shockingly also become a Pseudo-Emperor.
"Hehe." He Luo also appeared. He was also a Pseudo-Emperor.
The twelve Imperial Sons from the Twelve Lands of Death were all Pseudo-Emperors?
"You’ve had enough. A mere Saint can actually force us Pseudo-Emperors to besiege you!" Wu Xingtong said, her beautiful eyes shooting out a powerful killing intent.
Ling Han smiled faintly and shook his head, saying, "Merely cats and dogs like you are nothing but trash in my eyes! Forget it, it would be better to play your true trump card!"
This made Yang Yihuan and the others extremely angry and embarrassed, yet they couldn’t refute it.
Ling Han indeed had the right to do so.
"Hehe, Ling Han, Lyou really are a person that is skilled in performing miracles." A short figure appeared, but it was a child that looked to be only about eleven or twelve years old.
Little Ye!
He cocked his head as he looked at Ling Han, looking completely innocent.

Only now did a serious expression appear on Ling Han’s face. This child was really too strange. When he was a Saint, he was already able to play around with Brother Monkey, the large black dog and the others. If it was not for the fact that he had grasped the light of great dao, he probably would not have been able to escape this calamity either. He could be considered a trump card on the side of the Lands of Death.

Now, Little Ye had also become a Pseudo-Emperor, and who knew how far his Mystical Power that allowed him to manipulate the flow of time had improved. Ling Han had no choice but to treat him seriously.
"And the other one?" he asked calmly, "Since I have already fallen into the trap, what need is there for him to continue hiding?"
"Hehe, Iron Pillar, come out." Little Ye waved a hand. Weng, a terrifying murderous aura swept out, and a metallic figure appeared in front of them.
Natural-born Gold Spirit!

This was really a grand display. The side of the Lands of Death had mobilized a total of seven Pseudo-Emperors to besiege Ling Han, and among them, there was also such a deadly weapon like Little Ye and the Natural-born Gold Spirit.
Even if it was Buddha Doga, Qian Yanghao, and Xia Houping here, they would probably frown deeply.
Ling Han looked at Baili Haojie, shook his head, and said, "As the son of the Great Emperor, you’re colluding with the enemy. How can you face Great Emperor Ziwei?"
Baili Haoji looked furious, and shouted, "What nonsense are you spouting?"
Ling Han scoffed, "To trick me into coming here, how could your Baili Clan not have participated?"
Baili Haojie humphed, "If our Baili Clan was also involved, how could so many people have died?"
"That’s why I said, you’re quite ruthless!" Ling Han said slowly.
When his words fell, a great many members of the Baili Clan erupted.
"Second Elder, is this real?" they all asked.

As long as one was not an idiot, they would realize that though there were many deaths in the Baili Clan, they were basically all weaker members, and collateral branches. Very, very few people from the main branch of the clan had died. This was indeed suspicious, but the battle previously had been too intense, so who would think in this direction?
As it turned out, the main branch had sold them off, the collateral branches!
Baili Haojie flew into a humiliated rage, pointing at Ling Han and saying, "Don’t slander me."
Ling Han ignored him. In his eyes, Baili Haojie was completely insignificant. He had only spouted a few nonsense words to him on impulse, so what need was there for him to argue so hard?
"Ling Han, you’re really smart!" Di Wuji said with a smile. "Unfortunately, you’re already surrounded. Even if you have wings, you won’t be able to escape!"
Ling Han merely smiled. Since he could tell that this was a trap, how could he not have set up alternative arrangements?
He had long since discovered that there was an obscure net here. It would be retracted once he entered, but previously, he had already noiselessly destroyed a hole in this net.
If he wanted to leave, it would be a piece of cake.
However, it was rare for so many fallen Imperial Sons to be here, so he wanted to take the chance to kill a few of them.
"Come battle!" he shouted loudly, and directly charged out.
And his first target was shockingly Baili Haojie.
His speed was too fast, and the side of the Lands of Death had no intention to protect Baili Haojie. Thus, Ling Han directly charged over.

Unexpectedly, not only was he no match for Ling Han, even the Lord of Death had failed to kill Ling Han after several attempts.
This made him feel extremely displeased.
An Imperial Son should have been able to do as he liked in this world, and he was now a Pseudo-Emperor, but in front of Ling Han, he did not feel the slightest bit of superiority.
However!
He humphed, "Ling Han, today will be the day of your death!"
"Oh?" Ling Han smiled faintly, "Why are you so confident?"
"Because this is a trap set up against you!" Another voice rang out.
This was...
Yang Yihuan.
He had shockingly also become a Pseudo-Emperor.
"Hehe." He Luo also appeared.
He was also a Pseudo-Emperor.
The twelve Imperial Sons from the Twelve Lands of Death were all Pseudo-Emperors?
"You’ve had enough.
A mere Saint can actually force us Pseudo-Emperors to besiege you!" Wu Xingtong said, her beautiful eyes shooting out a powerful killing intent.
Ling Han smiled faintly and shook his head, saying, "Merely cats and dogs like you are nothing but trash in my eyes!
Forget it, it would be better to play your true trump card!"
This made Yang Yihuan and the others extremely angry and embarrassed, yet they couldn’t refute it.
Ling Han indeed had the right to do so.
"Hehe, Ling Han, Lyou really are a person that is skilled in performing miracles." A short figure appeared, but it was a child that looked to be only about eleven or twelve years old.
Little Ye!
He cocked his head as he looked at Ling Han, looking completely innocent.
Only now did a serious expression appear on Ling Han’s face.
This child was really too strange.
When he was a Saint, he was already able to play around with Brother Monkey, the large black dog and the others.
If it was not for the fact that he had grasped the light of great dao, he probably would not have been able to escape this calamity either.
He could be considered a trump card on the side of the Lands of Death.
Now, Little Ye had also become a Pseudo-Emperor, and who knew how far his Mystical Power that allowed him to manipulate the flow of time had improved.
Ling Han had no choice but to treat him seriously.
"And the other one?" he asked calmly, "Since I have already fallen into the trap, what need is there for him to continue hiding?"
"Hehe, Iron Pillar, come out." Little Ye waved a hand.
Weng, a terrifying murderous aura swept out, and a metallic figure appeared in front of them.
Natural-born Gold Spirit!
This was really a grand display.
The side of the Lands of Death had mobilized a total of seven Pseudo-Emperors to besiege Ling Han, and among them, there was also such a deadly weapon like Little Ye and the Natural-born Gold Spirit.
Even if it was Buddha Doga, Qian Yanghao, and Xia Houping here, they would probably frown deeply.
Ling Han looked at Baili Haojie, shook his head, and said, "As the son of the Great Emperor, you’re colluding with the enemy.
How can you face Great Emperor Ziwei?"
Baili Haoji looked furious, and shouted, "What nonsense are you spouting?"
Ling Han scoffed, "To trick me into coming here, how could your Baili Clan not have participated?"
Baili Haojie humphed, "If our Baili Clan was also involved, how could so many people have died?"
"That’s why I said, you’re quite ruthless!" Ling Han said slowly.
When his words fell, a great many members of the Baili Clan erupted.
"Second Elder, is this real?" they all asked.
As long as one was not an idiot, they would realize that though there were many deaths in the Baili Clan, they were basically all weaker members, and collateral branches.
Very, very few people from the main branch of the clan had died.
This was indeed suspicious, but the battle previously had been too intense, so who would think in this direction?
As it turned out, the main branch had sold them off, the collateral branches!
Baili Haojie flew into a humiliated rage, pointing at Ling Han and saying, "Don’t slander me."
Ling Han ignored him.
In his eyes, Baili Haojie was completely insignificant.
He had only spouted a few nonsense words to him on impulse, so what need was there for him to argue so hard?
"Ling Han, you’re really smart!" Di Wuji said with a smile.
"Unfortunately, you’re already surrounded.
Even if you have wings, you won’t be able to escape!"
Ling Han merely smiled.
Since he could tell that this was a trap, how could he not have set up alternative arrangements?
He had long since discovered that there was an obscure net here.
It would be retracted once he entered, but previously, he had already noiselessly destroyed a hole in this net.
If he wanted to leave, it would be a piece of cake.
However, it was rare for so many fallen Imperial Sons to be here, so he wanted to take the chance to kill a few of them.
"Come battle!" he shouted loudly, and directly charged out.
And his first target was shockingly Baili Haojie.
His speed was too fast, and the side of the Lands of Death had no intention to protect Baili Haojie.
Thus, Ling Han directly charged over.

chapters.title: Chapter 4783: Barging Through the Encirclement
paragraphs: Baili Haojie was the son of a Great Emperor, so there was no doubt about his natural talent and abilities. However, he was facing Ling Han.
Ling Han had killed even two Pseudo-Emperors, what more a mere Saint?
Baili Haojie’s expression changed drastically, and he subconsciously put on a defensive stance.
Peng! Ling Han’s punch landed, and Baili Haojie was obliterated into nothingness.
All of a sudden, the members of the Baili Clan all had complicated feelings. It was unknown whether they were happy, sad, angry or hurt.
This was the son of the Great Emperor, their Second Elder, yet he had actually collaborated with the Lands of Death, and betrayed a large number of his clansmen. How could he not deserve to die?
But with the death of Baili Haojie, the Baili Clan had completely declined, and no one else had any hope of breaking through to become Emperor.
In fact, with the army from the Lands of Death bearing down on them, it was hard to say whether the Baili Clan would still exist.
They all looked at Ling Han with complicated expressions. If this person was a member of their clan, how good would that be?
"To make a deal with the devil," Ling Han said calmly, looking towards Di Wuji and the others.

They must have promised Baili Haojie some benefits. It was even possible that they promised that he would become a Pseudo-Emperor, and that was why Baili Haojie was willing to give up the dignity of the Imperial Clan.

In Baili Haojie’s mind, if he became a Pseudo-Emperor, he would have hopes of becoming Emperor, and as long as he could become a Great Emperor, what need was there for him to worry about not being able to conquer the whole universe and establish an outstanding reputation?
Unfortunately, these fallen Imperial Sons only watched as Ling Han made his move. They had absolutely no intention of rescuing him.
Hence, to make a deal with the devil, he had brought this upon himself.
"Hehe, it’s time for you to die," Little Ye said, taking the initiative to attack.
The moment he moved, the Natural-born Gold Spirit immediately moved as well, joining him in a pincer attack on Ling Han.
These two "people" were both incredibly powerful.

When Little Ye was a Saint, she was already able to fight Ling Han head-on, and was only at a slight disadvantage. Now that he had advanced into Pseudo-Emperor-level, his abilities had naturally improved astonishingly. It could be said that he was only slightly inferior to Ling Han, and this was enough to become a strong rival for Ling Han.
Moreover... there was also the Natural-born Gold Spirit.
This was the true killing weapon.

This kind of spiritual matter that the heaven and earth had nurtured was a nine-star Pseudo-Emperor from the moment it was born. Furthermore, because of its unique nature, it was even stronger than the majority of nine-star Pseudo-Emperors. Furthermore, he was controlled by the twelve Lords of Death, which undoubtedly increased his battle prowess by tons.
The combined forces of Buddha Doga and the other Pseudo-Emperors was only barely able to block it, which showed how powerful it was.
No matter how freakish Ling Han was, he had only grasped 75 Regulations, and had not yet stepped into the threshold of Pseudo-Emperor, so how could he possibly match it?
Thus, he retreated at the first instant.

"Hehe, now that you’re here, don’t leave!" Little Ye moved, and pressed down on Ling Han. Weng, near Ling Han, the flow of time instantly decreased rapidly, which also caused Ling Han’s speed to become extraordinarily slow.
Ling Han released a battle cry, and the light of great dao burst forth. Instantly, the flow of time that had bound him instantly lost its effect.
However, the Natural-born Gold Spirit had already arrived. With a wave of its palm, it turned into a supreme God Tool that slashed towards Ling Han.
This was formed from his arm, and his body was comparable to the Origin Gold. If this attack landed, it was guaranteed that a Pseudo-Emperor would also be severed in half.
Even if Ling Han’s physique was tough, he didn’t dare to face it head-on now. He could only retreat rapidly.
"Hehe, big brother, stay and play!" Little Ye, who was standing on the sidelines, said innocently.
"Old monster that has lived for who knows how many years, get lost!" Ling Han shot out a punch.
Little Ye’s expression changed drastically. Old, old monster?
"You’re seeking death!" he shouted. Zi, two columns of light immediately shot out from his eyes, slashing towards Ling Han.
Towards Little Ye, Ling Han was only slightly apprehensive, but there was absolutely no possibility of fear.
Peng!
He greeted it with a punch, forcibly blasting Little Ye aside, and headed towards those Imperial Sons from the Lands of Death.
This caused the Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters to grit their teeth. ’You’re being hunted by the Natural-born Gold Spirit, yet you still dare to attack us?’
These people all shouted loudly, and counterattacked Ling Han.
—Even if they were no match for Ling Han, it was completely no problem for them to block a few moves.
Ling Han barged through. Though he was no match for the Natural-born Gold Spirit, the others were no match for him either.
The Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters were all speechless. Seven Pseudo-Emperors moving together actually couldn’t suppress Ling Han!
Thankfully, the Inescapable Net had already been set up. Ling Han was now trapped, and it was only a matter of time before he was captured.
Thus, they all smirked coldly. From today onwards, there would no longer be a freak like Ling Han in this world.

Meanwhile, Ling Han sighed inwardly. He very much wanted to kill a few more Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters from the Lands of Death, but with the two pursuers, Little Ye and Natural-born Gold Spirit behind him, he really did not have much of a chance to make a move, and could only keep running.
Forget it. When his strength increased further, he would still be able to come back and reap the lives of these people.
"Bullying with numbers, I’m not going to play with you guys anymore." Ling Han laughed loudly, and said, "I’ll leave your dog heads with you guys for now. I’ll take them back another day!"
With that said, he released a battle cry, and began to break out of the siege.
How fast was a Pseudo-Emperor?
Xiu, the fiery wings on Ling Han’s back flapped, and in an instant, he had gone millions and millions of km away.
"Ling Han, you still want to leave at a time like this?" The Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters all smirked coldly. ’Just wait to crash to the point that you’re bruised and battered.’
However, a shocking scene appeared. Ling Han flwewfurther and further away, and there was no sign that he was being blocked.
This!
These fallen Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters all exchanged looks, completely speechless.
Just now, they had been so confident, but in the end, Ling Han had just left without hesitation.
"This brat must have destroyed the restrictions long ago, and that’s why he could leave so calmly."
"How devious!"
The expressions of Di Wuji and the others were extremely ugly. Just think, they had made so many preparations in such a rush, yet in the end, they were completely played around with by Ling Han.
All of a sudden, they all turned their eyes on the Baili Imperial Clan, their killing intent blazing.
Since they had not managed to kill the main culprit, they would vent their anger on these people.
Sensing the cold killing intent from these Pseudo-Emperors, a great many people from the Baili Imperial Clan shouted, "Lords, we had an agreement; you would be responsible for protecting our safety!"
"Protect your sister!" Di Wuji humphed, and spat out a flame from his mouth. It instantly enveloped the entire Ziwei Planet, melting it completely.
The imperial formation was already damaged, and the Imperial Weapon was nowhere to be seen. So, how could it block the attack of a Pseudo-Emperor?
"We didn’t manage to kill that freak this time. Who knows how powerful that brat will become the next time he appears!" Yang Yihuan said with a frown.
"Humph, no matter how freakish he is, as long as he does not become Emperor, he would not be able to stand against a Great Emperor!" Di Wuji stated calmly.
"That’s right. Our plan is about to be completed. As long as our elders improve further, hehe, even if that brat becomes Emperor, so what?" He Luo nodded as well.

"However, this boy is ultimately a great scourge, a variable. If there is a chance, we still have to get rid of him," Wu Xingtong said coldly. The Battle God Palace had been razed to the ground by Ling Han. This was a public provocation to the Wu Clan.
"En!" These Pseudo-Emperors all nodded.

chapters.title: Chapter 4784: Wedding Again
paragraphs: Ling Han located the Imperial Clans one by one. After storing all the stars into his body, he began to set up formations and teleport them over extremely long distances.
The Imperial Formations were closed, and the Imperial Weapons were also hanging on his body. None of these could be stored into his body.
When the formation was set up, Ling Han immediately activated it and entered.
Weng, the teleportation began.
He had already experienced it once. Though it was a slight failure, it still allowed him to make some modifications. After travelling in the Void for half a day, peng, this passage exploded again.
Ling Han was instantly sent flying, his whole body covered in blood. Thankfully, he was not severely injured.
It was really terrible. He had to suffer like this every time.
Ling Han shook his head, and looked around. This place was completely empty. There were no stars, no sun, only darkness.
"Where is it?" he murmured, and began to search for Four Origin Planet.

If the distance was too far, then even if there was a mark that he had left on the Four Origin Planet, Ling Han would not be able to sense it. Thankfully, though he had been blasted out of the Void passageway, he was not too far away from the Four Origin Planet.
He began his journey again. Seven days later, the Four Origin Planet was already within sight.

Ling Han didn’t directly descend. Instead, he first released the planets in his body. Otherwise, if he released them on the Four Origin Planet, who knew how much damage would be caused by the collision of the planets.

He returned the Imperial Weapons to these Imperial Clan elites, and the Imperial Clan elites breathed a sigh of relief. They were truly afraid that Ling Han would take them for himself and not return them!

Though they could forcibly retrieve the Imperial Weapon, they would definitely become enemies with Ling Han, and in such a difficult time, the consequences of offending Ling Han were extremely serious.
Hehe, Ling Han wasn’t interested in their Imperial Weapon at all.
After returning to the Four Origin Planet, the empress and the others were naturally very happy.

He went to see Liu Yutong, Shui Yanyu and the others. After these people entered into the great universe, they could use the cultivation techniques of this world to cultivate, and now, they had steadily stepped into the level of Blood Transformation Tier and Mystery Realm Tier.
However, so far, not one of them had stepped onto the Celestial Path.
They had long since moved to the Four Origin Planet, and as their cultivation level increased, the most obvious change was that their bodies had become larger.
It should be known that when dimensions were taken out, they were only the size of a fist, so just how big was a planet?
Even a star was tens of thousands of times smaller than a grain of rice, let alone a human.
However, as they cultivated, they all grew larger, and were now about as tall as an arm. They were even "larger" than the dimension itself.

It could be imagined that the dimensions were equivalent to an Eighth Tier Heavenly Venerate. Meanwhile, how could Blood Transformation and Mystery Realm Tiers not be hundreds or even thousands of times more powerful than Heavenly Venerable Tier?
Thus, the increase of one’s cultivation level would definitely lead to the growth of one’s body size.
He was sure that once these people advanced into Celestial Path, they would all be able to return to the size of normal people.
Ling Han sent someone to monitor the life tokens. As long as Buddha Doga and the others sent a message, he would immediately tell them to return.
Er, though their trip would have amounted to nothing, it was still better than them continuing to search blankly in the universe.

After doing all this, Ling Han went to the Primitive Abyss again. However, the Azure Phoenix Emperor was standing guard at the entrance, and Ling Han was immediately hunted down by him the moment he entered.
Faced with a Great Emperor, even if it was a Great Emperor whose cultivation was very problematic, Ling Han was still no match. His only option was to flee.
Thankfully, the Imperial Weapon showed its might, and added with Ling Han’s tough physique and Phoenix Wings Divine Flight’s speed, he still managed to escape successfully.
This time, Ling Han couldn’t go to the Primitive Abyss, and the core area of the universe was now the territory of the Lands of Death. Ling Han was stuck in a dilemma. He couldn’t go anywhere.
So be it.
Ling Han was on the Four Origin Planet, guiding the cultivation of the people from the Genesis World, so that they could step onto Celestial Path sooner.

He did some calculations. He was presently a Four-Star Saint, and theoretically, he could only complete the Silent Destruction five times at most, and now that he had grasped 75 Regulations, he was still short of 24 to attain the consummate level.
In that case, one time of Silent Destruction could allow his body to accommodate five more Regulations, he would be able to cultivate 99 Regulations when he was a nine-star Saint.
This was completely possible!
Thus, even if Ling Han could no longer obtain Genesis Substance, he could still cultivate to the limits of Saint Tier.
Of course, this was only a matter of time.
Would the Netherworld or the Primitive Abyss give him so much time?

"Without the help of Genesis Substance, I would have to cultivate diligently for at least a thousand years or so to be able to advance another level. Furthermore, this is only advancing to five stars. The further I advance, the more time I would need to advance another level. Perhaps, it would take me more than ten thousand years to break through to become a nine-star Saint."
This was the main issue!

To say nothing of when the Lord of Deaths and the others would attack, just look at Yang Yihuan and the other fallen Imperial Sons. They were all Pseudo-Emperors now, and they only had to advance one step further, and they would become Emperor!

Although becoming Emperor definitely wouldn’t be as "easy" as becoming a Pseudo-Emperor, these people were all extraordinarily talented prodigies. This was a period of thousands of years, so the variables were really too great.
Once one of them became a Great Emperor, Ling Han would only be able to become a Pseudo-Emperor, at most. Even if he could match a Great Emperor, would he be able to turn the tide?

Furthermore, the Great Emperors had all planned for countless eras. Perhaps, the Great Emperor of this era would be able to become an existence that surpassed the Great Emperors of other eras. Then, Ling Han would be even more unable to calm the darkness.
Ling Han wracked his brains. He still wanted to increase his cultivation level faster, but there was nothing he could do.

"Yang Yihuan and the others must have obtained a great opportunity. Otherwise, they wouldn’t have been able to collectively advance into Pseudo-Emperor-level," Ling Han murmured. "It would be great if I could obtain their secrets."
However, charging into the territory of the Lords of Death and stealing this kind of secret?
Forget it.
Ling Han cast aside his distracting thoughts first. With the support of his alchemical pills, the cultivation level of the people from the Genesis World all soared, ushering in a great explosion.
On the other side, Buddha Doga and the others finally made contact with Four Origin Planet. After learning that Ling Han had already taken the Imperial Clans away, they began to return.
That would be another 200 years of long journey.
In this period of time, Ling Han cultivated and meditated and didn’t go anywhere.
Shui Yanyu, Liu Yutong, and the other beautiful wives all advanced into Celestial Path one after another. Their bodies were no different from normal people, and their family had truly been reunited.
200 years passed, and Buddha Doga and the others returned. When they found out that Ling Han had already become a Pseudo-Emperor, they were all very gratified.
At this time, Ling Han decided to hold another wedding.
He, Chi Menghan, and Song Lan had already become husband and wife in reality, but they had yet to hold a wedding, so he might as well take this opportunity to make up for it.
Furthermore, in this kind of dark age, there was indeed a need for something that would make one happy.
However, when Hu Niu found out, she immediately shouted that she too wanted to be the bride.

With her disturbance, the empress directly requested that she too wanted to be a bride, and though Liu Yutong and the other beautiful wives did not say it explicitly, the meaning in their eyes was very clear. They too wanted it.
After all, this was a great world, and represented a new beginning.
Fine then. With a wave of Ling Han’s hand, they would all get married again.

If the distance was too far, then even if there was a mark that he had left on the Four Origin Planet, Ling Han would not be able to sense it.
Thankfully, though he had been blasted out of the Void passageway, he was not too far away from the Four Origin Planet.
He began his journey again.
Seven days later, the Four Origin Planet was already within sight.
Ling Han didn’t directly descend.
Instead, he first released the planets in his body.
Otherwise, if he released them on the Four Origin Planet, who knew how much damage would be caused by the collision of the planets.
He returned the Imperial Weapons to these Imperial Clan elites, and the Imperial Clan elites breathed a sigh of relief.
They were truly afraid that Ling Han would take them for himself and not return them!

Though they could forcibly retrieve the Imperial Weapon, they would definitely become enemies with Ling Han, and in such a difficult time, the consequences of offending Ling Han were extremely serious.
Hehe, Ling Han wasn’t interested in their Imperial Weapon at all.
After returning to the Four Origin Planet, the empress and the others were naturally very happy.
He went to see Liu Yutong, Shui Yanyu and the others.

After these people entered into the great universe, they could use the cultivation techniques of this world to cultivate, and now, they had steadily stepped into the level of Blood Transformation Tier and Mystery Realm Tier.
However, so far, not one of them had stepped onto the Celestial Path.
They had long since moved to the Four Origin Planet, and as their cultivation level increased, the most obvious change was that their bodies had become larger.
It should be known that when dimensions were taken out, they were only the size of a fist, so just how big was a planet?
Even a star was tens of thousands of times smaller than a grain of rice, let alone a human.
However, as they cultivated, they all grew larger, and were now about as tall as an arm.
They were even "larger" than the dimension itself.
It could be imagined that the dimensions were equivalent to an Eighth Tier Heavenly Venerate.
Meanwhile, how could Blood Transformation and Mystery Realm Tiers not be hundreds or even thousands of times more powerful than Heavenly Venerable Tier?
Thus, the increase of one’s cultivation level would definitely lead to the growth of one’s body size.
He was sure that once these people advanced into Celestial Path, they would all be able to return to the size of normal people.
Ling Han sent someone to monitor the life tokens.
As long as Buddha Doga and the others sent a message, he would immediately tell them to return.
Er, though their trip would have amounted to nothing, it was still better than them continuing to search blankly in the universe.
After doing all this, Ling Han went to the Primitive Abyss again.
However, the Azure Phoenix Emperor was standing guard at the entrance, and Ling Han was immediately hunted down by him the moment he entered.
Faced with a Great Emperor, even if it was a Great Emperor whose cultivation was very problematic, Ling Han was still no match.
His only option was to flee.
Thankfully, the Imperial Weapon showed its might, and added with Ling Han’s tough physique and Phoenix Wings Divine Flight’s speed, he still managed to escape successfully.
This time, Ling Han couldn’t go to the Primitive Abyss, and the core area of the universe was now the territory of the Lands of Death.
Ling Han was stuck in a dilemma.
He couldn’t go anywhere.
So be it.
Ling Han was on the Four Origin Planet, guiding the cultivation of the people from the Genesis World, so that they could step onto Celestial Path sooner.
He did some calculations.

He was presently a Four-Star Saint, and theoretically, he could only complete the Silent Destruction five times at most, and now that he had grasped 75 Regulations, he was still short of 24 to attain the consummate level.
In that case, one time of Silent Destruction could allow his body to accommodate five more Regulations, he would be able to cultivate 99 Regulations when he was a nine-star Saint.
This was completely possible!
Thus, even if Ling Han could no longer obtain Genesis Substance, he could still cultivate to the limits of Saint Tier.
Of course, this was only a matter of time.
Would the Netherworld or the Primitive Abyss give him so much time?
"Without the help of Genesis Substance, I would have to cultivate diligently for at least a thousand years or so to be able to advance another level.
Furthermore, this is only advancing to five stars.
The further I advance, the more time I would need to advance another level.
Perhaps, it would take me more than ten thousand years to break through to become a nine-star Saint."
This was the main issue!
To say nothing of when the Lord of Deaths and the others would attack, just look at Yang Yihuan and the other fallen Imperial Sons.
They were all Pseudo-Emperors now, and they only had to advance one step further, and they would become Emperor!
Although becoming Emperor definitely wouldn’t be as "easy" as becoming a Pseudo-Emperor, these people were all extraordinarily talented prodigies.
This was a period of thousands of years, so the variables were really too great.
Once one of them became a Great Emperor, Ling Han would only be able to become a Pseudo-Emperor, at most.
Even if he could match a Great Emperor, would he be able to turn the tide?
Furthermore, the Great Emperors had all planned for countless eras.
Perhaps, the Great Emperor of this era would be able to become an existence that surpassed the Great Emperors of other eras.
Then, Ling Han would be even more unable to calm the darkness.
Ling Han wracked his brains.
He still wanted to increase his cultivation level faster, but there was nothing he could do.
"Yang Yihuan and the others must have obtained a great opportunity.
Otherwise, they wouldn’t have been able to collectively advance into Pseudo-Emperor-level," Ling Han murmured.
"It would be great if I could obtain their secrets."
However, charging into the territory of the Lords of Death and stealing this kind of secret?
Forget it.
Ling Han cast aside his distracting thoughts first.
With the support of his alchemical pills, the cultivation level of the people from the Genesis World all soared, ushering in a great explosion.
On the other side, Buddha Doga and the others finally made contact with Four Origin Planet.
After learning that Ling Han had already taken the Imperial Clans away, they began to return.
That would be another 200 years of long journey.
In this period of time, Ling Han cultivated and meditated and didn’t go anywhere.
Shui Yanyu, Liu Yutong, and the other beautiful wives all advanced into Celestial Path one after another.
Their bodies were no different from normal people, and their family had truly been reunited.
200 years passed, and Buddha Doga and the others returned.
When they found out that Ling Han had already become a Pseudo-Emperor, they were all very gratified.
At this time, Ling Han decided to hold another wedding.
He, Chi Menghan, and Song Lan had already become husband and wife in reality, but they had yet to hold a wedding, so he might as well take this opportunity to make up for it.
Furthermore, in this kind of dark age, there was indeed a need for something that would make one happy.
However, when Hu Niu found out, she immediately shouted that she too wanted to be the bride.

With her disturbance, the empress directly requested that she too wanted to be a bride, and though Liu Yutong and the other beautiful wives did not say it explicitly, the meaning in their eyes was very clear.
They too wanted it.
After all, this was a great world, and represented a new beginning.
Fine then.
With a wave of Ling Han’s hand, they would all get married again.

chapters.title: Chapter 4785: Barging In
paragraphs: When the news spread out, all the Imperial Clans naturally sent Saints to offer their congratulations.
Right now, Ling Han was like their only savior and hope. Moreover, in terms of battle prowess, he was also a Pseudo-Emperor.
This was the wedding of a Pseudo-Emperor; who wouldn’t give him face?
Thus, on the day of the wedding, there were many guests on the Four Origin Planet. There were envoys from the great Imperial Clans, as well as old friends from the Genesis World.

As for Yue Hongchang and Ling Dongxing, because their aptitude was poorer, even with the support of Ling Han’s alchemical pills, they were still unable to step onto the Celestial Path. Their figures were only the size of a forearm, and attracted a lot of attention.
When the great Imperial Clans found out that this was actually Ling Han’s parents, they couldn’t help but feel astonished.
Yi, why was it like this?
The wedding banquet lasted for a total of three days, and the hosts and guests were all satisfied.

When it came to happy events, people were really in high spirits. When they were consummating their wedding night, Ling Han had mixed feelings, and experienced the ebb and flow of life. He suddenly entered into a state of enlightenment.
He cultivated in seclusion for nine days, and when he reappeared, he was already a Five Star Saint!
When Ding Shu and the others found out about this, they were all extremely speechless.
They were all the Genesis World’s leaders, so why are you so outstanding?
Comparisons would drive one crazy.
After this breakthrough, the number of Regulations that Ling Han had grasped had also reached as many as 80.

He once again asked for guidance from Buddha Doga, Qian Yanghao and Xia Houping. In a fierce battle, he could fight Qian Yanghao and Xia Houping to a tie, but against Buddha Doga, he was still slightly inferior.
This was because both Qian Yanghao and Xia Houping had awakened eight times, while Buddha Doga had awakened nine times, reaching the pinnacle of Pseudo-Emperor.

However, the next step would be becoming Emperor. This would need the help of heaven and earth. Buddha Doga had already fought for it in his last life, so heaven and earth wouldn’t give him another chance to start over. Thus, his limit was Pseudo-Emperor, and he would never be able to take another step forward.
They were discussing where they should go next.

Time was tight, and Ling Han couldn’t afford to cultivate slowly. However, if he wanted to rapidly increase his cultivation level, he would either have to pluck chestnuts from the Lands of Death, or go to the Primitive Abyss to find Genesis Substance.
Neither path seemed to be easy to walk.
"Let’s go to the Primitive Abyss!" Buddha Doga said resolutely. His eyes were resolute, and he continued, "The three of us will open the path for you!"
Ling Han’s eyes involuntarily narrowed. He was both touched and uneasy.

Right now, the Azure Phoenix Emperor was standing guard at the entrance to the Primitive Abyss. It was clear that he didn’t want Ling Han to have another chance to enter. Meanwhile, the three Pseudo-Emperors would open the path for him, allowing him to enter. This would not be too difficult.
The problem was, if the Azure Phoenix Emperor pursued Ling Han, what would he do?
He couldn’t expect heaven and earth to coincidentally create an energy storm to separate Ling Han and the Azure Phoenix Emperor, right?

It could not be ruled out that there was such a possibility. However, the possibility of this was too small, and to bet one’s life to encounter this kind of luck was no different from committing suicide.

Thus, to ensure that Ling Han was fine, the three of them, Buddha Doga and the others, had to delay the Azure Phoenix Emperor. This would be dangerous. It was very possible that the three Pseudo-Emperors would be severely wounded, or even one or two of them would actually die.
How could the might of a Great Emperor be so easily violated?
Even if there was a problem with this Great Emperor.
"Seniors!" Ling Han hesitated. Old Man Ge had already died to save him, and he didn’t want to see anyone else die because of him.
"It’s all right!" Buddha Doga said with a smile. "We’ll each borrow a few Imperial Weapons. If it is just escorting you into the Primitive Abyss, I’m sure we can do it!"
He was brimming with confidence as he said this.
Ling Han pondered for a moment before nodding and saying, "Alright!"
Time was of the essence, and there was no time for him to be pretentious.

Because this venture was really dangerous, Ling Han chose to act alone. Otherwise, if he brought Brother Monkey, the large black dog, and the others with him, it would definitely increase the difficulty level for Buddha Doga and the others ten to a hundred times over.

Ding Shu, Jing Haoran, and Shui Qingchang, the three Genesis World rulers, remained on the Four Origin Planet. If they really encountered an attack fromthe Lands of Death, or if the Divine Beast Emperors from the Primitive Abyss appeared, they would also be able to immediately absorb all the planets into their bodies and flee.
Without Emperor-level battle prowess, this was something that could not be helped.
Ling Han spent a few days with the women before setting off with Buddha Doga and the others.

This time, entering into the Primitive Abyss, it was probably impossible for him to come out unless he had cultivated to the battle prowess of a Great Emperor. Firstly, he himself was unwilling, and secondly, with Great Emperors standing guard, it would be very difficult for him to come out.
Thus, everyone was reluctant to part.
"Husband, you have to take care of yourself!" Shui Yanyu, Chi Menghan and the other beautiful wives all reminded him repeatedly.

"Remember to bring gifts back!" Of course, this was Hu Niu. Her eyes were shining, and there was drool at the corners of her lips. She was already anticipating Ling Han bringing her delicious food, such as dragon meat and whatnot.
"Little Han, go and flatten those fake Divine Beasts!" the little azure dragon shouted from the sidelines.
"Jiu!" The little red bird nodded. She and the little azure dragon shared the same feeling. Her already dead parent had actually come back to life; this was blasphemy!

"Pick up a few more girls, and trample on a few more prodigies!" Meanwhile, the large black dog slung an arm around Ling Han’s shoulder, "If you have Origin Gold, remember to get a piece for Grandpa Dog. See, Grandpa Dog’s underpants have been torn and haven’t been mended yet!"
It even deliberately raised its behind.
Peng! Ling Han shot out a kick, and the large black dog instantly disappeared into the distance.
Only the empress did not speak. She gave Ling Han a domineering kiss, and quite a number of people covered their faces at the sight. This was too embarrassing.

Next, it was those juniors of Ling Han’s. In the Genesis World, he had lived for more than an epoch. He had a string of children and grandchildren, and all the great Imperial Clans were gritting their teeth upon seeing this. At first, they had thought that Ling Han was a young man, but why was his family so huge, and with so many generations at that?
After bidding farewell for a very long time, Ling Han and the three Pseudo-Emperors set out, and once again arrived at the entrance of the Primitive Abyss.
They entered, and when they reached the end of this passageway, they sensed the Imperial Might that was spreading out.
A massive Azure Phoenix lay there, blocking the path of entry.

"As expected, you guys have still come!" The Azure Phoenix Emperor released a baleful cry. With a flap of its wings, xiu, xiu, xiu, tens of thousands of feathers had already shot over. They were all entwined with nine-star Regulations. This was too terrifying.
Weng, weng, weng! Ling Han and the others activated the Imperial Weapon at the same time, and moved against the flow, greeting the Azure Phoenix Emperor.
Ling Han’s Imperial Weapon was naturally the Clear Bamboo Sword. Meanwhile, the Imperial Weapon of Buddha Doga and the others had been "borrowed" from the other Imperial Clans.
In this kind of situation, there was no room for these Imperial Clan elites to keep their secrets.
The four Imperial Weapons unleashed their might at the same time, which was equivalent to four Great Emperors awakening at the same time. They attacked the Azure Phoenix Emperor together.

In truth, it was impossible for the Imperial Weapon to compare to the Great Emperor. However, in an era when there was no Great Emperor, the Imperial Weapon was strong enough, and could easily suppress Saints. That was why there was the saying that the might of the Imperial Weapon was equivalent to the awakening of the Great Emperor.

However, the four Imperial Weapons unleashed their might at the same time, and this was still extremely terrifying. Furthermore, after all, there was also a problem with the Azure Phoenix Emperor itself. It could not compare to a true Great Emperor.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
Ling Han and the others joined forces, and actually managed to block the Azure Phoenix Emperor. However, it was clear that they were still at a disadvantage.
The might of a Great Emperor was just that domineering, not allowing others to be dissatisfied.

chapters.title: Chapter 4786: High purity ores
paragraphs: A Great Emperor was too strong. The four Pseudo-Emperors had activated the Imperial Weapon, and could only barely hold up against a Great Emperor.
And in terms of stamina, how could a Pseudo-Emperor compare to a Great Emperor?
Thus, if the battle dragged on for too long, it would definitely be Ling Han and the others that would be horribly defeated.
"Go!" Buddha Doga shouted.

The three Pseudo-Emperors went all out, forcing the Azure Phoenix Emperor to reveal an opening. Meanwhile, Ling Han took the chance to pass through. Using Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, he flew through this opening.
"Humph, you’re seeking death!" the Azure Phoenix Emperor said with a cold chuckle. He didn’t even turn around, and with a flap of his wings, he manifested a gigantic palm that grabbed at Ling Han.

Weng, weng, weng! At this moment, Buddha Doga and the others actually combusted the Imperial Source Source at the same time, instantly raising their battle prowess to a whole new level, detaining the Azure Phoenix Emperor firmly.

"Ah!" The Azure Phoenix Emperor was furious, but after combusting the Imperial Source, the battle prowess of the three Pseudo-Emperors had greatly increased, and added with the help of the Imperial Weapon, they were completely qualified to hold him back.
The Azure Phoenix Emperor sent out a message to contact the other Divine Beast Emperors to snipe Ling Han. Meanwhile, he stared at the Buddha Doga and the others, revealing a baleful killing intent.
"Since you people are so determined to seek death, I shall oblige you!"
"Retreat!" When Buddha Doga and the others saw Ling Han’s figure disappear, they immediately stopped burning the Imperial Source and began to retreat.
Although a Pseudo-Emperor had limited Imperial Source, it was enough to burn a few times.

Since the Azure Phoenix Emperor had already lost track of Ling Han, he naturally wouldn’t waste any more time. Instead, he continued to hunt down the three Pseudo-Emperors. As a great and noble Great Emperor, how could he swallow this anger?

Three fled, and one pursued. Of course, a Great Emperor’s speed was faster, but when the Azure Phoenix Emperor was about to catch up to them, the three Pseudo-Emperors would activate the Imperial Weapon in unison to oppose him.

Speaking of battle prowess, the three Pseudo-Emperors added with three Imperial Weapons were definitely no match for a true Great Emperor. However, if they were only focused on defense, there wouldn’t be too much of a problem.
Thus, Buddha Doga and the others retreated continuously. Although there were times of crisis, they didn’t face any danger.
The Azure Phoenix Emperor was truly enraged by now, and he chased after Ling Han like crazy. He didn’t look like he was going to give up.

Back to Ling Han. After breaking through the defenses of the Azure Phoenix Emperor, he rapidly advanced. Then, he quickly withdrew all his aura, assimilated with the environment, and slowed down his speed.
It was not that he did not know. Merely in this first level, there were nine great Divine Beasts — er, perhaps there were now eight of them.
But even if just one of the Divine Beasts came, it was not something that he could stand against at present.
Thus, he had to hide himself.
Weng, weng, weng! Not long after, Ling Han discovered a terrifying aura surging over.
This was the Flying Snake Emperor.
Ling Han only glimpsed a shadow, but he was absolutely certain that it was the Flying Snake Emperor.
He became even more cautious. Being hunted down by a Great Emperor, how could this be a joke?
Because he did not encounter the storm of heaven and earth, several days later, Ling Han arrived at the Dragon Head City.
At present, there was no Azure Phoenix Emperor standing guard here, nor was there the True Dragon Emperor. To Ling Han, this was practically no different from being completely unguarded.
He observed for a moment, and discovered that the nine great disciples... had come back to life!
So, the number of people here would never decrease, and would never increase, right?

Everyone’s fate was decided by birth. Some would become disciples of the Great Emperor, and were in the limelight, while others would become Saint-level guards. At least, they could be considered an important figure, and there were also some that would become miners, working day and night.
Ling Han snuck into the treasure storage again. He wanted to see how much ore they had gathered, and the result disappointed him.

Because every time he accumulated enough, the Great Emperor would begin to refine the Metal of Creation. He would either succeed, or fail. He only had that little bit stored away, and could not possibly have too much.

This time, because of the additional information provided by the Great Emperor Wu Ya, Ling Han guessed that these Divine Beast Emperors refined and created the Metal of Creation in order to forge a transcendent Imperial Weapon, to be used against the Great Emperor Wu Ya and the others.
Otherwise, it would really be meaningless.
Ling Han stood in the mineshaft, deciding what he was going to do.
By now, the Great Emperors in the first level would definitely be looking for him everywhere. Thus, it should be a good choice for him to hide in the mine area for a while.
In any case, time passed quickly here, so there was no need to worry even if it was slightly wasted.
Thus, Ling Han decided to settle down here.

He didn’t wear the special Battle Armor here, because Ling Han didn’t have a Spatial Spirit Tool in his possession, nor could he store it inside his body. Thus, it would be more convenient for him to travel without it.
After all, he had already been able to resist the extreme weight of gravity here before. Now, he even possessed the battle prowess of a Pseudo-Emperor.
There were many miners here, but with Ling Han’s strength, if he didn’t want to be discovered by them, who would realize that there was another person here?
However, it wasn’t long before a story of ghosts circulated among the miners. Some people swore solemnly that they saw people walking around here, but they disappeared in a flash.
Several days later, exclamations of shock suddenly traveled over from the mine. Everyone was overjoyed.
What was going on?
Ling Han ran over to take a look. As it turned out, the miners had dug out an extremely pure ore.
This attracted the attention of the Third King that was standing guard here. Holding this piece of ore, the Third King couldn’t help but laugh loudly, appearing to be extremely excited.
Ling Han also laughed loudly, and calmly walked over.
At the beginning, no one realized that something was off. After all, everyone was very excited, but when someone glanced at him, the situation became strange.
The others all lowered their voices, and then turned even more gazes towards Ling Han.
Who was this person?
"Who are you?" The eyes of the Third King were also fixed on Ling Han.
"Third, that’s not very nice of you. We’ve already met so many times," Ling Han said with a smile.
The Third King was very confused. This person was extremely unfamiliar, and he had never seen him before!
"Humph, you actually dare to enter this place secretly. No matter who you are, nothing good will happen to you!" The Third King moved directly, grabbing out at Ling Han.

Three hundred years in the outside world was more than thirty thousand years in the Primitive Abyss. Thus, this new Third King had long since cultivated to become a Saint. In fact, he was a Six Star Saint at that.
Combined with the Silver Battle Armor, his battle prowess was still quite shocking.
Boom, the large hand he stretched out was as black as ink, and grabbed hold of Ling Han in a single move.
"Die!" His fingers clenched into a fist, and he was just about to strangle Ling Han to death.
However, he shockingly discovered that as his fingers curled, he could not tighten his grip at all.
Was this a Saintly Material?
No, even Saintly Material, under his destructive power of as high as twenty stars, should have some slight distortion.
You f******.... freak!
Ling Han broke into a smile, "Third is still as cordial as always, shaking hands right off the bat!"
The Third King withdrew his hand. His eyes darted around madly, but in this place, he could not send out any signal at all, seeking the help of the Great Emperor.
What could he do?
All of a sudden, a thousand thoughts flashed through his mind.
"Come, give me that piece of ore," Ling Han said with a smile.

"Humph, don’t seek your own death!" The Third King refused decisively. This was something that the Great Emperor had specified that he wanted. If he surrendered it to Ling Han, he would also be severely punished.
Ling Han shook his head, and muttered, "Are you forcing me to kill you again?"

sentences.text: A Great Emperor was too strong.
The four Pseudo-Emperors had activated the Imperial Weapon, and could only barely hold up against a Great Emperor.
And in terms of stamina, how could a Pseudo-Emperor compare to a Great Emperor?
Thus, if the battle dragged on for too long, it would definitely be Ling Han and the others that would be horribly defeated.
"Go!" Buddha Doga shouted.
The three Pseudo-Emperors went all out, forcing the Azure Phoenix Emperor to reveal an opening.
Meanwhile, Ling Han took the chance to pass through.
Using Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, he flew through this opening.
"Humph, you’re seeking death!" the Azure Phoenix Emperor said with a cold chuckle.
He didn’t even turn around, and with a flap of his wings, he manifested a gigantic palm that grabbed at Ling Han.
Weng, weng, weng!

At this moment, Buddha Doga and the others actually combusted the Imperial Source Source at the same time, instantly raising their battle prowess to a whole new level, detaining the Azure Phoenix Emperor firmly.

"Ah!" The Azure Phoenix Emperor was furious, but after combusting the Imperial Source, the battle prowess of the three Pseudo-Emperors had greatly increased, and added with the help of the Imperial Weapon, they were completely qualified to hold him back.
The Azure Phoenix Emperor sent out a message to contact the other Divine Beast Emperors to snipe Ling Han.
Meanwhile, he stared at the Buddha Doga and the others, revealing a baleful killing intent.
"Since you people are so determined to seek death, I shall oblige you!"
"Retreat!" When Buddha Doga and the others saw Ling Han’s figure disappear, they immediately stopped burning the Imperial Source and began to retreat.
Although a Pseudo-Emperor had limited Imperial Source, it was enough to burn a few times.
Since the Azure Phoenix Emperor had already lost track of Ling Han, he naturally wouldn’t waste any more time.
Instead, he continued to hunt down the three Pseudo-Emperors.
As a great and noble Great Emperor, how could he swallow this anger?
Three fled, and one pursued.
Of course, a Great Emperor’s speed was faster, but when the Azure Phoenix Emperor was about to catch up to them, the three Pseudo-Emperors would activate the Imperial Weapon in unison to oppose him.
Speaking of battle prowess, the three Pseudo-Emperors added with three Imperial Weapons were definitely no match for a true Great Emperor.
However, if they were only focused on defense, there wouldn’t be too much of a problem.
Thus, Buddha Doga and the others retreated continuously.
Although there were times of crisis, they didn’t face any danger.
The Azure Phoenix Emperor was truly enraged by now, and he chased after Ling Han like crazy.
He didn’t look like he was going to give up.
Back to Ling Han.
After breaking through the defenses of the Azure Phoenix Emperor, he rapidly advanced.
Then, he quickly withdrew all his aura, assimilated with the environment, and slowed down his speed.
It was not that he did not know.
Merely in this first level, there were nine great Divine Beasts — er, perhaps there were now eight of them.
But even if just one of the Divine Beasts came, it was not something that he could stand against at present.
Thus, he had to hide himself.
Weng, weng, weng!
Not long after, Ling Han discovered a terrifying aura surging over.
This was the Flying Snake Emperor.
Ling Han only glimpsed a shadow, but he was absolutely certain that it was the Flying Snake Emperor.
He became even more cautious.
Being hunted down by a Great Emperor, how could this be a joke?
Because he did not encounter the storm of heaven and earth, several days later, Ling Han arrived at the Dragon Head City.
At present, there was no Azure Phoenix Emperor standing guard here, nor was there the True Dragon Emperor.
To Ling Han, this was practically no different from being completely unguarded.
He observed for a moment, and discovered that the nine great disciples... had come back to life!
So, the number of people here would never decrease, and would never increase, right?
Everyone’s fate was decided by birth.
Some would become disciples of the Great Emperor, and were in the limelight, while others would become Saint-level guards.
At least, they could be considered an important figure, and there were also some that would become miners, working day and night.
Ling Han snuck into the treasure storage again.
He wanted to see how much ore they had gathered, and the result disappointed him.
Because every time he accumulated enough, the Great Emperor would begin to refine the Metal of Creation.
He would either succeed, or fail.
He only had that little bit stored away, and could not possibly have too much.

This time, because of the additional information provided by the Great Emperor Wu Ya, Ling Han guessed that these Divine Beast Emperors refined and created the Metal of Creation in order to forge a transcendent Imperial Weapon, to be used against the Great Emperor Wu Ya and the others.
Otherwise, it would really be meaningless.

By now, the Great Emperors in the first level would definitely be looking for him everywhere.
Thus, it should be a good choice for him to hide in the mine area for a while.
In any case, time passed quickly here, so there was no need to worry even if it was slightly wasted.
Thus, Ling Han decided to settle down here.

Thus, it would be more convenient for him to travel without it.

Now, he even possessed the battle prowess of a Pseudo-Emperor.

Everyone was overjoyed.
What was going on?

As it turned out, the miners had dug out an extremely pure ore.
This attracted the attention of the Third King that was standing guard here.
Holding this piece of ore, the Third King couldn’t help but laugh loudly, appearing to be extremely excited.
Ling Han also laughed loudly, and calmly walked over.
At the beginning, no one realized that something was off.
After all, everyone was very excited, but when someone glanced at him, the situation became strange.
The others all lowered their voices, and then turned even more gazes towards Ling Han.
Who was this person?

We’ve already met so many times," Ling Han said with a smile.

"Humph, don’t seek your own death!" The Third King refused decisively.
