If he surrendered it to Ling Han, he would also be severely punished.
Ling Han shook his head, and muttered, "Are you forcing me to kill you again?"

chapters.title: Chapter 4787: Stone Mountain
paragraphs: "What nonsense are you spouting!" the Third King shouted.

"Sigh!" Ling Han couldn’t be bothered to speak any more nonsense. He sent out a palm strike, and pa, the Third King turned into a mush of blood. Even with the protection of the Silver Battle Armor, it was useless.
Ling Han’s attacks were too domineering. Even if he couldn’t shatter the Silver Battle Armor, the shockwaves of power still turned the Third King into minced meat.
A mere six-star Saint!

This scene caused the other miners to break out in a cold sweat. It was too terrifying. The disciple of the Great Emperor that was like a god in their eyes was actually unable to withstand a single blow. Could it be that this person was also a Great Emperor?
Ling Han cracked a smile, "All right, all right. Now that the excitement is over, let’s all go back to whatever we were doing. Please do not delay our proper business."
Er, are you going to take over as supervisor?

The miners didn’t dare to disobey at all. After leaving the mine, without the protection of the Battle Armor, their only fate would be death. Thus, they were like birds trapped in a cage, unable to resist at all.
They could only mine obediently, and Ling Han also took down the other three Saints that were standing guard here. He only had to take off their armor, and they could only stay here obediently.
Meanwhile, Ling Han held onto that piece of ore. After removing the impurities one by one, he actually obtained a piece of Metal of Creation that was the size of a thumb!
This was really a great gain.

It should be known that even the Metal of Creation that the Great Emperor Wu Ya and the others had "sent" through the Natural-born Gold Spirit was only this size, yet it had caused the True Dragon Emperor to personally come out to fight over it.
It was also because of this that the "Abyss Party" had appeared before the "Land of Death Party" for the first time.

The two weren’t in the same group, but they couldn’t be considered enemies either. At the moment, the Abyss Party was guarding the Primitive Abyss, and it seemed like they didn’t have any ambitions. Meanwhile, the Land of Death Party also minded their own business.
If such a piece of Metal of Creation fell into the hands of the Abyss Party, who knew how much trouble it would bring to the Great Emperor Wu Ya and the others.
"Hehe, this proves that I am very lucky, to have come at such a coincidental time." He began to praise himself very shamelessly.
He took out the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, wanting to immediately use it to improve his Pseudo-Imperial Weapon.
The Metal of Creation was continuously fused into the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, causing this precious tower to undergo some kind of transformation, but it wasn’t obvious now.
Ling Han had a feeling that this was a massive change that was brewing in the Origin Gold.
Once it happened, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower would undergo a complete transformation.
The Great Emperor Wu Ya said that the Metal of Creation could forge the strongest Imperial Weapon, and this was definitely not empty words.
Furthermore, Ling Han felt that it should not be an Imperial Weapon, but an existence that had surpassed the Imperial Weapon.
However, this required a large amount of Metal of Creation.

No wonder the 36 Divine Beasts were all stationed here. If they could really forge a Transcendent Weapon, and with the control of the Great Emperors, would they be able to insta-kill another Great Emperor?
Just like how the Pseudo-Emperor wielded the Imperial Weapon, what other Pseudo-Emperor would dare to face it head-on?
Thankfully, this was a qualitative change. It would only happen when a certain critical point had been reached. Otherwise, while there was improvement, it would not be too great.
As far as Ling Han could tell, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower had only become slightly sturdier than before. However, it didn’t seem to have become much more powerful.
Three months later, another three Saints came over to change shifts, and Ling Han captured all of them.
However, this also meant that he couldn’t stay here any longer. Afterward, the Dragon Head City would definitely send people over to investigate.
Ling Han simply absorbed all of them into his body. Even if the beings in the Abyss could create life, they would still need time, right?
Then, he strode off, heading towards the Azure Phoenix City.
His luck wasn’t bad, and he didn’t encounter any storms of heaven and earth along the way. Thus, after only five days, Ling Han arrived at the foot of the Azure Phoenix City.

He couldn’t help but think. Previously, he had participated in the Nine Cities Tournament here, and had even won the heart of a little girl. Who knew if this Mo Ziyun had also been reborn now, and when she met him, would she be attracted to him again?
Ling Han definitely wouldn’t tease this new Mo Ziyun again out of boredom. Instead, he quietly passed.

There was no Great Emperor standing guard here. The Azure Phoenix Emperor had gone to stand guard at the passageway, and the True Dragon Emperor had hidden in some unknown corner and was starting from the beginning again. Thus, this led to an empty space in two cities.

However, Ling Han didn’t dare to act recklessly. At the very least, the Flying Snake Emperor was looking for him everywhere. If he discovered any unusual movements in the two cities, he would definitely rush over at the first instant.
Thus, Ling Han kept a low profile as he continued to advance.
From here onwards, it was also incredibly unfamiliar to him. This was a path that he had never walked before.

Ling Han didn’t head to the third city. As long as they could trace his movements, they would be able to guess that his third stop should be the next city. Perhaps, there was already a Great Emperor waiting with an army there for him.

Thus, Ling Han walked all over the mountains and plains. His goal was to become stronger, and the main means of becoming stronger was Genesis Substance. Since that was the case, why did he have to go to the city?
However, Genesis Substance was too rare.
Even if this was the core area of the Primitive Abyss, where Genesis Substance was much more likely to be produced, it was still completely a matter of luck to find it.
Ling Han was willing to test this kind of luck. The flow of time here was a hundred times faster than outside, which gave him such confidence.
He walked slowly. Though he was not wearing Battle Armor, with his present physique and strength, it was still very easy for him without Battle Armor.
Unless he encountered a storm of heaven and earth, the Primitive Abyss no longer posed any threat to him.
From here, it looked no different from the outer circle. It was a barren plain, and looked harmless.
Of course, even Saints would be immediately crushed into dust if they entered this place without any protection.
Ling Han strode forwards, and very soon, a stone forest appeared ahead of him.
He did not take a different path, and entered straight ahead.
Hong long long, not long after, he suddenly heard a loud boom. That was the ground trembling.

It should be known that the structure here was extremely sturdy. Even if a Great Emperor made a move, the damage that he could cause would be limited. Then what kind of existence could cause even the ground to tremble?
Ling Han couldn’t hide his curiosity. He walked quickly, and after walking for another distance, he shockingly discovered that there were actually multiple rocks rolling forwards on the ground.

This scene was very majestic. Every rock seemed to have a life of its own, and was heading in the same direction. It was like ten thousand horses were galloping, and that was why the ground was trembling so much.
Yi, what was this? A mudslide?
Ling Han walked a little further ahead, and discovered that all the stones were rolling here, piled up one by one, as if they were building bricks.
Interesting, what was going on here?
Because of his curiosity, Ling Han stopped to watch for a while longer, wanting to know what was going on.
Soon, more and more rocks rolled here, turning into a mountain peak.
At this moment, no more rocks rolled over. Peace returned to the surroundings. Aside from the fact that there was a mountain of rocks here, there was nothing else unusual.
That was it?
Ling Han gritted his teeth. He was really bored out of his mind.
But right at this moment, boom, boom, boom, boom sounded again, and the mountain of rocks ahead of him actually moved.

chapters.title: Chapter 4788: Pseudo-Emperor Stone Spirit
paragraphs: It was as if these rocks had a life of their own. They continued to roll, accumulating on their own, and actually formed a human figure.
Stone, giant!

It was 30 meters tall, its arms extending below its knees. It had a round, plain head, and no features, but it seemed to have a pair of invisible eyes, making Ling Han feel like he was being targeted.
The key was his aura.
The aura of a Pseudo-Emperor surged over, bearing a mountain of pressure.
This rock monster was actually a Pseudo-Emperor!

Ling Han couldn’t help but sigh with emotion. In the outside world, those who could become Pseudo-Emperor did not outnumber the various Great Emperors of eras past by much, but in here, random rocks could be piled together to form one. How could he not sigh with emotion?
Cultivating arduously was inferior to a single thought from heaven and earth!
The rock golem cocked its head to one side, as if it was surveying Ling Han. However, in the next instant, it brandished its long and thick arms and ruthlessly smashed them down on Ling Han.
Boom, this attack was extremely powerful and terrifying.
How could the attack of a Pseudo-Emperor not be shocking?
Ling Han had now grasped 80 eight-star Regulations, so how could he be afraid? He immediately raised his fist to greet the attack.
Peng!

The two fists that differed greatly in size instantly crashed into each other, creating an incredibly powerful shockwave. Peng, peng, peng! Even if the rocks here were heavier than tens of thousands of stars, so what? Being shaken by a Pseudo-Emperor-level shockwave, they all began rolling, as if an earthquake had happened again.
The might of Pseudo-Emperor was as powerful as could be.

However, this also showed how sturdy the structure of heaven and earth here was. Even if Pseudo-Emperors moved, they could only cause the rocks here to roll around, and they were actually not sent flying!
Ling Han’s body shuddered, and he involuntarily retreated several kilometers before coming to a halt.
Good lord!
He thought to himself, ’This rock golem’s battle prowess is not inferior to that of Buddha Doga.’
The heaven and earth had moved, and it was a nine-star Pseudo-Emperor directly?
Ling Han didn’t think that this rock golem had also cultivated step by step to become a Pseudo-Emperor. Cultivating here? That was completely unrealistic!
Thus, it must have been born as a Pseudo-Emperor, and a peak stage Pseudo-Emperor at that.
Without having a body that experienced nine times of Silent Destruction, how could it be revived?
Realization immediately dawned on Ling Han. The current system of cultivation was only invented by the cultivators, so why couldn’t there be a second or third system of cultivation?
Directly speaking of the core, wasn’t the purpose of cultivating for the sake of strength?
However, wasn’t the strength and weakness of this world all decided by heaven and earth?
The heaven and earth wanted this rock golem to be Pseudo-Emperor-level and its battle prowess would be the strongest level among Pseudo-Emperors. What need was there for it to cultivate like that?

All of a sudden, Ling Han’s mind and spirit fluttered. It was as if he had caught hold of something, but at the same time, it was as if he had caught hold of a chaotic mess. It was extremely difficult to find the correct thread.
Boom, at this moment, the rock golem threw another punch, and a terrifying energy surged.
Ling Han laughed loudly, and withdrew his thoughts that had strayed. He raised his fist and confronted the rock golem head-on.
Fighting against Buddha Doga, because both sides had restraints, it could only be considered a sparring match to test out battle prowess. He could not truly test out his own limit of battle prowess.
However, this rock golem was different. It wouldn’t hold back.
Ling Han also needed an opponent of this level to exert enough pressure on him. Only then would he be able to unleash his potential.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
The two great Pseudo-Emperor-level beings clashed head-on, and without any fancy moves at all, unleashed their full battle prowess.

Because he had not used such trump cards like Destructive Energy, light of great dao and so on, Ling Han was naturally at a disadvantage. Furthermore, the disadvantage was very obvious. However, he had the intention to force out his limits, and was not willing to use his trump cards, even after so long.
In this way, his situation was in imminent danger.

"Roar, roar, roar!" The rock golem sent Ling Han flying with a punch, causing all the pores on Ling Han’s body to burst. Blood oozed out, and he instantly became a bloody figure, making this guy extremely excited. He pounded his chest like a gorilla.

"Hehe, do you want me to introduce my Little Stone to you?" Ling Han wiped the blood from the corner of his lips. This rock golem reminded him of the rock golem that he had subdued in the Genesis World. Both of them had different methods but achieved the same result. However, that Little Stone in the Genesis World was too weak, and had just stepped onto the Celestial Path.
"I don’t know if you’re male or female. If you’re male, wouldn’t that be gay?" he continued to mumble.
Boom! The rock golem threw a punch at Ling Han without any mercy.
Ling Han fought with all his might, but the gap in battle prowess was too obvious. After a long battle, Ling Han was at a complete disadvantage. It was only a matter of time before he lost.
The rock golem seemed to be very excited, and released a wave of divine sense through its "roar". Its attacks became even more rapid, as if it wanted to defeat Ling Han in one go.
"Hey, come!" Ling Han felt that it was about time. His battle prowess limit had already been forced out, and he could no longer just stay passive and take a beating like this.
Boom!
His hands shook, and his fists were immediately entwined with the light of great dao and Destructive Energy, exuding an incredibly dangerous aura.
The rock golem was startled. Although it didn’t have any facial features, it was clear that it was showing a hint of seriousness.
"You don’t dare to come?" Ling Han laughed loudly.
The rock golem seemed to have been angered. With a leap, it flew high into the air, and then landed heavily.
With its terrifying weight, even if it was just being crushed by such an impact, it was enough to kill any Saint.
Ling Han didn’t dare to let the rock golem crash into him, so he hurriedly retreated. Then, he swung his fists repeatedly, blasting towards the rock golem.
The rock golem howled. The blockhead seemed to have gone mad from the battle, and faced Ling Han’s iron fists head-on.
Peng, with this blow, Ling Han was indeed sent flying again, but the rock golem also roared loudly, its divine sense rippling like an ocean.
The damage caused by this punch was too terrifying. Even with the rock golem’s defenses, it couldn’t withstand it. Both its fists caved in, turning into dust.
The rock golem cocked its head as if pondering something. Then, it swung its arms, and pa, pa, pa, the rock on its fists fell off, turning into bare wrists.
Yi, is this considered cutting one’s losses?
But in the next instant, the rock golem stretched out its arms, and two large rocks nearby suddenly flew over and attached themselves to its bare wrists respectively, forming two fists again.
This?
’You can do that?’

Ling Han couldn’t help but grit his teeth. If he couldn’t kill the rock golem in one go, then as long as there were rocks nearby, not only would this guy not die, he might even be unable to injure it?
This was this big guy’s home ground.
Forget it, he couldn’t start a battle here.
Ling Han immediately turned around to flee. He didn’t linger in battle at all.
The rock golem was dazed for a moment. ’I was just having fun fighting, so why aren’t you fighting anymore?’
No way!
It immediately broke into a run, and set off in pursuit of Ling Han.
One ran, while the other pursued, moving unhindered in this massive stone forest.

It was unknown whether it was luck or misfortune, as they actually did not encounter any storms of heaven and earth along the way. Otherwise, Ling Han and the rock golem might have been stopped, and be forced to battle, or the rock golem might have given up its pursuit.
Two months later, they finally rushed out of this vast stone forest, and a great ocean suddenly appeared ahead of them.

They continued to roll, accumulating on their own, and actually formed a human figure.
Stone, giant!
It was 30 meters tall, its arms extending below its knees.
It had a round, plain head, and no features, but it seemed to have a pair of invisible eyes, making Ling Han feel like he was being targeted.
The key was his aura.
The aura of a Pseudo-Emperor surged over, bearing a mountain of pressure.
This rock monster was actually a Pseudo-Emperor!
Ling Han couldn’t help but sigh with emotion.
In the outside world, those who could become Pseudo-Emperor did not outnumber the various Great Emperors of eras past by much, but in here, random rocks could be piled together to form one.
How could he not sigh with emotion?
Cultivating arduously was inferior to a single thought from heaven and earth!
The rock golem cocked its head to one side, as if it was surveying Ling Han.
However, in the next instant, it brandished its long and thick arms and ruthlessly smashed them down on Ling Han.
Boom, this attack was extremely powerful and terrifying.
How could the attack of a Pseudo-Emperor not be shocking?
Ling Han had now grasped 80 eight-star Regulations, so how could he be afraid?
He immediately raised his fist to greet the attack.
Peng!
The two fists that differed greatly in size instantly crashed into each other, creating an incredibly powerful shockwave.
Peng, peng, peng!
Even if the rocks here were heavier than tens of thousands of stars, so what?
Being shaken by a Pseudo-Emperor-level shockwave, they all began rolling, as if an earthquake had happened again.
The might of Pseudo-Emperor was as powerful as could be.
However, this also showed how sturdy the structure of heaven and earth here was.
Even if Pseudo-Emperors moved, they could only cause the rocks here to roll around, and they were actually not sent flying!
Ling Han’s body shuddered, and he involuntarily retreated several kilometers before coming to a halt.
Good lord!

The heaven and earth had moved, and it was a nine-star Pseudo-Emperor directly?
Ling Han didn’t think that this rock golem had also cultivated step by step to become a Pseudo-Emperor.
Cultivating here?
That was completely unrealistic!
Thus, it must have been born as a Pseudo-Emperor, and a peak stage Pseudo-Emperor at that.
Without having a body that experienced nine times of Silent Destruction, how could it be revived?
Realization immediately dawned on Ling Han.
The current system of cultivation was only invented by the cultivators, so why couldn’t there be a second or third system of cultivation?
Directly speaking of the core, wasn’t the purpose of cultivating for the sake of strength?
However, wasn’t the strength and weakness of this world all decided by heaven and earth?
The heaven and earth wanted this rock golem to be Pseudo-Emperor-level and its battle prowess would be the strongest level among Pseudo-Emperors.
What need was there for it to cultivate like that?
All of a sudden, Ling Han’s mind and spirit fluttered.
It was as if he had caught hold of something, but at the same time, it was as if he had caught hold of a chaotic mess.

Boom, at this moment, the rock golem threw another punch, and a terrifying energy surged.
Ling Han laughed loudly, and withdrew his thoughts that had strayed.

Fighting against Buddha Doga, because both sides had restraints, it could only be considered a sparring match to test out battle prowess.

However, this rock golem was different.
It wouldn’t hold back.
Ling Han also needed an opponent of this level to exert enough pressure on him.
Only then would he be able to unleash his potential.
Hong!
Hong!
Hong!
The two great Pseudo-Emperor-level beings clashed head-on, and without any fancy moves at all, unleashed their full battle prowess.

Furthermore, the disadvantage was very obvious.

In this way, his situation was in imminent danger.

This rock golem reminded him of the rock golem that he had subdued in the Genesis World.
Both of them had different methods but achieved the same result.
However, that Little Stone in the Genesis World was too weak, and had just stepped onto the Celestial Path.

If you’re male, wouldn’t that be gay?" he continued to mumble.

chapters.title: Chapter 4789: Turning an enemy into a friend
paragraphs: The sea was expansive, and the waters were dark blue. There was no wind or waves, and it was like a beautiful piece of agate.
Ling Han suddenly stopped in his tracks, and stood on the beach.
"Stupid big guy, do you really think I’m afraid of you?" he asked with a smile.

The rock golem’s body suddenly trembled, making Ling Han think that there was something wrong with it. He didn’t expect that a wave of divine sense would immediately transmit over. Although it didn’t have much meaning, it was very obvious that it was laughing.
’Er, are you saying that I’m bluffing?’
Just how much was he looking down on him?
Ling Han gritted his teeth. Although this was a Pseudo-Emperor, in terms of intelligence alone, it was very low.
He was actually being mocked by such a rock golem with low intelligence?
"All right, I’ll beat you to your heart’s content!" Ling Han laughed loudly, and brandished his fist at the rock golem. Boom, Destructive Energy surged, and the light of great dao shone.
Peng! Peng! Peng!
The battle between the two sides was incredibly intense.

If it were Budha Doga, he definitely wouldn’t engage in close-quarter combat with Ling Han. Instead, he would distance himself from Ling Han and avoid coming into direct contact with Destructive Energy and light of great dao. The destructive power of that was really too great. In fact, it even surpassed the Imperial Weapon.
Just one question, would a Pseudo-Emperor dare to face an Imperial Weapon head-on?
No!
Thus, the might of Ling Han’s attack was even more terrifying than the might of the Imperial Weapon. No matter how tough the rock golem’s skin was, it couldn’t be helped that it was seeking death.

In a few moments, its fists were gone. However, there were no rocks here to replenish its energy, so it could only use its arms to attack. Fortunately, it was made of rocks in the first place, so this did not have much effect on it.
Then, its arms became shorter and shorter, bit by bit, right until it became armless.
"Wu?" The rock golem was also very confused. Yi, why was it that as they fought, my arms have disappeared?
However, a blockhead was still a blockhead. Without arms, what was there to be afraid of? Didn’t he still have a pair of legs?
This time, it switched to using its feet, and stomped madly on Ling Han.
Ling Han did the same thing. Not long after, the rock golem’s two legs were gone, leaving behind only a massive body and a massive head.
But this guy was a fool. What if he lost both his arms and legs?
It directly rammed its body into Ling Han, but if it didn’t change its battle style, how could it not suffer losses?
Soon, its body was also destroyed, and its head was also gone. Finally, an earthen-yellow crystal was left behind, exuding a powerful life force.
This was a little similar to Genesis Substance, but there was also a difference. It was like it had the same origins as Genesis Substance but had evolved into a new branch.
Ling Han had a feeling that if he refined this crystal, his cultivation level wouldn’t increase, but his life force would become much, much stronger.
It was this crystal that had given life to the rock golem. Otherwise, the rocks that had been piled up would only be rocks.
Ling Han hesitated. He could refine this crystal. Though it could not increase his cultivation level, it could strengthen his life force to make up for the massive expense he had previously expended.
However, this rock golem was especially innocent. In fact, when it was fighting with him, it was only purely fighting, and did not leave with the thought that it would definitely beat him to death.
Could he take in a lackey?
A peak stage Pseudo-Emperor-level lackey should be very interesting.
Ling Han took the crystal and walked back, arriving once more in the stone forest. Then, he placed the crystal on a rock.
Instantly, this rock immediately trembled lightly. Then, the rocks in the surroundings seemed to have boiled, and began to tremble.
Xiu, xiu, xiu! Multiple rocks were absorbed over, and piled up on the first rock. After a few rocks, the earthen-yellow crystal could no longer be seen, and was surrounded within the rocks.
Then, visibly, a rock golem was rapidly piled up.
Though it was not quite the same as the last one, er, after all, it was not built from the same pile of rocks, but it gave Ling Han the same feeling.
Silly, naive.
Boom, as soon as the rock golem appeared, it threw a punch at Ling Han.
"Stupid big guy, you are really ungrateful!" Ling Han stepped back.
However, the rock golem’s punch didn’t land. Instead, it stopped in midair.
It cocked its head, as if it was confused about something. Then, it obediently withdrew its fist, and sat down cross-legged in front of Ling Han.
A foolishly smiling wave of divine sense immediately spread out in Ling Han’s mind.
Er, he had really become stupid.
Ling Han stretched out a hand and patted the rock golem’s body. The rock golem didn’t resist, and seemed to be enjoying it very much.
"Er, you have no eyes or nose. You look so awkward." Ling Han thought for a moment, then leaped onto the rock golem’s head, and began to carve on its "face".
The rock golem didn’t have any sense of pain. Its core was that earthen-yellow crystal, so if the crystal wasn’t damaged, it wouldn’t be damaged. The rocks it absorbed were only a protective layer.
Thus, the rock golem obediently allowed Ling Han to draw.
"En, en, en, not bad." Ling Han smiled. Originally, the rock golem didn’t have a front or back, and now, he had drawn eyes, nose, and mouth on one side. This was the main face.

However, if there were others here, they would definitely shake their heads incessantly. That was because not only was Ling Han incompetent in naming, his skill in drawing was also worrying. The eyes, nose, and mouth that he drew were all crooked.
"Er, it’s still better than before," Ling Han consoled himself.

"People definitely have their strengths and weaknesses. My natural talent in martial arts is so freakish, and I’m also Alchemy Emperor and Formation Grandmaster. Thus, it’s normal that I’m not good at drawing."

However, he was still a bit driven mad. Why was it that when he was drawing formation patterns, no matter how complicated the veined patterns were, he could draw them in a neat and orderly manner, and when it was time to draw a nose and eyes, hey became incompetent?
"Sigh, this can only be blamed on the heavens."
After resting for a while, Ling Han set off. The rock golem hurriedly followed behind him.
"My family already has a Small Rock, so you can be called Big Rock." Ling Han thought for a moment, and gave the rock golem a name.
—His incompetence in naming was exposed without a doubt.
The rock golem didn’t mind this, and merely let out a cry with its divine sense.
"Alright, as long as you’re happy."
Ling Han brought the rock golem along, and once again arrived at the side of the blue sea.
"Looks like we can only fly over."

Without Pseudo-Emperor-level battle prowess, Ling Han wouldn’t have been able to fly under such extreme weight of gravity. However, it was a different story now. He had enough power to break free from the restraints of gravity and soar through the air.
However, flying here required additional energy. If there was no need, Ling Han actually didn’t want to fly. In any case, running on the ground wasn’t slow.
He soared into the sky and flew forwards. As for the rock golem, peng, it rushed into the sea, and after running a few steps with it, its entire body had already disappeared without a trace.
Er, what intelligence.
Forget it, you can just walk in the sea.
Ling Han activated his eye technique, and it was still visible that the rock golem had directly sunk to the bottom of the sea, and was currently running on the seabed.
Xiu, he continued to fly.
After walking for three days, Ling Han was already a little tired. However, he suddenly saw a small island appear ahead of him.
This was just in time for him to settle down.
Yi?

chapters.title: Chapter 4790: Giant Turtle
paragraphs: Yi, Ling Han was very surprised, because this island was floating on the ocean’s surface.

It should be known that the substances in the Primitive Abyss were all extraordinarily heavy. You see, the rock golem was clearly a Pseudo-Emperor, but it still sank directly into the sea, and could only run at the bottom of the sea.
What right did this island have to float?
Celestial medicine!

Ling Han’s sharp eyes focused on the island. There was a crimson plant growing on it, and it had borne a pure purple fruit. It was not big, and was about the size of an olive. It was completely transparent.
"The aura of Genesis Substance."
Ling Han murmured softly, revealing an expression of delight. He had really not thought that after searching high and low for so long, he would inadvertently make a great discovery.
"This is mine now."
His figure descended rapidly, heading towards the small island.
But right at this moment, xiu, xiu, xiu, over a hundred water arrows suddenly shot towards him.
Yi?
Ling Han was astonished. Why was he being attacked?
Who had attacked him?
He was puzzled, but Ling Han naturally wouldn’t allow the water arrows to hit him. He hurriedly turned around and dodged this attack.
Shua, shua, shua! The water arrows gushed out endlessly, shooting fiercely towards Ling Han.
F***, what the hell?
Ling Han was stunned, because the might of this attack had shockingly reached the level of Pseudo-Emperor.
The deeper one ventured into the Primitive Abyss, the more dangerous it was indeed. Beings with Pseudo-Emperor-level battle prowess appeared one after another.
Huala, a loud bang was heard, and then the rock golem came out of the seabed, leaping straight into the air. Then, it landed on the island, its fists smashing down fiercely.
Ling Han couldn’t help but grit his teeth in pain. ’You f****** are loyal to your master, I know that, but please don’t destroy my Celestial medicine.’

The Celestial medicine was a very special existence. It could grow in incomparably vile places, and its vitality was incredibly tenacious. But at the same time, it itself was also incredibly fragile, and would be destroyed at the slightest bit of attack.
The rock golem’s attack wasn’t as terrifying as Ling Han’s, but its advantage was its physique, which was stronger.
More importantly, it was fine even if its body was damaged. The rocks outside were only its armor in the first place.

Peng, peng, peng! The water arrows arrived, and left multiple holes on the rock golem’s body. However, the rock golem didn’t care at all. Its figure had already descended, and its fists smashed down rapidly.
Boom!
A loud boom rang out, and the entire island was smashed off its original position by the rock golem. Then, this island suddenly moved.
Ling Han saw that the island had four limbs, a head, and a tail protruding from different places... this was shockingly a giant turtle. Previously, it had only shrunk its body into its shell.
F***, no wonder he had been attacked.
Shua, shua, shua! The giant turtle and the rock golem battled fiercely, water arrows flying, fist shadows surging.

This giant turtle’s battle prowess was not inferior to the rock golem’s at all. In a fierce battle, the rock golem couldn’t get the slightest advantage. However, with its super strong defense, it didn’t lose out either. It released a wave of divine sense, and accompanied with its weird face, it was clearly a fierce battle, yet Ling Han felt that it was very hilarious.
He did not continue to watch the battle. The Celestial medicine was right in front of his eyes, so how could he possibly sit by and watch?
Moreover, with how simple-minded Big Rock was, what if he damaged the Celestial medicine?
Ling Han made his move. He did not make a move on the giant turtle, but rather headed directly for the Celestial medicine.
Unless he had no other choice, he did not want to kill. After all, there was no animosity between him and this giant turtle, so there was no need for him to kill for no reason.

The giant turtle battled fiercely with the rock golem, and had no time to be distracted. Furthermore, Ling Han did not reveal the slightest bit of killing intent. At this moment, he had transformed into the Killing Saint of the Battle God Palace, but was countless times stronger than that old Killing Saint. If he did not reveal his killing intent, it would be extremely difficult for even a Pseudo-Emperor to discover his existence.
Xiu, Ling Han landed on the giant turtle, and plucked up the Celestial medicine.
"Ang!" The giant turtle released a roar of pain. Where this Celestial medicine had been pulled out, a wound actually appeared, blood gushing out.
Yi, this Celestial medicine was actually nurtured from the flesh and blood of the giant turtle?

Ling Han didn’t immediately leave. With a leap, he had already arrived in the air. If he killed the giant turtle, he would definitely be able to obtain even more benefits, but this kind of killing without grudges had surpassed Ling Han’s bottom line.

Otherwise, what was the difference between him and the Lords of Death?
"Big Rock, let’s go!" Ling Han said.
However, the rock golem’s interest was piqued by the battle, and it completely ignored him. It continued to battle fiercely with the giant turtle, as if it was determined to win.
Fine then.
Ling Han leaped down and battled the giant turtle with the rock golem.
With two Pseudo-Emperors joining forces, and two at the strongest level at that, how could the giant turtle hold up against that?
After about a hundred moves, the giant turtle could no longer withstand it. With a swift dive, it sank into the ocean waters.
The rock golem wanted to give chase again, but Ling Han forcibly pulled it back.
"Ang?" It looked at Ling Han dumbly, looking puzzled.
If you’re a man, then don’t cower!
Could it be that you are not a man?
Ling Han smacked it on the head, "Let’s go."

He had nothing to step on here, and he was unable to refine the Celestial medicine here. Moreover, Ling Han had flown continuously for three days. In this kind of land of extreme gravity, even he felt a little tired, and needed a good rest.
There was nothing else that could be done. His foothold had already fled, so Ling Han could only continue to fly.
Fortunately, after travelling for another two days, land finally appeared ahead of them.
Ling Han hurriedly descended, and recovered first.
The rock golem also came out of the sea, and when it walked to Ling Han’s side, it deliberately shook its body. Shua, drops of water dripped over.

It should be known that all the matter here was super concentrated. A grain of sand was equivalent to the weight of a planet, and a single drop of water was even more terrifying than the weight of a planet. When several hundred drops sprayed over, it was equivalent to several hundred Saints attacking at the same time.
Ling Han also bared his teeth, and looked towards the rock golem.
This guy was wearing a silly smile, as if he had not realized what he had done at all.
Alright, he was the one who had drawn this silly smile on his face, so he would admit it.
Ling Han took a good rest. After he recovered, he took out the Celestial medicine and began to refine it.
There wasn’t much Genesis Substance in this Celestial medicine, but it still allowed Ling Han to accommodate three more Regulations.
He had reached 83 flashes.
A smile appeared on Ling Han’s face. As expected, if he wanted to quickly increase his cultivation level, he still had to come to the Primitive Abyss.
"Big Rock, let’s go." He stood up and continued forward.
The rock golem was dumb. When Ling Han stopped, it would stop, and when Ling Han left, it would follow.
Very quickly, a mountain range appeared ahead of them. It was so tall that the summit could not be seen, and its length was endless.
It was impossible to circle around, and they could only climb over the mountains.
Ling Han and the rock golem started to climb the mountain. However, not long after they climbed the mountain, their speed slowed without prior discussion.

In this place, the gravity field had become even more terrifying, and more importantly, this mountain was too uneven. There were sharp rocks protruding like blades everywhere, and one would have to step on them with every step, and if one stepped on them, it was equivalent to cutting off their flesh.
Ling Han had to focus a large amount of his energy on defense. Otherwise, even with his physique, he wouldn’t be able to withstand it.

chapters.title: Chapter 4791: Kui Bull City
paragraphs: They had only climbed a height of 30,000 meters, before Ling Han had no choice but to retreat.

He couldn’t hold on any longer. The soles of his feet were already badly mangled. If he continued to force himself, it was guaranteed that his feet would be ground off, followed by his ankles, then his thighs. His whole person would be ground to nothing.
He retreated to the foot of the mountain, and so did the rock golem. It stood dumbly beside Ling Han.
"Let me see your feet," Ling Han said.
However, the rock golem didn’t react at all. It couldn’t understand Ling Han’s words.
Er.
Ling Han sat cross-legged on the ground, his legs raised.
The rock golem followed suit, plonking down and crossing its legs.
Its feet had also become distorted, and a part of its feet had been forcibly gouged out.
Hiss, what a terrifying place. Both he and the rock golem had suffered greatly.
It was only at this moment that Ling Han further realized just how terrifying the Primitive Abyss was.
Previously, it had only been a storm of heaven and earth. Though it was frightening, it could be dodged, but in this place, if one wanted to pass, they could only face the challenge head-on.
No wonder it was said that this was a place where even Great Emperors could enter but not exit.
Moreover, this wasn’t truly the depths of the Primitive Abyss yet.
"It can’t be crossed?" Ling Han looked at the great mountain that lay ahead of them, and frowned deeply.
He was not the type to admit defeat easily.
"This is just right. I can use it to temper my willpower and physical body."
He channeled the Ten Cultivation Technique, and the injuries on his feet slowly healed. After resting for a while, he began to continue climbing the mountain.
The rock golem couldn’t recover its body, but it didn’t feel any pain anyway. Ling Han walked, and it followed, looking completely dumb.
This time, Ling Han ascended a further distance.
When they retreated back to the foot of the mountain, Ling Han was very satisfied with himself. As long as there was improvement, that would be a good thing.

He climbed the mountain every day, and as the days passed, the heights he could reach became higher and higher. However, in recent times, his improvement was also getting smaller and smaller, and he was just about to reach his limit.
In the future, he would still be able to improve, but it was possible that he would only walk an additional few dozen steps, or a hundred steps every day.

Looking at the soles of his feet again, even if he had an amazing technique like Ten Cultivation Technique, there were still multiple gashes left behind, as if they had been cut out by a flurry of sabers.
He was already like this, and the rock golem was even worse off. It had been forcefully degraded greatly.
— Its two legs had long since been worn down, but that was all right. By removing some part of its arms, it could still form two legs.
Even the rocks on his arms had been worn off, didn’t he still have a body? In any case, it was big, so he could dismantle it as he liked.
For Ling Han, this was not a waste of time. He had sharpened his willpower to become even sturdier, and his physique had also become considerably stronger. His battle prowess had improved greatly.
However, whether the blockhead had improved or not... Uh, Ling Han didn’t know.
Judging by its silly look, it probably had not.
Were they stuck at this mountain?
Ling Han thought for a moment, then shook his head.

He was already close to his limit. Even if he could squeeze out some more potential, his improvement wouldn’t be too great, and if the summit was in sight, he might be able to succeed if he put his life on the line.
However, the problem now was that the summit was not even visible. Ling Han could only make another attempt when his cultivation level increased again.
"Perhaps, only a Great Emperor would be able to cross this mountain."
Ling Han murmured, and decided to take a different path.
He set off with the rock golem. After circling around the mountain range for a long time, another desolate plain appeared ahead of them, but there were rocks scattered everywhere.

The rock golem immediately charged out. Pa, pa, pa! Multiple rocks attached to its body, and its body began to grow larger. And this time, even if it had reached its original size, it did not stop. Instead, it was still growing larger.
Finally, it turned into a giant that was three hundred meters tall before stopping.
"Er, are you afraid of losing too much of your body?" Ling Han asked with a smile. This guy had absorbed so many rocks, so it would be able to support an expenditure for a very long time.
The rock golem didn’t understand, and simply "grinned dumbly" at him.
They passed through the stone forest, and after walking for another few dozen days, they saw that the mountain range had actually been severed, and there was a city in the middle.
It looked like a wild bull, vivid and lifelike.
"Divine Beast... Kui Bull?" Ling Han murmured. Among the Divine Beasts, only the Kui Bull was in the shape of a bull, and it only had one leg. It could not be any more obvious.
"Yi, in that case, I have now entered into the area of the second level?"
The Kui Bull Emperor was not among the nine great Divine Beasts of the first level.
Although the nine cities in the first level were different in depth, they all belonged to the same area overall, but this time, Ling Han had walked a very, very long path.
Thus, he had already walked out of the first level, and arrived at the second level.
"If I want to continue forward, I either have to climb mountains, or pass through this city."

Ling Han thought quickly. The 36 Divine Beasts were all standing guard at the passageway into the Primitive Abyss. Then, did this mean that these areas were actually relatively safe areas, such as the corresponding area of this city? It was highly possible that there had been a passageway here in the past.
"It’s impossible to climb the mountains. The requirements for abilities are too high, so if we want to continue deeper, we can only pass through this city."
Ling Han retracted all of his aura and observed the surroundings. If he rashly walked over and drew the attention of the Kui Bull Emperor, things would definitely become troublesome.
"Hold on, the first level is an area, and the second level is self-contained."
"With how big this space is, even the disciples of a Great Emperor can’t simply barge in."
"Thus, I am completely capable of impersonating one."
Ling Han’s eyes lit up, and he said to the rock golem, "Big Rock, let’s go."
The rock golem was dumb, and only when Ling Han set off did it hurriedly follow him.
Peng, peng, peng! It followed behind Ling Han, and when its feet landed, it created a loud sound.
It wasn’t long before Ling Han arrived before the city gates.
"Stop right there!" There were guards at the city gates, and they were all wearing Bronze Battle Armors. They blocked Ling Han’s path. "Who are you?"
Ling Han smiled faintly, and said, "I’m a disciple of the True Dragon Emperor, the Ninth King."
The guards faltered.
The True Dragon Emperor? The Ninth King?
"That’s the first level area!" The guard’s face was filled with disbelief. From the first level area to here, what kind of difficult journey would he have to go through?
Apart from those having Emperor-level strength, who else could pass?
Hold on!
He suddenly discovered the rock golem, and couldn’t help but reveal a shocked expression.
What a large rock golem, how could it exude such a terrifying aura, making him tremble and want to kneel down?
He was a Saint!
Ling Han smiled, "This is my underling, who has escorted me all the way here."

The rock golem sized up the guard. It didn’t have much intelligence, but it could sensitively sense Ling Han’s will When it discovered that Ling Han didn’t have killing intent, it didn’t attack the guard.
In its eyes, this guard was like an ant, completely beneath its notice.
The guard nodded blankly. With such a powerful guard, it was no wonder that Ling Han could move unhindered.
"Please wait for a moment, Lord. I have to go and make my report first."

chapters.title: Chapter 4792: Luo Wuyang
paragraphs: Ling Han smiled, and waited at the gates.
Peng, the rock golem also sat down. With how heavy it was, once it sat down, even the ground was trembling madly.
Ling Han glanced at this guy, and the rock golem looked back at him blankly. Its two painted eyes, one higher than the other, were filled with hilarity.
Er, he was the one who had drawn it, so he shouldn’t laugh!
Ling Han sighed. Couldn’t there be someone more dependable by his side?

The large black dog and little azure dragon were both despicable characters. Although Brother Monkey didn’t have this problem, he would charge forward with a roar when he saw the enemy. This rock golem... Forget it, it didn’t even have a brain, so there was no need to have too many expectations.
After a while, Ling Han felt a powerful aura bearing down on him. He had not even reacted, when the rock golem suddenly jumped up, its fists pounding on its chest, looking very fierce.
"Big Rock, calm down!" Ling Han said. However, it was pointless to say this, as Big Rock didn’t understand it at all.
However, the rock golem could still sense Ling Han’s intent. Since Ling Han didn’t have any killing intent, it suppressed its urge and simply stared ahead.

Ling Han looked over, and a young man walked out of the city. He wasn’t wearing any kind of Battle Armor, but rather a snow-white tight-fitting suit, exuding a fierce and domineering aura, like a Great Emperor.
This wasn’t a Great Emperor, and Ling Han was certain of it. However, the other party had already cultivated to the level of Pseudo-Emperor.
Was this the disciple of a Great Emperor?
Hiss, they had only reached the second level, and already a Pseudo-Emperor had appeared!
"It really is a Pseudo-Emperor!" The white-robed man did not pay much attention to Ling Han. Instead, he merely stared at the rock golem, his eyes filled with both shock and greed.

In this place, living creatures that were naturally born were called Source Spirits, but generally speaking, they were all Saint-level. In such harsh environments, they would usually die the moment they were born, so they were very rare.
Most of those who managed to survive were Pseudo-Emperor-level, but they were even rarer. It would be as difficult as ascending the heavens to even encounter one, let alone taking one as a lackey.
This kind of creature was born with a natural inclination for freedom. Even if the Great Emperor made a move, he would only be able to suppress it, and not subdue it.
Thus, the fact this Stone Spirit was actually subdued by Ling Han made him extremely surprised and envious.
A Pseudo-Emperor-level guard!
The rock golem, meanwhile, pounded its arms, looking displeased. Though its intelligence was low, it was very sensitive to the evil thoughts exuded by every single person.
"How dare you!" The guard from before had also returned, and hurriedly raised the spear in his hands, but his arms were trembling.
The character in front of him was a Pseudo-Emperor.

Yet the white-robed man stretched out a hand to stop him, meaning that there was no need to be nervous, and in truth, if the rock golem was really going to flip out, what use would mere Saint-level guards be?
Only then did he turn to look at Ling Han, and said with a smile, "I am Luo Wuyang, a disciple of Kui Bull Emperor."
Yi, did the Kui Bull Emperor only have one disciple? Otherwise, he would probably have added a few more disciples.
Ling Han nodded, and said, "I am the Ninth King under the True Dragon Emperor, Han Lin."
"Brother Han, please." Luo Wuyang gestured for Ling Han to enter the city.

Ling Han raised his head and glanced at it. If he took this step, it would be equivalent to entering a dragon’s lair or a tiger’s den. With a Great Emperor overseeing things, he could use the Imperial Weapon against it. Though there was hope of escaping, it was also possible that he would be detained.
But for the sake of strength, he naturally had no other choice.
Ling Han walked through the city gates.
Peng! Peng! Peng!

The rock golem naturally followed them in. Because there was no powerful gravity field in the city, or rather, there was an anti-gravity field here, the rock golem instantly missed its footing and floated up.

"Ang?" The rock golem’s divine sense fluctuated in surprise and excitement, as if it was a child that had suddenly gotten an interesting toy. It instantly started to play around, and somersaulted in midair.
However, it was a Pseudo-Emperor. Once it released its restraints, it instantly set off turbulent waves. One after another, hurricanes formed, and began to blow around the city.
Thankfully, the buildings here were similarly extremely heavy, and could not possibly be damaged by this kind of hurricane wind. However, it was a different story for people.
The guard bore the brunt of it, and was instantly sent flying by the hurricane winds. With a peng, he crashed into a wall, and slid down, coughing up blood continuously.
The might of a Pseudo-Emperor was as powerful as could be.
Ling Han hurriedly calmed the rock golem down. If it continued to play around a few more times, the people in the city would be sent flying.
He had not come to crash the party.

Seeing that the rock golem was indeed obeying Ling Han’s commands and obediently walking on the ground, Luo Wuyang couldn’t help but look envious. Though he was a Pseudo-Emperor, he did not possess such a servant, so how could he not be envious?
Luo Wuyang and Ling Han walked in front, while the rock golem followed closely behind.

"Brother Han, why did you suddenly think of coming here?" Luo Wuyang asked. He was really curious, but it was not because he was suspicious of Ling Han’s identity. After all, the Primitive Abyss had never been "invaded".
Ling Han pondered for a moment before saying, "It’s better to travel ten thousand miles than to read ten thousand books."
Luo Wuyang couldn’t help but feel speechless. This was f******* the Primitive Abyss.
How would you read ten thousand books here? And wasn’t walking ten thousand miles here a suicidal action?
With just these few words, he could confirm that Ling Han was definitely not a "normal" character.
"How did you subdue this Source Spirit?" Luo Wuyang asked again. This really made him too curious, and he could not figure it out no matter how hard he thought about it.

He knew that in the first area, the disciples of the Great Emperors were only Saint-level cultivators. Unlike the second area, where there were few disciples of Great Emperors, their individual abilities were much stronger. They were all Pseudo-Emperor-level existences.
"I don’t know either. Perhaps it’s because I’m good-looking." Ling Han spread out his hands.
A muscle twitched in Luo Wuyang’s cheek. He already knew that Ling Han was not a normal character, but he was actually so f****** abnormal, which made him want to throw up blood.
Furthermore, you are good-looking, so if this Source Spirit follows you, what you mean is that others would not be good-looking.
How did this mouth grow? When it came to insulting others, he could practically kill others without spilling any blood.
"Heh, so be it if Brother Han doesn’t want to tell me," he said in a calm voice. He naturally wouldn’t believe him.
He made arrangements for Ling Han’s accommodations, then informed Ling Han that he would arrange a celebratory feast for Ling Han.
Originally, Ling Han had wanted to leave the city. However, doing so could possibly cause two Great Emperors to pincer attack him. This was undoubtedly a very dangerous thing.
Thus, since his identity hadn’t been exposed, he didn’t mind feigning civility.
Two days later, Luo Wuyang indeed hosted a banquet for Ling Han.
Luo Wuyang was not the only one present. There were also a great many young prodigies in the city.

Everyone sat down, one after another. The resources of the Primitive Abyss were scarce, so they ate less, drank less, and dressed less. However, once they obtained meat, it would be a Saint-level Source Spirit, at least, and Celestial medicines were similarly Saint-level.
Thus, though there was not much food in front of everyone, it was still incredibly precious.

chapters.title: Chapter 4793: Conflict
paragraphs: It was unknown whether Luo Wuyang was naturally courteous, or if he was deliberately trying to impress Ling Han by hosting such a "luxurious" banquet.
The Young Misses and Young Masters that had come all exclaimed in shock. This was a luxurious feast that they may not even have in a few hundred years.
"Haha, Lord Luo is really generous."
"That’s right. If it was not for Lord Luo, we may not even be able to eat such a meal in a few hundred years."
"It is our fortune to have a disciple of the Great Emperor like Lord Luo!"
Everyone began to flatter him.
Ling Han said calmly, "Yi, shouldn’t you guys be thanking me? Without me coming here, which one of you would be able to eat?"
This!
At this moment, everyone was speechless. How could there be such a shameless guy?
However, it had to be said that these words were actually quite logical.
In terms of cause and effect, that was indeed the case. If Ling Han hadn’t come here, they wouldn’t have been able to come here, and naturally wouldn’t have been able to eat such a great meal.
However, why was it so strange for Ling Han to say something that was clearly reasonable?
The corner of Luo Wuyang’s mouth twitched. This was not only abnormal, but also f****** shameless!
"Haha, everyone, drink to your heart’s content, and eat to your heart’s content!" He waved his hand.

Everyone chewed slowly. This wine had been brewed with Celestial medicines, and the meat was a Saint-level Source Spirit. They were all extremely precious. Usually, they would only be able to eat it once every few hundred or a few thousand years, so they had to savor it.
Yet Ling Han really ate as much as he liked. Very soon, he had finished all the meat and wine in front of him.
"That—" He looked towards Luo Wuyang.
"Serve the dishes." After Luo Wuyang’s expression darkened, he waved his hand, indicating for the servant to replenish Ling Han’s food.

However, in the Primitive Abyss, food was really too precious. This was not a must-have item, yet was incredibly hard to obtain, so it had become a luxury item. Even if Ling Han’s food was replenished, it would still be pitifully little.
Ling Han didn’t care, and he quickly finished the food.
"Give me another serving." This time, he did not even bother to speak to Luo Wuyang, and directly said to the servant beside him.
The servant’s expression also darkened. ’You really don’t treat yourself as an outsider.’
This was Luo Wuyang’s manor, and those who didn’t know better would think that you were the owner.
The servant looked towards Luo Wuyang, and Luo Wuyang waved his hand helplessly.
At this banquet, he actually wanted to show Ling Han his strength to intimidate him. He had not thought that Ling Han would be so shameless. This was practically like trying to signal to a blind man.
Some people were brave, and when they saw Ling Han do this, they quickly finished their own portion, and requested for an additional serving.
Luo Wuyang’s expression became even darker.

The Primitive Abyss was far too dangerous, so much so that even the Saint-level guards didn’t dare to leave the city so easily. Only he, one with great skill and courage, dared to pluck Celestial medicines and hunt Source Spirits by himself. This was a symbol of his strength.
But now?
He felt like a fool.
Why had the atmosphere suddenly veered off course? Not too long ago, everyone was still praising him, so why had they all become gluttons now?

Some people were brave enough to do it first, so others naturally followed suit. The result was great. Now, everyone was eating and drinking with their heads lowered, as if this was the true purpose of their coming to the banquet.
Luo Wuyang sighed. Had they all become stupid?
He had no choice but to use his divine sense to transmit a message to some people.
In this way, those people finally came to their senses as if they had just woken up from a dream.
"Brother Han, why don’t you tell us how you obtained this Source Spirit?" Someone stopped eating and drinking, and asked Ling Han.
Ling Han pondered for a moment before replying, "Because I’m good-looking!"
That person couldn’t help but feel his expression darken. ’Though you are indeed quite good-looking, there is no need to exaggerate so much, right?’
This was mockery. Were they not good-looking, and that was why they had not been able to obtain such a Source Spirit?
At this moment, everyone looked at Ling Han with a slightly resentful gaze.
"Brother Han, is your Source Spirit Pseudo-Emperor-level?" After a while, someone asked.
Ling Han pondered for a moment before saying, "You’ll know once you fight it."
’Holy f*ck!’
Everyone was so infuriated that they wanted to vomit blood. Before you answered, you deliberately paused for a moment just to come up with a retort, right?
You don’t have any God Tools that can collect resentment, so why are you so keen on insulting others?
"Hehe, let me try." Luo Wuyang stepped out.
Though he knew that this Source Spirit was Pseudo-Emperor-level, he did not know the exact details of its abilities. Thus, he could take this chance to find out.
In addition, he also wanted to show off his strength and let the rock golem know that following him was the wisest choice.
"Okay." Ling Han nodded. Then, he said to the rock golem behind him, "Big Rock , someone wants to fight you."
The rock golem didn’t understand, so it wore a blank expression.
Everyone looked at its eyebrows and crooked smile, and couldn’t help but want to complain again. What kind of drawing ability was this?
It must have been drawn by the rock golem itself. It had low intelligence, after all, and that was why it looked so ugly.
Thankfully, these were only thoughts, and had not been spoken out loud. Otherwise, Ling Han would definitely go berserk.
Was his intelligence f*cking low?

Everyone carried the tables and retreated into their rooms, clearing out the space. In any case, the structure here was sturdy. As long as they hid in their rooms, they would not be swept by the aftermath of the battle.
The rock golem foolishly retreated with Ling Han, completely unaware that it was the main character of the next event.
This caused everyone to laugh loudly. Sigh, with such low intelligence, his battle prowess would definitely be limited.
Ling Han also smiled, and locked his divine sense onto Luo Wuyang, suddenly unleashing his killing intent.
"Ang!" The rock golem immediately became excited, and released a divine sense-level cry, charging towards Luo Wuyang.

Previously, it had been very well-behaved, giving people the misconception that it was harmless. However, after moving, everyone knew that this was a Source Spirit that could run rampant in the Primitive Abyss.
Peng! Peng! Peng!
The rock golem charged forwards, its feet stepping on the ground, releasing a massive boom, causing the whole ground to tremble violently.
Everyone was transfixed with shock. Such a Source Spirit was indescribably terrifying.
Meanwhile, Luo Wuyang revealed a bellicose expression. With a battle cry, he took the initiative to greet the rock golem.
As a Pseudo-Emperor, who would be afraid of—
Peng!
Luo Wuyang’s expression changed drastically. His whole person was sent flying.
He was completely outmatched!
He was only a Two-Star Pseudo-Emperor, but what about the rock golem?
It was at the highest level.
It should be known that previously, it was Ling Han who had faced off against the rock golem. Before using his ultimate move, he was also being suppressed by the rock golem, what more Luo Wuyang.
The rock golem’s attack succeeded, and it immediately set off in pursuit.
Even though it looked stupid, once it entered battle mode, its instincts were extremely terrifying.
A natural Source Spirit was born for battle.
In the past few days, it had been suppressed and unable to battle. Now that it had suddenly gotten a chance, the rock golem was practically beside itself with excitement.
It chased after Luo Wuyang and beat him up madly.
Peng, peng, peng! Luo Wuyang was no match at all, and was instantly pressed onto the ground.

chapters.title: Chapter 4794: Exchange
paragraphs: Everyone was speechless.
That was Luo Wuyang! Not only was he a disciple of the Great Emperor, but he was also a Pseudo-Emperor.
But now, he was actually beaten to his heart’s content by a Source Spirit, completely unable to fight back. How could everyone accept this?
This was too tragic, wasn’t it?
"Big Rock, Big Rock, that’s enough. If you continue, someone will die." Ling Han called a halt.
However, the rock golem was already excited by the battle, and didn’t listen at all.
In truth, it was not Ling Han’s servant. However, after Ling Han spared its life, it had been running around with Ling Han like a lackey.
After Ling Han called out a few times, the rock golem finally obeyed and stopped.
However, Luo Wuyang was already in a tragic state. He was lying on the ground, badly mangled.

Fortunately, Saints could regrow severed limbs, and Pseudo-Emperors were even more superior. As long as their Imperial Source was not damaged, they would be able to easily recover. It only needed a little time.
"Hehe, you’ve already eaten and drunk, so everyone can leave now," Ling Han said with a smile, leaving with the rock golem.
Everyone was dumbfounded. This guy was really something. He had eaten and drunk his food and wine, and in the end, he had even beaten the host up. Luo Wuyang was really out of luck.
However, this Source Spirit was actually so powerful!

Everyone was stunned. Luo Wuyang was a Pseudo-Emperor. In their hearts, this was an existence that was only inferior to the Kui Bull Emperor, but now? He was easily pressed and pounded into the ground by someone else’s servant.
They were also incredibly envious. How lucky was Ling Han to have such a servant?
They really wanted to possess one as well.
Ling Han stayed for a few days. Just as he was about to leave, he saw Luo Wuyang pay him a visit.
"Yi, Brother Luo’s injuries recover so quickly!" he said.
Luo Wuyang couldn’t help but wear a dark expression. How could anyone speak like this?
Someone like you actually managed to live until now without being beaten to death. The heavens really are blind.
He really wanted to flip out, but when he saw the rock golem standing on the sidelines, looking like it was eyeing him covetously, he very consciously withdrew this kind of urge.
—He couldn’t possibly alert the Kui Bull Emperor just because of a disciple of a Great Emperor, right?
He couldn’t afford to lose face either.
Luo Wuyang controlled his emotions, and continued, "That um, Brother Han, I want this Source Spirit. Name a price."
Ling Han looked at him seriously, "Brother Luo, this is Pseudo-Emperor-level !"
Have you seen anyone selling or buying Pseudo-Emperors?

"A Genesis-level Celestial medicine!" Luo Wuyang said through gritted teeth. He had only managed to find this after searching for 300,000 years. Originally, he had planned to use it to break through to become a three-star Pseudo-Emperor.

However, Genesis Substance could only add icing on the cake. Whether he could break through or not would have to depend on his own aptitude, and the problem was that he seemed to have reached his limit as well, and could not improve any further.
Thus, rather than wasting a Genesis-level Celestial medicine for nothing, it would be better to use it to exchange for a Pseudo-Emperor-level servant.
Ling Han pondered for a moment, "Ten!"
Luo Wuyang almost went crazy, "Do you know how precious Genesis Substance is?"
"You also have to know how rare Pseudo-Emperors are," Ling Han also said.
This... was indeed the case.

Even if there were 10 Genesis-level Celestial medicines, it was still impossible for them to produce a single Pseudo-Emperor. With that calculation, it was him who would profit more from this transaction.
However, why did he keep feeling that something was off?
Yi, such a powerful guard, as long as there are ten Genesis-level Celestial medicines, you are going to give it up just like that?
Luo Wuyang shook his head, "I only have a stalk of Genesis-level Celestial medicine in my possession."

"Brother Luo, though we feel like old friends at first sight, even blood brothers have to settle accounts clearly, right?" Ling Han said with a smile, "You want to trade a single Genesis-level Celestial medicine for my Big Rock. You are really too greedy, aren’t you?"
"But I really only have one Genesis-level Celestial medicine," Luo Wuyang said, "Otherwise, you can go to my treasure chamber and take a look for yourself."
"Alright!" Ling Han nodded without hesitation.
Yi, could you be a bit more shameless?
However, he was the one who had spoken, so Luo Wuyang could only helplessly bring Ling Han to the treasure chamber.

The contents of the so-called treasure chamber was actually mostly the remains of corpses. They were all Source Spirits of the Primitive Abyss. Of course, he hadn’t killed them, but rather they had been killed by the storm of heaven and earth. He had only picked up the corpses.
Additionally, that would be precious material, but it was mostly Saintly Material, and there was no Origin Gold, or any Metal of Creation.
The Celestial medicine that Luo Wuyang had spoken of was also placed here. It could be considered the most valuable treasure in this place.
"I’ll take them all." Ling Han pointed at them.
Luo Wuyang couldn’t help but sneer, "There are so many, can you fit them all?"
The Spatial Spirit Tool was completely useless here. It would be crushed into pieces. You only have two hands, so how are you supposed to hold all this?
Ling Han smiled faintly, and said, "You don’t have to worry about that. One word, do you want to trade or not?"

"Trade!" Luo Wuyang immediately said. Though this treasure chamber had taken him innumerable years to accumulate, compared to the value of a Pseudo-Emperor Source Spirit, it was not worth mentioning at all.
"All right, Big Rock is outside. I’ll leave it to you." Ling Han waved his hand dismissively, "You can go out now. I want to properly admire my treasures."
’F*ck! These are mine!’
Luo Wuyang held back for a moment, and did not make a move.
In his eyes, Ling Han was nothing more than a Saint. He could easily deal with him.
However, they were both disciples of Great Emperors, so he didn’t dare to make a move.
Thus, he retreated out of the room, and went off to socialize with Big Rock.
Ling Han retrieved the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower and started to collect the items here.
The Spatial Spirit Tool couldn’t withstand the gravity fields here, but the Origin Gold could.
After collecting all the items, Ling Han strode out.
"Big Rock, you can stay here from now on," Ling Han said with a smile. He waved a hand at the rock golem, then sent out a divine sense message, making the rock golem sit down peacefully.

In the previous journey, Ling Han had also tried to communicate with the rock golem. Although it wasn’t ideal, he had still reached some relatively simple tacit understanding, such as having the rock golem sit.
"Brother Luo, then I won’t disturb you. I still have to continue my journey," Ling Han said.
Luo Wuyang had obtained a Pseudo-Emperor Source Spirit, so he couldn’t bother with Ling Han anymore. He nodded and said, "Bye."
The deal was done, and his attitude immediately turned cold. After all, he had been quite angered by Ling Han just now.
Ling Han smiled, but did not take it to heart, because Luo Wuyang would go mad with anger later.
He exited the city and continued to advance towards the core area of the Primitive Abyss.
After walking for half a day, he muttered, "It’s about time."
The rock golem was like a child, and its patience was definitely limited. Thus, if it was told to sit peacefully, half a day was the limit.
And in Kui Niu City, Luo Wuyang could no longer wait to show off the Rock Source Spirit to others.

Previously, he had been horribly defeated by the rock golem, and it could be said that he had lost all face. Thus, he naturally had to get back his pride immediately. After all, he was a disciple of the Great Emperor, so his identity was sensitive.
Furthermore, these days were really too boring.
Everyone came over, and when they saw the rock golem that was sitting upright, they all clicked their tongues in praise.
A Pseudo-Emperor-level Source Spirit!
"Lord Luo, could you have this Source Spirit move agilely, and fully display its divine might?" someone asked. This was also boot-licking Luo Wuyang, so that he would have a chance to perform.
Luo Wuyang nodded in satisfaction, "All right."
He issued a command to the rock golem, "Rise!"
The rock golem didn’t move at all.
"Get up!" Luo Wuyang called out loudly again.
The rock golem still didn’t move.
This!
Luo Wuyang instantly felt very humiliated. In full public, this was very embarrassing, all right?
If it was not for the fact that he was no match for this Source Spirit, he really wanted to make a move.
Could it be that it was too stupid and did not understand his words?
"Run!" he roared. At the same time, he also used his divine sense to transmit his voice. This was a pure intent that had transcended the language barrier.
The rock golem suddenly stood up. Peng! It charged forward.
At this, Luo Wuyang finally showed an expression of joy. He was finally obedient.
Everyone also praised repeatedly. This was a Pseudo-Emperor-level servant.
"That..." A guest suddenly said weakly, "That Source Spirit doesn’t seem to have turned back."
Er!
