chapters.title: Chapter 4795: Ran off
paragraphs: That’s right, what happened to the rock golem?
If it was told to run, it would run. It didn’t know that it had to stop at all, nor did it know that it had to turn back, right?
This was what a retard was!
Luo Wuyang was speechless. This rock golem wouldn’t run all the wayand never come back, right?
As expected, a Pseudo-Emperor that had not reached that level by itself would be so retarted?
Luo Wuyang could only give chase. After all, he couldn’t let this retarded Source Spirit continue to run towards the setting sun and never return, right?
Seeing Luo Wuyang chase after it, everyone felt a <anno data-annotation-id="9d380756-eefc-4b60-948c-22ef7bf64234" data-title="toothache">toothache1</anno>.

Back to the other side, Luo Wuyang ran madly. The rock golem didn’t know how to hide its tracks at all, so it naturally left behind extremely obvious clues, allowing him to track it all the way, and soon arrived in the wilderness.
He had been worried that his strength was inferior to the rock golem, so he might not be able to catch up to this big guy.
However, after only half a day, he discovered that the rock golem’s tall figure had appeared ahead of him.
Yi, it actually stopped.
Luo Wuyang was very curious. This idiot actually knew to stop?
’What? You’re tired, so you want to take a rest?’
However, his expression immediately became dark, because there was another person standing beside the rock golem.
Ling Han.
Realization dawned on him. Ling Han had absolutely no plans to sell the Source Spirit to him. Instead, he was using the Source Spirit to scam him of all his wealth.
This was too despicable!

"Han Lin!" He arrived in a single leap, his face filled with fury, "As fellow disciples of Great Emperors, you actually dare to bully me. Aren’t you afraid that I will make a complaint against you in front of the True Dragon Emperor?"
Ling Han spread his hands, "When have I bullied you?"
"This Source Spirit, you have already traded with me, and now you are taking it back. Wouldn’t that be bullying me?" Luo Wuyang asked coldly.
Ling Han smiled and said, "Brother Luo, you’re wrong to say that. I did trade it with you, but it came to find me on its own, so what does it have to do with me?"
"Alright, then I’ll bring it back now," Luo Wuyang said.
Ling Han spread his hands, "Whatever."
Luo Wuyang turned to the rock golem and said, "Come with me." He was afraid that the rock golem wouldn’t understand, so he used his divine sense to communicate.
However, the rock golem was completely unmoved, and ignored him completely.
Yi, he had still been able to understand just now, so why had he become stupid now?
How could he have known that when he shouted ’run’, he just happened to reach the limit of the rock golem’s patience, causing him to mistakenly think that he could control the rock golem.
Ling Han smiled, "Brother Luo, farewell."
He turned around to leave, and the rock golem immediately followed.
Luo Wuyang was furious. This was intolerable, this was really intolerable, acting shamelessly right in front of him.
"Han Lin, do you think I don’t dare to make a move on you?" he asked balefully. He was already truly angered.
"Come!" Ling Han crooked a finger at Luo Wuyang.
He was too arrogant.
Luo Wuyang shouted loudly, and charged towards Ling Han.
However, before Ling Han could even make a move, the rock golem had already appeared before Ling Han.
Zhi!
Luo Wuyang hurriedly stopped in his tracks. It wasn’t like he hadn’t exchanged blows with the rock golem before. He was completely outmatched!
However, just because he had stopped, it did not mean that the rock golem would stop as well. This blockhead leaped up high, and descended towards Luo Wuyang.
How could Luo Wuyang dare to face it head-on? He hurriedly fled in all directions.

Pseudo-Emperor against Pseudo-Emperor, even if there was a gap in terms of battle prowess, but if one side only cared about fleeing, then no matter how strong the other side was, it would still have difficulty catching up with the side that was running.
Thus, Luo Wuyang kept running, while the rock golem chased fiercely behind him.
"Han Lin, do you dare battle me?" Luo Wuyang was battered and exhausted, yet there was nothing he could do. He could only challenge Ling Han to a battle.
Ling Han chuckled, "Sure."
Though he said that, he had no intention of stopping the rock golem from making a move, and continued to watch the excitement.
"Han Lin, you—" Luo Wuyang was so furious that he almost threw up blood. Shameless, shameless, he had never seen such a shameless person.
Ling Han smiled, and said, "Big Rock, come back."
However, the rock golem was reckless, and after he issued a few commands, it finally stood still dumbly.
Its face was filled with confusion. Why did he stop it?
Meanwhile, Luo Wuyang’s killing intent soared. Humph, this person was really arrogant, but where did his confidence come from? A mere Saint actually dared to face him, a Pseudo-Emperor, head-on.
"You’re asking for your own suffering!" With a leap, he had already charged right in front of Ling Han, brandishing his fists in a rapid barrage.
Peng!
Ling Han also threw a punch, and exchanged a blow with Luo Wuyang.
What!

Luo Wuyang shockingly discovered that an indescribably powerful force was assailing him. It was not something that he could stand against at all. Instantly, his whole person was sent flying, and fell backwards.
Peng, he fell heavily onto the ground, feeling dizzy and blurred.
He was also a little confused. What was going on?
He was actually no match for a Saint?

Luo Wuyang got back to his feet, and rubbed his chest. If it was not for the fact that it still hurt so much that he wanted to throw up blood, he really could not believe that he had actually been sent flying by a Saint.
Could it be that it was the rock golem that had attacked just now?
"You, how do you have such strong strength?" he asked.
"A good-looking person’s luck would definitely not be too bad," Ling Han said with a smile. "The heavens view me in a different light, and that’s why I’m so strong."
Luo Wuyang naturally wouldn’t believe him. He stared at Ling Han and said with a frown, "You’re not a disciple of the True Dragon Emperor."

In the first level, the disciples of the Great Emperors were all Saints. At most, they would only be nine-star Saints, and it was definitely impossible that they would possess Pseudo-Emperor-level battle prowess.
Ling Han cracked a smile, "That’s right."
"Who exactly are you?" Luo Wuyang took a deep breath.
"Me?" Ling Han smiled, and said, "Ling Han, from the outside world."
"What!" Luo Wuyang paled in shock. People from the outside world could actually barge into this place?
Heavens, there were Great Emperors in charge of the first level. How had this guy managed to break through the blockade set up by the Great Emperors?
Though he was filled with doubts, Luo Wuyang still broke into a run and fled without the slightest hesitation.
He had to report this matter to the Kui Bull Emperor. An outsider with Pseudo-Emperor-level battle prowess had actually come to this place. This was a serious matter.

However, he had just moved, when he saw that Ling Han was already standing in front of him — previously, he had been sent flying with a punch from Ling Han, and Ling Han had already taken advantage of the opening to cut off his path of retreat.
He wanted to turn around and circle around him, but the rock golem roared and attacked him from behind.
At the same time, he had to face two beings with Pseudo-Emperor-level battle prowess, and each of them was stronger than him.
Luo Wuyang couldn’t help but break out in a cold sweat. Under such a pincer attack, how was he supposed to escape?

Saints were hard to kill, and Pseudo-Emperors were even even harder to kill, but it could not be helped that he had been too careless just now, actually falling into the condition of being under the pincer attack of two Pseudo-Emperors.
What could he do?
At this moment, he actually couldn’t think of any strategy.
However, since Ling Han had already made his identity clear, how could he possibly allow Luo Wuyang to return alive?
He and the rock golem attacked from the front and back, not giving Luo Wuyang any chance to escape.
Luo Wuyang also began to put his life on the line. He went all out, unleashing his Pseudo Emperor-level power. Every move and every strike possessed world-shaking might.
However, compared to Ling Han and the rock golem, his strength was far inferior. So what if he put his life on the line? He would still be thrashed.

Zhi!
Luo Wuyang hurriedly stopped in his tracks.
It wasn’t like he hadn’t exchanged blows with the rock golem before.
He was completely outmatched!
However, just because he had stopped, it did not mean that the rock golem would stop as well.
This blockhead leaped up high, and descended towards Luo Wuyang.
How could Luo Wuyang dare to face it head-on?
He hurriedly fled in all directions.

Pseudo-Emperor against Pseudo-Emperor, even if there was a gap in terms of battle prowess, but if one side only cared about fleeing, then no matter how strong the other side was, it would still have difficulty catching up with the side that was running.
Thus, Luo Wuyang kept running, while the rock golem chased fiercely behind him.
"Han Lin, do you dare battle me?" Luo Wuyang was battered and exhausted, yet there was nothing he could do.
He could only challenge Ling Han to a battle.
Ling Han chuckled, "Sure."
Though he said that, he had no intention of stopping the rock golem from making a move, and continued to watch the excitement.
"Han Lin, you—" Luo Wuyang was so furious that he almost threw up blood.
Shameless, shameless, he had never seen such a shameless person.
Ling Han smiled, and said, "Big Rock, come back."
However, the rock golem was reckless, and after he issued a few commands, it finally stood still dumbly.
Its face was filled with confusion.
Why did he stop it?
Meanwhile, Luo Wuyang’s killing intent soared.
Humph, this person was really arrogant, but where did his confidence come from?
A mere Saint actually dared to face him, a Pseudo-Emperor, head-on.
"You’re asking for your own suffering!" With a leap, he had already charged right in front of Ling Han, brandishing his fists in a rapid barrage.
Peng!
Ling Han also threw a punch, and exchanged a blow with Luo Wuyang.
What!
Luo Wuyang shockingly discovered that an indescribably powerful force was assailing him.
It was not something that he could stand against at all.
Instantly, his whole person was sent flying, and fell backwards.
Peng, he fell heavily onto the ground, feeling dizzy and blurred.
He was also a little confused.
What was going on?
He was actually no match for a Saint?
Luo Wuyang got back to his feet, and rubbed his chest.
If it was not for the fact that it still hurt so much that he wanted to throw up blood, he really could not believe that he had actually been sent flying by a Saint.
Could it be that it was the rock golem that had attacked just now?
"You, how do you have such strong strength?" he asked.
"A good-looking person’s luck would definitely not be too bad," Ling Han said with a smile.
"The heavens view me in a different light, and that’s why I’m so strong."
Luo Wuyang naturally wouldn’t believe him.
He stared at Ling Han and said with a frown, "You’re not a disciple of the True Dragon Emperor."
In the first level, the disciples of the Great Emperors were all Saints.
At most, they would only be nine-star Saints, and it was definitely impossible that they would possess Pseudo-Emperor-level battle prowess.
Ling Han cracked a smile, "That’s right."
"Who exactly are you?" Luo Wuyang took a deep breath.
"Me?" Ling Han smiled, and said, "Ling Han, from the outside world."
"What!" Luo Wuyang paled in shock.
People from the outside world could actually barge into this place?
Heavens, there were Great Emperors in charge of the first level.
How had this guy managed to break through the blockade set up by the Great Emperors?
Though he was filled with doubts, Luo Wuyang still broke into a run and fled without the slightest hesitation.
He had to report this matter to the Kui Bull Emperor.
An outsider with Pseudo-Emperor-level battle prowess had actually come to this place.
This was a serious matter.

However, he had just moved, when he saw that Ling Han was already standing in front of him — previously, he had been sent flying with a punch from Ling Han, and Ling Han had already taken advantage of the opening to cut off his path of retreat.
He wanted to turn around and circle around him, but the rock golem roared and attacked him from behind.
At the same time, he had to face two beings with Pseudo-Emperor-level battle prowess, and each of them was stronger than him.
Luo Wuyang couldn’t help but break out in a cold sweat.
Under such a pincer attack, how was he supposed to escape?

Saints were hard to kill, and Pseudo-Emperors were even even harder to kill, but it could not be helped that he had been too careless just now, actually falling into the condition of being under the pincer attack of two Pseudo-Emperors.
What could he do?
At this moment, he actually couldn’t think of any strategy.
However, since Ling Han had already made his identity clear, how could he possibly allow Luo Wuyang to return alive?
He and the rock golem attacked from the front and back, not giving Luo Wuyang any chance to escape.
Luo Wuyang also began to put his life on the line.
He went all out, unleashing his Pseudo Emperor-level power.
Every move and every strike possessed world-shaking might.
However, compared to Ling Han and the rock golem, his strength was far inferior.
So what if he put his life on the line?
He would still be thrashed.

chapters.title: Chapter 4796: Great Emperor catches up
paragraphs: Luo Wuyang tried his best to struggle, but the gap between their abilities was too wide, and he was completely unable to reverse the situation.

"As an outsider, you actually dare barge into this place. When the Great Emperors make their move, you will definitely die a tragic death!" he roared in fury. "Even if you are the strongest Pseudo-Emperor, so what? In the end, you will still be blasted into dust."
Ling Han smiled, "There is no need for you to worry about that!"
He threw a punch, and Destructive Energy surged, turning into a terrifying shockwave that shot towards Luo Wuyang.

Luo Wuyang was currently engaged in an intense battle with the rock golem, so he couldn’t concentrate on resisting at all. Moreover, he couldn’t sense how terrifying Destructive Energy was either. He turned around and tried to block this attack.
However, there was nothing that the Destructive Energy could not obliterate. As the attack surged past, Luo Wuyang screamed, and his entire arm was forcibly turned into nothing.
He was shocked. Although a Pseudo-Emperor could regrow severed limbs, that would expend life force and time, and he had no time to recover now.
What kind of energy was this? How could it be so terrifying?
Hong! Hong! Hong!
Ling Han launched Destructive Energy repeatedly, causing Luo Wuyang to suffer injuries repeatedly.

His battle prowess was inferior to Ling Han and the rock golem in the first place, and the gap was not just by a little bit either. He had been in a precarious situation all this while, and was teetering on the edge of life and death. How could he defend against Ling Han’s ultimate attack?
Under Ling Han’s mad barrage of attacks, Luo Wuyang was unable to block at all. Very soon, he was blasted into smithereens.
This was the third Pseudo-Emperor that had died at Ling Han’s hands.

However, Ling Han was astonished. A Pseudo-Emperor was capable of burning the Imperial Source. For example, Shi Gang didn’t hesitate to burn the Imperial Source at the most dangerous moment, even if it meant that he would fall from the position of Pseudo-Emperor or even die.
But now that things had come to this, could it be that he still had to keep it in reserve?

However, in the Primitive Abyss, both the Pseudo-Emperors that Ling Han killed didn’t burn the Imperial Source. It was the case for the True Dragon Emperor, and it was the same for Luo Wuyang as well.
Strange, looking at Luo Wuyang’s expression just now, he clearly knew that he was at the end of his rope, and was putting his life on the line. Why didn’t he burn the Imperial Source?
This was extremely abnormal.
Unless—
He did not have the Imperial Source!
Ling Han was suddenly shocked. That’s right, that must be the case.

The Imperial Source was the foundation of a Great Emperor, and also the basis for why a Great Emperor was a Great Emperor. However, these creatures that had suddenly appeared in the Primitive Abyss were extremely strange. It was as if everything had been planned out, and everyone was born for a certain level.
Was this still called cultivating?
It was just like... being created, and assigned to a specific location.

Thus, since they did not cultivate to that level by themselves, then it was understandable that a Pseudo-Emperor would not have Imperial Source, and why the True Dragon Emperor was inferior to the normal standard of Great Emperor.
There was no other reason, and that was because there was no Imperial Source.

As for why there was no Imperial Source but they possessed Emperor-level battle prowess, that could only be attributed to the strangeness of the Primitive Abyss Just look, weren’t rock golems, giant turtles, and so on born Pseudo-Emperors?
Furthermore, the core of the rock golem was an earthen-yellow crystal. How could this be Imperial Source?

Because he did not have the Imperial Source, even if he had the corresponding cultivation level, his battle prowess was inferior to those that had reached this level through hard work and cultivation.
Ling Han nodded, "Big Rock, we should leave."

Initially, he had wanted to keep a low profile, but with his personality, he could not. Furthermore, his persona would always mysteriously crumble. Now that he had killed Luo Wuyang, he could only begin to flee.
He was sure that very soon, a Great Emperor would move out, and search for his whereabouts, wanting to kill him.
However, Ling Han still found a place to refine the Genesis-level Celestial medicine that he had obtained first.

He had just experienced Silent Destruction not too long ago, so his body was extremely accommodating to Regulations. When Genesis Substance was completely absorbed into his body, the number of Regulations he could accommodate also reached as many as 86.
He was only a mere thirteen flashes away from the finishing line.

As long as, as long as there were a few more Genesis-level Celestial medicines, or something like the Pool of Genesis, he would be able to reach the limit of 99 flashes, allowing him to have the qualifications to break through to Pseudo-Emperor Tier.
"Continue searching."

Ling Han walked in this vast heaven and earth. Even if he had battle prowess on the level of Pseudo-Emperor, he still couldn’t walk very fast here. The gravity fields were too terrifying, and even a Great Emperor couldn’t ignore them, and stimulate his speed to the extreme.
On the way, Ling Han saw grotesque, bizarre scenes. A great many natural phenomena that were completely impossible appeared here, one after another, playing out endless fantastic scenes.
Weng!
Ling Han and the rock golem were still walking when they felt an incredibly powerful intent sweep over them. Under this intent, nothing could hide.
Not good, a Great Emperor had caught up!
Ling Han hurriedly used the Strange Shadow Steps and fled into the shadows. Then, he sent a mental message to the rock golem, "Stupid big guy, run!"
It was not the target of the Great Emperor’s attack. Thus, if it fled, the Great Emperor would definitely not waste time on it.
After all, he was still a Pseudo-Emperor. If he was determined to flee, it would definitely take a considerable amount of time for a Great Emperor to catch up to him.
However, he obviously overestimated the rock golem’s intelligence.
The rock golem was at a loss. Yi, why had Ling Han disappeared?
So strange!
This was so fun!
Are you here to play hide and seek with me?
It immediately went off to search for Ling Han, but it circled back and forth in this area, and did not leave.
Heavens!
Ling Han placed a hand on his forehead. What was he supposed to do?
Xiu, he had not even finished the thought, when he saw a massive Divine Beast fly down from the skies.

It looked a little like a bull, but there was a long single bull growing on its forehead. It was twisted like a curved blade, and there were spikes growing on its spine. They were extraordinarily thick like horns, and its whole body was mainly golden, with a hint of purple.
The Divine Beast... the Qiong Qi Emperor!
"Ang!" When the rock golem saw this, it immediately pounded its chest, and roared as it charged towards the Qiong Qi Emperor.
’Holy f*ck!’
Ling Han was rendered speechless. ’You’re not from the line of the Battle Saint, so why are you so stubborn? Can’t you see what level your opponent is? Yet, you’re charging over with a roar?’
It was rare that the line of the Battle Saint still had an inheritance, and the rock golem could only be seen here.
They had all died from recklessness.

At this moment, it was already too late for Ling Han to make a move. Qiong Qi Emperor waved a hand, and peng, the rock golem was immediately sent flying. Its massive body fell apart, revealing its core.

Qiong Qi Emperor followed up with another strike. Pa, that earthen-yellow crystal actually did not shatter, but there were also web-like cracks on it, and all of a sudden, the aura of life returned to silence.
The rock golem... died.
Someone as strong as a nine-star Pseudo-Emperor was actually killed in two moves?
Who asked it to be facing a Great Emperor?
In a head-on confrontation, a Pseudo-Emperor didn’t even dare to face the Imperial Weapon head-on, let alone the Great Emperor himself.
—Even if it was a Great Emperor that had a lot of issues.
Ling Han gritted his teeth, and forcibly suppressed the urge to appear.
If the rock golem was still alive, he would definitely jump out and take a gamble. He would activate the Imperial Weapon and leave with the rock golem.
But now, the rock golem was killed in a few moves, so even if he rushed out again, it would be useless.
Qiong Qi Emperor released his divine sense, and searched for Ling Han’s whereabouts.

Previously, he had already swept his gaze over Ling Han, but Ling Han was only a Pseudo-Emperor, after all. With such a great distance separating them, and after Ling Han had entered into the shadows, he naturally removed himself from being detected by his divine sense.
However, this brat would definitely not be able to escape too far.

chapters.title: Chapter 4797: Escape
paragraphs: Qiong Qi Emperor searched over and over again. However, the Strange Shadow Steps was a top-notch hiding technique in the world in the first place, and it was highly possible that it had been passed down from the Void Emperor. It was naturally very awesome.

Additionally, Ling Han himself also had Pseudo-Emperor-level battle prowess. It was impossible for him to match a Great Emperor, but if he only had to avoid being searched by a Great Emperor, there was still a great chance.
Moreover, there was also a huge problem with this Great Emperor.
In the end, Qiong Qi Emperor could only give up and leave.
In a certain corner, Ling Han was sitting cross-legged, and did not immediately appear.
Perhaps Qiong Qi Emperor had not gone too far, but had rather hidden himself in the shadows, and was merely luring him out.
—If a Pseudo-Emperor could fool a Great Emperor Pseudo-Emperor with his unique movement technique, then wouldn’t it be even easier for a Great Emperor to fool the senses of a Pseudo-Emperor?
He was sure that this must be a trap.
"Big Rock, I’ll definitely come back and take you away to see the outside world."
Ling Han thought to himself, and left with the Strange Shadow Steps.
After walking for a very far distance, he finally revealed himself.
Without becoming a Pseudo-Emperor, it was useless no matter how many Regulations he cultivated. He was completely unqualified to match a Great Emperor.

He gritted his teeth and clenched his fists. Although he hadn’t spent much time with the rock golem, the blockhead was simple and honest, and his thoughts were simple. He was basically a blank piece of paper, which had already made him develop a fondness for it.
How could he remain unmoved as he watched the rock golem being killed in front of his eyes?
He had to become stronger as soon as possible!
Ling Han didn’t want the same tragedy to happen to the empress, the large black dog, and the others.
He continued to advance, sensing the aura of Genesis Substance everywhere.
However, even in the Primitive Abyss, Genesis Substance was still extremely rare. After a few years, Ling Han still had zero gains.
This was not strange at all. Just look at Luo Wuyang, he had only managed to get a stalk of Genesis-level Celestial medicine after hundreds of thousands of years.
"Hmm?"
Ling Han was suddenly shocked. An incredibly powerful divine sense swept over, and then locked onto him.
Several years had passed, and he had finally been found by a Great Emperor again.
He immediately fled into the darkness, and in only an instant, a Divine Beast appeared.
It had the face of a human and the legs of a tiger. Its fur was extraordinarily long, and its tail was like a halberd.
Divine Beast, Taowu Emperor!
He was also unable to find Ling Han in the shadows, but he could confirm that Ling Han had not left this area yet.
"Brat, come out!" The Taowu Emperor shouted lightly. Weng, his voice reverberated, turning into a terrifying shockwave.
Pa! Pa! Pa!
On the desolate plain, countless rocks exploded one after another.
It should be known that every grain of sand here was as heavy as a star. With a shout from a Great Emperor, it actually caused countless rocks to explode. Just how strong was its might?
Peng, Ling Han was also blasted out.
Indeed, he had not fled too far, and had still been shaken by the soundwaves.
The moment he appeared, Ling Han immediately used Phoenix Wings Divine Flight and began to run madly.
"You think you can escape?" Taowu Emperor smirked coldly. With a single step, he had already caught up to Ling Han. With a sweep of his tail, he delivered a smack at Ling Han’s waist.
This whip of his tail was extraordinarily fast.
Even if Ling Han possessed the number one movement technique in the world, it was useless. There was no way he could dodge.
This was the attack of a Great Emperor!
However, this wasn’t Ling Han’s first time exchanging blows with a Great Emperor. He immediately activated the Clear Bamboo Sword, and slashed at Taowu Emperor.
Boom!

The Imperial Weapon and the Great Emperor clashed head-on, and a terrifying power rebounded back. Ling Han only felt a pain in the web between his thumb and index finger. The Imperial Weapon instantly flew out of his hand, and he couldn’t control it at all.
It didn’t matter. His divine sense was connected to the Imperial Weapon, and under his control, the Imperial Weapon shone brightly, protecting Ling Han.
Ling Han didn’t linger in battle at all. So what if he had an Imperial Weapon? Against a Great Emperor, he had no chance of winning at all. Staying in battle was merely courting death.

Moreover, the two great Emperors, Qiong Qi and Taowu, had already appeared. Who knows, even more Great Emperors would appear. If one more came, so what if he had the Imperial Weapon protecting him? It was guaranteed that he would die very quickly.
Just like how Luo Wuyang had previously been pincered by two beings stronger than himself, unable to escape, and could only fight to the death. Naturally, the only fate left was death.
He didn’t want to suffer the same fate, so he naturally fled.
In the Primitive Abyss, it was not impossible to escape from a Great Emperor.
The storm of heaven and earth!

This was something that even the Great Emperor would have to be wary of. Thus, as long as they encountered the storm of heaven and earth, he would have a chance to break free from the pursuit of the Great Emperor.
He fled, and Taowu Emperor chased after him.

Under normal circumstances, Ling Han wouldn’t be able to escape at all. He would be caught up repeatedly, and could only use the Clear Bamboo Sword to protect himself. However, under the terrifying shockwaves of power, even if he was a Pseudo-Emperor, so what? His whole body was covered with wounds.
If this continued, there would be no need for a second Great Emperor to appear. He would become severely injured due to the accumulation of injuries, and severe injuries would become fatal injuries.
However, it was at this moment that a second Great Emperor caught up to them.
Qiong Qi Emperor..
He charged over from the sidelines, and his aura as a Great Emperor was on full display. Merely this aura alone was enough to kill a Saint.
Ling Han’s heart shuddered. Once the two Great Emperors formed a pincer attack, he wouldn’t be able to escape even if he wanted to.
Shua, the wind suddenly blew.
Yi?
Ling Han saw that a sandstorm had appeared in the distance, and was rapidly sweeping towards him.
If it was another time, he would definitely turn around and run without another word when he saw this sandstorm.
But now, Ling Han looked overjoyed, and took the initiative to head towards the sandstorm.
"Humph!" The two Divine Beast Emperors both smirked coldly, and set off in hot pursuit.

The storms of heaven and earth were also divided into tiers. These sandstorms were not difficult for them, but they would greatly affect their vision and divine sense. Thus, if Ling Han really rushed in, it was possible that they would lose him.
Thus, they both launched their attacks. Two claws descended from the sky, and pressed down on Ling Han.

Ling Han unleashed his full strength. With a flap of his wings, xiu, his body suddenly sped up, and he actually charged out of the area that was enshrouded by the two claws in an inconceivable manner.
However, he also spat out a mouthful of blood, his face as pale as a sheet.
The acceleration just now was completely because he had channeled too much energy. It was too hurtful.
However, Ling Han didn’t stop at all, continuing to run forwards madly.
When the two Great Emperors attacked again, the sandstorm in front of them surged over at an astonishing speed, and Ling Han was already swept up in it.
At this moment, even the two Great Emperors were unable to determine Ling Han’s exact location.

Boom, the attack landed, and even the whole sandstorm slowed down for a moment, but there was no sign of Ling Han. Hu, the sandstorm continued to sweep by, and did not stop at all. Once again, it turned heaven and earth into a world of yellow sand.

The winds blew madly, and even the two Great Emperors had to put up a shield to resist. After all, every grain of sand was equivalent to a star, and with such a terrifying speed, just how terrifying would the destructive power be?
They advanced, searching for Ling Han’s whereabouts.
However, with how violent the sandstorm was, no matter what traces Ling Han left behind, they would still be blown clean. How could they catch up to him?
The two Great Emperors were also exasperated. They had moved personally, and a Saint had actually managed to escape.
No one would believe this even if they told them.

sentences.text: Qiong Qi Emperor searched over and over again.
However, the Strange Shadow Steps was a top-notch hiding technique in the world in the first place, and it was highly possible that it had been passed down from the Void Emperor.
It was naturally very awesome.
Additionally, Ling Han himself also had Pseudo-Emperor-level battle prowess.
It was impossible for him to match a Great Emperor, but if he only had to avoid being searched by a Great Emperor, there was still a great chance.
Moreover, there was also a huge problem with this Great Emperor.
In the end, Qiong Qi Emperor could only give up and leave.
In a certain corner, Ling Han was sitting cross-legged, and did not immediately appear.
Perhaps Qiong Qi Emperor had not gone too far, but had rather hidden himself in the shadows, and was merely luring him out.
—If a Pseudo-Emperor could fool a Great Emperor Pseudo-Emperor with his unique movement technique, then wouldn’t it be even easier for a Great Emperor to fool the senses of a Pseudo-Emperor?
He was sure that this must be a trap.
"Big Rock, I’ll definitely come back and take you away to see the outside world."
Ling Han thought to himself, and left with the Strange Shadow Steps.
After walking for a very far distance, he finally revealed himself.
Without becoming a Pseudo-Emperor, it was useless no matter how many Regulations he cultivated.
He was completely unqualified to match a Great Emperor.
He gritted his teeth and clenched his fists.
Although he hadn’t spent much time with the rock golem, the blockhead was simple and honest, and his thoughts were simple.
He was basically a blank piece of paper, which had already made him develop a fondness for it.
How could he remain unmoved as he watched the rock golem being killed in front of his eyes?
He had to become stronger as soon as possible!
Ling Han didn’t want the same tragedy to happen to the empress, the large black dog, and the others.
He continued to advance, sensing the aura of Genesis Substance everywhere.
However, even in the Primitive Abyss, Genesis Substance was still extremely rare.
After a few years, Ling Han still had zero gains.
This was not strange at all.
Just look at Luo Wuyang, he had only managed to get a stalk of Genesis-level Celestial medicine after hundreds of thousands of years.
"Hmm?"
Ling Han was suddenly shocked.
An incredibly powerful divine sense swept over, and then locked onto him.
Several years had passed, and he had finally been found by a Great Emperor again.
He immediately fled into the darkness, and in only an instant, a Divine Beast appeared.
It had the face of a human and the legs of a tiger.
Its fur was extraordinarily long, and its tail was like a halberd.
Divine Beast, Taowu Emperor!
He was also unable to find Ling Han in the shadows, but he could confirm that Ling Han had not left this area yet.
"Brat, come out!" The Taowu Emperor shouted lightly.
Weng, his voice reverberated, turning into a terrifying shockwave.
Pa!
Pa!
Pa!
On the desolate plain, countless rocks exploded one after another.
It should be known that every grain of sand here was as heavy as a star.
With a shout from a Great Emperor, it actually caused countless rocks to explode.
Just how strong was its might?
Peng, Ling Han was also blasted out.
Indeed, he had not fled too far, and had still been shaken by the soundwaves.
The moment he appeared, Ling Han immediately used Phoenix Wings Divine Flight and began to run madly.
"You think you can escape?" Taowu Emperor smirked coldly.
With a single step, he had already caught up to Ling Han.
With a sweep of his tail, he delivered a smack at Ling Han’s waist.
This whip of his tail was extraordinarily fast.
Even if Ling Han possessed the number one movement technique in the world, it was useless.
There was no way he could dodge.
This was the attack of a Great Emperor!
However, this wasn’t Ling Han’s first time exchanging blows with a Great Emperor.
He immediately activated the Clear Bamboo Sword, and slashed at Taowu Emperor.
Boom!
The Imperial Weapon and the Great Emperor clashed head-on, and a terrifying power rebounded back.
Ling Han only felt a pain in the web between his thumb and index finger.
The Imperial Weapon instantly flew out of his hand, and he couldn’t control it at all.
It didn’t matter.
His divine sense was connected to the Imperial Weapon, and under his control, the Imperial Weapon shone brightly, protecting Ling Han.
Ling Han didn’t linger in battle at all.
So what if he had an Imperial Weapon?
Against a Great Emperor, he had no chance of winning at all.
Staying in battle was merely courting death.
Moreover, the two great Emperors, Qiong Qi and Taowu, had already appeared.
Who knows, even more Great Emperors would appear.
If one more came, so what if he had the Imperial Weapon protecting him?
It was guaranteed that he would die very quickly.
Just like how Luo Wuyang had previously been pincered by two beings stronger than himself, unable to escape, and could only fight to the death.
Naturally, the only fate left was death.
He didn’t want to suffer the same fate, so he naturally fled.
In the Primitive Abyss, it was not impossible to escape from a Great Emperor.
The storm of heaven and earth!
This was something that even the Great Emperor would have to be wary of.
Thus, as long as they encountered the storm of heaven and earth, he would have a chance to break free from the pursuit of the Great Emperor.
He fled, and Taowu Emperor chased after him.
Under normal circumstances, Ling Han wouldn’t be able to escape at all.
He would be caught up repeatedly, and could only use the Clear Bamboo Sword to protect himself.
However, under the terrifying shockwaves of power, even if he was a Pseudo-Emperor, so what?
His whole body was covered with wounds.
If this continued, there would be no need for a second Great Emperor to appear.
He would become severely injured due to the accumulation of injuries, and severe injuries would become fatal injuries.
However, it was at this moment that a second Great Emperor caught up to them.
Qiong Qi Emperor..
He charged over from the sidelines, and his aura as a Great Emperor was on full display.
Merely this aura alone was enough to kill a Saint.
Ling Han’s heart shuddered.
Once the two Great Emperors formed a pincer attack, he wouldn’t be able to escape even if he wanted to.
Shua, the wind suddenly blew.
Yi?
Ling Han saw that a sandstorm had appeared in the distance, and was rapidly sweeping towards him.
If it was another time, he would definitely turn around and run without another word when he saw this sandstorm.
But now, Ling Han looked overjoyed, and took the initiative to head towards the sandstorm.
"Humph!" The two Divine Beast Emperors both smirked coldly, and set off in hot pursuit.
The storms of heaven and earth were also divided into tiers.
These sandstorms were not difficult for them, but they would greatly affect their vision and divine sense.
Thus, if Ling Han really rushed in, it was possible that they would lose him.
Thus, they both launched their attacks.
Two claws descended from the sky, and pressed down on Ling Han.
Ling Han unleashed his full strength.
With a flap of his wings, xiu, his body suddenly sped up, and he actually charged out of the area that was enshrouded by the two claws in an inconceivable manner.
However, he also spat out a mouthful of blood, his face as pale as a sheet.
The acceleration just now was completely because he had channeled too much energy.
It was too hurtful.
However, Ling Han didn’t stop at all, continuing to run forwards madly.
When the two Great Emperors attacked again, the sandstorm in front of them surged over at an astonishing speed, and Ling Han was already swept up in it.
At this moment, even the two Great Emperors were unable to determine Ling Han’s exact location.
Boom, the attack landed, and even the whole sandstorm slowed down for a moment, but there was no sign of Ling Han.
Hu, the sandstorm continued to sweep by, and did not stop at all.
Once again, it turned heaven and earth into a world of yellow sand.
The winds blew madly, and even the two Great Emperors had to put up a shield to resist.
After all, every grain of sand was equivalent to a star, and with such a terrifying speed, just how terrifying would the destructive power be?
They advanced, searching for Ling Han’s whereabouts.
However, with how violent the sandstorm was, no matter what traces Ling Han left behind, they would still be blown clean.
How could they catch up to him?
The two Great Emperors were also exasperated.
They had moved personally, and a Saint had actually managed to escape.
No one would believe this even if they told them.

chapters.title: Chapter 4798: Reviving the rock golem
paragraphs: Half a month later, Ling Han finally walked out of the sandstorm.
"Wa!" He spat out blood madly, his whole person already badly mangled.

In the last period of time, he had already expended all his power, and could only take the impact of the sandstorm head-on with his physical body. Even if his physique was tough, so what? He could not withstand this endless barrage of attacks.
If this continued for a few more days, Ling Han would probably be blasted to death by the sandstorm.
Thankfully, the heavens did not move to exterminate him.
Ling Han lay lifelessly on the ground.
After lying down for a few days, he finally woke up and channeled the Tenth Cultivation Technique to heal himself.
This healing process actually lasted for a whole seventeen years, and only then did Ling Han recover about fifty percent.
He left, and began to walk back.
He had sworn that he would take the core of the rock golem and leave. No matter what, he had to be buried on the Four Origin Planet.
However, the path of return was extraordinarily difficult. Occasionally, he would encounter the storms of heaven and earth, causing Ling Han to have no choice but to stop or retreat continuously.
After a whole 133 years, Ling Han finally arrived at the place where the rock golem had exploded.
However, it was also beneficial. After such a long time, his injuries had also completely recovered.

The Great Emperor naturally disdained from picking up a stone that had already been crippled. Thus, though so much time had passed, the crystal core of the rock golem was still lying there, entirely covered with a pattern of cracks, and had long since lost all signs of life.
Ling Han picked up this crystal core, and couldn’t help but sigh.
What an idiot.
He sat quietly for a while, and was just about to stand up and leave, when a thought suddenly occurred to him.
Could the rock golem be revived?
From a certain aspect, this was a little similar to a dead star.
Since he could revive planets, why couldn’t he revive the rock golem?
He could give it a try.
He gripped the crystal, and recalled how he had revived planets previously. Then, waves of power surged out, and entered into the crystal core.
There was no reaction; the inside of the crystal core had already shattered.
Ling Han didn’t expect to revive the rock golem instantaneously. He first repaired the inside of the crystal core, making it complete again.
In the blink of an eye, three years had passed.
Ling Han didn’t think that he was wasting time, because he discovered that he had developed a deeper understanding of the essence of life.
At this rate, he may be able to revive the dead.
"Come, come back to life!"
Ling Han shouted loudly. Boom, endless power surged into the crystal.
Weng, the surface of the crystal glowed, but immediately dimmed again.
Again!
Ling Han injected power into it again, filled with life and vitality.
Weng, the crystal lit up again, but it still dimmed again.
Again, again, again!
Ling Han continued to experiment, and the light that the crystal emitted lasted longer and longer. After a certain time, the light that it emitted finally stopped dimming.
Success?

Ling Han stood up and left. He found a forest of stone, then placed the crystal on top of the stones. Instantly, it was as if the stones in the surroundings had come to life, absorbing them one after another.
A rock golem appeared under Ling Han’s gaze.
"Ang?" The rock golem sent out a dazed wave of divine sense.
Why am I here? What happened?

"Yi?" Ling Han was also surprised. He discovered that his divine sense had actually developed a connection with the rock golem. This was a one-sided relationship, and he could influence, command, or even forcefully control this big guy.
When he revived the rock golem, it was inevitable that he would leave his mark on it, and with his mark, he would naturally be able to control the rock golem.
This was not Ling Han’s intention, but it was inevitable.
"Congratulations, you’ve come back to life," he said with a smile.
In any case, he treated the rock golem as a friend.
The rock golem rubbed its head against Ling Han’s arm, appearing very affectionate.
Thankfully, this was Ling Han. Otherwise, even if it rubbed against him lightly, it would still be Pseudo-Emperor-level, and that was enough to break the bones and shatter the flesh of a Saint.
"All right, let’s go."
Ling Han stood up, and the rock golem immediately stood up obediently. Now, this guy could finally be commanded.

The two of them continued onwards, searching for places that they had not set foot in before. Hopefully, they would have a burst of luck, and they would be able to find a Genesis-level Celestial medicine, or any Genesis Substance.
In the blink of an eye, more than seven hundred years had passed.
Ling Han did not gain anything, but the Divine Beast Emperors also seemed to think that he had died, and did not set out to look for him again.

"Sigh, idiot, who knows how long we’ll have to travel to get Genesis Substance." Ling Han sighed. Time passed quickly here, but he couldn’t sense Regulations. There were Regulations outside, but the flow of time was normal.
Thus, if Ling Han wanted to rapidly improve himself, he could only depend on Genesis Substance.
"Ang." The rock golem strode forwards. It was unknown whether it understood Ling Han’s sigh or not.

Ling Han sat on the shoulder of the rock golem. Travelling here was actually quite tiring, and the rock golem didn’t have a physical body, so it naturally wouldn’t feel tired. Thus, it was very good to act as a steed.
The higher he sat, the farther he could see.
’Hmm?’
Ling Han faltered. He had actually spotted a group of people ahead of him.
A group of people could actually be seen in this place?
With a thought from Ling Han, his appearance changed. Using his divine sense, he said, "Come, let’s go over there."
He only had to release his divine sense, and he would be able to accurately make the rock golem follow his commands. However, if it was just talking, the rock golem would still be dumb.
Peng! Peng! Peng!
The rock golem left in large strides, and raced towards the place that Ling Han had indicated.
Its speed was very fast, and with its astonishing weight, as it raced past, even the ground released a rumble, which caused a slight tremor.
Ahead of them, those people immediately turned to look.
The first thing they saw was naturally the rock golem, and they immediately revealed shocked expressions.
Source Spirit, and it was Pseudo-Emperor-level at that.
None of them were wearing Battle Armors, yet they could walk in the wilderness. From this, it could be determined that they were at least Pseudo-Emperor-level.
In truth, they were all disciples of Great Emperors in the second level.
They were all prepared for battle. The Source Spirits here did not have intelligence, and only knew to battle. Thus, this was an unavoidable hard battle.
Then, they saw Ling Han sitting on the rock golem’s shoulder.
"Luo Wuyang!"
They all exclaimed in shock. It was precisely because they knew each other that they were so shocked.
They hadn’t seen each other for tens of thousands of years, so how could this guy be so awesome, obtaining a Pseudo-Emperor as a servant?
This was practically enough to make anyone die of envy.
"Brother Luo!" A person approached, "Were you the one who subdued him?"
"Otherwise, would it be you?" Ling Han immediately retorted.
’Holy f*ck!’
That person was infuriated by Ling Han’s retort. How could you speak like that? Do we have a grudge?
His name was Zong Yuze, and he was a disciple of Qiong Qi Emperor.
"Could it be that you think you can look down on us just because you obtained a Pseudo-Emperor-level Source Spirit?" he said angrily.
"That’s right." Ling Han nodded, "Otherwise, why don’t you come and fight me?"
How could Zong Yuze tolerate this? He immediately shouted loudly, and charged towards Ling Han.
Peng, the rock golem moved, and smacked Zong Yuze forcefully into the ground.
Er...

chapters.title: Chapter 4799: Snowy Lotus Peak
paragraphs: Ling Han broke into a smile, "Does anyone else have any objections?"
The remaining seven people were all speechless.
’Holy f*ck! He’s far too vicious!’
It wasn’t like they didn’t know how sturdy the ground was, but the rock golem smacked Zong Yuze into the ground with a single palm strike; what kind of great power was that?
They could not afford to trifle with him.
The rock golem withdrew its palm, as if it had just swatted a fly to death, and appeared to be completely nonchalant.
And in the ground, Zong Yuze only managed to climb out after exerting some effort.
His clothes were torn and tattered. In the previous situation, he could only try his best to ensure that he would not be injured, so how could he still care about his clothes?
"Haha, we’re both disciples of Great Emperors, so let’s not ruin the peace." Ning Xuelin, a disciple of Bi Fang Emperor, stepped out to mediate the situation.
Ling Han naturally pretended to be so arrogant. In this way, everyone would keep their distance from him, and would not expose the fact that he was actually an imposter.
—Just how sensitive was a Pseudo-Emperor’s insight? If he spent all his time with these people, it was inevitable that he would be seen through.
For these disciples of the Great Emperors to suddenly gather together, there must be a great matter brewing.
Yi, could it be that there was also a Pool of Genesis here?
Ling Han thought expectantly. However, it was naturally impossible for him to ask, or he would immediately give himself away.
His expression was filled with pride, "Haven’t you rested enough? It’s time to set out!"
He didn’t say where they would be going. In any case, he wouldn’t lead the way.
Zong Yuze and the others were all furious. First, this guy came to strut around, and now, he was even commanding. He had really gone too far.
But there was nothing that could be done. The Source Spirit that he had subdued was a high-level Pseudo-Emperor. Its battle prowess was too terrifying.

Yang Deyu, a disciple of Zhu Jian Emperor, also spoke up to mediate the atmosphere, and said with a smile, "Brother Luo, I heard that you have disappeared for several hundred years. So it turns out that you have gone to subdue this Source Spirit?"

The Divine Beast Cities did not communicate with one another, and everyone was doing their own things. Only the Great Emperors would be exchanging information. Previously, they had all come out to hunt down Ling Han.
However, did the Great Emperors still need to report the situation to these disciples?
Thus, these people only thought that Luo Wuyang had gone somewhere to train, and had never thought that this person would actually be killed.
"Are you envious?" Ling Han looked towards Yang Deyu.
’Holy motherf*cker!’
Yang Deyu was also rendered speechless. Had this guy taken the wrong medicine? Why did he blast retorts back at everyone he came across?
"All right, let’s set out."

The others were also very displeased, but firstly, they were all disciples of the Great Emperors, so they couldn’t possibly start a fight over such a small matter, right? Secondly, if they really came to blows, they might not be a match for the rock golem.
There was a world of difference between a high-level Pseudo-Emperor and Two Star and Three Star Pseudo-Emperors like them.
Everyone set off, but Zong Yuze and the others had clearly distanced themselves from Ling Han, looking like they wanted to ignore him.
This was naturally Ling Han’s motive. He put on a haughty expression, and had the rock golem follow behind these eight people.
In this way, he would be able to find out what these people were scheming before he revealed his identity.
Tsk, tsk. This was the first time that his persona was so stable. He did not have to worry at all that it would collapse. This was great.
The group travelled in silence. The atmosphere had already been completely ruined by Ling Han, and no one was willing to speak.
After walking for a few months, the temperature suddenly dropped drastically.
Ahead of them, a mountain peak that looked like a lotus flower appeared. It was covered with snow, and looked like a snow lotus flower.

"We’ve finally arrived at the Snowy Lotus Peak," Zong Yuze said. He then immediately glanced at Ling Han. Along the way, Ling Han had taken delight in insulting others, and this had given him a psychological trauma.
This time, Ling Han ignored him. He was only observing this mountain peak.
It was too cold. Even if he hadn’t climbed the mountain yet, he still felt as if his blood was about to be frozen.
If they went up, they would definitely be turned into ice statues.
Were these people rushing to their deaths?
"The temperature is still rising. We did not miss the time," a woman said.
Out of the nine people, only two were female. One was her, Du Ziying, who was a disciple of Xiemu Emperor, and the other was An Tingmei, who was a disciple of Taowu Emperor.
The others nodded as well. With the sensitivity of their divine sense, they could naturally sense the slightest change in temperature.
The temperature was rising, so were these people waiting, conspiring for some treasure on the mountain peak?
Was it the Pool of Genesis?

Ling Han was a little excited. If he was given another Pool of Genesis at this time, he would definitely be able to rush up to the height of 99 Regulations. Then, with a few more years of accumulation, with how fast time flowed in the Primitive Abyss, at most a hundred years would have passed in the outside world, so how could it be that he would not be able to rush up to the height of Pseudo-Emperor by then?
They waited, and this wait lasted for as long as 12 years.

The time was indeed a little long, but there was nothing that could be done. There were too many unpredictable changes here. Any random storm of heaven and earth would be able to stop people for eight to ten years. Thus, it was naturally better to arrive earlier than to plan to arrive just in time.
"Let’s go."
Everyone continued to advance. At this time, though the temperature was still frighteningly low, it was already within the range that a Pseudo-Emperor could contend with.
Not long after, they began to climb the mountain.
This was extraordinarily dangerous.

The accumulated snow would not melt all year round, and after experiencing innumerable years of winds, it was already very firm. Furthermore, it was incredibly slippery. Furthermore, the gravity fields here were astonishingly powerful, so it was impossible for them to fly. They could only take one solid step at a time.
This caused the Pseudo-Emperors to slip and stumble here and there.

And it should be known that there were rocks everywhere in this place, and the edges of the rocks were covered with icicles, which were extraordinarily long and sharp. Ling Han had tried them out before. Even if it was a physique like the rock golem, a hole would still be created if it was pierced by the icicles.

Furthermore, there was also a strange poison in these ice pillars. If it was not for the fact that the rock golem’s body was only a suit of armor, and he could immediately dispose of that rock, it was possible that his whole body would be completely destroyed.
Thus, it was too dangerous to lose footing here. If his body was pierced by an icicle, he might die.
Everyone carefully and slowly climbed the mountain.
Only Ling Han was an exception. He had the rock golem, and the rock golem did not care. If he was damaged or scraped, he could just throw away the corresponding rock.
Previously, the rock golem had strengthened its body to the limit, absorbing a lot of rocks, so it could completely withstand this kind of expenditure.
If it had used up all the rocks?
When he returned to the stone forest and the desolate plains, he could simply absorb some more stones, and wouldn’t he be back to normal again?
Thus, Ling Han advanced all the way, his speed not too fast.
Zong Yuze and the others were all envious, but they all held back, and did not open their mouths to ask Ling Han to give them a ride, so that they would not seek their own humiliation.
However, after Ling Han walked for a while, the rock golem finally stopped.
After a long while, they finally caught up.
"You guys... do you want me to give you a lift?" Ling Han asked.
F***, you have finally found your conscience?
Everyone nodded. Walking here, one had to be very careful and tense. As time passed, even Pseudo-Emperors would be under great pressure, breaking out in a cold sweat.
Thus, it would be great if they could have an alternative means of transport.
"I’ll trade Genesis Substance for it," Ling Han said with a beaming smile.

sentences.text: Ling Han broke into a smile, "Does anyone else have any objections?"
The remaining seven people were all speechless.
’Holy f*ck!
He’s far too vicious!’
It wasn’t like they didn’t know how sturdy the ground was, but the rock golem smacked Zong Yuze into the ground with a single palm strike; what kind of great power was that?
They could not afford to trifle with him.
The rock golem withdrew its palm, as if it had just swatted a fly to death, and appeared to be completely nonchalant.
And in the ground, Zong Yuze only managed to climb out after exerting some effort.
His clothes were torn and tattered.
In the previous situation, he could only try his best to ensure that he would not be injured, so how could he still care about his clothes?
"Haha, we’re both disciples of Great Emperors, so let’s not ruin the peace." Ning Xuelin, a disciple of Bi Fang Emperor, stepped out to mediate the situation.
Ling Han naturally pretended to be so arrogant.
In this way, everyone would keep their distance from him, and would not expose the fact that he was actually an imposter.
—Just how sensitive was a Pseudo-Emperor’s insight?
If he spent all his time with these people, it was inevitable that he would be seen through.
For these disciples of the Great Emperors to suddenly gather together, there must be a great matter brewing.
Yi, could it be that there was also a Pool of Genesis here?
Ling Han thought expectantly.
However, it was naturally impossible for him to ask, or he would immediately give himself away.
His expression was filled with pride, "Haven’t you rested enough?
It’s time to set out!"
He didn’t say where they would be going.
In any case, he wouldn’t lead the way.
Zong Yuze and the others were all furious.
First, this guy came to strut around, and now, he was even commanding.
He had really gone too far.
But there was nothing that could be done.
The Source Spirit that he had subdued was a high-level Pseudo-Emperor.
Its battle prowess was too terrifying.
Yang Deyu, a disciple of Zhu Jian Emperor, also spoke up to mediate the atmosphere, and said with a smile, "Brother Luo, I heard that you have disappeared for several hundred years.
So it turns out that you have gone to subdue this Source Spirit?"
The Divine Beast Cities did not communicate with one another, and everyone was doing their own things.
Only the Great Emperors would be exchanging information.
Previously, they had all come out to hunt down Ling Han.
However, did the Great Emperors still need to report the situation to these disciples?
Thus, these people only thought that Luo Wuyang had gone somewhere to train, and had never thought that this person would actually be killed.
"Are you envious?" Ling Han looked towards Yang Deyu.
’Holy motherf*cker!’
Yang Deyu was also rendered speechless.
Had this guy taken the wrong medicine?
Why did he blast retorts back at everyone he came across?
"All right, let’s set out."
The others were also very displeased, but firstly, they were all disciples of the Great Emperors, so they couldn’t possibly start a fight over such a small matter, right?
Secondly, if they really came to blows, they might not be a match for the rock golem.
There was a world of difference between a high-level Pseudo-Emperor and Two Star and Three Star Pseudo-Emperors like them.
Everyone set off, but Zong Yuze and the others had clearly distanced themselves from Ling Han, looking like they wanted to ignore him.
This was naturally Ling Han’s motive.
He put on a haughty expression, and had the rock golem follow behind these eight people.
In this way, he would be able to find out what these people were scheming before he revealed his identity.
Tsk, tsk.
This was the first time that his persona was so stable.
He did not have to worry at all that it would collapse.
This was great.
The group travelled in silence.
The atmosphere had already been completely ruined by Ling Han, and no one was willing to speak.
After walking for a few months, the temperature suddenly dropped drastically.
Ahead of them, a mountain peak that looked like a lotus flower appeared.
It was covered with snow, and looked like a snow lotus flower.
"We’ve finally arrived at the Snowy Lotus Peak," Zong Yuze said.
He then immediately glanced at Ling Han.
Along the way, Ling Han had taken delight in insulting others, and this had given him a psychological trauma.
This time, Ling Han ignored him.
He was only observing this mountain peak.
It was too cold.
Even if he hadn’t climbed the mountain yet, he still felt as if his blood was about to be frozen.
If they went up, they would definitely be turned into ice statues.
Were these people rushing to their deaths?
"The temperature is still rising.
We did not miss the time," a woman said.
Out of the nine people, only two were female.
One was her, Du Ziying, who was a disciple of Xiemu Emperor, and the other was An Tingmei, who was a disciple of Taowu Emperor.
The others nodded as well.
With the sensitivity of their divine sense, they could naturally sense the slightest change in temperature.
The temperature was rising, so were these people waiting, conspiring for some treasure on the mountain peak?
Was it the Pool of Genesis?
Ling Han was a little excited.
If he was given another Pool of Genesis at this time, he would definitely be able to rush up to the height of 99 Regulations.

Then, with a few more years of accumulation, with how fast time flowed in the Primitive Abyss, at most a hundred years would have passed in the outside world, so how could it be that he would not be able to rush up to the height of Pseudo-Emperor by then?
They waited, and this wait lasted for as long as 12 years.
The time was indeed a little long, but there was nothing that could be done.
There were too many unpredictable changes here.
Any random storm of heaven and earth would be able to stop people for eight to ten years.
Thus, it was naturally better to arrive earlier than to plan to arrive just in time.
"Let’s go."
Everyone continued to advance.
At this time, though the temperature was still frighteningly low, it was already within the range that a Pseudo-Emperor could contend with.
Not long after, they began to climb the mountain.
This was extraordinarily dangerous.
The accumulated snow would not melt all year round, and after experiencing innumerable years of winds, it was already very firm.
Furthermore, it was incredibly slippery.
Furthermore, the gravity fields here were astonishingly powerful, so it was impossible for them to fly.
They could only take one solid step at a time.
This caused the Pseudo-Emperors to slip and stumble here and there.
And it should be known that there were rocks everywhere in this place, and the edges of the rocks were covered with icicles, which were extraordinarily long and sharp.
Ling Han had tried them out before.
Even if it was a physique like the rock golem, a hole would still be created if it was pierced by the icicles.

chapters.title: Chapter 4800: Cold Water of Death
paragraphs: The faces of Zong Yuze and the others instantly darkened.
They really could not think too highly of this guy.
Hiss, they had never felt that this person was so greedy before. Why had he changed so much in these tens of thousands of years?

Ling Han continued to patiently tempt them, "This place is very dangerous, and one could lose his life at the slightest provocation. No matter how precious worldly possessions are, can they compare to your life?"
The eight people were speechless. You are obviously just f****** greedy, so why do you still have to act so sanctimonious? Pei!
"Humph! Luo Wuyang, we’re all from the same side, so what you’re doing is far too uncourteous!"
"Even if we agree, do you think that we would bring such a treasure with us?"
Everyone rebuked.
True.
Ling Han felt extremely regretful. He had initially thought that he could earn a small profit, but in the end, it was all for naught.
Forget it.
"Then take it slow." He laughed, and gestured for the rock golem to continue climbing the mountain.
For the moment, he did not make a move. Firstly, he still did not know why these people had come, and if he killed them, there was nothing to be gained.
Additionally, though he and the rock golem were powerful, there were only two of them after all. It would be very difficult for them to capture and kill all eight Pseudo-Emperors.
Thus, he had to find a better opportunity.
The rock golem continued to advance. Although it could "ignore" the threats here, it couldn’t be too rash. Otherwise, it would grind away all the rocks on its body before it even reached the summit.
Even so, they were still much faster than Zong Yuze and the others.
Three days later, they reached the summit.
After all, this Snow Lotus Mountain wasn’t overwhelmingly tall. One could still see its summit with a single glance.
The summit was very flat, and there was a black pool.

What was strange was that even though this place was extremely cold, that if Pseudo-Emperors did not resist, even they would be frozen into a block of ice, the water in this pool still maintained a liquid state.
The black water, with a single glance, caused Ling Han to involuntarily shiver, as if a part of his body had suddenly died.
He had a feeling that if he touched this water, he would really die.
Was this the Water of Death?
Yi, could it be that what Zong Yuze and the others had come to find was not a treasure like the Pool of Genesis, but rather this liquid that was filled with an air of death?
"Big Rock, do you dare touch this thing?" Ling Han asked.
The rock golem hurriedly shook its head, sending a vague thought to Ling Han.

If its core came into contact with this liquid, it would immediately lose its life force, and if its arms came into contact with it, they would also immediately fall off its body, because they would lose vitality.
Thus, this thing was different from Destructive Energy.
Destructive Energy Energy directly turned objects into nothingness, vanishing completely, but this liquid was only death, absolute death. Even a Pseudo-Emperor couldn’t withstand it.
More importantly, what did Zong Yuze and the others want this liquid for?
—If their target was this thing.
With their strength, there was practically no one that could match them in this area. Could it be that they wanted to make a move on a Great Emperor?
That was impossible.
Yi?
A thought flashed in Ling Han’s head. Could it be that after collecting it, they would have to send it into the innermost depths?
There, the Great Emperor Wu Ya and the others were currently fighting against some powerful mysterious force. They were at a disadvantage, but at least, they could still hold on.

In order to turn the tables, the Great Emperor Wu Ya and the others gifted the Natural-born Gold Spirit, the Metal of Creation and so on. In fact, it was extremely likely that the predecessor of the Genesis World had also been gifted by the Great Emperor Wu Ya and the others. It was called the "Stone of Life."
But since the Great Emperor Wu Ya and the others could set up arrangements, why couldn’t that mysterious force do the same?
Did they just blindly oppose the Great Emperor Wu Ya and the others?
Hence, sending someone to retrieve this Water of Death, and then deal with the Great Emperor Wu Ya and the others?
Logically speaking, this made sense completely.
Ling Han broke into a grin. If that was really the case, then it was really fate that he had come across such a coincidence.
Since this was happening right before him, he would definitely not allow such a thing to happen.
Ling Han waited. This place was not bad, and it was just right to send Zong Yuze and the others on their way.
After waiting for another four days, Zong Yuze and the others finally climbed to the summit.
"You came up so early, and actually just sat there all this while?" Seeing Ling Han sit by the side of the pool, the eight people were about to go crazy.

At first, they had still been hoping that Ling Han would have long since retrieved the item. This would also save them some trouble, but after waiting for a long time for Ling Han to come down, they could only continue to climb the mountain as per their original plan.
But Ling Han... was actually sitting lazily by the side of the pool. This almost drove them mad with fury.
"That’s right." Ling Han nodded, and asked in reply, "What else would I do?"
Yi, why can you speak in such a self-righteous manner?
Zong Yuze and the others exchanged looks. Though it was rare for them to see each other, this Luo Wuyang had changed too much.
Had he been provoked in some way?
Even if they were beaten to death, they would never have imagined that this was not Luo Wuyang at all, and that this was another person, because this theory was too unrealistic.
In this area, there had never been any invasion from external enemies.
"Forget it, don’t waste your breath on him."
"Hurry up and withdraw the Cold Water of Death. Let’s quickly descend the mountain. Who knows when this place will return to being dead cold."
These people said, and then took out the vessels that could contain the liquid.
In truth, these were just a few stones that had been hollowed out.
Sigh!
Ling Han sighed. Before confirming it, he still had a sliver of hope. Actually, these guys had come to find Genesis Substance.
Yet now, he could not hold himself back.
Zong Yuze and the others had come to retrieve the liquid that could kill Pseudo-Emperors.
Cold Water of Death?
Fine then.
Ling Han stood up, then snapped his fingers.
The rock golem immediately became excited, releasing a howling wave of divine sense. Then, it charged towards Zong Yuze and the others.
"What is the meaning of this?" Zong Yuze and the others were both shocked and furious. They could not have imagined that the rock golem would make a move at this time.
"Luo Wuyang, hurry up and make it stop!"
Ling Han laughed loudly, and returned to his original appearance, "Apologies, I am not Luo Wuyang."
What!
Zong Yuze and the others were all shocked. How could this be? This person was actually an imposter.
No wonder!
Previously, this guy was always insulting others, making them so angry that they were about to throw up blood. As it turned out, he was not Luo Wuyang.
"Who are you?" the eight Pseudo-Emperors asked Ling Han, as they fought against the rock golem.
They were really too shocked. This was something that they would never have imagined, causing their heads to explode.
Ling Han shook his head, and said, "You people won’t know even if I tell you... Forget it. I’m the most powerful Saint of all eternity, Ling Han."
Strongest in all eternity?
Hehe, what big boasts you have.
Hold on.
"You’re a Saint?" Zong Yuze and the others all came to a realization.
Ling Han released the holy flame, and said with a smile, "True!"
Heavens!
Zong Yuze and the others were all shaken quite a bit, and the rock golem almost broke through their line of defense with a single move.
Was it really a Saint?
However, this wasn’t the city, so why could this guy walk freely without wearing a Battle Armor?
Could it be that he possessed Pseudo-Emperor-level battle prowess?
